In the BATTLE ARENA, we undertake
the Set KO Tourney.

All participants enter with a team of
three POKéMON.

The three POKéMON must be lined up in
the order in which they are to appear.

During battle, the POKéMON will appear
one at a time in the preset order.

remain out until the match is decided.

three turns, it goes to judging.

If you wish to interrupt your challenge,
please save the game.

If you don't save, you will not be able
to continue with your challenge.

If you pull off the feat of beating

we will present you with Battle Points.

texts.BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_Exp:
The Set KO Tourney has special rules,
unlike standard battles.

First, one battle lasts only
three turns.

If the outcome is not decided after
three turns, it goes to judging.

The REFEREE will choose the winner
based on how the POKéMON battled.

Also, a POKéMON cannot be switched out
until its battle's outcome is decided.

The first judging factor is “Mind.”
This factor evaluates how aggressive

the battlers were.

The judging is based on how often
the TRAINERS ordered the use of

offensive moves.

The second judging factor is “Skill.”
This factor evaluates how effectively

POKéMON moves were used.

If a move worked successfully,
the Skill rating goes up.

If a move failed, the Skill rating
is lowered.

If it was an offensive move, the Skill
rating goes up if the move was “super

effective” and goes down if it was

“not very effective.”

The Skill rating will not go up for
moves such as PROTECT and DETECT.

If the opponent used PROTECT or
DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to

hit with a move, its Skill rating will not

go down.

The third judging factor is “Body.”
This factor is based on how much HP

remained at the end of a battle.

The rating takes into account how much
HP a POKéMON had at the start of

battle, and what remained at the end.

In a Battle Swap event, you may use
only three POKéMON.

Whether you are renting or swapping,
your team may not have two or more

of the same POKéMON.

You may swap POKéMON only with
the TRAINER you have just defeated.

You may swap for only those POKéMON
used by the beaten TRAINER.

After every battle you win, you may
swap for one of your defeated

opponent's POKéMON.

You will not be able to swap POKéMON
with the seventh TRAINER in the event.

There are two key points to be aware
of when swapping POKéMON.

First, when swapping, you can't check
the stats of the POKéMON you are

about to receive.

Second, the POKéMON on your team
are lined up in sequence, depending on

the order in which you rented them.

This sequence remains unchanged
even when swaps are made.

In the Open Level, the rental POKéMON
and the opposing TRAINERS' POKéMON

are all Level 100.

texts.BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_Ex:
In the BATTLE PALACE, there are
several auditoriums for DOUBLE BATTLES

that are named DOUBLE BATTLE HALLS.

The DOUBLE BATTLES are conducted in
the usual way, except with one crucial

rule that must be obeyed.

TRAINERS are permitted only to switch
their POKéMON in and out.

TRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to
command their POKéMON.

The POKéMON are to behave according
to their nature and battle on their own.

You must put your trust in your
POKéMON and watch over them.

If you achieve the honor of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,

we will present you with Battle Points.

If you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.

If you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.

texts.BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_Ex:
Here, POKéMON are required to think
and battle by themselves.

Unlike in the wild, POKéMON that live
with people behave differently

depending on their nature.

Depending on its nature, a POKéMON
may prefer to attack no matter what.

Another POKéMON may prefer to protect
itself from any harm.

Yet another may enjoy vexing or
confounding its foes.

Due to its nature, a POKéMON
will have favorite moves that it is good

at using.

It may also dislike certain moves that
it has trouble using.

There are offensive moves that inflict
direct damage on the foe.

There are defensive moves that are
used to prepare for enemy attacks or

used to heal HP and so on.

There are also other somewhat-odd
moves that may enfeeble the foes with

stat problems including poison and 

paralysis.

POKéMON will consider using moves in
these three categories.

When not under command by its TRAINER,
a POKéMON may be unable to effectively

use certain moves.

A POKéMON is not good at using any
move that it dislikes.

If a POKéMON only knows moves that
do not match its nature, it will often

be unable to live up to its potential.

Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may
start using moves that don't match its

nature when it is in trouble.

If a POKéMON begins behaving oddly
in a pinch, watch it carefully.

Where the courage of TRAINERS
is put to the test!

Welcome to the BATTLE PYRAMID!

I am your guide to
the Battle Quest.
texts.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_E:
Have you the courage to embark on
the Battle Quest challenge?
texts.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_A: We await your challenge in the future!
texts.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_E:
The Battle Quest is a battling
event in which you must explore

the PYRAMID and try to reach the top.

In the PYRAMID are seven floors of
mazes, all of them filled with not only

skilled TRAINERS but also wild POKéMON.

You must enter with three POKéMON,
none of them holding an item.

On your ascent, you will be provided
with a BATTLE BAG for items.

If you fail in your challenge, any item
placed in the BATTLE BAG disappears.

If you want to interrupt your
challenge, you must select “REST”

and save the game.

If you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.
texts.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_W:
The PYRAMID offers two courses,
Level 50 and Open Level.

Which will you enter?

Welcome…

texts.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_H:
I see a shower of sparks…

…And in it, I see your POKéMON
struggling with paralysis…

I see poison…

…And, I see your POKéMON suffering
from the effects of poison…

I see bright red flames…

…And, I see your POKéMON suffering
from burns…

I sense the tremendous pressure of
unrequited anger…

It is a curse…

…And, I see your POKéMON drained of
Power Points and having no recourse

but to use STRUGGLE…

I see POKéMON loftily airborne…

…And, I see your POKéMON frustrated
by powerless GROUND-type moves…

I sense terrific energy rising from
the ground below…

…And, I see your POKéMON unable to
escape the power's clutches…

I see ICE-type POKéMON…

…And, I see your POKéMON fighting
the freezing effects of ice…

I see a flurry of moves that imperil
the user…

…And, I see your POKéMON falling
to them…

I see PSYCHIC-type POKéMON…

…And, I see your POKéMON in torment
from PSYCHIC moves…

I see ROCK-type POKéMON…

…And, I see your POKéMON suffering
from ROCK moves…

I see FIGHTING-type POKéMON…

…And, I see your POKéMON pummeled
by FIGHTING moves…

RAIN DANCE… SUNNY DAY…
SANDSTORM… HAIL…

I see POKéMON that become stronger
with the weather…

…And, I see your POKéMON confounded
by different types of moves…

I see BUG-type POKéMON…

…And, I see your POKéMON suffering
from different kinds of attacks…

I see DARK-type POKéMON…

…And, I see your POKéMON suffering
from DARK-type moves…

I see WATER-type POKéMON…

…And, I see your POKéMON suffering
from WATER-type moves…

I see GHOST-type POKéMON…

…And, I see your POKéMON suffering
from GHOST-type moves…

I see STEEL-type POKéMON…

…And, I see your POKéMON suffering
from enormously powerful moves…

I see flying POKéMON…

…And, I see your POKéMON suffering
from enormously powerful moves…

I see those that have evolved from
the power of stones…

I also sense fire, water,
and electricity…

…And, I see your POKéMON suffering
from those three powers…

I see NORMAL-type POKéMON…

…And, I see your POKéMON suffering
from enormously powerful moves…

Whether you believe my fortunes
or not, the choice is yours…

The future can be changed anytime…
I wish you safe passage…
texts.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_T:
Did you know?

If you run fast, TRAINERS may notice
and come after you for a battle.

So, if you want to avoid TRAINERS,
don't catch their eyes, but sneak

cautiously and quietly past them.
texts.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_L:
Awaaaaaaarrrrgh!

I had a whole lot of items, but I lost
them all when I lost!

Awaaaaaaarrrrgh!
texts.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_Y:
Welcome back!
You've done the unthinkable!

You've defeated the PYRAMID KING
and conquered the BATTLE PYRAMID!
texts.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_G:

In commendation of your courage,

we give you these Battle Point(s)!

texts.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_E:
When the PYRAMID is conquered,
the wild POKéMON that appear in it

are replaced by different kinds.

Explore, observe, and learn what kinds
of wild POKéMON you may encounter.

TRAINERS are lying in wait for you
inside the PYRAMID.

On each floor, there are up to
eight TRAINERS.

When you defeat a TRAINER, you will
get a helpful hint for your adventure.

The mazes in the PYRAMID rearrange
themselves every time you enter it.

The mazes are poorly lit.
You must advance with caution.

The light grows brighter whenever you
defeat a wild POKéMON or a TRAINER.

The BATTLE BAG serves as your BAG
while in the PYRAMID.

There are two separate BATTLE BAGS--
one each for the Level 50 and

Open Level adventures.

They each can hold up to 99 pieces
of ten kinds of items.

The contents of the BATTLE BAG are
lost if you fail in your quest.
texts.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_Rea:
It is a delight to see you here!
You have reached the summit of

the BATTLE PYRAMID!

Above here is the PYRAMID's
lookout point.

It is a place open only to those
who have conquered the PYRAMID.

Now, please!
Up you go!

Unfortunately, you were second by
a mere fraction of time!

Our chief has already conquered
the PYRAMID ahead of you.

However, my young explorer…
You are a TRAINER!

Assert your power and take the glory
of the pinnacle from our chief!

Now, please! When you are ready,
take one more step of courage!
texts.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_Exp:
Young adventurer…

Wouldn't you agree that explorations
are the grandest of adventures?

Your own wits!

Your own strength!

Your own POKéMON!

And, above all, only your own courage
to lead you through unknown worlds…

Aah, yes, indeed this life is grand!
Grand, it is! Eh?

I'm BRANDON!

I'm the PYRAMID KING, which means
I'm in charge here.

Most people call me the chief!

You coming here means you have
that much confidence in yourself,

am I right?

Hahahah!
This should be exciting!

Grand, yes, indeed!

Your FRONTIER PASS, please!

texts.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_Loo:
Young explorer!
I look forward to our next meeting!

Your love of adventure seems to come

Yes… You are exactly as I was in

… … …Ah…

The passionate!

The dangerous!

The desperate!

Those days of death-defying,
life-affirming adventures are back…
texts.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_MyC:
Now, then!

I sense my own courage is off

texts.BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_Eve:

I'm braced for it all!

Remarkable!

Yes, it's grand, indeed!

Young explorer!

You've bested me through and through!
Here! I want you to have this!

I have much to learn still!

May our paths cross again!

texts.BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Exp:
The BATTLE TOWER's MULTI BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting

MULTI BATTLES.

For MULTI BATTLES, you must partner
with a TRAINER in the TOWER and enter

with two POKéMON each.

Inside the TOWER is a room named
the BATTLE SALON where you may meet

other TRAINERS.

There, you must find a TRAINER to act
as your partner in MULTI BATTLES.

Once you have partnered up, you will
be shown to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM.

In the MULTI BATTLE ROOM, seven
tag teams await your challenge.

If you manage to defeat all seven
teams, you will earn Battle Points.

If you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.

If you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.

The BATTLE TOWER's MULTI BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting

MULTI BATTLES with a friend.

You must link with your friend using
Wireless Adapters or a Game Boy

Advance Game Link cable.

You must partner with your friend and
enter two different kinds of POKéMON.

There are many MULTI BATTLE ROOMS
in the BATTLE TOWER for team battles.

In a MULTI BATTLE ROOM, seven
tag teams await you and your friend

to make a tag-team challenge.

If you manage to defeat all seven
teams, you will earn Battle Points.

Please beware that unlike other ROOMS,
you may not interrupt your challenge.

Once you start, you must battle seven
MULTI BATTLES in a row nonstop.

texts.BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Exp:
The BATTLE TOWER is a facility where
four types of battles are waged--

SINGLE BATTLE, DOUBLE BATTLE, MULTI

BATTLE, and LINK MULTI BATTLE.

For each of these types, there are
separate BATTLE ROOMS.

Please speak with a guide offering
the type of battle you wish to enter.

Depending on the BATTLE ROOM you are
entering, you will be required to take

a certain number of POKéMON.

The SINGLE BATTLE mode requires
three POKéMON.

The DOUBLE BATTLE mode requires four,
and the MULTI modes both require two.

The BATTLE SALON is where you must
find a partner to form a tag team for

the MULTI BATTLE ROOM challenge.

Choose the best partner for you by
examining other TRAINERS'

POKéMON and their moves.

You may choose a new tag partner
after winning seven straight matches.

The LINK MULTI BATTLE Mode is for two
friends to mount a challenge together.

You and your friend must be linked with
Wireless Adapters or a GBA Game Link

cable.

You must choose two POKéMON at
the registration counter.

These POKéMON must be different
from those of your friend.

You may not interrupt this challenge
in the middle, unlike other modes.

texts.BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattle:

how DOUBLE BATTLES are played here

in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

Watch yourself in the battles here.

strategies they developed just for

DOUBLE BATTLES.

with DOUBLE BATTLES here, you should

think about challenging other places

texts.BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouLookTough:
…Huh?
You look to me like a tough TRAINER.

Heheh…
Listen, I have this proposition.

We have a little group going here,
and we play a little game with what

goes on in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

The rules are really simple.

First, we pick one of the facilities
in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

Then, we each pick a different TRAINER
who's taking that facility's challenge,

and bet with our Battle Points.

The guy who bet on the TRAINER with
the best record takes all the Battle

Points in the pool.

Sounds simple, huh?
So, anyway…

You couldn't tell it from looking now,

I had a reputation as the toughest
BEAUTY around, I tell you!

… … … … … …

What is it now?
You don't believe me.

I'm not like that blowhard woman over
there. I'm actually talented!

Let me prove it to you.
I can teach your POKéMON special and

yet cute moves.

But my lessons don't come free.
How about paying for the moves I teach

with a wee bit of Battle Points?

yet cute POKéMON moves?

I had a reputation as the most
invincible SWIMMER around, I tell you!

… … … … … …

What's wrong?
You don't believe me.

I'm not like that buffoonish woman over
there. I'm actually experienced!

I can prove it to you.
I can teach your POKéMON hard and

yet pretty moves.

But my lessons don't come free.
How about paying for the moves I teach

with a wee bit of Battle Points?
texts.BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorWe:
Ihihihi!

Have you come to learn hard and
yet pretty POKéMON moves?

each other, you probably think that

they don't get along.

But if that were true, they wouldn't
stay out here together, would they?
texts.BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereSt:
When I was just a wee YOUNGSTER,
those ladies were strong and beautiful.

They were idols among us TRAINERS.

Even now, age hasn't dulled their
abilities.

In fact, their POKéMON moves have
grown even more polished.

But… For some reason, I can't help
but feel this…

Time is so cruel…

half the user's
maximum HP.

identical to the

incredible power.

powerful kick with
intense force.

Strategy…

Luck…

Guts…

Spirit…

Bravery…

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePy:
This is the BATTLE PYRAMID!
Advance through the Battle Quest!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_RankingH:
BATTLE FRONTIER RANKING HALL
Set your sights on new records!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_Exchange:
BATTLE POINT EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER
Exchange your Battle Points!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTo:
Wow!
It's huge!

The BATTLE TOWER feels special.
It's different from the others.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerL:
My grand ambition is to conquer both
the BATTLE FRONTIER and the POKéMON

LEAGUE.

And if my dream comes true…

I… I'm going to ask MIMI next door
if she will be friends with me!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PyramidT:
The BATTLE PYRAMID's too harsh!
I just can't make it to the top!

Since I'm out of options, maybe I can
climb the outside…
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ThriveIn:
I thrive in darkness…
Yes… What is worthy of me?

None other than the BATTLE PYRAMID…

What say you to wandering in darkness
and in utter and total desperation?
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PutToget:
I didn't sleep for a week, but then
I put together the ultimate team!

I can't see myself losing, no joke.
We're storming the BATTLE ARENA!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScott:
Did SCOTT bring you here, too?
What is it with that guy?

It sounds like he really does know
how to spot talented TRAINERS, but…

I've never seen him battling in person
ever.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BelieveI:
ZIGG!
I believe in you, little buddy!

I'll make my little ZIGG any favorite
tasty treats you like if you win!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCa:
People call me a busybody,
but I can't help it.

Your hat's on crooked!
Oh, no, trash on the ground!

Oops, it's almost dinnertime!

I don't know if I can stand to just
watch at the BATTLE PALACE…
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceBeat:
I may not look that impressive now,
but I once beat a GYM LEADER.

Who knows, maybe I should give it
another shot at glory.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FastOnBi:
I'm fast on my BIKE, and that goes for
the way I battle, too.

I win matches in the blink of
an eye!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BetterTh:
I'm better than my daddy
at POKéMON.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GoRackUp:
Go on, my baby sweetie!
Go rack up some wins for Daddy!

You're just like your mother,
so you'll be dominating!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPre:
It wasn't easy getting here,
but I'd heard about this knockout

pretty girl at the BATTLE ARENA.

Instead of her, do you know what
I found?

A whole teeming mob of sweaty,
stinky, and primitive martial artists!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_Sometime:
I sometimes see this really important-
looking old man going in there.

He has these really awesome POKéMON.
He seems really nice, though.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOf:
Do you know it?
The legend of the BATTLE PYRAMID?

When there comes a confident TRAINER
reaching for the golden pinnacle,

there shall appear a man among men.

Don't know that legend?
Well, of course not!

I just made it up!

What's it supposed to mean?
That, my friend, I can't say!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWiped:
Man! Oh man!
I've never lost once before!

But I got wiped out with no saving
grace at all!

And then I'm told I don't have any
talent?! Man!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTra:
This guy ran into a horribly tough
TRAINER while he was on the BATTLE

TOWER challenge.

Now look at him…

You need to be cautious if you ever
decide to go to the BATTLE TOWER.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBa:
Yes!
I've finally got enough Battle Points!

I guess I'll trade for another giant
plush DOLL!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHa:
Oh, yeah, okay!
So this is the RANKING HALL!

I'd like to go down in history as
a super champ and have my name

recorded here for posterity.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_CanDoAny: With you by my side, I can do anything.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfO:
Ooh, darling, you are so wonderful!

Ooh, I just can't wait anymore!

Let's go to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM
right this instant!

If we get together in the BATTLE SALON,
the power of our love will overcome

everyone we meet.

Why, before us, darling, everything
will topple like dominoes!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_Frontier:
The BATTLE FRONTIER isn't exclusively
for tough TRAINERS.

Many people with special abilities
have been invited, it seems.

That man SCOTT…

He may have built this place to serve
a bigger objective…
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeH:
Excuse me, young one.
Have you good eyesight?

There is an odd tree past here, and to
my tired eyes it seems to wiggle.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceAnOd:
Excuse me, young one.
Have you a good memory?

I have this feeling there once was
an odd tree past here.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMo:
I…
I saw it!

There was a sticky sort of a POKéMON
with a long tail up ahead!

It was hiding under a boulder, and
it kept staring at me!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleDo:
This is the BATTLE DOME!
Your path to the invincible superstar!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleFa:
This is the BATTLE FACTORY!
Seek out the toughest POKéMON!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattlePi:
This is the BATTLE PIKE!
Choose one of three paths!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThisIsBa:
This is the BATTLE TOWER.

TRAINERS bring their best-raised
POKéMON for elimination-style matches.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MayISeeY:
Hello, are you here for the ferry?
May I see your TICKET?
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHave:
{PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…

I'm terribly sorry.

You must have a TICKET to board
the ferry.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWou:
{PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.

Perfect! That's all you need!

And where would you like to go?
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SailWith: Please sail with us another time!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_PleaseBo:
Please board the ferry and wait for
departure.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThenWher: Then, where would you like to go?
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BestOutO:
I'm the best out of all my friends.
But here…

I've been useless!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_CantFind:
I want to go to the BATTLE TOWER,
but I can't find it even though I have

a map of the BATTLE FRONTIER.

This place is just too big!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_GotSeasi:
I wanted to take a challenge as soon
as I arrived here.

But on the way, I got seasick…
Urrrrp…
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToug:
It's not as if just anyone can come
here, you know?

Only those TRAINERS who've been
recognized as tough are brought here.

That's why many TRAINERS don't even
know about the BATTLE FRONTIER.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SureWeCa:
Hey, bro…

Are you sure we can make challenges
even if we don't have any POKéMON?
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySa:
Uh…
I'm sure it'll be okay.

I think…

But remember that big scary guy?
He said, “I'll lend you POKéMON!”
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhosRais:
That's the BATTLE FACTORY.
You can rent strong POKéMON there.

But it makes me wonder.
Who's raising those rental POKéMON?
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ScaredOf:
I'm scared of going into the BATTLE
PIKE because of SEVIPER…

B-but I came all the way here, so I will
try to conquer everything!

…Shudder…
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LetsPlay:
Let's play rock, paper, scissors!
One, two, three!

… … … … … …
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WonIllTa:
Yay! I won!
I will take the BATTLE PIKE challenge!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LostIllP:
Oh, no…
I lost.

I guess I'm not very lucky today.
I'll put off my BATTLE PIKE challenge

until tomorrow.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ChooseFi:
I believe I'm the only person here who,
for some unknown reason, would choose

fishing over battling.

Huh? You can't catch anything here?
That's disappointing…
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_KeepBatt:
Today, I'm going to keep battling, no
matter what, until I get a Symbol.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_YoureOff:
Oh? You're off to challenge
the BATTLE DOME?

I'll wish you the best of luck.
Let us both win our way up and meet

in challenges.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeIsHe:
Grandpa, over here!
The BATTLE DOME is here!

Go get 'em, Grandpa!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WontLetG:
Ah, so this here is the BATTLE DOME?
I won't let GENTLEMEN beat me!

But where is the entrance?
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_NothingH:
There used to be nothing here not all
that long ago.

But, now look at this place! Amazing!
I'll bring my mother out to see this.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FinallyA:
I've finally arrived at the BATTLE
FRONTIER!

I'm sure to grab attention with
my looks and ability!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFi:
Munch, munch…

It looks like this square's filled with
tough people.

Munch, munch…
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlder:
Crunch, munch…

A while back, I met this older girl
at the BATTLE PIKE.

She had these eyes that were scary
in a real ornery way.

Crunch, munch…

She got all furious: “Will you quit
eating!” Then she whaled on me.

It was a hair-raising kind of
scary experience, sure enough.

Crunch, munch…
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LastTime:
Huh? Will you listen to yourself?
That's nothing!

Why, the last time I cheered for him,
our eyes met and sparks flew!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceL:
Whaaaaaat?!
Pfft!

That only happened because
I happened to be sitting next to you!

The DOME ACE only looked our way
because my cheering was so loud!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceI:
Oh, shush!
Keep that racket down!

You fair-weather fans should stick
to cheering for some GYM LEADER!

The DOME ACE is mine!
The only idol for me!
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOver:
Those people squabbling over there…

It's hard to believe, but they once
were TRAINERS, and good ones, too.

They used to be incredibly tough,
and they were famous, too.

But they were obliterated by this
certain TRAINER at a tournament.

They were so thoroughly whipped,
they became smitten by the TRAINER.

Now they're just fans of the TRAINER.
They go cheer for their idol at the

BATTLE DOME every day now.
texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithL:
I heard a rumor that someone saw
a POKéMON with an unusually long tail

somewhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

It must be adorable. I'm sure of it…

Oh, challenges can wait. I feel driven
to find the delightful creature!
texts.BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Nev:
There was someone here using a 
POKéMON I've never seen before.

I never learned about it at
TRAINER'S SCHOOL at least.

I wonder where you can catch POKéMON
like that.
texts.BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Nex:
Okay! Next stop, the BATTLE ARENA!
I'd better get the right POKéMON from

the PC Storage System.
texts.BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Goi:
Giggle… I'm going to go through every
challenge with just this baby!
texts.BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_ExplainR:
This is the RANKING HALL.

This is where we recognize the immortal
TRAINERS who left great records in

BATTLE FRONTIER events.
texts.BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_DomePike:
BATTLE DOME, BATTLE PIKE,
and BATTLE FACTORY Records
texts.BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_PalaceAr:
BATTLE PALACE, BATTLE ARENA,
and BATTLE PYRAMID Records
texts.BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_IsYourNa: Hi, is your name on this list?
texts.BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WowThats:
Wow, that's super!
I'll have to try harder, too!
texts.BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WorkHard:
Oh, is that right?

If you saw your friend's name up here,
I bet it would make you work harder!
texts.BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_MyNamesN:
Hmm…
My name's not up there…

Well, it's only natural since I haven't
taken any challenges yet.
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_FirstT:
Is it your first time here?
Please step this way!
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Welcom:
The front lines of POKéMON battling!
Welcome to the BATTLE FRONTIER!
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IssueF:
For a first-time visitor, we issue
the FRONTIER PASS.

It's for use at all the facilities
in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

Here you are!
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Placed:
{PLAYER} placed the TRAINER CARD
in the FRONTIER PASS.
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_EnjoyB:
We hope you enjoy all that the BATTLE
FRONTIER has to offer!
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IfItIs:
???: Well, if it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You came out here!
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OhMrSc:
GUIDE: Oh! MR. SCOTT, sir!
Good day to you, sir!
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ScottG:
SCOTT: It's great to see you here,
it really is!

I hope you'll take your time and
explore everywhere.

Naturally, I hope you'll also experience
the pure essence of battling.

I also have my quarters here, so feel
free to visit if you have time.
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGu:
I'm your guide to the various facilities
here in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnA: Which would you like to learn about?
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Battle:
It is the gigantic tower considered
to be the BATTLE FRONTIER's symbol.

There are four kinds of BATTLE ROOMS
in the tower for SINGLE, DOUBLE, MULTI,

and LINK MULTI BATTLES.

The BATTLE DOME is the large building
shaped like a huge egg.

Events named Battle Tourneys are held
in this facility.

The Battle Tourneys are offered in
two courses--for SINGLE and DOUBLE

BATTLES.

The BATTLE PALACE is the red building
on the right of the BATTLE FRONTIER.

There are two kinds of BATTLE HALLS
for SINGLE and DOUBLE BATTLES.

The BATTLE ARENA is the dojo-like
building at the center-right of

the BATTLE FRONTIER.

An event called the Set KO Tourney
takes place at the BATTLE ARENA.

The BATTLE FACTORY is the large
building that is the closest to us.

An event called the Battle Swap
is conducted there.

The Battle Swap event is offered in
two courses for SINGLE and DOUBLE

BATTLES.

The BATTLE PIKE is the building shaped
like a POKéMON at the center-left of

the BATTLE FRONTIER.

An event called the Battle Choice
is conducted there.

The BATTLE PYRAMID is the enormous
pyramid.

An event called the Battle Quest
is conducted there.
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Rankin:
The RANKING HALL is located near
the BATTLE TOWER.

There, you may see the most fantastic
records left by the TRAINERS that

took on the many challenges of

the BATTLE FRONTIER.
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Exchan:
The EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER is near
the BATTLE TOWER.

The Battle Points you have earned in
the BATTLE FRONTIER may be exchanged

for fabulous prizes there.
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGu:
I'm your guide to the basic rules that
are common to all the challenges

offered by the facilities in the BATTLE

FRONTIER.
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnA: What would you like to learn about?
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LevelM:
All the challenges at the BATTLE
FRONTIER's facilities come in

two courses--Level 50 and Open Level.
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level5:
The Level 50 course is open to POKéMON
up to and including Level 50.

Please keep in mind, however, that
no TRAINER you face will have any

POKéMON below Level 50.

This course is the entry level for
battles at the BATTLE FRONTIER.

To begin, we hope you will challenge
this course.
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OpenLe:
The Open Level course places no limit
on the levels of POKéMON entering

challenges.

The levels of your opponents will
be adjusted to match the levels of

your POKéMON.

However, no TRAINER you face will
have any POKéMON below Level 60.
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEnt:
Virtually any kind of POKéMON may take
on the challenges at all facilities.

EGGS and certain kinds of POKéMON,
however, are not permitted.

The numbers of POKéMON required for
challenges will depend on the facility.

At all facilities, however, two or more
of the same kind of POKéMON are not

permitted.
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_HoldIt:
When entering a challenge at a BATTLE
FRONTIER facility, POKéMON may not

be holding the same kind of item.

Please make sure that all POKéMON
entering a challenge are holding

different items.
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGu: I'm your guide to the FRONTIER PASS.
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnA: Which would you like to learn about?
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Symbol:
There are seven facilities at
the BATTLE FRONTIER.

TRAINERS who gain recognition for
their abilities may be rewarded with

symbols from each of the facilities.

To earn a symbol, TRAINERS may need
to defeat other TRAINERS in a row,

and may need to win events repeatedly.

It's certainly not easy to win symbols.
I wish you the best of luck!
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Record:
It is possible to record one battle
on your FRONTIER PASS.

You may record a battle you had with
a friend or friends.

Or you may record a battle conducted
at the BATTLE FRONTIER excluding

matches at the BATTLE PIKE or

the BATTLE PYRAMID.

You may choose to record your match
at the end of a battle.
texts.BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Battle:
Battle Points are rewards given to
TRAINERS who battled outstandingly

at the BATTLE FRONTIER.

You may trade in your Battle Points
for prizes at the EXCHANGE SERVICE

CORNER.
texts.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WelcomeT:
SCOTT: Well, hello and welcome!
Heheh… Sorry about the cramped space.

Anyway, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let me formally
welcome you to the BATTLE FRONTIER.

This is my dream come true.
It took me years and years, but I've

finally given shape to my dream.
texts.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HowMuchE:
On reflection, it was a terribly long
journey…

I left home alone on a quest to find
strong TRAINERS.

No one can imagine how much effort
or time it took to make this real.
texts.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveThis:
But that's all in the past.
No point dwelling on that!

All I want for you is to enjoy battling
to your heart's content here.

{PLAYER}{KUN}, I want you to have this
as a memento for all the time our

paths crossed on our journeys.
texts.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExplainB:
SCOTT: You can check your Battle
Points on your FRONTIER PASS.

The more success you have here at
the BATTLE FRONTIER, the more Battle

Points you will collect.

Use your Battle Points the way you
see fit, like trading them for items.
texts.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Expectin: I'm expecting great things from you!
texts.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSe:
SCOTT: Every TRAINER is an individual.
They all lead lives of their own.

But when they're in a battle,
it doesn't matter who they are.

They're all the same!

I love the purity of battle,
where everyone is equal.

That's why I go everywhere seeking
TRAINERS who are serious about

battling, and invite them here.
texts.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveYouM:
SCOTT: Have you met any of
the FRONTIER BRAINS?

Better yet, have you obtained any
symbols from them?

I handpicked the FRONTIER BRAINS
as the toughest TRAINERS anywhere.

But I'm sure that seeing how tough
you are will startle even them!
texts.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindW:
SCOTT: You don't just train for battle,
right?

I think I remember you working on
a POKéDEX as well.

Well, guess what?

You may run into wild POKéMON in
the BATTLE FRONTIER somewhere…

Fufufu!
texts.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCol:
SCOTT: Are you enjoying things in
the BATTLE FRONTIER?

…Wait a second…
Oh!

Your FRONTIER PASS!
You've collected the full set

of silver symbols!

That's more than impressive!
You are tough, just as I suspected!

Normally, I wouldn't do something
like this, but this is a special time!

I want you to have this.
I'm sure you can put it to proper use.

SCOTT: I hope you're enjoying
everything in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

…Wait a second…
Oh, my disbelieving eyes!

Your FRONTIER PASS!
You've gathered up the full set

of gold symbols!

That's more than stupendous!
You're incredible, just as I suspected!

… … … … … …

{PLAYER}, you've got to accept this!

I think you will be able to
appreciate the value of my gift!
texts.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_SoGladIB:
I must say I have the gift of knowing
a good TRAINER when I see one.

I'm so glad I had the foresight to
bring you here!
texts.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_BerryPoc:
Your BERRY POCKET seems to
be stuffed.
texts.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat50Tr:
SCOTT: Oh, I heard about you!
How you ruled the BATTLE TOWER!

You beat over 50 TRAINERS in a row?

That's fantastic!
I want you to have this!
texts.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat100T:
SCOTT: Oh, my! I heard about you!
How you overwhelmed the BATTLE TOWER!

You beat over 100 TRAINERS in a row?

That's ridiculously spectacular!
You've got to have this!
texts.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Expectin:
I'll be expecting to hear even greater
things about you now!
texts.BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ComeBack:
Oops, well, if you have too much
stuff, come back for this later.
texts.CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory:
Ah, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}?
I've heard tales of your exploits.

My name is WALLACE.

I was once the GYM LEADER of
SOOTOPOLIS, but something came up.

So now, I've entrusted my mentor JUAN
with the GYM's operation.

… … … … … …
… … … … … …

GROUDON and KYOGRE, the two POKéMON
wreaking havoc here, are considered

to be super-ancient POKéMON.

But there aren't just two super-
ancient POKéMON.

There is one more somewhere.

Somewhere, there is a super-
ancient POKéMON named RAYQUAZA.

It's said that it was RAYQUAZA that
becalmed the two combatants in

the distant past.

But even I have no clue as to
RAYQUAZA's whereabouts…
texts.CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WhereIsRayquaza:
WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, do you perhaps
know where RAYQUAZA is now?

If you do, please tell me.
texts.CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_ButWereInCaveOfOri:
WALLACE: The CAVE OF ORIGIN?

But that's right here!
I need you to do better than that!

Please, I need you to think about
where RAYQUAZA might be right now.
texts.CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentio:
WALLACE: MT. PYRE?

But when I met the old lady there
earlier, she made no mention of it.

I very much doubt that the old lady
would try to hide something from me…

{PLAYER}{KUN}, could you think about this
more carefully for me?
texts.CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_CantYouRememberSom:
WALLACE: Huh? You don't remember?
Hmm… That's a problem…

Can't you remember somehow?
texts.CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WellHeadToSkyPilla:
WALLACE: The SKY PILLAR?

That's it!
It must be the SKY PILLAR!

{PLAYER}{KUN}, there's not a moment to lose!
We'll head to the SKY PILLAR right away!
texts.DewfordTown_Text_TinyIslandCommunity:
DEWFORD is a tiny island community.
If something gets trendy here,

everyone picks up on it right away.
texts.DewfordTown_Text_TownSign:
DEWFORD TOWN
“A tiny island in the blue sea.”
texts.DewfordTown_Text_GymSign:
DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM
LEADER: BRAWLY

“A big wave in fighting!”
texts.Route104_Text_LandedInDewfordDeliverLett:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
We've hit land in DEWFORD.

I suppose you're off to deliver that
LETTER to, who was it now, STEVEN!
texts.DewfordTown_Text_SetSailBackToPetalburg:
MR. BRINEY: Have you delivered your
LETTER?

Or were you meaning to sail back to
PETALBURG?
texts.DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSai:
MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG it is, then!

Anchors aweigh!
PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!
texts.DewfordTown_Text_GoDeliverIllBeWaiting:
MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver
the LETTER. I'll be waiting.
texts.DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInDewford:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
We've hit land in DEWFORD!

You just go on and tell me whenever
you want to set sail again!
texts.DewfordTown_Text_WhereAreWeBound:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
For you, I'll go out to sea anytime!

Now, my friend, where are we bound?
texts.DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSai:
MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG, is it?

Anchors aweigh!
PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!
texts.DewfordTown_Text_SlateportWereSettingSai:
MR. BRINEY: SLATEPORT, is it?

Anchors aweigh!
PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!
texts.DewfordTown_Text_JustTellMeWhenYouNeedTo:
MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever
you need to set sail again!
texts.DewfordTown_Text_GettingItchToFish:
This is a renowned fishing spot.
Are you getting the itch to fish?
texts.DewfordTown_Text_GiveYouOneOfMyRods:
I hear you, and I like what
you're saying!

I'll give you one of my fishing RODS.
texts.DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice:
And, as an added bonus, I'll even throw
in a little fishing advice!

First, you want to face the water,
then use the ROD.

Focus your mind…
If you get a bite, pull on the ROD.

Sometimes you can snag something
immediately, but with bigger catches,

you need to time the pulls on your ROD

to haul them in.
texts.DewfordTown_Text_ThatsTooBadThen:
Oh, is that so?
That's too bad, then.
texts.DewfordTown_Text_GreatHaulInSomeBigOnes:
Is that right! That's great!
Haul in some big ones!
texts.DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice:
Oh, hey, don't get down on yourself!
I'll give you a little fishing advice.

First, you want to face the water,
then use the ROD.

Focus your mind…
If you get a bite, pull the ROD.

Sometimes you can snag something
immediately, but with bigger catches,

you need to time the pulls on your ROD

to haul them in.
texts.DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningT:
I like what's hip, happening, and trendy.
I'm always checking it out.

Listen, have you heard about this new
“{STR_VAR_1}”?

That's right!
Of course you know!

I mean, sheesh,
“{STR_VAR_1}”…

It's the hottest thing in cool!

Wherever you're from,
“{STR_VAR_1}”

is the biggest happening thing, right?
texts.DewfordTown_Text_TellMeWhatsNewAndIn:
Hunh?
It's not the hip and happening thing?

Well, hey, you have to tell me,
what's new and what's “in”?
texts.DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat:
Hunh?
“{STR_VAR_2}”?

… …

…Uh… Yeah! That's right!
Yeah, I knew that! Knew it all along!

Of course I know about that!
“{STR_VAR_2},” right?

Yeah, that's it, it's there!
Isn't “{STR_VAR_2}”

the coolest, or what?

It's the hippest thing in hip.
You think I'd not know about it?

“{STR_VAR_1}”…
It's, like, so five minutes ago.

Now, “{STR_VAR_2}” is
what's vital and in tune with the times!
texts.DewfordTown_Text_XHuhIThinkYIsCool:
Hmm…
“{STR_VAR_2},” huh?

But personally, I think
“{STR_VAR_1}”

is what's real in cool.
texts.DewfordTown_Text_HearOfAnyTrendsComeShar:
Well, if you hear of any happening new
trends, come share them with me, okay?
texts.DewfordTown_Text_YeahDefinitionOfInRight:
Yeah, absolutely right!

“{STR_VAR_1}” is the
definition of “in” right now.
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?

DEWFORD's GYM LEADER BRAWLY commands
FIGHTING-type POKéMON.

Going against him with NORMAL-type
POKéMON is asking for trouble.

FIGHTING POKéMON will lay a serious
smack down on NORMAL POKéMON,

so be careful!

What's worse, the GYM is as dark as
the ocean floor.

But it will get brighter after defeating
the TRAINERS in your way.

Hey, okay, go for it!
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory:
Whoah! It's turned too bright in here!

Your future is bright, too!
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoPostBattle:
Your skill overcame my strength!
Your technique is commendable!
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynIntro:
There's no need for BRAWLY to be
involved!

I'll crush you!
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynDefeat:
But… How?
How could I lose so easily?
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle:
I'm not going to waste this loss.
I'll use it to motivate me to train!

One day I'll become a GYM LEADER…

No, I'll become the POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION!
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraIntro:
Don't you dare brush me off!
It's not my fault if you cry!
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraPostBattle:
I battle in the dark to make my heart
stronger.

But because it's so dark, I can never
see BRAWLY's face…
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithIntro:
Ufufu…
Are you stumbling around in the dark?
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithDefeat:
Oh, you…
I don't want to know you!
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithPostBattle:
You deserve to stay lost and end up
back at the entrance again!
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenIntro:
I'll show you the gumption of
a sailing man!
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenDefeat:
How'd this happen?
It's not like me to lose this way!
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenPostBattle:
Oh, aye! You're worthy of seeing
our GYM LEADER.
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianIntro:
If you mean to pass, it has to be
through me!
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianPostBattle:
You win!
Go after that BADGE!
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro:
I'm BRAWLY!
DEWFORD's GYM LEADER!

I've been churned in the rough waves
of these parts, and I've grown tough

in the pitch-black cave!

So you wanted to challenge me?
Let me see what you're made of!
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat:
Whoah, wow! You made a much bigger
splash than I expected!

You swamped me!

Okay, you've got me.
Take this GYM BADGE!
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ReceivedKnuckleBadg:
{PLAYER} received the KNUCKLE BADGE
from BRAWLY.
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_KnuckleBadgeInfoTak:
The KNUCKLE BADGE makes all POKéMON
up to Level 30, even those you get in

trades, obey without question.

And, you'll be able to use the HM move
FLASH outside of battle.

If you'd like, use this TECHNICAL
MACHINE, too.
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ExplainBulkUp:
That TM08 contains BULK UP.

It's a move that raises both ATTACK
and DEFENSE stats.

… … … … … …
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_RegisteredBrawly:
Registered GYM LEADER BRAWLY
in the POKéNAV.
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostBattle:
I can see your talent becoming a giant
wave to cause a storm of astonishment

among TRAINERS one day!
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPreRematch:
BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it
always returns to the shore.

A giant wave of a talent like you…
I knew you would return!

Show me how much higher
you've gone!
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostRematch:
BRAWLY: Battling is vast and it's deep.
You can't see the bottom.

It's just like the sea of HOENN!
texts.DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTw:
BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it
always returns to the shore.

A giant wave of a talent like you…
I knew you would return!

Oh? You only have one POKéMON
that can battle.

I'm sorry, but I'd like you to come back
with at least two POKéMON.
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_CantImagineLifeWit:
What's in vogue? Why, it has to be
“{STR_VAR_1}”!

I can't imagine what life would be like
without “{STR_VAR_1}”!
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_GettingBoredOfTren:
What's in vogue? Why, it has to be
“{STR_VAR_1}”!

But I'm getting kind of bored with it.

I should look for the next big thing.
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TeachingMonAboutTr:
I'm teaching my POKéMON about
“{STR_VAR_1},”

but it's not going well.

It's a bit too much, I think.
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_DeepLinkBetweenXAn:
I'm studying up on the hip and trendy
“{STR_VAR_1}” now.

Is it true that there's a deep link
between “{STR_VAR_1}”

and “{STR_VAR_2}”?
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_MyHunchWasRight:
Oh!
So, my hunch was right!

I'm one step closer to being hip and
happening, yowza!
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_NotEasyToKeepUp:
What?!
Is that so?!

It's not easy for an older fellow like
me to keep up with trends!
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TVShowAboutTrend:
This whole business about
“{STR_VAR_1}”…

Isn't there a TV show on it?
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_IsTrendMorePopular:
Across the sea…

Is “{STR_VAR_1}”
even more popular?
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_CollectTrendMercha:
I collect official
“{STR_VAR_1}”

licensed merchandise.

I have official
“{STR_VAR_1}” DOLLS…

Official “{STR_VAR_1}”
brand clothing…

And officially licensed
“{STR_VAR_1}”

picture books.

Heheh, I own!
I'm not sharing anything with you!
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BooksAboutTrend:
IDENTIFYING GOOD
“{STR_VAR_1}” &

BAD “{STR_VAR_1}”…

THE LINK BETWEEN
“{STR_VAR_1}” AND

POKéMON…

USEFUL
“{STR_VAR_1}”…

It's neatly jammed with books about
“{STR_VAR_1}.”
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_SawTrendCoolestThi:
I saw “{STR_VAR_1}”!
Cool, huh?

It's, like, the coolest thing going!

It was awesome!
It was the real thing, oh yeah!
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_AllegedTrendNotAut:
Oh, no, no, no.

That alleged
“{STR_VAR_1}”

you claim to have seen--it's not.

The authentic article is much…
How should I say it?

Sharper, yet more mellow!

Ah, no matter. It's astonishing!
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_ComposedTrendTheme:
Hey, listen, I composed a theme song
for “{STR_VAR_1}.”

“{STR_VAR_1}”
is really popular right now.

Okay, listen!
… …

Oh!
{STR_VAR_1}!

Wonderful
{STR_VAR_1}!
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_WorkOnYourSinging:
… …

I dare say, chap, it would pay for you
to work on your singing before you

trifle yourself with

“{STR_VAR_1}.”
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_OrganizeTrendParty:
Anyway, as I was saying earlier, we
should get together and organize a

“{STR_VAR_1}” party

on the island.
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BrilliantIndeed:
Oh, a smashing good idea!

It will settle once and for all
who is the best at

“{STR_VAR_1}.”

Brilliant, indeed!

Starting today, our lives will revolve
around “{STR_VAR_1}”!
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendHasBecomePart:
I was thinking, though…

Wouldn't you agree that
“{STR_VAR_1}” has

grown from being something trendy to

being a part of our daily lives?
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendWeighsHeavily:
Beg pardon?
That much, what?

However, it's true that
“{STR_VAR_1}”

weighs heavily on your mind, whether

you're awake or asleep.

Absolutely, you're the
“{STR_VAR_1}”

PROFESSOR, old sport!
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_IfWeTeamUpWellBeIn:
If you and me team up as a combo,
we'll be invincible when it comes to all

things “{STR_VAR_1}”!
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_WellBeTrendDuo:
Spot on, my friend!

We shall be the
“{STR_VAR_1}” DUO!

Isn't that a ripe image?
Hahahah!
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_GiveYouSludgeBomb:
For me, SLUDGE BOMB is at the peak
of popularity. It's the one.

Hunh? You're telling me that you don't
know about SLUDGE BOMB?

That's outright pitiful.
I'll give you one.
texts.DewfordTown_Hall_Text_LoveSludgeBombButT:
I love SLUDGE BOMB.

But POKéMON with the move
“{STR_VAR_1}”

are in, too.
texts.DewfordTown_House1_Text_LotToBeSaidForLi:
There's a lot to be said for living on
a small island like this in harmony with

POKéMON and the family.
texts.DewfordTown_House1_Text_LifeGoesSlowlyOn:
I left the major port of SLATEPORT
CITY when I married my husband here.

Life goes by slowly on this little
island. But being surrounded by the

beautiful sea--that's happiness, too.
texts.DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSil:
Gorge your eyes on this!

It's a SILK SCARF. It's right at the
cutting edge of fashion, yeah!

Oh, I can see your eyes twinkling!
You appreciate my dazzling style!

Oh, you're a delight!
Here you go. I want you to have it!
texts.DewfordTown_House2_Text_NoRoom:
Oh, you don't have room?

Now, listen tight, this SCARF is a must-
have! Why, I would sell all my items

in order to get it!
texts.DewfordTown_House2_Text_ExplainSilkScarf:
The SILK SCARF raises the power of
NORMAL-type moves.

It's a marvelous SCARF that will go
with almost all POKéMON!
texts.DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool:
Wow, you bothered to cross the sea
to visit DEWFORD?

Did you maybe come here because you
heard about BRAWLY?

He's so cool…
Everyone idolizes him.
texts.DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_StoneC:
There's a stone cavern at the edge
of town.

I've heard you can find rare stones
there.
texts.DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Fainte:
Even if a POKéMON faints and can't
battle, it can still use a move learned

from a HIDDEN MACHINE (HM).
texts.EverGrandeCity_Text_CitySign:
EVER GRANDE CITY

“The paradise of flowers, the sea,
and POKéMON.”
texts.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroS:
WALLACE: Welcome, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

That incident in SOOTOPOLIS CITY…
That was superb work, putting an end

to that crisis all by yourself.

Oops!

It wouldn't be fair to say that you
alone ended the crisis.

You overcame that difficult situation
by working as one with your POKéMON.

We TRAINERS raise POKéMON by giving
them items and by teaching them new

techniques for battle.

But we ourselves also learn many
things from POKéMON.

And this is where your achievements
are put to the test against what

others like you have achieved.

Now!

Who can most elegantly dance with
their POKéMON in HOENN?

Show me right here and now!
texts.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat:
I, the CHAMPION, fall in defeat…

That was wonderful work.
You were elegant, infuriatingly so.

And yet it was utterly glorious!

Kudos to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

You are a truly noble POKéMON
TRAINER!
texts.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBa:
WALLACE: The POKéMON you sent into
battle…

At times they danced like a spring
breeze, and at times they struck

like lightning.

It was with light, yet surefooted,
elegance that you led your POKéMON.

Even I felt bedazzled by your
masterful performance!

You now stand at the glorious peak
of the POKéMON LEAGUE.

I now proclaim you to be the new
HOENN region…
texts.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayAdv:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!

Here's some advice before you challenge
the CHAMPION…
texts.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayIts:
MAY: Huh?
What, what, what?

{PLAYER}{KUN}…
Could it be that…

It's already over?
texts.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Brenda:
BRENDAN: {PLAYER}!

How would you like some advice before
you challenge the CHAMPION?…

BRENDAN: {PLAYER}…

Are you trying to tell me…
You've beaten the CHAMPION?
texts.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchA:
PROF. BIRCH: See?
What did I tell you, {RIVAL}?

Didn't I tell you that you don't need
to worry about {PLAYER}{KUN}?

… … … … … … … …
{PLAYER}{KUN}, you've finally done it.

When I heard that you defeated your
own father at the PETALBURG GYM,

I thought perhaps you had a chance…

But to think you've actually become
the CHAMPION!

Ah, yes!

What became of your POKéDEX?
Here, let me see.
texts.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchC:
PROF. BIRCH: Anyways,
congratulations!

Now, go proudly into the final room!
texts.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Wallac:
WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…

No, let me rephrase that properly.

The new CHAMPION!

Come with me.

WALLACE: I'm sorry, but…

From here on, only those TRAINERS who
have become CHAMPIONS may enter.

You'll have to wait outside with
PROF. BIRCH.
texts.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayCon:
MAY: Groan…

… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …

I'm just joking! That's okay!
That's the rule!

{PLAYER}{KUN}!
Honestly, congratulations!
texts.EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Brenda:
BRENDAN: Whaaaat?! … … … … …
… … … … … … … …

It can't be helped if that's the rule.

{PLAYER}, way to go!
Congratulations!
texts.EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_IntroSpee:
I am the last of the POKéMON LEAGUE
ELITE FOUR, DRAKE the DRAGON master!

In their natural state, POKéMON are
wild living things. They are free.

At times, they hinder us.
At times, they help us.

For us to battle with POKéMON as
partners, do you know what it takes?

Do you know what is needed?

If you don't, then you will never
prevail over me!
texts.EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_PostBattl:
You deserve every credit for coming
this far as a TRAINER of POKéMON.

You do seem to know what is needed.

Yes, what a TRAINER needs is a
virtuous heart.

POKéMON touch the good hearts of
TRAINERS and learn good from wrong.

They touch the good hearts of
TRAINERS and grow strong.

Go! Go onwards!
The CHAMPION is waiting!
texts.EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_IntroSpe:
Welcome, my name is GLACIA
of the ELITE FOUR.

I've traveled from afar to HOENN
so that I may hone my ice skills.

But all I have seen are challenges by
weak TRAINERS and their POKéMON.

What about you?

It would please me to no end if I could
go all out against you!
texts.EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_Defeat:
You and your POKéMON…
How hot your spirits burn!

The all-consuming heat overwhelms.

It's no surprise that my icy skills
failed to harm you.
texts.EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_PostBatt:
Advance to the next room.

And there, confirm the truly fearsome
side of the POKéMON LEAGUE.
texts.EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_HereWeHon:
WALLACE: This room…

This is where we keep records of
POKéMON that prevailed through

harsh battles.

It is here that the LEAGUE CHAMPIONS
are honored.
texts.EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_LetsRecor:
WALLACE: Come on, let's record your
name as a TRAINER who triumphed over

the POKéMON LEAGUE, and the names of

the partners who battled with you.
texts.EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_IntroSpe:
Ahahaha!

I'm PHOEBE of the ELITE FOUR.
I did my training on MT. PYRE.

While I trained, I gained the ability
to commune with GHOST-type POKéMON.

Yes, the bond I developed with POKéMON
is extremely tight.

So, come on, just try and see if you can
even inflict damage on my POKéMON!
texts.EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_Defeat:
Oh, darn.
I've gone and lost.
texts.EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_PostBatt:
There's a definite bond between you
and your POKéMON, too.

I didn't recognize it, so it's only
natural that I lost.

Yup, I'd like to see how far your bond
will carry you.

Go ahead, move on to the next room.
texts.EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Lea:
The POKéMON LEAGUE is only a short
distance after the VICTORY ROAD.

If you've come this far, what choice
do you have but to keep going?
texts.EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Bel:
The long and harrowing VICTORY ROAD…

It's like reliving the path one has
traveled in life…

Believe in your POKéMON and give it
your very best!
texts.EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Sco:
SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've clawed your
way up to face the POKéMON LEAGUE!

I'm happy for you!
You made my cheering worthwhile!

{PLAYER}{KUN}, if you were to become
the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION…

I'll get in touch with you then.

Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
Go for greatness!
texts.EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_Mus:
Beyond this point, only those TRAINERS
who have collected all the GYM BADGES

are permitted to enter.

TRAINER, let us confirm that you have
all the GYM BADGES.
texts.EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_Hav:
You haven't obtained all the BADGES.

If you're bound for the POKéMON
LEAGUE, you must return with them.
texts.EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_GoF:
TRAINER! Believe in yourself and your
POKéMON, and go forth!
texts.EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_IntroSpe:
Welcome, challenger!
I'm SIDNEY of the ELITE FOUR.

I like that look you're giving me.
I guess you'll give me a good match.

That's good! Looking real good!

All right! You and me, let's enjoy
a battle that can only be staged

here in the POKéMON LEAGUE!
texts.EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_Defeat:
Well, how do you like that? I lost!
Eh, it was fun, so it doesn't matter.
texts.EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_PostBatt:
Well, listen to what this loser has
to say.

You've got what it takes to go far.
Now, go on to the next room and enjoy

your next battle!
texts.FallarborTown_Text_ShadyCharactersCozmos:
Something's happening,
and I don't like it!

I've seen shady characters wandering
in and out of PROF. COZMO's home…
texts.FallarborTown_Text_RegionKnownForMeteors:
This region's been known for meteors
since the olden days.

They say METEOR FALLS was gouged out
by a falling meteorite long ago.
texts.FallarborTown_Text_MyPreciousAzurill:
See! Take a look!
This is my precious AZURILL!

It's slick and smooth and plushy, too!
texts.FallarborTown_Text_HaveYouChallengedFlan:
Have you already challenged FLANNERY,
the LEADER of LAVARIDGE GYM?

The girl's grandfather was famous.
He was one of the ELITE FOUR in the

POKéMON LEAGUE at one point.

It wouldn't surprise me to see FLANNERY
become a great TRAINER in her own

right.
texts.FallarborTown_Text_BattleTentSign:
BATTLE TENT FALLARBOR SITE
“May the Greatest Teams Gather!”
texts.FallarborTown_Text_TownSign:
FALLARBOR TOWN
“A farm community with small gardens.”
texts.FallarborTown_Text_MoveTutorSign:
MOVE TUTOR'S HOUSE
“New moves taught to POKéMON.”
texts.FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_DoAllRigh:
We do all right in the preliminary round,
but we can never win the appeals…

Maybe it means I have to watch what
other contestants are doing…
texts.FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_MonAllThe:
See!
My POKéMON won all these RIBBONS!

Have your POKéMON earned any RIBBONS?
You can check them on your POKéNAV.
texts.FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_CantWinEv:
I can't beat GYM LEADERS…

I can't win any CONTESTS…

I've been here, there, and everywhere,
and it's all for naught…
texts.FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MakeT:
Fufufufufu.

I'm going to make everyone think
I'm just a kid and let them play down.

Then, I'll shock them and grab
the title!
texts.FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Falla:
You know how BATTLE TENTS offer
different events in different towns?

My favorite is definitely the BATTLE
TENT in FALLARBOR TOWN.

I think it's fantastic how TRAINERS
try to win with all their faith in

their POKéMON.
texts.FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_CameT:
I heard something about some tent,
so I came to camp out.

I didn't know that tents these days
are so luxurious!

Since I'm here, I may as well try
my hand at battling!
texts.FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Scott:
SCOTT: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
So you came out to this BATTLE TENT!

The people in these parts tend to be
easygoing and laid-back.

But, you see, what I'm looking for are
people with…

How should I say this?

Someone bursting with the desire
and the drive to win.

If there were a TRAINER like that,
I'd immediately…

Whoops! Never mind!
Keep working at it!

SCOTT: Instead of wasting your
time with the likes of me, why not

make a challenge?
texts.FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_Meteorite:
PROF. COZMO: Oh…
I never should have let myself be

conned into telling TEAM MAGMA where

you can find METEORITES…

That METEORITE from METEOR FALLS…
It's never going to be mine now…
texts.FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMet:
Oh!
Hah?

That item…

Could it be?

Is it the METEORITE that TEAM MAGMA
took from METEOR FALLS?

Please, may I have it?

I'm not asking for it for free.
How about in exchange for this TM?
texts.FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_PleaseUse:
PROF. COZMO: This TM, it represents
my feeling of gratitude.

Please use it!
texts.FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_ReallyGoi:
PROF. COZMO: Oh, I can't believe it.
This is really, really great!

This is really going to help my research!
texts.FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CrushedWi:
PROF. COZMO: Oh, but…
I'm crushed with disappointment…
texts.FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MayIHaveM:
PROF. COZMO: Please, may I have that
METEORITE?

I'm not asking for it for free.
How about in exchange for this TM?
texts.FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoWent:
PROF. COZMO went off to METEOR FALLS
on ROUTE 114 with some people from

TEAM MAGMA.
texts.FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_FeelSorry:
Poor PROF. COZMO…
He's so depressed… I feel sorry for him.
texts.FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoIsSo:
Look at PROF. COZMO…
He's so happy! I think it's cute.
texts.FallarborTown_Mart_Text_DecidingSkittyEv:
I'm having a hard time deciding if I
should make my SKITTY evolve or not.

I only have to use this MOON STONE,
but it's so hard to decide…

If I make it evolve, it will become
much stronger.

But it will look so different, too.
texts.FallarborTown_Mart_Text_SellNuggetIFound:
This NUGGET I found here…
I suppose I'll have to sell it, seeing

as how it has no other use.
texts.FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_I:
I'm the MOVE TUTOR.

I know all the moves that POKéMON
learn--every one of them--and I can

teach POKéMON those moves.

I can teach a move to a POKéMON
of yours if you'd like.

I'll do it for a HEART SCALE.
I'm collecting those now.
texts.FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_T:
Oh! That's it! That's an honest to
goodness HEART SCALE!

Let me guess, you want me to teach
a move?
texts.FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_D:
Sorry…

It doesn't appear as if I have any move
I can teach that POKéMON.
texts.FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_H:
{PLAYER} handed over one HEART SCALE
in exchange.
texts.FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_C:
If your POKéMON need to learn a move,
come back with a HEART SCALE.

Hunh? There isn't a single move that
I can teach an EGG.
texts.FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Lane:
Oh, hello.
You are?

Okay, your name's {PLAYER}{KUN}.
I can see that you're a TRAINER.

So that means you use the POKéMON
Storage System I developed.

How I arrived at that conclusion is
a simple deductive process.

You spoke to me because you wanted
to access something on this PC.

Oh, I'm sorry. I'm LANETTE.

Honestly, I'm glad to meet you--it's
great you're using the Storage System.

If you could, please visit me at home.
My house is on ROUTE 114.
texts.FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Foss:
I wonder what POKéMON looked like
long, long ago?

Maybe the FOSSIL MANIAC at the edge
of town will know.
texts.FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Plan:
In the fields of FALLARBOR, we plant
seedlings of hardy trees that thrive

even in volcanic ash.
texts.FarawayIsland_Interior_Text_TheFeelingOf: The feeling of being watched faded…
texts.FortreeCity_Text_SawGiganticPokemonInSky:
No one believes me, but I saw this
gigantic POKéMON in the sky.

It seemed to squirm as it flew toward
ROUTE 131.

By the way… Sniff…
Um… You, uh…smell singed.

Were you at a volcano or something?
texts.FortreeCity_Text_SomethingBlockingGym:
I want to go to the POKéMON GYM,
but something's blocking the way.

After all the bother I went through
training on ROUTE 120…
texts.FortreeCity_Text_ThisTimeIllBeatWinona:
I've got my pride-and-joy POKéMON
with me. This time, I'll beat WINONA.
texts.FortreeCity_Text_TreesGrowByDrinkingRain:
The ground absorbs rainwater, and
trees grow by drinking that water…

Our FORTREE CITY exists because
there's both water and soil.
texts.FortreeCity_Text_EveryoneHealthyAndLivel:
The CITY consists of homes built on
trees.

Perhaps because of that lifestyle,
everyone is healthy and lively.

Why, even myself--I feel as if I've
grown thirty years younger.
texts.FortreeCity_Text_BugPokemonComeThroughWi:
Living on top of trees is okay.

But sometimes BUG POKéMON come in
through windows.

It can be really startling.
texts.FortreeCity_Text_PokemonThatEvolveWhenTr:
There are POKéMON that evolve when
you trade them! That's what I heard.
texts.FortreeCity_Text_SomethingUnseeable: Something unseeable is in the way.
texts.FortreeCity_Text_UnseeableUseDevonScope:
Something unseeable is in the way.

Want to use the DEVON SCOPE?
texts.FortreeCity_Text_UsedDevonScopePokemonFl:
{PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE.

An invisible POKéMON became completely
visible!

The startled POKéMON fled!
texts.FortreeCity_Text_CitySign:
FORTREE CITY
“The treetop city that frolics with

nature.”
texts.FortreeCity_Text_GymSign:
FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM
LEADER: WINONA

“The bird user taking flight into
the world.”
texts.FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_Merchand:
Merchandise you buy here is sent to
your own PC.

That's fantastic! I wish they could
also deliver me home like that.
texts.FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_BuyingDe:
I'm buying a pretty desk and I'm
putting my cute DOLLS on it.

If I don't, when I decorate my
SECRET BASE, my DOLLS will get

dirty or poked with splinters.
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?

FORTREE GYM LEADER WINONA is
a master of FLYING-type POKéMON.

She's waiting at the back of this GYM,
behind the rotating doors.

She's waiting for new challengers
who are trying to take wing!

Okay, go for it!
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory:
You did it!
You've achieved liftoff!
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredIntro:
Behold the elegant battle style of
BIRD POKéMON!
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredPostBattle:
A TRAINER has to be smart to keep
up with unexpected turns of events.

Do you have the smarts to get to
our LEADER?
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoIntro:
The lovers of BIRD POKéMON aspire
to join this GYM.

As a member of the FORTREE GYM,
I'm not allowed to lose!
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoDefeat:
It was too much of a load for me
to bear…
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoPostBattle:
The world is huge, and there are
countless tough TRAINERS.

I'm going to keep training and make
myself even stronger.
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintIntro:
There's no need for WINONA, our GYM
LEADER, to deal with you!

I'm plenty good enough for you!
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintPostBattle:
WINONA is cute and she's strong.
She's the ultimate LEADER!

Blush…
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyIntro:
WINONA taught me personally!
You can't beat me easily!
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyPostBattle:
Thanks to WINONA, the people of
FORTREE can live without fear.
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoIntro:
When WINONA takes to battle, her face
shines with beautiful determination…

I'm not letting you witness that
lovely sight!
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoPostBattle:
You'd better watch it!
Don't get distracted staring at WINONA

or you'll go crashing down in a heap!
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusIntro:
You'd better know that there are all
sorts of FLYING-type POKéMON.

You do know that, right?
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusDefeat: You seem to know your stuff!
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusPostBattle:
Sure, you beat me all right.
But you'd better watch it! Our LEADER

WINONA's POKéMON are all business.
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro:
I am WINONA. I am the LEADER of
the FORTREE POKéMON GYM.

I have become one with BIRD POKéMON
and have soared the skies…

However grueling the battle, we have
triumphed with grace…

Witness the elegant choreography
of BIRD POKéMON and I!
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaDefeat:
Never before have I seen a TRAINER
command POKéMON with more grace

than I…

In recognition of your prowess,
I present to you this GYM BADGE.
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedFeatherBadg:
{PLAYER} received the FEATHER BADGE
from WINONA.
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFeatherBadge:
With the FEATHER BADGE, all POKéMON up
to LV 70, even those received through

trades, will obey your every command.

You will also be able to use
the HM move FLY outside of battle.

And this…
This is a gift from me.
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainAerialAce:
TM40 contains AERIAL ACE.

Its speed…
No POKéMON should be able to avoid it.

… … … … … …
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWinona:
Registered GYM LEADER WINONA
in the POKéNAV.
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostBattle:
Though I fell to you, I will remain
devoted to BIRD POKéMON.
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch:
WINONA: We humans can never escape
gravity's pull on the ground.

But by striving for excellence,
we have the power to soar!

You have scaled the pinnacle as
the reigning CHAMPION.

Please, allow me to see your power
at full flight!
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchDefeat: I failed to reach your height again…
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostRematch:
WINONA: Even though I have lost,
the wings of my heart remain unbroken.

I can rise and soar again and
yet again.

I am convinced of it!
texts.FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTw:
WINONA: We humans can never escape
gravity's pull on the ground.

But by striving for excellence,
we have the power to soar!

You have scaled the pinnacle as
the reigning CHAMPION.

Please, allow me to see your power
at full flight!

Oh, no… Do you have but one
POKéMON with you?

Please return with two POKéMON
at the very least.
texts.FortreeCity_House1_Text_YouWillTradeWont:
Wrooooaaar! I need it!
I have to get me a {STR_VAR_1}!

I'll do anything for it!

…Uh… Did you hear that?
My shout from the bottom of my heart?

Having heard that, you will trade
your {STR_VAR_1} for my {STR_VAR_2},

won't you?
texts.FortreeCity_House1_Text_MonYouTakeCare:
Oh, yeah, right on!

{STR_VAR_1}, welcome!
{STR_VAR_2}, you take care!
texts.FortreeCity_House1_Text_ThisIsntAMon:
Uh, no, I don't think so.
That isn't a {STR_VAR_1}.
texts.FortreeCity_House1_Text_YouWontTradeMe:
No? You won't trade me?
Even after I bared my heart to you?
texts.FortreeCity_House1_Text_GoingToMakeVolbe:
I'm going to make VOLBEAT super
strong from this moment on!

I hope you do the same with PLUSLE!
texts.FortreeCity_House1_Text_TradingMemoriesW:
Trading POKéMON with others…

It's as if you're trading your own
memories with other people.
texts.FortreeCity_House2_Text_HiddenPowersArou:
People… POKéMON…

Their hidden powers are aroused by
living in natural environments…
texts.FortreeCity_House2_Text_CoinInWhichHand:
Let this old woman see if your hidden
power has awoken…

I hold a coin in my hand.

Now, tell me, have I palmed it in
the right hand? Or in the left?
texts.FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainW:
Oh! Yes, correct!

We shall try again.

In which hand have I palmed the coin?
The right or left?

Oh! Yes, correct!

We shall try again.

In which hand have I palmed the coin?
The right or left?
texts.FortreeCity_House2_Text_YourHiddenPowerH:
Oh! Splendid!
Your hidden power has awoken!

Here, take this and awaken the hidden
power of your POKéMON.
texts.FortreeCity_House2_Text_ExplainHiddenPow:
HIDDEN POWER is a move that changes
with the POKéMON.
texts.FortreeCity_House2_Text_YouGuessedWrong:
No, too bad.
You guessed wrong.
texts.FortreeCity_House3_Text_MetStevenHadAmaz:
While speaking about POKéDEXES,
I remembered something.

I met this TRAINER, STEVEN, when
I was searching for rare stones.

Hoo, boy, he had some amazing POKéMON
with him.

They weren't just rare, they were
trained to terrifying extremes!

He might even be stronger than the
GYM LEADER in this town…
texts.FortreeCity_House3_Text_OhYouHavePokedex:
What's that thing you have there?

… … … … … …

Oh, it's called a POKéDEX?
It's really awesome!
texts.FortreeCity_House4_Text_BringsWorldClose:
By being together with POKéMON,
people make more and more friends.

And that brings the world closer
together. I think it's wonderful!
texts.FortreeCity_House4_Text_AskedWingullToRu:
Heheh, I asked my WINGULL to run
an errand for me.
texts.FortreeCity_House4_Text_WelcomeWingullTa:
Good!
Welcome back, WINGULL!

Huh? What is this?
What is it holding?

A MENTAL HERB?
It must have picked it up somewhere.

But I'm not a TRAINER, so you can
have it.
texts.FortreeCity_House4_Text_FriendsFarAwayTh:
Thanks to my WINGULL, I have friends
who live far away.
texts.FortreeCity_House5_Text_TreeHousesAreGre:
The tree houses of FORTREE are great!

I think it's the number one town for
living together with POKéMON.
texts.FortreeCity_House5_Text_AdaptedToNature:
POKéMON and people have adapted to
nature for survival.

There's no need to make nature
conform to the way we want to live.
texts.FortreeCity_Mart_Text_SuperRepelBetter:
SUPER REPEL lasts a long time,
and it gets the job done.

It's much better than an ordinary
REPEL.
texts.FortreeCity_Mart_Text_StockUpOnItems:
I always stock up on more items than
I'm sure I'll need.

You never know what might happen.
Better to be safe than sorry!
texts.FortreeCity_Mart_Text_RareCandyMakesMonG:
A RARE CANDY makes a POKéMON grow
immediately by one level.
texts.FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoToSa:
Listen, kid, are you working
on a POKéDEX?

Hmm… Go to the SAFARI ZONE.
That's my suggestion.
texts.FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Record:
Have you done anything at
the RECORD CORNER?

It's pretty neat. It mixes and matches
the records of TRAINERS.

I don't know quite how it works,
but it's cool. It's exciting, even!
texts.FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DoYouK:
Oh, wow, you have a POKéNAV!
And it's just like mine!

Do you know about POKéNAV's
MATCH CALL system?

Access it, and you can chat with
registered TRAINERS anytime.

It also shows you which TRAINERS
want a rematch with you.

It's really nifty! Those DEVON guys
sure know what they're doing!
texts.GraniteCave_1F_Text_GetsDarkAheadHereYou:
Hey, you.
It gets awfully dark ahead.

It'll be tough trying to explore.

That guy who came by earlier…
STEVEN, I think it was.

He knew how to use FLASH, so he ought
to be all right, but…

Well, for us HIKERS, helping out those
that we meet is our motto.

Here you go, I'll pass this on to you.
texts.GraniteCave_1F_Text_ExplainFlash:
Teach that hidden move FLASH to
a POKéMON and use it.

It lights up even the inky darkness
of caves.

But, to use it, you need the GYM BADGE
from DEWFORD's POKéMON GYM.
texts.GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ImStevenLet:
My name is STEVEN.

I'm interested in rare stones,
so I travel here and there.

Oh?
A LETTER for me?
texts.GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ThankYouTak:
STEVEN: Okay, thank you.

You went through all this trouble to
deliver that. I need to thank you.

Let me see…
I'll give you this TM.

It contains my favorite move,
STEEL WING.
texts.GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_CouldBecome:
STEVEN: Your POKéMON appear quite
capable.

If you keep training, you could even
become the CHAMPION of the POKéMON

LEAGUE one day. That's what I think.

I know, since we've gotten to know each
other, let's register one another in

our POKéNAVS.

… … … … … …
texts.GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_IveGotToHur: Now, I've got to hurry along.
texts.GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_OhBagIsFull:
Oh, your BAG is full…
That's too bad, then.
texts.InsideOfTruck_Text_BoxPrintedWithMonLogo:
The box is printed with a POKéMON logo.

It's a POKéMON brand moving and
delivery service.
texts.JaggedPass_Text_EricIntro:
MT. CHIMNEY's JAGGED PASS…

Now this is what I've always wanted
in a mountain.

This jagged bumpiness…
It rocks my soul!
texts.JaggedPass_Text_EricPostBattle:
Yes, I did lose at POKéMON…

But, when it comes to the love of
the mountains, I have you beat!
texts.JaggedPass_Text_DianaIntro:
This place isn't your casual hike.
It's not suited for a picnic.
texts.JaggedPass_Text_DianaDefeat:
Ohhh, no!
The ground is too bumpy…
texts.JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostBattle:
Did you know?

Some people cleverly ride their
bicycles up this horribly bumpy pass.
texts.JaggedPass_Text_DianaRegister:
Will you ever be back in this area?
If you do return, I'd like a rematch.
texts.JaggedPass_Text_DianaRematchIntro:
Picnics are fun wherever you go.
Just like POKéMON!
texts.JaggedPass_Text_DianaRematchDefeat:
I only lost because the ground is
too bumpy!
texts.JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostRematch:
I'll forget about losing and just
enjoy this bumpy hike.
texts.JaggedPass_Text_EthanIntro:
JAGGED PASS is hard to walk on.
It's a good place for training.
texts.JaggedPass_Text_EthanDefeat:
It was all over while we were still
trying to find a good footing…
texts.JaggedPass_Text_EthanPostBattle:
If I had an ACRO BIKE, I'd be able to
jump ledges.
texts.JaggedPass_Text_EthanRegister:
When I get more used to this bumpiness,
I'll be sure to win!

Can you register me in your POKéNAV?
texts.JaggedPass_Text_EthanRematchIntro:
I got used to this bumpiness.
I sing while I climb now.
texts.JaggedPass_Text_EthanRematchDefeat:
It's still not easy to battle on this
