bumpy ground…
texts.JaggedPass_Text_EthanPostRematch:
I should get an ACRO BIKE from RYDEL
in MAUVILLE CITY…
texts.JaggedPass_Text_GruntIntro:
Wah!
What are you doing here?

What am I doing in a place like this?

What business is it of yours?
texts.JaggedPass_Text_GruntDefeat:
Urrrgh…

I should've ducked into our HIDEOUT
right away…
texts.JaggedPass_Text_GoWhereverYouWant:
Okay, oh-kay!
I admit it--you're strong!

Don't worry about me.
Go wherever you want!
texts.JaggedPass_Text_BoulderShakingInResponse:
Oh! This boulder is shaking in response
to the MAGMA EMBLEM!
texts.JaggedPass_Text_JulioIntro:
Aiyeeh! It's awfully scary to shoot
down the mountain in one go!
texts.JaggedPass_Text_JulioDefeat: I feel like I'm falling apart…
texts.JaggedPass_Text_JulioPostBattle:
My bicycle bounced around so much,
my rear end's sore…
texts.JaggedPass_Text_AutumnIntro:
I climb this hill every day.
I have confidence in my strength!
texts.JaggedPass_Text_AutumnPostBattle:
What is that odd rock protrusion
a little up the hill from here?
texts.LavaridgeTown_Text_MayNiceBadgesTakeThis:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Long time no see!

Oh? While I visited the hot springs,
you got the LAVARIDGE GYM BADGE.

You must have collected
good POKéMON…

No, I believe you raised some.

I guess it would be okay for you to
have this.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Text_MayExplainGoGogglesCh:
MAY: With those GO-GOGGLES, you'll
have no trouble getting through the

desert near ROUTE 111.

But, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}…
Challenging GYMS…

You're trying hard because you don't
want to lose to me, I bet!

{PLAYER}{KUN}, I think I should challenge
your dad in PETALBURG GYM.

See you again!
texts.LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanNiceBadgesTake:
BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, hey, it's been a while.
How's it going?

Hmm…
That's a decent collection of BADGES.

All right, then.
You may as well have this.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanExplainGoGoggl:
BRENDAN: Keep those with you if you're
planning on going into that desert near

ROUTE 111.

There should be some POKéMON that
are exclusively desert-dwellers.

You might look around for those.

As for me…
I'm considering challenging NORMAN,

the GYM LEADER of PETALBURG.

Unlike you, {PLAYER}, your dad looks like
he really is tough.

See you around!
texts.LavaridgeTown_Text_HaveEggWillYouTakeIt:
I have here an EGG.

I'd hoped to hatch it by covering it in
hot sand by the hot springs.

But that doesn't seem to be enough…

I've heard it would be best if it were
kept together with POKéMON and

carried about.

You are a TRAINER, yes?
And your POKéMON radiate vitality.

So, what say you?
Will you take this EGG to hatch?
texts.LavaridgeTown_Text_HopeYoullWalkPlentyWi:
Good! I hope you'll walk plenty with
this here EGG!
texts.LavaridgeTown_Text_NoRoomForThisEgg:
Oh? You've too many POKéMON.
There's no room for this EGG…
texts.LavaridgeTown_Text_AsYouWishThen:
As you wish, then…

If you have a change of heart about
hatching this EGG, I will be here.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Text_EverySoOftenEggFoundA:
Every so often, an EGG will be found at
the POKéMON DAY CARE.

Or at least that's how the rumor goes.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsNeverRunDry:
We draw as much hot water as we need,
and yet the hot springs never run dry.

Isn't it magical?

These hot springs appear near active
volcanoes. Veins of water under the

ground are heated by magma to well up

as hot springs.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Text_PokemonNippedBackside:
Being buried in this hot sand is…
Sigh…

So warm and heavenly…

Eh? Gyaah! Ouch!

A POKéMON nipped my backside!
texts.LavaridgeTown_Text_OhYouLikeHotSprings:
Oh, you like hot springs, do you?

That's surprising for one as young
as you.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Text_BatheInHotSpringsEver:
I bathe in the hot springs every day.

I want to become a beautiful and strong
GYM LEADER like FLANNERY.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Text_IfPokemonInHotSprings:
If people put POKéMON in hot springs,
it might be seriously strange.

Why, it might be an electric bath, or
a bubble bath, or even a lava bath…
texts.LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsClaims:
They're claiming that these hot springs
are good for calming nervous tension,

relieving aching muscles, solving

romantic problems, and attracting

money…
texts.LavaridgeTown_Text_TownSign:
LAVARIDGE TOWN

“POKéMON CENTER HOT SPRINGS
An excellent place for relaxing!”
texts.LavaridgeTown_Text_GymSign:
LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM
LEADER: FLANNERY

“One with a fiery passion that burns!”
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?

LAVARIDGE's GYM LEADER FLANNERY
uses FIRE-type POKéMON.

Her passion for POKéMON burns stronger
and hotter than a volcano.

Don't get too close to her--you'll burn!
Hose her down with water and then

go for it!
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVi: Yow! That was a scorching-hot battle!
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColeDefeat: I'm blinded by sweat in my eyes…
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColePostBattle:
Being buried in hot sand promotes
circulation.

It's effective for healing pain in
your joints.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxleIntro:
I'm trying to relieve my stress.
Don't come along and stress me out!
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxleDefeat: I hope FLANNERY flames you good!
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxlePostBattle:
Haaah… Whew…

If you spend too much time buried in
hot sand, it tuckers you out…
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganIntro:
You must be getting tired by now.
You'd like to rest in the hot sand,

wouldn't you?

But you should know that maintaining
your willpower is an important ability

for all TRAINERS.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganDefeat: Play with fire, and be burned…
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganPostBat:
Your skill is real…
But our LEADER FLANNERY is strong.

If you don't watch yourself, you'll be
burned seriously.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldPostBatt:
The temperature of magma is
392 degrees.

Your POKéMON beat me, so they should
easily survive in magma.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DanielleIntro:
Um…
Okay, I'll battle with you.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DaniellePostBa:
I'm going to be a pretty and strong
TRAINER just like FLANNERY.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JaceIntro:
Come on, get with it!
Let's go before my feelings cool!
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JaceDefeat:
It's so hot, and yet my heart is
clutched by ice…
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JacePostBattl:
The way the battling spirit burns
within you, you may stand a chance

against our LEADER.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffIntro:
See how the flames blaze wildly?
They flare in anticipation of my win!
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffPostBattl:
Well, so what? I say so what?
I can walk on hot coals barefoot!

…Don't even think about trying it!
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliIntro:
As much as I love mountains,
I especially love volcanoes.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliDefeat:
Well, it seems to me I lost without
ever being in control.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliPostBattle:
I stay here because I became a fan
of FLANNERY's power.

Hehehehe.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro:
Welcome… No, wait.

Puny TRAINER, how good to see you've
made it here!

I have been entrusted with the…
No, wait.

I am FLANNERY, and I'm the GYM
LEADER here!

Uh…
Dare not underestimate me, though

I have been LEADER only a short time!

With skills inherited from my grand-
father, I shall, uh…demonstrate the

hot moves we have honed on this land!
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryDefeat:
Oh…
I guess I was trying too hard…

I… I've only recently become
a GYM LEADER.

I tried too hard to be someone
I'm not.

I have to do things my natural way. If
I don't, my POKéMON will be confused.

Thanks for teaching me that.
For that, you deserve this.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ReceivedHeatBa:
{PLAYER} received the HEAT BADGE
from FLANNERY.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainHeatBad:
If you have a HEAT BADGE, all POKéMON
up to Level 50, even those you get in

trades from other people, will obey

you completely.

And, it lets POKéMON use the HM move
STRENGTH outside of battle.

This is a token of my appreciation.
Don't be shy about taking it!
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainOverhea:
That TM50 contains OVERHEAT.

That move inflicts serious damage on
the opponent.

But it also sharply cuts the SP. ATK
of the POKéMON using it. It might not

be suitable for longer battles.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredFlan:
Registered GYM LEADER FLANNERY
in the POKéNAV.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostBa:
Your power reminds me of someone…

Oh! I know! You battle like NORMAN,
the GYM LEADER of PETALBURG.
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPreRem:
FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going
to deflate me.

I love POKéMON.
I love to battle.

And… I love this GYM!

Let's exchange superhot moves
in another battle!
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematc:
Whew!
On the verge of eruption!
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostRe:
FLANNERY: I lost the match,
but I'm completely satisfied.

It's not often I get to enjoy a battle
this heated.

Let's have another one like this
again sometime!
texts.LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematc:
FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going
to deflate me.

I love POKéMON.
I love to battle.

And… I love this GYM!

Let's exchange superhot moves
in another battle!

Oh, wait. Do you only have one POKéMON
that can battle?

I hate to say this, but when you come
see me, bring at least two POKéMON.
texts.LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_WelcomeToHer:
Welcome to the HERB SHOP, home of
effective and inexpensive medicine!
texts.LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_YouveComeToL:
You've come to look at herbal medicine
in LAVARIDGE?

That's rather commendable.

I like you! Take this!
texts.LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_ExplainCharc:
That CHARCOAL I gave you, it's used
for making herbal medicine.

It also does wonders when held by
a POKéMON.

It intensifies the power of FIRE-type
moves.
texts.LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_HerbalMedici:
Herbal medicine works impressively well.
But your POKéMON will dislike you for it.

It must be horribly bitter!
texts.LavaridgeTown_House_Text_WifeWarmingEggI:
My wife's warming an EGG in the hot
springs. This is what she told me.

She left two POKéMON with the DAY CARE.
And they discovered that EGG!
texts.LavaridgeTown_Mart_Text_XSpeedFirstStrik:
Use X SPEED to add to a POKéMON's
SPEED in battle.

That will help it get in the first
strike--a decided advantage!
texts.LavaridgeTown_Mart_Text_LocalSpecialtyOn:
On MT. CHIMNEY's peak, there's a local
specialty that you can buy only there.

Give it to a POKéMON--it will be elated.
texts.LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Trai:
I think POKéMON get closer to their
TRAINERS if they spend time together.

The longer the better.
That's what I think.
texts.LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HotS:
It's sort of magical how just sitting
in a hot-spring pool can invigorate.

I wish I could let my POKéMON
soak, too.
texts.LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Trai:
Hohoho! Hey, kid, you can reach
the hot springs from here.

If POKéMON are getting rest, so too
should their TRAINERS.
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_MayShoppingLetsBattle:
MAY: Oh, hey?
{PLAYER}{KUN}, are you shopping, too?

I bought a whole bunch of DOLLS and
POSTERS.

Of course, I've also caught a lot of
POKéMON, and I'm raising them

properly, too.

Actually, I'm more worried if you're
raising POKéMON properly, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

I'll battle with you, so you can show
me your POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_MayNotRaisingPokemon:
MAY: Oh, why? {PLAYER}{KUN}, haven't you
been raising your POKéMON?

That's not a very good showing as a
TRAINER…
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_MayBattleMe:
MAY: Come on, battle with me, so I can
check out your POKéMON!
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_MayWontBeBeaten:
MAY: The POKéMON I raised won't be
beaten by your POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_MayDefeat:
… … … … … … … …

I remember the battle I had with you,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, on ROUTE 103.

That battle helped you become this
strong, {PLAYER}{KUN}, didn't it?
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_MayGoingBackToLittlero:
MAY: I'm thinking of going back to
LITTLEROOT soon.

I've caught a decent group of POKéMON,
and my POKéDEX is coming along, so

I'm going home to show my dad.
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToCollectBa:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?

Collect all the GYM BADGES and take
the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?

Well, while you're collecting BADGES,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm going to work on my

POKéDEX. I'll complete it before you!

See you!
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToPokemonLe:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?

Are you taking the POKéMON LEAGUE
challenge?

Or, are you going to complete your
POKéDEX?

I might've lost to you in battling,
but I'll finish my POKéDEX before you!

See you!
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToBattleFro:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?

Are you taking the BATTLE FRONTIER
challenge?

Or, are you going to complete your
POKéDEX?

I might've lost to you in battling,
but I'll finish my POKéDEX before you!

See you!
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanShoppingLetsBat:
BRENDAN: Oh, hey, it's {PLAYER}.

I'm running an errand for my dad.
No, I'm not buying any DOLLS.

Anyways, it's been a while.

Want to have a battle to see who's been
raising POKéMON better?
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidence:
BRENDAN: Oh, what's the matter?
Don't have the confidence?
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanBattleMe:
BRENDAN: Want to battle to see who's
been raising POKéMON better?
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanWontBeBeaten:
BRENDAN: Aww, but you know I'm not
going to lose to no {PLAYER}.
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanDefeat:
Humph…
You've done a lot of raising.

That stings a bit--I had a head start
on you as a TRAINER…
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanGoingBackToLitt:
BRENDAN: I…
I plan on going home to LITTLEROOT.

You know I'm helping out my dad on his
POKéDEX. It's coming together pretty

decently, so I should go show him.
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToColle:
{PLAYER}, what are you going to do?

Collect all the GYM BADGES and take
the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?

Maybe I'll do that, too…

Well, anyway, hang in there!
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToPokem:
{PLAYER}, what are you going to do?

Since you're that strong, are you
taking the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?

Heh, even me--if I trained my POKéMON
a bit more, I should be stronger than

you, {PLAYER}.

Well, anyway, hang in there!
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToBattl:
{PLAYER}, what are you going to do?

Are you taking the BATTLE FRONTIER
challenge?

Or, are you going to complete your
POKéDEX?

Since you're that strong, you should
consider the BATTLE FRONTIER.

Heh, if I train my POKéMON a bit more,
I'll get stronger than you, {PLAYER}.

Maybe I should go to the BATTLE
FRONTIER.

Well, anyway, hang in there!
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_MovedLootIntoHideoutTo:
Fufufu…

We moved more loot into our secret
HIDEOUT today…

Wh-who are you?!
I was just talking to myself!
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_ChanceToDoBigThings:
I'm just a GRUNT, so I don't know what
the BOSS is thinking…

But being on TEAM AQUA, I know I'll get
the chance to do big things!

Wh-who are you?!
I was just talking to myself!
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_DontGoNearCaveInCove:
Hey, you!

Don't go near the cave in the cove!

Why? You don't need a reason why!
I'm an adult, so you just listen to me!
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_IfWorldBecomesOurs:
If this whole wide world becomes ours,
TEAM AQUA's, it will be a happier

place for POKéMON, too.
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_WailmerLeapOutOfWater:
There! WAILMER!
Leap out of the water now!
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_GetLostMessingUpTraini:
Hunh? What do you want?

You're messing up our training,
so can you, like, get lost?
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_ContestHallInTown:
There's a POKéMON CONTEST HALL
right in this here town. 

That means well-raised POKéMON will
come from all over the country.

My heart swells with excitement!
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_StrangeCaveInCove:
Have you seen that strange cave in
the cove at the edge of town?
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_GoingToMoveDeleterForH:
I'm going to teach my POKéMON some new
moves for entering a CONTEST.

So, I'm going to see the MOVE DELETER
and make it forget HM moves.
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_ImFromKanto:
I came from KANTO.

The HOENN region is beautiful with
all its water and verdant nature.

Hunh? Wait a second…

Could there be rare POKéMON that live
only in this area?
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaBeenTrainingWa:
TEAM AQUA's been training their
WAILMER in the cove.

We SAILORS can't get our boats out
to sea with them in the way!
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_SomeonePuntedTeamAquaO:
Ahoy, did you know?

Someone punted TEAM AQUA out of
the way for us!

That got the WAILMER out of the cove,
so we can get our boats out again.
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_SomeoneStoleMyPokemon:
I was taking a relaxing snooze at the
seaside inn to the sound of waves…

When someone stole my POKéMON!

Who's the abductor?
TEAM AQUA? Is it TEAM AQUA?
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_MissingPokemonCameBack:
My missing POKéMON…
It came back without me noticing!
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_ImArtDealer:
I'm an ART DEALER.

I am a buyer and seller of fine art,
especially paintings.

I've heard that the MUSEUM here has
magnificent works on exhibit…
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_SeaRemainsForeverYoung:
Even as we grow old and wrinkled,
the sea remains forever young with

the vivid brilliance of life…

Fwohoho fwohohohoho…
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_SixtyYearsAgoHusbandPr:
It was sixty years ago that my husband
proposed to me here.

The sea remains as beautiful as ever.

Mufufufu mufufufufufu…
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaRenovatedCaver:
Hm, you know of the peculiar cavern
in this cove?

That had been a natural formation,
but then that TEAM AQUA lot came

along and made their renovations.

They call themselves
the “nature-loving TEAM AQUA”!

But what they do and what they say
don't match at all!
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaLotGoneForGood:
That cave in the cove…

I didn't notice it right away,
but it's completely empty now.

That TEAM AQUA lot, they must
have gone away for good.
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_CitySign:
LILYCOVE CITY

“Where the land ends and the
sea begins.”
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_ContestHallSign:
POKéMON CONTEST HALL
“The gathering place for TRAINERS!”
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_MotelSign:
COVE LILY MOTEL

“Remember us as COVE LILY of
LILYCOVE.”
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_MuseumSign:
LILYCOVE MUSEUM

“POKéMON Masterpiece Collection
on exhibit!”
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_MuseumSignPlayersExhib:
LILYCOVE MUSEUM

“{PLAYER}'s POKéMON Collection
on exhibit!”
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSignUnderConstru:
LILYCOVE CITY HARBOR

“The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under
construction in SLATEPORT CITY.

“Service is scheduled to begin
shortly.”
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSign:
LILYCOVE CITY HARBOR

“Enjoy a delightful cruise on
the ferry S.S. TIDAL.”
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_TrainerFanClubSign:
POKéMON TRAINER FAN CLUB

The names of TRAINERS are scribbled
all over the sign…
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_DepartmentStoreSign:
LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE

“Overflowing with great merchandise
and excitement!

“A great place to find that something
you need!”
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_MoveDeletersHouseSign:
MOVE DELETER'S HOUSE

“Unwanted POKéMON moves deleted.”
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_DoYouKnowAboutBerryBle:
Do you know about the machine
BERRY BLENDER?
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_FasterSpinBetterPokebl:
People have to work together to get it
to spin faster.

The faster you can make it spin, the
better {POKEBLOCK}S you can get, I've heard.
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_ExplainBerryBlender:
It's used for making a kind of candy
called a {POKEBLOCK}.

If you give a good {POKEBLOCK} to a POKéMON,
its condition will improve by a lot.
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_HeardTowerCalledSkyPil:
I heard there's a tower somewhere out
on the sea routes.

It's called the SKY PILLAR, I hear.
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_SawTallTowerOnRoute131:
I saw this tall tower somewhere
around ROUTE 131.

Could that possibly be…?
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_JustArrivedAndSawRareP:
We just arrived here on our
honeymoon vacation.

We happened to see a DRAGON-type
POKéMON flying way up in the sky.

Do cool POKéMON like that live in
the HOENN region?
texts.LilycoveCity_Text_HoneymoonVowToSeeRareP:
On our honeymoon, we vowed to see as
many rare POKéMON as we can.

So we were delighted to see a rare
POKéMON as soon as we arrived.

I mean, we are totally happy!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSm:
This POKéMON won the BEAUTY CONTEST
here before.

Well, guess what? Today, I made it
win a SMARTNESS CONTEST!

My abilities scare even me…
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBun:
I've entered a bunch of CONTESTS,
so I'm seeing how things work.

If you're in a COOLNESS CONTEST,
cool moves go over as appeals.

But smart moves and cute moves
don't go over well, for instance.
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ManWhoWonE:
That young man who won earlier had
a whole bunch of different {POKEBLOCK}S.

Can you win if you had that many
of those things?
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IsntThisPl:
Whoa, isn't this place humongous!

The tension in the air… It's not
like a CONTEST hall in the sticks.
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GiveItBest:
MC: Okay, SMART POKéMON and their
TRAINERS, are you ready?!

Give it your best showing!
Let's appeal!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnjo:
JUDGE: Are you enjoying this CONTEST?

Come back with three friends, and
all of you may enter a CONTEST!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWro:
Ayayayay…
I entered the wrong CONTEST.

I entered this tough POKéMON in
the SMARTNESS CONTEST…

Come on, wow them with a smart-looking
ROCK SMASH.
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonT:
I've spent many a year, and all my
wisdom besides, raising this POKéMON

to be smart.

It won't be easily bested by some
young pup's POKéMON.

My dear wife, are you seeing this?
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IfMonPulls:
There it is!

If my POKéMON pulls a smart move next,
the audience's excitement will peak!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_DontApprec:
Oh, dear, no!

My darling ZUBAT's LEECH LIFE is so
cute I kept using it over and over!

But these mean people don't appreciate
it at all!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AllSeemToU:
Even when TRAINERS enter the same
kind of POKéMON, they all seem to use

different moves for appeals.

It's just like the way people have
different styles for battling.
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonSma:
I think the POKéMON look smarter
than their TRAINERS. By a lot.
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_StillLoveS:
When all's said and done, I still love
SMARTNESS CONTESTS.

That intellectual green color…
It's so… So… Cool.
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnte:
MC: Are you entering the BEAUTY
CONTEST, too? Good luck!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EveryPokem:
JUDGE: Ah, every POKéMON here is
a model of pristine beauty!

Why, I almost forgot to score them!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EyesWillBe:
A POKéMON this beautiful…
There isn't another one like it.

Everyone's eyes will be glued to
my beauty.
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGro:
Waaaah!

I brushed and groomed my POKéMON
carefully for this CONTEST…

But I overdid it…
My POKéMON's coat turned all scraggly…

What should I do?
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWontS:
This AURORA BEAM is so dazzling,
the JUDGE won't be able to see it.

Uh, wait a second…
That'll be meaningless, then!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonLoo:
This pretty POKéMON looks just like
me when I was younger.

Right when I said that, my husband
spewed the coffee he was drinking.

Did I say something funny?
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WinBeautyC:
You know, if I win at a BEAUTY
CONTEST, sure it makes me

happy. More than usual, anyway.
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GanderAtAl:
Wahahahah!

Will you take a gander at all those
pretty POKéMON!

I just love this sort of glitz!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CantWinOnB:
You can't always win on just beauty
alone.

You have to groom your POKéMON so
it's nice and glossy like mine.
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_InTheMiddl:
MC: Uh-oh! Hello!
We're in the middle of a CONTEST!

Please enter at our registration
counter and come out, okay?
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SuchCharmi:
JUDGE: Oh, such charming and cute
appeals!

Oh, my goodness! What a perfectly
adorable WATER SPORT appeal!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyAzurillW:
Oh, no… My sweet AZURILL was
distracted by another POKéMON.
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_NeverWonBa:
My POKéMON has never won in a battle,
but put it in a CONTEST and look out!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PetalDance:
My POKéMON's PETAL DANCE is a marvel
of elegance.

I won't let anyone disturb its
performance.
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonAppea:
Everyone's POKéMON are very cute.

However, if my POKéMON were to make
a cute appeal…

I'm sure that it would be so much 
cuter than the others.
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyChildIsI: My child is in this CONTEST.
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ComeOnDear:
Come on, dear. Go for it!
Your POKéMON is the best!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ThatGirlTh:
I think that girl over there is
the cutest of the lot.

What's that? They're judging
POKéMON by their looks?
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WantCuteMo:
Ohh, seeing all these cute POKéMON,
they make we want to get my own!

I'm going to go catch some!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_BeautyCont:
BEAUTY CONTEST STAGE
BE ALLURED BY BEAUTIFUL POKéMON!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CuteContes:
CUTENESS CONTEST STAGE
BE CHARMED BY CUTE POKéMON!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SmartConte:
SMARTNESS CONTEST STAGE
BE IMPRESSED BY SMART POKéMON!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LadyGaveM:
Yippee!

The lady at the reception counter
gave me a case for {POKEBLOCK}S!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MakePokeb:
Make {POKEBLOCK}S and put them in there.

When you make a {POKEBLOCK}, everyone
has to put in a different BERRY.
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_YourPokem:
Congratulations!

I did a painting of your POKéMON to
commemorate its victory…

Well, your POKéMON's appeals were
so fantastic, it spurred me into

painting better than I usually do.

Look, see?
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ShouldITa:
What do you think? I'm confident in
what I've done, but do you like it?

A work of this caliber, it wouldn't look
out of place in an art museum.

Huh? An art museum really is looking
for paintings?

Do you think I should take this there?
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_IllTakePa:
What, really? Then, sure, I will take
this painting there right now.

I'll give it a proper title, too.

I hope they'll like it and consider
exhibiting this.

Please check if they did accept this.
Thank you!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeMemen:
Oh, that's right!

As a memento of me painting your
POKéMON, please take this.
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeHomeB:
Oh… Then, I guess I'll just take
this home with me…

But, you know, I would like to take
this to the art museum… Okay?
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_FineThats:
Oh, fine, that's the way it is.
I will hang this in my own house.

I'll just have to try harder next time.
Well, be seeing you.
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MasterRan:
Hoo, boy… Master Rank CONTESTS,
here I come.

The world will know that my dearest
POKéMON is the cutest being in all

existence. The time has come!

Uheheheh.
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WholeVari:
You can see a whole variety of
POKéMON here.

That's why I make this place a regular
part of my daily stroll.
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ContestFe:
Wow, coming out to a CONTEST is
a feast for these eyes!

Would you look at all the POKéMON
that just scream to be painted?
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ToughCont:
The TOUGHNESS CONTEST is like
extreme, man!

Those muscular appeals…
Cascading sweat… I swoon!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LavishedC:
Day in and day out, I lavished my care
on this POKéMON.

Its condition is peaking.
Today, victory is mine!
texts.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MadePokeb:
I made {POKEBLOCK}S with Mom, Dad, and
Big Sister. They turned out great!

I bet you can make smoother, better
{POKEBLOCK}S if you have more people.
texts.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_Guest:
Hm, so they doubled the guests by
using POKéMON as attractions?

Hm, well, maybe I should make a cute
POKéMON our inn's mascot.

I wonder if that will attract more
guests to stay with us?
texts.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_NoGue:
Oh, sorry, sorry!
I was too involved in watching TV!

Since that TEAM AQUA came to town,
the tourists have been staying away.
texts.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_CantS:
Hey, down in front!
I can't see the TV!
texts.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_MonFo:
Amazing! You're telling me a POKéMON
found someone's lost item?

That's something. If we had some smart
POKéMON like that…

We could recover anything that our
guests mislaid…
texts.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_Heard:
Oh, sorry, sorry!
I was too involved in watching TV!

I heard that someone busted
the TEAM AQUA HIDEOUT.

Thanks to that, we just booked
a reservation from a big group.

It was a company called… Uh…
GAME something…
texts.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_House:
Amazing! A house-sitting POKéMON
caught a burglar?

That's something. If we had a tough
POKéMON as a security guard…

We would be able to provide our guests
with greater safety.
texts.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_Bette:
Oh, sorry, sorry!
I was too involved in watching TV.

Oh, yes. A big group of guests arrived
a little while ago.

They booked in as GAME FREAK,
so I guess they must make games.

Uh-oh, I'd better get working on
their dinner!
texts.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ShowM:
I'm the GAME DESIGNER.

Oh, is that right?
You're working on a POKéDEX?

It's tough trying to complete it,
but don't give up.

If you do complete it, please come
show me.
texts.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_Fille:
Wow! That's awesome!
Yep, it's totally awesome!

This POKéDEX is completely filled!
You really must love POKéMON!

I'm so impressed!

Let me give you something in
recognition of your feat!
texts.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ImThe:
Me? You're talking to me?
I'm the PROGRAMMER.

I wonder what the SLOTS are
like here.

I'm the GRAPHIC ARTIST! Aren't the
POKéMON of HOENN interesting?
texts.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_Girls:
The girl TUBERS, they're cute, hey?
To battle against a cute TUBER…

Whoop, it's so awesome!

And the TWINS! Aren't they cute?
A 2-on-2 battle with TWINS…

Whoop, it's unbearably fun!
texts.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SeaBr:
The sea breeze tickles my heart.
It feels wonderful here!
texts.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_Never:
You never know when and where
people will challenge you.

That's why I never leave home without
my GAME BOY ADVANCE.
texts.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_Snooz:
SCOTT: … … … … …
… … … … … Zzz…

… … … … … Huh?!
Oh, sorry, sorry! I was snoozing!

I came to check out this POKéMON
CONTEST thing.

I have to admit, it does look quite
entertaining, but…

Consider me a purist--I prefer
battles and tough TRAINERS.

But that's just me.

{PLAYER}{KUN}, I hope you'll enjoy everything
like the GYMS, CONTESTS, BATTLE TENT,

the whole works!
texts.LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_Conte:
SCOTT: I think it does take strategy
to win a CONTEST.

Devising CONTEST strategies is one way
of becoming a better TRAINER, I'd say.
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text:
Don't they have set dates for their
clear-out sales?

I watch TV, but they never show any
commercials.

Yes! I've been waiting a long time for
this clear-out sale.

They have items that you can only get
here. I'm going to load up, that I am!

It's a VENDING MACHINE.
Which drink would you like?

Clang!

A can of {STR_VAR_1} dropped down.
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_IBu:
Whenever I come to the DEPARTMENT
STORE, I always end up buying all sorts

of things because it's so fun.
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Mom:
Today, my mom is going to buy me some
nice furniture.
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Buy:
I'm buying something for my AZUMARILL
as a reward for winning a CONTEST.
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Flo:
1F: SERVICE COUNTER
    LOTTERY CORNER

2F: TRAINER'S ZONE

3F: BATTLE COLLECTION

4F: TM CORNER

5F: POKé DOLL FLOOR

ROOFTOP: ROOFTOP PLAZA
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Wir:
Wireless Communication is a
lot of fun, isn't it?

I think it lets you do things that
weren't possible before.

For instance, you can now trade
with people you couldn't before.

I think it's going to be exciting!
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Spr:
I want to spread the word about how
fun Wireless Communication can be.
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_Lea:
Learn to use items properly.
That's basic, really.
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_Goo:
My husband is waiting at home.
What would make a good gift for him?
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_Sto:
I'm leaving on a long journey soon.
I need to stock up on items.
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Ite:
For quickly toughening up POKéMON,
items are the best.

PROTEIN boosts ATTACK,
and CALCIUM raises SP. ATK.
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Wan:
I want my POKéMON to have more
endurance.

I'm trying to decide whether to raise
DEFENSE with IRON, or SP. DEF with ZINC.
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Gav:
I gave a CARBOS to my POKéMON,
and its SPEED went up.
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_Att:
Hmm…

An attacking move…
Or a defensive move…

It's no easy matter to decide which TM
moves should be taught to POKéMON…
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_Fif:
There are so many different kinds of
TM moves.

A catalog I read said there are fifty
different kinds.
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_Pok:
I'd like to get all the different TMs,
but a POKéMON learns only four moves.
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Pla:
This place is full of cute DOLLS.

I should buy some for me, instead of
just for my children.
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Get:
I'm not big enough to raise POKéMON,
so I'm getting a cute DOLL instead.
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Sel:
They sell many cute MATS here.

I wonder which one I should get?
Maybe I'll buy them all…
texts.LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Clo:
I think they closed the rooftop
because the weather is wild today.
texts.LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_FerryUnavailabl:
I beg your pardon?
You're looking for a ship?

I'm sorry, the ferry service isn't
available at present…
texts.LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_MayISeeYourTick:
Hello, are you here for the ferry?
May I see your TICKET?
texts.LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_NoTicket:
{PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…

I'm terribly sorry.

You must have a TICKET to board
the ferry.
texts.LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_FlashTicketWher:
{PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.

Perfect! That's all you need!

And where would you like to go?
texts.LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailAnotherTime: Please sail with us another time!
texts.LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_PleaseBoard:
Please board the ferry and wait for
departure.
texts.LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_WhereWouldYouLi: Then, where would you like to go?
texts.LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryUnav:
Until they finish making the ferry,
we sailors have nothing to do…

I wish they'd get a move on, the folks
at the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT.
texts.LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryAvai:
The ferry S.S. TIDAL is finally in
operation.

The folks at the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT
must've worked extra hard.

Well, it's my turn to get busy now!
texts.LilycoveCity_House1_Text_PokemonPartners:
POKéMON are partners to people.
They aren't our tools.

Unfortunately, there are some people
who fail to understand that…
texts.LilycoveCity_House2_Text_NotAwakeYetHave:
Huh? What? What's that?

I'm not near awake yet…
You can have this…
texts.LilycoveCity_House2_Text_SleepIsEssentia:
Yawn…

Sleep is essential for good health…
Sleep and regain health…
texts.LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LearnFromMaster:
Oh, my, my! Are you traveling alone?
But you're so young! Good for you!

I'm sure my kids could learn a thing
or two from you!

Me? I'm a master of {POKEBLOCK}S.

If I get serious just a little, why,
I can concoct great {POKEBLOCK}S.

Would you like to learn from me,
a master of {POKEBLOCK}S?
texts.LilycoveCity_House3_Text_OhAreYouSure:
Oh? Are you sure?

You shouldn't always try to do
everything by yourself, dear!
texts.LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokebloc:
Oh, good! You're a smart soul!
This is a bit long, so listen up!

Are you ready?

If you look at {POKEBLOCK}S, you should see
that they are rated on how they feel.

The lower the feel rating,
the better it is. Don't forget this!

A good {POKEBLOCK} has a low feel
rating and a high level.

A POKéMON can eat more good
{POKEBLOCK}S than ordinary ones, too.

And this is important.

If you want to make smooth {POKEBLOCK}S,
use different kinds of BERRIES.

Don't be stingy--the kinds of BERRIES
affect the smoothness of {POKEBLOCK}S.

And another thing.

The more people blending BERRIES,
the smoother the {POKEBLOCK}S.

That's why you should talk to other
people and make {POKEBLOCK}S together.

That's about all you need to know to
make good {POKEBLOCK}S.

If everyone had POKéMON they love,
smooth {POKEBLOCK}S, and a loving family,

the world would be a happier place.

Don't give up, dear!
texts.LilycoveCity_House3_Text_HappyToHaveQuad:
When my wife gave birth to quadruplets,
you bet I was shocked.

But, now, seeing them play together,
it makes me happy.
texts.LilycoveCity_House3_Text_GoingToWinMulti:
We're having MULTI BATTLES, but I know
I'm going to win.
texts.LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LikeMixingAtRec:
We like mixing stuff at
the RECORD CORNER.

But what gets mixed up?
texts.LilycoveCity_House3_Text_MakePokeblocksW:
We're going to make super {POKEBLOCK}S
with a BERRY BLENDER!
texts.LilycoveCity_House3_Text_GoingToEnterCon:
I want to brag about how tough my
POKéMON is, so we're going to enter

a CONTEST together.
texts.LilycoveCity_House4_Text_MysteriesAtBott:
This planet's biggest mysteries are
at the bottom of the sea.

Somebody said that, but I don't know…
texts.LilycoveCity_House4_Text_UnderwaterTrenc:
There's a deep underwater trench
between MOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS.

That's what someone told me, anyway.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Welc:
Welcome to LILYCOVE MUSEUM.

Please take the time to enjoy our
collection of fantastic artwork

featuring POKéMON.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ImCu:
I'm the CURATOR of this MUSEUM of
fine arts.

It's heartening to see someone so
young as you in our MUSEUM.

Have you viewed our collection of
paintings already?
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_NotD:
Ah, then let me not disturb you.
Please, do take your time.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Have:
Oh? I do believe that you seem to
be a POKéMON TRAINER.

Have you an interest in paintings,
too?
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Hono:
I see…

I'm honored that you would visit
us in spite of that.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Exce:
Ah, excellent!
You do like paintings!

Then, may I ask you to come with me?
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Very:
It's a very old painting.
The paint is peeling here and there.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_OddL:
It's an odd landscape with bizarre
and fantastic scenery.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Pain:
It's a painting of a beautiful, smiling
woman with a POKéMON on her lap.

It's a painting of a legendary POKéMON
from long ago.

The artist painted this from
imagination.

It's a painting of GRASS POKéMON
swaying in a breeze.

They appear to be enjoying the wind's
gentle caress.

It's a delicious-looking painting
of BERRIES.

This painting could make you hungry!
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_Text_BirdPok:
It's a replica of a famous sculpture.

It depicts an ancient BIRD POKéMON.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_BigP:
It's a big POKé BALL carved from
a black stone.

It was apparently used in festivals
in the olden days.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Ston:
It's a huge stone tablet inscribed
with POKéMON and dense text in the

small characters of an ancient,

unreadable language.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Work:
Hmmm…
What works of great magnificence…
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Must:
Battling with POKéMON is fun,
I'll grant you that.

But one mustn't forget our love for
the fine arts.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_This:
This ART MUSEUM… Well, you could
see many fantastic paintings.

And the CURATOR is a wonderful person.

Among artists like myself, this MUSEUM
is an inspiration.

This lady is pretty!
She's like Mommy!

This POKéMON is adorable!
Just like our little boy!
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Hear:
I'd heard that this ART MUSEUM got
in some new paintings.

So, naturally I hurried over.

Are the new paintings up on
the second floor?
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Cura:
Lately, the CURATOR has been
unusually cheerful.

I bet something good happened for him.
Definitely.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_AimT:
I aim to see many great paintings
here and learn from them.

I have this dream of one day having
my artwork exhibited here.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Muse:
The ART MUSEUM has become a favorite
tourist destination.

It's great for LILYCOVE…
No, great for the HOENN region!

This is what I've heard--a lone TRAINER
procured all the paintings upstairs.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_This: This is our special exhibit hall.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Expl:
As you can plainly see, there is not
a single painting on exhibit.

Here, I don't wish to exhibit works of
so-called classical art.

Such classical works you can see on
our ground floor.

I wish to exhibit work that is far
different from the classics.

Art, after all, is not restricted to old,
famous works!

This exhibit hall, I wish to fill it with…

Modern and vibrant artworks of
POKéMON seemingly ready to spring

forth into glorious life!
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Plea:
I beg your pardon. I didn't intend
to monopolize the conversation.

Now, as you are young, and yet
obviously well traveled…

You must encounter lively POKéMON
and works of art depicting them.

If you were to come across such
a painting, may we ask you to obtain

the artist's permission to exhibit

it here?
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Wish:
I wish to fill this exhibit hall with
modern and vibrant paintings of

POKéMON.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Than:
Thanks to you, we've added a new
painting to our collection!

I've heard it depicts your POKéMON.
Truly magnificent!

Thank you so very, very much!
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Pain:
Isn't this marvelous?
This collection of paintings!

Each one of them flawless!
None better than another!

These paintings have attracted
more guests to our ART MUSEUM.

Sincerely, I thank you, {PLAYER}.
This is my dream come true!
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Toke: This is merely a token of my gratitude.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Keep:
I will keep this for you until we
meet again.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Hono:
Ah, so good to see you, {PLAYER}!

It's an honor to have you visit us
on your busy journeys.

Please, relax and do enjoy your
visit with us.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsP:
It's a picture frame with pink-colored
adornments.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsY:
It's a picture frame with
yellow-colored adornments.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsB:
It's a picture frame with
blue-colored adornments.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsR:
It's a picture frame with
red-colored adornments.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsG:
It's a picture frame with
green-colored adornments.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewP:
I've been away awhile, so the new
paintings up here surprised me.

I wish someone would paint my POKéMON
this pretty.

Well… So this is where they show
the topical POKéMON paintings.

I see, these new paintings are indeed
rather amusing.
texts.LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Thes:
Wow, is that right?
These paintings are of your POKéMON.

Isn't that just the ultimate joy for
a TRAINER?
texts.LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ICan:
Uh…
Oh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.

I can make POKéMON forget their moves.

Would you like me to do that?

texts.LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_:
Oh, wow!
It's {PLAYER}!

I've heard the news!
You're really strong, aren't you?

We always argue about who is the
strongest of all TRAINERS here.

So when I heard about you, I decided
to be your fan!

I hope you'll keep on battling other
tough TRAINERS.

That way, we'll be able to see more
of your hot, hot battles.

That will make the others here see
exactly how great you are.

Remember, I'm cheering for you,
{PLAYER}!

Yo, {PLAYER}!
You're the one we want to win!

The others, they don't know that
you're the best of the best!

Isn't that right, {PLAYER}?
Show them you've got guts!

I hate to say this, but the TRAINER
everybody's talking about is

{STR_VAR_1}, no question about it!

That TRAINER's power…
It's out of the ordinary.

Darn it… I've been telling people
that {STR_VAR_1} is the best now…

But no one wants to listen…

I've been hearing things about
a tough new TRAINER.

This TRAINER's supposed to be beating
GYM LEADERS, even.

Do you know anything about this
new TRAINER?

Oh!
{PLAYER}!

Go for it!
I'm pulling for you!

Sigh…
BRAWLY…

Oh, no! Wait!
That's not right! No, no, no!

I'm your fan through and through!

So make me proud!
Go for it!

I can't help it, I can only get to
like BRAWLY…

Nobody understands the charm of
BRAWLY…

I don't care!

Even if I'm the only one, I'm going
to keep cheering for BRAWLY!

Whatever anyone says, my favorite
TRAINER is DEWFORD's GYM LEADER

BRAWLY!

You've surpassed your own father in
every regard!

I'm telling you, so there's no question
about it at all!

Even when things turned bleak,
your father never gave up.

This I know to be true.

You never give up even if you lose!
So keep on battling!

NORMAN battled with more power,
charisma, and showmanship than you.

Even though people may say that
you're strong…

You've still got a long way to go
compared to your father.

You're beginning to get the same
air of awe NORMAN exudes.

But there's something conclusively
different between you and NORMAN.

I can't tell you what that is.
You'll have to find it yourself.

Everyone here, we're all huge fans
of POKéMON battles.

We discuss who we consider to be
the strongest of all TRAINERS.

If you were to become famous,
we might even become your fans!

Oh, woweee! It's {PLAYER}!
For real, too!

Please, shake my hand, shake my hand!

I'll always cheer for you, {PLAYER}!
Always, always!

I don't want to see you lose ever,
{PLAYER}.

Because I know you're really,
really strong, {PLAYER}!

{STR_VAR_1} is really cool…

Everyone thinks so, right, right?

{STR_VAR_1} really is cool, don't
you think so?

Even if it's just me, I'm going to keep
cheering my favorite TRAINER.

My favorite TRAINER is…

Cool…

Strong…

And really nice…

I wish there was a TRAINER like that…

Whoa! It's {PLAYER}!
Wicked!

When I grow up, I want to be strong
like you, {PLAYER}!

Even if I'm the only one…

You'll always be the only one
I cheer for, {PLAYER}!

Because I believe in you, {PLAYER}!

{STR_VAR_1} is so wickedly cool…
I want to shake hands with my hero.

Even if I'm the only one…

I'm never going to stop being
{STR_VAR_1}'s fan!

Because I've heard, {STR_VAR_1}
never loses!

{PLAYER}!
You are amazing after all!

Ever since I set eyes on you,
I knew that you were great.

It looks like my eyes didn't deceive me.

Who cares about the others.
I'm in your corner!

You don't need to worry. Just get
out there and battle like always.

You're a pretty decent TRAINER,
I think.

But I also think that {STR_VAR_1}
is number one right now.

That's just my opinion.
Don't worry about it too much.

Wow, you really are strong.
Maybe even stronger than {STR_VAR_1}.

But {STR_VAR_1} needs me.

If I don't cheer for {STR_VAR_1},
who will?

You've changed my mind!
You are strong, aren't you?

I'd like you to tell me how you managed
to get so strong!

The tougher the situation, the more
attractively you battle.

I can't wait for your next battle!

Among the recently hot TRAINERS,
{STR_VAR_1} is the standout.

That toughness, it's simply not normal.

You're doing okay, but you're not in
the same class as {STR_VAR_1}.

You are really popular…

You're strong, and you're caring to
POKéMON. No one can knock you.

But, you know, I believe in {STR_VAR_1}.

{STR_VAR_1} is definitely stronger!
I'm positive!

You…

Impressive!

Your true worth, it is fine if only
I recognized it.

The others I doubt will understand
the hidden power that beats within.

Yes, I see strength in your eyes.

But!

You still haven't realized your
potential.

It is true that you are tremendously
powerful.

But!
I can tell…

That strength cannot be considered
true strength yet!

True strength is…!
… …

Actually, I have no idea, either.

in the moving truck.

How do you like it?
This is our new home!

It has a quaint feel, but it seems to be
an easy place to live, don't you think?

Let's go inside.

introduce yourself to PROF. BIRCH?

Oh! What an adorable POKéMON!
You got it from PROF. BIRCH. How nice!

Here, honey! If you're going out on an
adventure, wear these RUNNING SHOES.

texts.LittlerootTown_Text_SwitchShoesWithRunni:
{PLAYER} switched shoes with the
RUNNING SHOES.

MOM: {PLAYER}, those shoes came with
instructions.

“Press the B Button while wearing these
RUNNING SHOES to run extra-fast!

“Slip on these RUNNING SHOES and race
in the great outdoors!”

… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …

To think that you have your very own
POKéMON now…

Your father will be overjoyed.

…But please be careful.

Go on, go get them, honey!
texts.LittlerootTown_Text_CanUsePCToStoreItems:
If you use a PC, you can store items
and POKéMON.

The power of science is staggering!

PROF. BIRCH spends days in his LAB
studying, then he'll suddenly go out in

the wild to do more research…

When does PROF. BIRCH spend time
at home?
texts.LittlerootTown_Text_IfYouGoInGrassPokemo:

If you go outside and go in the grass,
wild POKéMON will jump out!
texts.LittlerootTown_Text_DangerousIfYouDontHa:
It's dangerous if you don't have
your own POKéMON.

Um, hi!

There are scary POKéMON outside!
I can hear their cries!

I want to go see what's going on,
but I don't have any POKéMON…

Can you go see what's happening
for me?
texts.LittlerootTown_Text_YouSavedBirch:
You saved PROF. BIRCH!
I'm so glad!
texts.LittlerootTown_Text_GoodLuckCatchingPoke:
Are you going to catch POKéMON?
Good luck!

LITTLEROOT TOWN

I knew there was something special

MOM: See, {PLAYER}?
Isn't it nice in here, too?

The mover's POKéMON do all the work

Go set the clock in your room, honey.

Too bad.

MOM: Did you introduce yourself to

texts.PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DontPushYourselfToo:

… … …

I wonder where I should go catch

Wouldn't it be funny if we ran into each
other, {PLAYER}{KUN}?

There are still many POKéMON that
I need to catch, I know, but this

Checking this POKéDEX out gives me

Hunh? PROF. BIRCH?

The PROF's away on fieldwork.
Ergo, he isn't here.

Oh, let me explain what fieldwork is.

It is to study things in the natural
environment, like fields and mountains,

instead of a laboratory.

The PROF isn't one for doing desk work.
He's the type of person who would

rather go outside and experience

things than read about them here.

The PROF isn't one for doing desk work.
He's the type of person who would

rather go outside and experience

things than read about them here.

and distribution of POKéMON.

The PROF enjoys {RIVAL}'s help, too.

texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_L:
PROF. BIRCH: So, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

I've heard so much about you from
your father.

I've heard that you don't have your
own POKéMON yet.

But the way you battled earlier,
you pulled it off with aplomb!

I guess you have your father's blood
in your veins after all!

Oh, yes. As thanks for rescuing me,
I'd like you to have the POKéMON you

used earlier.

{PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}!
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_W:
PROF. BIRCH: While you're at it, why not
give a nickname to that {STR_VAR_1}?
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M:
PROF. BIRCH: If you work at POKéMON
and gain experience, I think you'll make

an extremely good TRAINER.

My kid, {RIVAL}, is also studying
POKéMON while helping me out.

{PLAYER}{KUN}, don't you think it might be
a good idea to go see {RIVAL}?
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_G:
PROF. BIRCH: Great!
{RIVAL} should be happy, too.

Get {RIVAL} to teach you what it
means to be a TRAINER.
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_D:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, don't be that way.
You should go meet my kid.
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B:

Gone home, I think.

in tall grass again somewhere…

If you or your POKéMON get tired,
you should get some rest at home.
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_H:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

I heard you beat {RIVAL} on
your first try. That's excellent!

{RIVAL}'s been helping with my research
for a long time.

{RIVAL} has an extensive history as
a TRAINER already.

Here, {PLAYER}{KUN}, I ordered this for my
research, but I think you should have

this POKéDEX.

tool that automatically makes a record

of any POKéMON you meet or catch.

My kid, {RIVAL}, goes everywhere
with it.

Whenever my kid catches a rare POKéMON
and records its data in the POKéDEX,

why, {RIVAL} looks for me while I'm out

doing fieldwork, and shows me.
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_C:
PROF. BIRCH: Countless POKéMON
await you!

Argh, I'm getting the itch to get out
and do fieldwork again!

You got a POKéDEX, too!

I'll give you these.

I'm going to explore all over the place

I'll try to get them with POKé BALLS.
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B:

Better not mess around with it.
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_C: It's crammed with books on POKéMON.
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B: It's a book that's too hard to read.
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_O:
PROF. BIRCH: Now…

{PLAYER}{KUN} and {RIVAL}, I've had the two
of you help me study POKéMON.

Thanks to your help, new facts
are coming to light.

It appears that in the HOENN region,
there are also POKéMON from other

regions.

It goes to show how rich and varied
the natural environments of HOENN

happen to be.

That's why I think it's necessary for
me to upgrade your POKéDEX to

the NATIONAL Mode.

Here, let me see your POKéDEX units.
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M:
MAY: Eheheh!

It's so cool that even my POKéDEX
is getting updated!

It's because you went out and caught
so many POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B:
BRENDAN: I went out all over HOENN
and checked out POKéMON.

You can thank me for getting
the NATIONAL Mode POKéDEX.

Yep, you're lucky, {PLAYER}!
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_P:
{PLAYER}'s POKéDEX was upgraded
to the NATIONAL Mode!
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_G:
PROF. BIRCH: But listen.
You've become the CHAMPION,

but your POKéMON journey isn't over.

There is no end to the road
that is POKéMON.

Somewhere, there is a grassy patch
that's waiting for you!
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M:
MAY: I think I'll take a short break
from fieldwork.

I think I'll help the PROF here for
a while.
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B:
BRENDAN: For the time being,
I'm taking a break from fieldwork.

I'll be helping out the PROF here
for a while.
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_C:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Let's have a look at your POKéDEX.

… … … … … …
… … … … … …

Yes, there's no doubt about it.

You really have completed the HOENN
region's POKéDEX.

That's more than just impressive.

I have a gift for you.

Consider it my show of appreciation
for the fantastic work you've done.

My gift is a rare POKéMON only found
in another region!

You can have any one of these
three POKéMON!

PROF. BIRCH: These are rare POKéMON
only found in another region!

You can have any one of these
three POKéMON!
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_Y:
PROF. BIRCH: The FIRE POKéMON
CYNDAQUIL caught your eye!

You're as sharp as ever!

So the CYNDAQUIL is your choice?

PROF. BIRCH: The WATER POKéMON
TOTODILE is your choice!

You know how to pick a good one.

So, you'll take the TOTODILE?

PROF. BIRCH: The GRASS POKéMON
CHIKORITA is your choice!

You sure know what you're doing.

So, you'll take the CHIKORITA?
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_T:
PROF. BIRCH: Take your time before
you decide.

They're all invaluable POKéMON.
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_P:
PROF. BIRCH: I see!
You picked a fine POKéMON!
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_N:
Want to give a nickname to
the {STR_VAR_1} you received?
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_G:
PROF. BIRCH: Listen, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
You've completed the HOENN POKéDEX,

but your POKéMON journey isn't over.

There is no end to the road
that is POKéMON.

Somewhere, there is a grassy patch
that's waiting for you!
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B:
You received the promised POKéMON.
Better leave the others alone.
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_D:
Oh, you don't have any room for
this POKéMON.
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, after this…
What are you going to do?

Are you going to keep battling
and sharpening your skills?

Or are you going to try filling
the NATIONAL POKéDEX?

I'm staying here to help the PROF.
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B:
BRENDAN: Rather than collecting
POKéMON, I prefer slowly and 

steadily raising the one I chose.
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M:
MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Have you gone to that place,

the BATTLE FRONTIER?
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B:
BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}!
Have you gone out to that place,

the BATTLE FRONTIER?
texts.LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_S:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!

SCOTT: Hi, hi, {PLAYER}!
It's me, SCOTT.

I'm aboard the S.S. TIDAL now.
It feels great to be on the sea!

By the way…

There's this place that I'd like to
invite you to for a visit.

If you're interested, board a ferry
at either SLATEPORT or LILYCOVE.

I'll fill you in on the details when
we meet. I'll be waiting!

… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!
texts.MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro:
When TEAM MAGMA has roll call, we get
important guarding assignments in

the order that we line up.

That's why I'm stuck off in this corner.
I'm always late to roll call!
texts.MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat:
I'm always late for training sessions,
too!

I hate to say it, but I'm wimpy…
texts.MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle:
Okay, I'll try to put a little more
effort into things from now on…
texts.MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro:
Our leader told us to dig into
MT. CHIMNEY, so we dug and dug.

And in the course of digging, we came
across something that blew our minds!

What did we find?

Fuhahaha!
I'll tell you if you beat me!
texts.MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle:
I won't tell you after all.
You'll find out when you get there!

It'd be better if you saved surprises
to the end, don't you think?
texts.MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Intro:
What, what, what?

Only TEAM MAGMA members are supposed
to be in here!

But you're not dressed in TEAM MAGMA's
uniform…

You rouse my suspicion!
Battle with me!
texts.MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Defeat:
Aiyiyi…
My pride as a TEAM MAGMA member…
texts.MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14PostBattl:
If you suffer from chills, you should
join TEAM MAGMA.
texts.MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3Intro:
Hold it right there!

You don't really expect me to keep
my trap shut and let you waltz by me?
texts.MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3PostBattle:
Maybe it would've been better if I did
just let you go unchallenged…
texts.MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4PostBattle:
I've already lost.

Do I really need to keep running
around in a circle?
texts.MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5PostBattle: Actually, I'm no expert at battling…
texts.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15Intro:
I don't have a bone to pick with you.
I'm just following orders!
texts.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15PostBattl:
We dug up something beyond belief!
And, we got the BLUE ORB!

All that's left is for our leader to…
Fufufu… Fwahahaha!
texts.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Intro:
I can't stand heat. Maybe I should've
joined TEAM AQUA instead…
texts.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Defeat:
Yeah, I really may not be right for
TEAM MAGMA…
texts.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6PostBattle:
Don't you get lonely for the sea
being in a place like this?
texts.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Intro:
You can hear tremors here sometimes.

Could it be the volcano rattling?
Or is it GROU…

Whoops!
No, no, never mind!
texts.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Defeat:
You're a fiery battler.
Just like a volcano!
texts.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7PostBattle:
You just happened to win this time,
but that doesn't matter.

TEAM MAGMA's goal is about to be
reached!
texts.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Intro:
One of our guys was freaking out that
he lost his MAGMA EMBLEM…

Wait a minute!
Was it you who found it?
texts.MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8PostBattle:
I'm getting this feeling that our plan
is going to end in failure…
texts.MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9Intro:
What did I do to deserve this guard
posting?

My left ear is burning up!
texts.MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9PostBattle:
Do you think it's odd that we're wearing
hoods in this magma-filled volcano?
texts.MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Intro:
We joined so we can help our leader
achieve his fantastic vision.

I don't care if you're with TEAM AQUA
or if you're just some kid passing by.

No one interferes with us and gets
away with it!
texts.MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Defeat:
Oh, no!
You're not to be trusted at all!
texts.MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16PostBattl:
Listen to me.
TEAM MAGMA is right!

Don't listen to TEAM AQUA.
Don't believe their lies!
texts.MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Intro:
I understand everything our leader
says. But you know what?

Doing stuff like digging up a super-
ancient POKéMON and ripping off

someone's METEORITE…

I think we're going a little too far.
What do you think?
texts.MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Defeat:
Yeah, I think we are doing something
wrong somehow.
texts.MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10PostBattl:
You know, losing to you cleared my mind.

The next time I see our leader,
I'm going to ask him about what we do.
texts.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Intro:
I want to see GROUDON, too, but they
won't let me see even its tail…

It's got me feeling really frustrated.

Oh, no!
I blabbed about GROUDON!
texts.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Defeat:
I guess it's impossible to win if one
doesn't have a calm mind…
texts.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11PostBattle: I wonder if GROUDON even has a tail?
texts.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Intro:
Fuhahaha!
Soon! Very soon!

Our grand objective will be achieved!
texts.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Defeat:
Grrr…
I've come so far, but now this?
texts.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12PostBattle:
MAXIE, sir!
An intruder is headed your way!
texts.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Intro:
You're not finished yet!
You're not getting by me easily!
texts.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Defeat: Was I that easy to knock down?
texts.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaIntro:
Hehehe!
You made it this far, so I'll tell you!

That's right!
Up ahead, GROUDON is sleeping!

MAXIE went to GROUDON just seconds
ago!

It's going to awaken real soon!
Hehe! Hehehe!
texts.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaPostBattle:
…And while you wasted time with me,
MAXIE should have awakened GROUDON…
texts.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon:
MAXIE: GROUDON…

Nothing could awaken you from your
sleep bathed in magma…

This BLUE ORB is what you sought.
Wasn't it?

I have brought you the BLUE ORB.
Let its shine awaken you!

And show me…
Show me the full extent of your power!
texts.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieGroudonWhatsWr:
MAXIE: GROUDON!
What's wrong?

Wasn't the BLUE ORB the key?

GROUDON!
Where have you gone…
texts.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieOhItWasYou:
MAXIE: Oh, so it was you?

I've seen you poking around uninvited
here and there…

I get it now!
You must have pulled a cheap stunt!
texts.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieDefeat:
What makes you so adept at handling
POKéMON?
texts.MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGr:
MAXIE: There has to be some reason
why GROUDON fled…

That's what you're trying to say,
aren't you?

… … … … … …
… … … … … …

Humph…
You think I didn't know that?

With GROUDON gone, there is no longer
any need for this blasted volcano.

I am going after GROUDON, so this
is where we part!
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_UncleHesTooPeppy:
UNCLE: It's because of POKéMON that
this boy's got more pep, I suppose…

But he's become a bit too peppy…
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWantToChallengeGy:
WALLY: Aww, UNCLE, please?

I want to challenge this GYM and see
how much better I've become.

Please? May I, please?
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_UncleYourePushingIt:
UNCLE: Now hold on, WALLY.

Since you started living with POKéMON,
you have grown quite a lot stronger.

But don't you think you're pushing it
to suddenly challenge a GYM?
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWeCanBeatAnyone:
WALLY: I'm not pushing it.

If I combine forces with RALTS,
we can beat anyone!
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWillYouBattleMe:
WALLY: Oh! Hi, {PLAYER}!

I've gotten a lot stronger since
we met.

{PLAYER}, I want you and my UNCLE to
understand that.

{PLAYER}, please, will you have
a battle with me?
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_WallyMyUncleWontKnowIm:
WALLY: Oh… If you won't battle me,
{PLAYER}, my UNCLE won't know that I've

become really strong.
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_UncleCanYouBattleWally:
UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, was it?
On WALLY's behalf, can I ask you to

battle with him just this once?

I don't think he's going to listen to
any reason the way he is now.
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPleaseBattleMe:
WALLY: {PLAYER}, please!
Battle with me, please.
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_WallyHereICome:
WALLY: {PLAYER}, thank you.

Okay… Here I come!
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_WallyIllGoBackToVerdan:
WALLY: UNCLE…
I'll go back to VERDANTURF…
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_ThankYouNotEnoughToBat:
{PLAYER}, thank you.
Being a TRAINER is tough, isn't it?

It's not enough just to have POKéMON
and make them battle. That isn't what

being a real TRAINER is about.
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_UncleNoNeedToBeDown:
UNCLE: WALLY, there's no need to be so
down on yourself.

Why, what's keeping you from becoming
stronger and stronger?

Come on, let's go home.
Everyone's waiting for you.
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_UncleVisitUsSometime:
UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, it just dawned on me
that you must be the TRAINER who kept

an eye out for WALLY when he caught

his POKéMON.

Why don't you visit us in VERDANTURF
sometime?

I'm sure WALLY would enjoy it.
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPokenavCall:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!

WALLY: Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!

I just wanted to tell you that
my uncle bought me a POKéNAV!

Now I can get in touch with you
anytime, {PLAYER}!

… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack:
SCOTT: Hehe…
I was watching that match!

You're friends with that boy WALLY,
aren't you?

But you didn't hold anything back
and beat him impressively.

Yeah! That's what a real POKéMON
battle is all about!

I idolize TRAINERS like that!

… … … … … …
I'll be cheering for you!
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKe:
WATTSON: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You look like you have a lot of zip!

That's a good thing, wahahahaha!

Fine! I've decided!
I need a favor, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

MAUVILLE CITY has an underground
sector called NEW MAUVILLE.

{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'd like you to go there and
switch off the GENERATOR.

The GENERATOR has been running a bit
haywire. It's getting unsafe.

Here, this is the KEY to get into
NEW MAUVILLE.
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonWontBeChallenge:
WATTSON: Don't you worry about it.
It won't be a challenge to you.

The entrance to NEW MAUVILLE is just
a short SURF away from ROUTE 110.

That's it, then, you have my trust!
Wahahahaha!
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonThanksTakeTM:
WATTSON: Wahahahaha!

I knew it, {PLAYER}{KUN}! I knew I'd made
the right choice asking you!

This is my thanks--a TM containing
THUNDERBOLT!

Go on, you've earned it!
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonYoungTakeCharge:
WATTSON: Wahahahaha!

It pleases me to no end to see
the young step up and take charge!
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_NurseHurtMonBackToHeal:
You know, it's cool to have POKéMON
battles and stuff…

But if your POKéMON gets hurt,
you have to nurse it back to health.
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_AllSortsOfPeopleComeTh:
The roads of this town stretch north
and south, and east and west.

Because of that, we get all sorts of
people coming through.
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_RydelVeryGenerous:
Have you been to RYDEL'S CYCLES yet?

RYDEL, the owner, is a very generous
man.
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_PokemonCanJumpYouOnBik:
Even if you're riding a BIKE,
wild POKéMON could jump you.
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_CitySign:
MAUVILLE CITY
“The bright and shiny city of fun!”
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_GymSign:
MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM
LEADER: WATTSON

“The cheerfully electrifying man!”
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_BikeShopSign:
“Ride in gravel and shake up your
soul!”

RYDEL'S CYCLES
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_GameCornerSign:
“The play spot for all!”
MAUVILLE GAME CORNER
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_ExplainTV:
Hi, do you check out TV at all?

They've added a bunch of cool new
shows recently.

TV is so cool. I've seen my friends on
TV just out of the blue.

And, sometimes, they even put you on TV
without telling you.

I wish I would be on TV sometime.

That's why I think you should check
out TVs whenever you can.
texts.MauvilleCity_Text_BeenCheckingOutTV: Hi, have you been checking out TVs?
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_RydelGreeting:
Well, well, what have we here?
A most energetic customer!

Me? You may call me RYDEL.
I'm the owner of this cycle shop.
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_DidYouComeFro:
RYDEL: Your RUNNING SHOES…
They're awfully filthy.

Did you come from far away?
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_GuessYouDontN:
RYDEL: Is that right?

Then, I guess you have no need for
any of my BIKES.
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesC:
RYDEL: Hm, hm… … … … …

You're saying that you came all this
way from LITTLEROOT?

My goodness!
That's ridiculously far!

If you had one of my BIKES, you could
go anywhere easily while feeling the

gentle caress of the wind!

I'll tell you what!
I'll give you a BIKE!

Oh, wait a second!

I forgot to tell you that there are
two kinds of BIKES!

They are the MACH BIKE and
the ACRO BIKE!

The MACH BIKE is for cyclists who want
to feel the wind with their bodies!

And an ACRO BIKE is for those who
prefer technical rides!

I'm a real sweetheart, so you can
have whichever one you like!

Which one will you choose?
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ComeBackToSwi:
RYDEL: If you get the urge to switch
BIKES, just come see me!
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_WantToSwitchB:
RYDEL: Oh? Were you thinking about
switching BIKES?
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_IllSwitchBike:
RYDEL: Okay, no problem!
I'll switch BIKES for you!
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedMach:
{PLAYER} got the MACH BIKE exchanged
for an ACRO BIKE.
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedAcro:
{PLAYER} got the ACRO BIKE exchanged
for a MACH BIKE.
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HappyYouLikeI:
RYDEL: Good, good!
I'm happy that you like it!
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsI:
Oh? What happened to that BIKE
I gave you?

Oh, I get it, you stored it using your PC.

Well, take it out of PC storage,
and I'll be happy to exchange it!

May the wind always be at your back
on your adventure!
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HandbooksAreI:
I'm learning about BIKES while
I work here.

If you need advice on how to ride your
BIKE, there're a couple handbooks in

the back.
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_MachHandbookW:
It's a handbook on the MACH BIKE.

Which page do you want to read?
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMach:
A BIKE moves in the direction that
the + Control Pad is pressed.

It will speed up once it gets rolling.

To stop, release the + Control Pad.
The BIKE will slow to a stop.

Want to read a different page?
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMach:
A MACH BIKE is speedy, but it can't
stop very quickly.

It gets a little tricky to get around
a corner.

Release the + Control Pad a little
before the corner and slow down.

Want to read a different page?
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes:
There are small sandy slopes
throughout the HOENN region.

The loose, crumbly sand makes it
impossible to climb normally.

But if you have a MACH BIKE, you can
zip up a sandy slope.

Want to read a different page?
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_AcroHandbookW:
It's a handbook on the ACRO BIKE.

Which page do you want to read?
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies:
Press the B Button while riding,
and the front wheel lifts up.

You can zip around with the front
wheel up using the + Control Pad.

This technique is called a wheelie.

Want to read a different page?
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops:
Keeping the B Button pressed,
your BIKE can hop on the spot.

This technique is called a bunny hop.

You can ride while hopping, too.

Want to read a different page?
texts.MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps:
Press the B Button and the + Control
Pad at the same time to jump.

Press the + Control Pad to the side
to jump sideways.

Press it backwards to make the BIKE
change directions while jumping.

Want to read a different page?
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCas:
Okay, you wanted some COINS for
the games?

But you don't have a COIN CASE for
stowing the COINS.
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_WereYouLook:
Were you looking for COINS?

It's ¥1000 for 50 COINS.
Would you like some?
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ThankYouHer:
Thank you very much!
Here are your COINS!
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontHaveEno:
Um… You don't appear to have
enough money…
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinCaseIsF:
Oh?
Your COIN CASE is full.
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontNeedCoi:
Oh… You don't need COINS, then?
Good luck on your adventure!
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ExchangeCoi:
Welcome.

You can exchange your COINS for
prizes here.
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SendToYourH:
Thank you!
We'll send it to your PC at home.
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NoRoomForPl:
There isn't any room available for
placing {STR_VAR_1}.
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_OhIsThatSo:
Oh, is that so? 
You need to save some COINS before

coming back here.
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantCarryAn: Oh, you can't carry any more than that.
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_GotTwoOfSam:
I made a mistake and got two of
the same DOLLS.

Would you like one of them?
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_YouWantItBu:
Huh?
You want it, but not right now?
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontBeNegat:
Oh, don't be so negative!
You can have this!
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantWinJack:
There's a prize I want, but I can't win
the jackpot.
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCas:
Hey, kid, if you want to play here,
you need a COIN CASE.

I think the young lady next door
had one. Go see her!
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_LuckOnlyLas:
My luck can only last so long.
This is too much for me.

Here, take some COINS!
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_MauvilleSom:
MAUVILLE has something for
everyone.

For me, it's the GAME CORNER.
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteTab:
The ROULETTE tables have different
rates.

Check your COINS if you're going to
pick a table.
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_EasyToLoseT:
It's easy to lose track of time in here. 
I should get back to work.
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinsAreNee:
COINS are needed to play here
in the GAME CORNER.
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteOnl:
This ROULETTE thing…
It's rather demanding.

Win or lose, it's only by luck.
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_UpTo3CoinsC:
Up to three COINS can be used to play
the SLOTS.
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DifficultTo:
It's very difficult to make it stop
right on “7.”

If it stops on “7” during the REEL TIME
bonus game, you'll receive extra COINS.
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HeresSomeSl:
Here's some information for you
about the SLOTS.

The more lightning bolts you stock,
the more REEL TIME chances you get.

In a game with the maximum five
REEL TIME chances…

It is possible to receive four regular
bonuses, then a big bonus.

That would total 660 COINS, but it's
very difficult to get.
texts.MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantPlayWit:
You can't play if you don't have
a COIN CASE.
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?

WATTSON, the LEADER of MAUVILLE
GYM, uses ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.

If you challenge him with WATER-type
POKéMON, he'll zap them! Bzzt!

And, he's put in switch-controlled
doors all over his GYM! Eccentric!

Hey, go for it!
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictor:
Whoa, you're electrifying!
You've powered the door open!
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro:
My electric soul, it'll shatter your
dreams whole, whoa-yeahah!
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkDefeat:
That was plugged in, amped up,
over-driven electric, man!
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle:
POKéMON and rock, it's all about heart,
whoa-yeah!
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro:
I trained under WATTSON!
There ain't no way I'll lose easily!
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle:
WATTSON, our GYM LEADER, has been
around for a long, long time.

He was battling even before your
daddy was born, that tough coot.
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenIntro:
This GYM's got puzzles!
Isn't it fun?
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenPostBattle:
WATTSON says he likes setting up
little traps with switches.
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianIntro:
With my charm and my POKéMON's moves,
you'll be shocked!
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianPostBattle:
I've heard that MAUVILLE was founded
by WATTSON.

He was a TRAINER long before we
became TRAINERS.

He must know all sorts of things!
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloPostBattle:
MAUVILLE GYM's WATTSON has a shiny
forehead. It makes me happy!
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro:
I've given up on my plans to convert
the city, I have.

And so, I put my time into making
door traps in my GYM.

Oh? Now, what are you doing here?

What's that? You say you've gotten
past all my rigged doors?

Wahahahah!
Now, that is amusing!

Then, I, WATTSON, the LEADER of
MAUVILLE GYM, shall electrify you!
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonDefeat:
Wahahahah!
Fine, I lost!

You ended up giving me a thrill!
Take this BADGE!
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedDynamoBadg:
{PLAYER} received the DYNAMO BADGE
from WATTSON.
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainDynamoBadge:
With the DYNAMO BADGE, POKéMON can
use ROCK SMASH out of battle.

And, it will make your POKéMON a little
