bit faster, too.

Hmm…
You should take this, too!
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainShockWave:
That TM34 there contains SHOCK WAVE.

It's a trustworthy move that never
misses! You can count on it!

… … … … … …
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWattson:
Registered GYM LEADER WATTSON
in the POKéNAV.
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostBattle:
I swell with optimism, seeing a promising
young TRAINER like you!
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonGoForthAndE:
Wahahahah!
Go forth and endeavor, youngster!
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPreRematch:
WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last!
I know what you want.

You want to battle my POKéMON!

Wahahahaha!

I'll make sparks fly from you!
Don't say I didn't warn you!
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostRematch:
WATTSON: We'll have to recharge our
batteries again.

When we're fully charged up, we'll
gladly accept your challenge.

So, come back again sometime,
won't you?
texts.MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchNeed:
WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last!
I know what you want.

You want to battle my POKéMON!

Wahahahaha!

Oops! Wait!
You've only one POKéMON with you!

Come see me with two or more
POKéMON, all right?
texts.MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ImRockSmashDude:
Woohoo!

I hear people call me the ROCK SMASH
GUY, but I find that sort of degrading.

I think I deserve a bit more respect,
like maybe the ROCK SMASH DUDE.

Woohoo!

Anyways, your POKéMON look pretty
strong.

I like that!
Here, take this HIDDEN MACHINE!
texts.MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ExplainRockSmas:
That HM contains ROCK SMASH.

If you come across large boulders
that block your path…

Well, use that HM move and smash
them right out of your way!

Yes, sir! Smash rocks aside, I say!
Woohoo!
texts.MauvilleCity_House1_Text_MonCanFlyOutOfS:
Oh, yes, if you smash a rock, a POKéMON
could come flying out of hiding.

Woohoo!
texts.MauvilleCity_House2_Text_BuyHarborMailAt:
If I had a BIKE, it'd be easy to cycle to
SLATEPORT for some shopping.

I'd be able to buy HARBOR MAIL at the
POKéMON MART in SLATEPORT…
texts.MauvilleCity_House2_Text_TradeHarborMail:
Oh! You have HARBOR MAIL?
Will you trade it for a COIN CASE?
texts.MauvilleCity_House2_Text_IllTradeYouCoin:
Oh, I'm so happy!
Okay, I'll trade you a COIN CASE!
texts.MauvilleCity_House2_Text_UseCoinCaseAtGa:
That COIN CASE can be used
at the GAME CORNER.
texts.MauvilleCity_House2_Text_ThatsDisappoint:
Oh, that's disappointing.

A COIN CASE is needed for the
GAME CORNER.
texts.MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_ItemsToTemporaril:
There are items that temporarily
elevate the stats of POKéMON.

The ones I know you use in battle
are X ATTACK and X DEFEND…

I do believe that there are others
like them.
texts.MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_DecisionsDetermin:
Use a certain move, or use an item
instead…

The TRAINER's decisions determine how
battles turn out, I think.
texts.MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManOv:
That man over there, he says weird
things!

He's funny in a weird way.
I doubt I'll forget about him!
texts.MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MyDat:
When I accessed the RECORD CORNER,
the data for what's hot in DEWFORD

got updated.

Now that bit of data is the same
as my friend's!
texts.MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Recor:
A RECORD CORNER opened upstairs in
the POKéMON CENTER.

I don't know what it's about, but it
sounds fun. I'll go check it out!
texts.MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_2F_Text_Young:
Did you know that you can link battle
at the COLOSSEUM here?

They put up your record on the wall
for everyone to see.

It's embarrassing if you lose more
often than you win…
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WithThisMeteorite:
Hehehe!

With this METEORITE, that thing in
MT. CHIMNEY will…
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_DontExpectMercyFr:
Heh?

I don't know who you are, but if you get
in the way of TEAM MAGMA, don't

expect any mercy!
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_HoldItRightThereM:
Hold it right there, TEAM MAGMA!

You're badly mistaken if you think you
can have your way with the world!
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAq:
Hehehe!
Even TEAM AQUA joins us!

But it's too much trouble to deal with
you all…

Heh, it doesn't matter!

We've got the METEORITE, so off to
MT. CHIMNEY we go!

Hehehe! Be seeing you, you TEAM
AQUA dingbats!
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefo:
ARCHIE: Didn't I see you before?
At SLATEPORT's MUSEUM?

Ah, so your name is {PLAYER}.

At the time, I thought you were one
of TEAM MAGMA's goons.

Humph…
You're one odd kid.

TEAM MAGMA is a dangerous group of
total fanatics.

They engage in destruction, claiming
to expand the land mass.

They are the rivals to us,
the sea-loving TEAM AQUA!
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BossWeShouldChase:
BOSS, we should give chase to
TEAM MAGMA…
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieYesNoTellin:
ARCHIE: Yes, yes, we must!
We've got to hurry.

There's no telling what TEAM MAGMA
will do at MT. CHIMNEY!
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieFarewell:
ARCHIE: {PLAYER}, you should keep
an eye out for TEAM MAGMA, too.

Farewell!
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo:
I… I'm COZMO…
I'm a PROFESSOR…

TEAM MAGMA asked me to guide them
to METEOR FALLS…

But they tricked me.
They even took my METEORITE away…

And then another similar bunch,
TEAM AQUA showed up.

After that…
I don't understand any of it.

But that TEAM MAGMA…

What are they going to do with that
METEORITE at MT. CHIMNEY?
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WhatsTeamMagmaDoi:
PROF. COZMO: But that TEAM MAGMA…

What are they going to do with that
METEORITE at MT. CHIMNEY?
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasIntro:
This is where we DRAGON users do our
training.

The CHAMPION even visits.
Now do you see how special it is here?
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasDefeat:
Urgh!
I didn't expect you to be so strong!
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostBattle:
The road ahead remains long and harsh.

When will my POKéMON and I become
the best?
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRegister:
I want to know more about your power.
Let me register you in my POKéNAV.
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchInt:
Since we met, we have trained hard
with our sights on number one.

Help us see how much stronger we've
become!
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchDef:
Urgh!
I didn't expect you to be so strong!
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostRematc:
You've obviously kept up your
POKéMON training.

So long as you remain strong, I, too,
can become stronger!
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnIntro:
JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON
together as a twosome.

We've confidence in ourselves.
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnDefeat:
JOHN: Oh, my.
We've lost, dear wife.
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostBattle:
JOHN: We've been married for
fifty years.

Come to think of it, I've yet to beat
my dear wife in a battle.
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnNotEnoughMons:
JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER!

Will you battle with us? If so, you'll
have to return with more POKéMON.
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRegister:
JOHN: Young TRAINER, if the chance
arises, will you battle with us again?
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayIntro:
JAY: We've been married for
fifty years.

The bond we share as a couple could
never be broken.
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayDefeat:
JAY: Oh, dear.
We've lost, my dear husband.
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostBattle:
JAY: Fifty years of marriage…

If we ever argued, we always settled
it with a POKéMON battle…
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayNotEnoughMons:
JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young
TRAINER?

If you'd care to battle with us, you'll
have to come back with more POKéMON.
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchIntro:
JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON
together as a twosome.

We've confidence in ourselves.
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchDefeat:
JOHN: Oh, my.
We've lost, dear wife.
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostRematch:
JOHN: Married for fifty years…

On reflection, the dear wife and I,
we battled day in and day out…
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchNotEno:
JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER!

Will you battle with us? If so, you'll
have to return with more POKéMON.
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchIntro:
JAY: We've been married for
fifty years.

We've supported each other all that
time. We've made ourselves strong.
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchDefeat:
JAY: Oh, dear.
We've lost, my dear husband.
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostRematch:
JAY: Fifty years of marriage…
Many things have happened.

I hope that we will continue to make
happy memories together.
texts.MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchNotEnou:
JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young
TRAINER?

If you'd care to battle with us, you'll
have to come back with more POKéMON.
texts.MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_ShouldKnowH:
STEVEN: Oh, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
I'm amazed you knew where to find me.

Do you, uh…maybe think of me as
just a rock maniac?

No, that can't be right.

We battled alongside each other at
the SOOTOPOLIS SPACE CENTER.

You should have a very good idea
about how good I am.

Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, if you're going to mount
a serious challenge, expect the worst!
texts.MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_StevenDefea:
You…
I had no idea you'd become so strong…
texts.MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_MyPredictio:
STEVEN: Come to think of it, ever since
our paths first crossed in GRANITE

CAVE in DEWFORD, I had this feeling.

I thought that you would eventually
become the CHAMPION.

My predictions usually come true.

And where will you go from here?

… … … … … …
… … … … … …

Fufufu, even I couldn't tell you that.
texts.MirageTower_4F_Text_TakeRootFossil:
You found the ROOT FOSSIL.

If this FOSSIL is taken, the ground
around it will likely crumble away…

Take the ROOT FOSSIL anyway?
texts.MirageTower_4F_Text_TakeClawFossil:
You found the CLAW FOSSIL.

If this FOSSIL is taken, the ground
around it will likely crumble away…

Take the CLAW FOSSIL anyway?
texts.MossdeepCity_Text_WantKingsRockStevenGav:
I got this from STEVEN, but I don't
know what it's good for.

I think it's called KING'S ROCK.
Do you want it?
texts.MossdeepCity_Text_YouCanKeepIt:
Why would you want it?
You're weird.

You can keep it, but keep it a secret
from STEVEN.
texts.MossdeepCity_Text_StevensHouseOverThere: STEVEN's house is right over there!
texts.MossdeepCity_Text_WhatToDoWithWeirdRock:
Yeah, you think so, too! What are you
supposed to do with some weird rock?
texts.MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching:
Around MOSSDEEP, you can see wild
WAILMER.

It's called, uh…
What was it now…

WAI, WAI, WAI…

WAILMER watching!
texts.MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterReceivedLet:
The island's SPACE CENTER has been
launching huge rockets.

There's been some kind of an uproar
over a letter they received recently.
texts.MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterLaunchingRo:
The island's SPACE CENTER has been
launching huge rockets.
texts.MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagm:
I heard from a SAILOR buddy that
TEAM AQUA set up shop in LILYCOVE.

I also heard that someone came along
and wiped the floor with them!

But MOSSDEEP here's been targeted
by that TEAM MAGMA.

If you want to know what they're up to,
go visit the SPACE CENTER.
texts.MossdeepCity_Text_FeelReliefOnLand:
I'm a SAILOR, so the sea's obviously
more important to me.

But you know? When I get back on land
after a long voyage, I do feel relief!
texts.MossdeepCity_Text_NiceIfWorldCoveredByFl:
Wouldn't it be nice?

If the whole world was covered in
plants and flowers like this island?
texts.MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive:
All life needs the sea to live, even
though it makes its home on the land.

Life, having run its course, becomes
soil and returns to the land.

And the sea is always connected to
the land.

Yes, like the very shoreline here.
texts.MossdeepCity_Text_SurfExhilarating:
A voyage on a ship is fine.

But crossing the sea with POKéMON
using SURF…

Now that's an exhilarating trip!
Wouldn't you agree, youngster?
texts.MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock:
This rock has a special meaning to
the people at the SPACE CENTER.

They put it here as their wish for
their rockets to fly safely.

When you make a wish, what do you use?
Do you wish upon a star?

I use a wish tag to make it happen.
That's what I do.
texts.MossdeepCity_Text_GymSign:
MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM
LEADERS: LIZA & TATE

“The mystic combination!”
texts.MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterSign:
MOSSDEEP SPACE CENTER
“The closest place to space.”
texts.MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWit:
SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, feeling good?
I'm doing great!

I'd heard MOSSDEEP's GYM LEADER is
pretty strong, so I decided to come

take a look-see for myself.

But there's something wrong about
this town.

People are going on about a warning
letter and the SPACE CENTER…

I don't think it concerns me in any
way, though.
texts.MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader:
Ahh… It feels great letting the waves
wash over my feet…

Speaking of the waves, you know that
island city SOOTOPOLIS?

I think the GYM there had a new
LEADER come in.

People tell me the new LEADER once
mentored WALLACE.
texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_OldManGreetin:
When I was young, I traveled the world
as a POKéMON TRAINER.

Now that I've become an old buzzard,
my only amusement is watching young

TRAINERS battle.
texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_DoorIsLocked: The door appears to be locked.
texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_ChallengeVisi:
A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1} is
visiting my home.

Would you like to challenge
{STR_VAR_1}?
texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_YouWontBattle:
You won't battle? I'm disappointed
that I can't see you battle…
texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_KeepItToA3On3:
Oh, good, good!

But my house isn't all that sturdy.

Could I ask you to keep it down to
a 3-on-3 match?
texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_SaveYourProgr:
Before you two battle, you should
save your progress.
texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_HopeToSeeAGoo: I hope to see a good match!
texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleTie:
So, it became a standoff.

It was a brilliant match in which
neither side conceded a step!
texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleWon:
That was superlative!

Why, it was like seeing myself in
my youth again!
texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleLost:
Ah, too bad for you!

But it was a good match.
I hope you can win next time.
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-bound
{PLAYER}?

The GYM LEADERS here use
PSYCHIC-type POKéMON.

If you go up against them with
FIGHTING- or POISON-type POKéMON,

they'll inflict horrible damage!

Plus, they'll come at you with
outstanding combination attacks.

If you want to win, you'll need to show
them how tight you are with your

POKéMON. Go for it!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictor:
Wow, you're astounding!
You're one great TRAINER!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro:
Battles hinge on the strength of your
spirit! The weak-spirited will never win!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonDefeat:
I lost!
I must temper my spirit again!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle:
The indecisive lose.
That's my warning to you.
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilPostBattle:
If there are prodigies in the world,
then our GYM LEADERS are them!

However, you may be even more talented
than them…
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro:
Fufufufu… Watch me levitate a POKé
BALL telekinetically!

Wrooooooooaaaar!
… … … … … … …

Sometimes, I'm out of sync…
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeDefeat:
My POKéMON battling skills are out
of sync, too!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle:
A POKé BALL was too heavy to lift
psychically. But this dust bunny…

Whoooooooooooooooh!
… … … … … …

No, I'm not cheating!
I didn't blow on it! Honestly!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahIntro:
When you lose to me, don't be too hard
on yourself.

It's not that you're weak--I'm just
too strong!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahPostBattle:
I'm not going to get down on myself for
losing. I just need to train harder.

Positive thinking--that's my strong
point!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaIntro:
I see it…
I see your future…

If you can beat me, I will tell you
your future!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaPostBattle:
You will wage a terrifically intense
battle with our GYM LEADERS…

The result…
You won't hear it from me!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraIntro:
The roads you have traveled…
What you have experienced…

Come at me with everything you've
learned!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraDefeat: You've traveled a path of greatness!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle:
A bright future awaits those who have
worked diligently.

For those who lazed idly, there is
only despair at the end.

What goes around comes around…
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaIntro:
Even at the risk of life, I will win
this battle!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaDefeat:
What you do…
It horrifies me…
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaPostBattle:
How dare you beat me…

It won't be my fault if something
horrible befalls you…
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro:
Hohoho.

You need me to show you how tenacious
the PSYCHIC type can be.
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateDefeat:
Oh! My, my!
Your battle style is fantastic!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle:
I… I don't let defeat rattle m-me,
however b-badly.
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenIntro:
Let me show you a perfectly awful,
horrifying time!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenPostBattle:
Your vitality is contagious!
Get away from me quickly!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordIntro:
I may be past my prime, but I suggest
you not patronize me.
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordDefeat:
Ah, you overflow with the power
of youth!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordPostBattle:
It seems that I could not overcome
your youthful energy.
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyIntro:
You're not getting through to the end!
Not if I can help it!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyDefeat:
How could you be so ludicrously
strong?
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyPostBattle:
Humph! You may be strong, but you're
not suitable for the PSYCHIC type!

The way you battle is somehow brutal!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasIntro:
Wroooar! Have a taste of my super
POKéMON hard-battling power!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasPostBattle:
All right! I think I'll develop a special
invincible POKéMON power next.
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro:
TATE: Hehehe… Were you surprised?

LIZA: Fufufu… Were you surprised?

TATE: That there are two GYM LEADERS?
LIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?

TATE: We're twins!
LIZA: We're twins!

TATE: We don't need to talk because…
LIZA: We can each determine what…

TATE: The other is thinking…
LIZA: All in our minds!

TATE: This combination of ours…
LIZA: Can you beat it?
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaDefeat:
TATE: What?! Our combination…
LIZA: Was shattered!

TATE: It can't be helped. You've won…
LIZA: So, in recognition, take this.
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedMindBadge:
{PLAYER} received the MIND BADGE
from TATE and LIZA.
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMindBadgeTa:
TATE: The MIND BADGE enhances the
SP. ATK and SP. DEF of POKéMON.

LIZA: It also lets you use the HM move
DIVE outside of battle.

TATE: You should also take this, too.
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCalmMind:
TATE: That TM04 contains…
LIZA: CALM MIND!

TATE: It raises SP. ATK and…
LIZA: It raises SP. DEF!

TATE: It's a move that's perfect…
LIZA: For PSYCHIC POKéMON!

… … … … … …
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredTateAndL:
Registered GYM LEADERS TATE & LIZA
in the POKéNAV.
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostBat:
TATE: Looks like the bond between you
and your POKéMON is far stronger than

the bond that we share as twins.

LIZA: You will become even stronger!
We've battled you, so we know.
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaNeedTwo:
TATE: Hehehe… Were you surprised?

LIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?

TATE: Oops, you have only one…
LIZA: POKéMON that can battle.

TATE: We can't battle that way!

LIZA: If you want to challenge us,
bring some more POKéMON.
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPreRema:
TATE: POKéMON…
LIZA: POKéMON…

TATE: By changing the party's mix…
LIZA: The battle style changes.

TATE: But me…
LIZA: But me…

TATE: I'll always be with LIZA!
LIZA: I'll always be with TATE!

TATE: Our combination…
LIZA: We'll show you again and again!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematch:
TATE: You and your POKéMON…
LIZA: It's as if you were siblings!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostRem:
TATE: You can knock us down,
but we'll never stay down!

LIZA: Because the two of us,
we always support each other!
texts.MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematch:
TATE: You're back again…
LIZA: You're back again…

TATE: To give us a rematch.
LIZA: To give us a rematch.

TATE: But…
LIZA: For our match…

TATE: You brought just one POKéMON!
LIZA: You brought just one POKéMON!

TATE: We need you to bring at least…
LIZA: Two POKéMON when you come back.
texts.MossdeepCity_House1_Text_ItLikesXPokeblo:
It likes {STR_VAR_1}S,
doesn't it?

No, I'm positive of it! It definitely
likes {STR_VAR_1}S!
texts.MossdeepCity_House1_Text_DoesntLikeOrDis:
It doesn't appear to like or dislike
any {POKEBLOCK}S.
texts.MossdeepCity_House1_Text_HusbandCanTellP:
My husband can tell what kind of
{POKEBLOCK}S a POKéMON likes at a glance.
texts.MossdeepCity_House2_Text_SisterMailsBoyf:
My little sister exchanges MAIL with
her boyfriend in FORTREE.

I don't envy her one bit at all.
texts.MossdeepCity_House2_Text_PokemonCarriesM:
Even though I can't see my friend in
FORTREE, my POKéMON carries MAIL

back and forth for us.

I'm not lonesome, even though we're
apart.
texts.MossdeepCity_House3_Text_YouWantSuperRod:
Hey there, TRAINER!
A SUPER ROD really is super!

Say all you want, but this baby can
catch POKéMON off the seafloor!

What do you think?
You want it, don't you?
texts.MossdeepCity_House3_Text_SuperRodIsSuper:
You bet, you bet!
After all, a SUPER ROD is really super!
texts.MossdeepCity_House3_Text_TryDroppingRodI:
If there's any water, try dropping in
your ROD and see what bites!
texts.MossdeepCity_House3_Text_DontYouLikeToFi:
Hunh?
Don't you like to fish?
texts.MossdeepCity_House3_Text_GoAfterSeafloor:
Go after the seafloor POKéMON with
your SUPER ROD.
texts.MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToF:
My little brother says he likes to go
find people's SECRET BASES.
texts.MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToV:
My little brother says he likes to
visit people's SECRET BASES and have

POKéMON battles.
texts.MossdeepCity_House4_Text_YouMadeSecretBa:
Was it you who made a SECRET BASE
near {STR_VAR_1}?
texts.MossdeepCity_House4_Text_MakeSecretBase:
You should make a SECRET BASE
somewhere. I'll go find it!
texts.MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsFantastic:
REVIVE is fantastic!

Give it to a fainted POKéMON,
and the POKéMON will arise.

But be careful, REVIVE doesn't restore
the used-up PP of moves.
texts.MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_MaxRepelLastsLong:
MAX REPEL keeps all weak POKéMON away.

Out of all the REPEL sprays, it lasts
the longest.
texts.MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_NetAndDiveBallsRa:
The NET and DIVE BALLS are rare POKé
BALLS that are only made in MOSSDEEP.

A NET BALL is effective against
BUG-type and WATER-type POKéMON.

A DIVE BALL works best on POKéMON
at the bottom of the sea.
texts.MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GymLe:
The GYM LEADERS in this town are
a formidable duo.

Their combination attacks are, like,
excellent and wow!
texts.MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Abili:
Depending on the special abilities of
POKéMON, some moves might change

or not work at all.
texts.MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_2F_Text_Woman:
If I win a whole lot of link battles
and show everyone how good I am,

I might get a fan following!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Success:
The rocket launched safely!
That's successful launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Haywire:
I know that things are a little
haywire right now, but…

The rocket's launch is imminent!

I know that things are a little
haywire right now, but…

The rocket launched safely!
That's successful launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketL:
A rocket launch demands perfection.
Not even a 1% margin of error is allowed.

Even if it's 99% okay, the whole thing
is useless if 1% happens to be no good.

Despite that, we never stop trying.
Why? It's a dream that never ends.
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaHa:
Those MAGMA thugs have their sights
set on our SPACE CENTER.

But we can't allow anything that minor
to interfere with our rocket launch!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_FoundTh:
I was taking a stroll down the beach
when I found this.

It's not anything I need, so you can
have it.
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HoennFa:
The HOENN region has been famous for 
its meteor showers for a long time.
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaCa:
TEAM MAGMA can't be allowed to steal
the rocket fuel.

Oh, by the way, you can have this stone
I found on the beach.
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_CantStr:
With TEAM MAGMA around, I guess
strolls on the beach aren't safe.
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_DidPoke:
Some people claim that POKéMON came
from space. Could it be true?
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_AquaSho:
TEAM AQUA should take care of
TEAM MAGMA!

But if they did that, TEAM AQUA will
become bold and brazen, won't they?
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Rockets:
A giant chunk of metal bursts through
the skies and flies into space…

It boggles my mind!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaWa:
A giant chunk of metal bursts through
the skies and flies into space…

But TEAM MAGMA wants to spoil
that dream of mine!

I'm not having any of that!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenM:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, have you read that
proclamation already?

TEAM MAGMA is coming after the rocket
fuel on this island.

I don't know what they'd need it for,
but they can't be allowed to take it.

I'll keep an eye on things for
a while longer.

In the meantime, why don't you go
check out the town?
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3I:
As promised, we've come for
the rocket fuel!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3P:
Don't think you're on a roll just
because you've beaten me!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1I:
We gave you fair warning!
There's nothing sneaky about us!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1D:
Grrr…
We should've used sneaky treachery…
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1P:
Okay, I get it already! The next time,
we'll come unannounced.
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4I:
The rocket fuel the SPACE CENTER has
in storage--that's what we're after.

We mean to take every last bit of it!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4D:
Please, can you spare some fuel?
Even a chintzy cup will do!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4P:
What are we going to do with
the rocket fuel?

How would I know?
Ask our leader upstairs!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2I:
Our leader said no one, but no one,
gets past me!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2P:
Please, tell our leader that
I never abandoned my post.

That I stayed to the bitter end…
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIn:
This is…
An intent-to-steal notice?

“To the staff of the SPACE CENTER:
How are you? We are doing fine.

“We will soon visit you to take your
rocket fuel.

“Please don't try to stop us.
We will take the fuel no matter what.

“Let there be more land!
                                          TEAM MAGMA”
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Mossdee:
MOSSDEEP has mainly sunny weather,
and its winds are stable.

It's an ideal location for launching
rockets.
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WhyWoul:
Why would TEAM MAGMA want to steal
our rocket fuel in the first place?
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Wouldve:
If only I was a little younger, I would
have liked being an astronaut…

No… It's not too late!
I can and will try!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MagmaCa:
If TEAM MAGMA takes the rocket fuel,
I won't be able to go to space!

They can't be allowed to get away
with such an outrage!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WishOrd:
I wish ordinary people could go into
space one day…
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_DoesMag:
TEAM MAGMA…
Do they want to go to space, too?
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_YoureOu:
What's wrong with you?

You're outnumbered three to one,
but you still want to take us on?
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_GoodAns:
Good answer!
That's what a smart person'll do!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5I:
A reckless go-getter, are you?
Okay, I'll go first!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6I:
It's too soon to be relieved!
I'm up next!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7I:
I bet you want to take a break.
But I'm not about to let you do that!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7D:
We should've taken a break…
That's what we should've done…
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6P:
Three of us here, and look at the sorry
mess we got ourselves into.
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7P:
We three losing like this…
We look worse than usual by triple!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5P:
Are we being useful to our leader
at all?
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WellTak:
Hehehe!

We come all the way here to get some
fuel, and we're interfered with again!

If you're going to mess with us too,
we'll take care of you at the same time!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieDo:
MAXIE: Clear out of the way!
Don't you dare interfere!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenW:
STEVEN: TEAM MAGMA…

What's the point of stealing rocket
fuel?
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieUs:
MAXIE: Fufufu… Since you're so
curious, you deserve an explanation.

We're going to jettison the entire
load into MT. CHIMNEY!

With GROUDON gone, we have no need
for that slag heap of a mountain!

So we'll use the fuel's power to make
the volcano erupt!

It will be savage!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenA:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You're going to help me?

Let's go into battle together!
Are you ready?
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenH:
STEVEN: Then, hurry!
Get ready quickly!
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_JustWan:
All I want…
I just want to expand the land mass…
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWe:
MAXIE: We failed to make the volcano
erupt…

We failed to control GROUDON after
we had awoken it…

Is our goal to expand the land
misguided?

… … … … … …
… … … … … …

If…
If we, TEAM MAGMA, are wrong…

… … … … … …

Then might TEAM AQUA's goal to expand
the sea also be equally misguided?

MAXIE: All right…
We will give up on the fuel…

There appear to be more important
matters that I must examine…
texts.MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenT:
STEVEN: Whew, that was too tense.
{PLAYER}{KUN}, thank you.

I have something to give you as
thanks for your support.

Please come see me at home
after this.

Oh, yes, I don't live in RUSTBORO CITY.
I live right here on this island.
texts.MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_YouveEarn:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}…

As you can see, there's not much here,
but this is my home.

Thank you for all that you've done.

This is my token of appreciation.
It's the HIDDEN MACHINE DIVE.

No need to be shy--you've earned
this HM.
texts.MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ExplainDi:
STEVEN: While you're using SURF, you
should notice dark patches of water.

Use DIVE if you come to deep water
like it. You'll drop to the seafloor.

When you want to come back up, use
DIVE again.

In some places, it won't be possible
for you to surface, though.
texts.MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_Underwate:
STEVEN: Apparently, there's an
underwater cavern between

MOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS.

You know, the one that CAPT. STERN
found in his submarine.
texts.MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_TakeBallC:
{PLAYER} checked the POKé BALL.

It contained the POKéMON
BELDUM.

Take the POKé BALL?
texts.MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_NoSpaceFo: There is no space for another POKéMON.
texts.MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LeftPokeB:
{PLAYER} left the POKé BALL where
it was.
texts.MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFro:
It's a letter.

… … … … … …

To {PLAYER}{KUN}…

I've decided to do a little soul-
searching and train on the road.

I don't plan to return home for some
time.

I have a favor to ask of you.

I want you to take the POKé BALL on
the desk.

Inside it is a BELDUM, my favorite
POKéMON.

I'm counting on you.

May our paths cross someday.

STEVEN STONE
texts.MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_Collectio:
It's a collection of rare rocks and
stones assembled by STEVEN.
texts.MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteWillActivateVolc:
The power contained in the METEORITE…

By amplifying its power with this
machine, MT. CHIMNEY's volcanic

activity will instantly intensify…

Its energy will grow deep inside
the crater and…

Fufufu…
texts.MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro:
MAXIE: Hm?
Who are you?

… … … … … …
… … … … … …

I'd heard ARCHIE bemoaning a child
who's been meddling in TEAM AQUA's

affairs.

It must be you he meant.

Humph! So you're thinking of
interfering with us, TEAM MAGMA?

Now you listen.
Long ago, living things used the

land to live and grow.

That is why land is all important!
It is the cradle of all!

That is why TEAM MAGMA is dedicated
to the expansion of the land mass.

It is for further advancement of
humankind and POKéMON!

And for that, we need the power of
what sleeps within this mountain…

Oh! There was no need for you to
learn that much.

But, no matter!
I'll teach you the consequences of

meddling in our grand design!
texts.MtChimney_Text_MaxieDefeat:
What?!

I, MAXIE, was caught off guard?!
texts.MtChimney_Text_MaxieYouHaventSeenLastOfM:
MAXIE: But, enough.
I will back off this time.

But don't think that this is the last
you've seen of TEAM MAGMA.

Fufufu…

Even without the METEORITE, if we
obtain that ORB… Fufufu…
texts.MtChimney_Text_TabithaIntro:
Hehehe!

So you've come all the way here!

But you're too late!
I've already delivered the METEORITE

from METEOR FALLS to the BOSS!
texts.MtChimney_Text_TabithaDefeat:
Hehehe…

Even though I've lost, if our leader
awakens that thing…
texts.MtChimney_Text_TabithaPostBattle:
BOSS, hurry!
Give it the METEORITE's energy!

Hehehe…
texts.MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Intro:
We of TEAM MAGMA are working hard for
everyone's sake.

Like, if that thing's power made more
land, there'd be more places to live.

Everyone'd be happy!
texts.MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Defeat:
Hunh?
What do you mean I lost?
texts.MtChimney_Text_Grunt2PostBattle:
Our BOSS says, “It will make everyone
happy.”

But why does everyone keep getting
in our way?
texts.MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Intro:
If there were more land, I'd be able
to get a big house of my own!

I'm going to build it on hardened lava!
texts.MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Defeat: My dream of a big house…
texts.MtChimney_Text_Grunt1PostBattle:
A kid like you, you ought to be
splashing about in the waves!
texts.MtChimney_Text_TeamAquaAlwaysMessingWith:
That annoying TEAM AQUA…
They always mess with our plans!
texts.MtChimney_Text_YouBetterNotMessWithUs:
You'd better not mess with us!

We're trying to awaken that thing
for the benefit of everyone!
texts.MtChimney_Text_AquasNameSimilar:
We're TEAM MAGMA!

They're TEAM AQUA!

It totally annoys me that they'd
use a name like ours!
texts.MtChimney_Text_KeepMakingMoreLand: We're going to keep making more land!
texts.MtChimney_Text_ArchieGoStopTeamMagma:
ARCHIE: Grr, {PLAYER}!
I should've guessed you'd show up!

See for yourself what the fanatics
of TEAM MAGMA are up to!

They're trying to inject the stolen
METEORITE's power into the volcano!

Doing something like that will cause
the volcano's eruption!
texts.MtChimney_Text_ArchieIHaveMyHandsFull:
ARCHIE: Grrr…

I want to stop that MAXIE,
but I can't!

Not when I have my hands full battling
three opponents at once!
texts.MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou:
ARCHIE: {PLAYER}!
Thank you!

With your help, we thwarted TEAM
MAGMA's destructive plan!

But… You…
Whose side are you on?

Ah, it doesn't matter.

We will remain vigilant and keep up
our pursuit of TEAM MAGMA.

{PLAYER}, we shall meet again!
texts.MtChimney_Text_MagmaOutnumbersUs:
Darn… TEAM MAGMA outnumbers us!
We can't keep up with them!
texts.MtChimney_Text_LessHabitatForWaterPokemo:
If they expand the land, there'll be
less habitats for WATER POKéMON!
texts.MtChimney_Text_MagmasNameSimilar:
We're TEAM AQUA!

They're TEAM MAGMA!

It burns me up that they'd use such
a confusing name!
texts.MtChimney_Text_LavaCookiesJust200:
LAVA COOKIES are MT. CHIMNEY's local
specialty.

Try one. It's just ¥200.
texts.MtChimney_Text_YouveNotGotTheMoney:
Oh, dear. You can't buy a thing if
you've not got the money.
texts.MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteFittedOnMachine:
A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious
machine…

The machine seems to be storing
energy in the METEORITE.
texts.MtChimney_Text_RemoveTheMeteorite:
A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious
machine…

Do you want to remove the METEORITE?
texts.MtChimney_Text_PlayerRemovedMeteorite:
{PLAYER} removed the METEORITE from
the mysterious machine.
texts.MtChimney_Text_PlayerLeftMeteorite:
{PLAYER} left the METEORITE where
it was.
texts.MtChimney_Text_MachineMakesNoResponse:
This mysterious machine…
It makes no response whatsoever.
texts.MtChimney_Text_ShelbyIntro:
I've been to the hot springs and
refreshed my tired bones.

Right now I'm feeling strong!
texts.MtChimney_Text_ShelbyDefeat:
Oh, my goodness.
Now, aren't you something!
texts.MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostBattle:
Well, well, I've lost. I can't call
myself an EXPERT now, can I?
texts.MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRegister:
Thank you, child. It was fun, as if
I were battling my own grandchild.

Please, come see me again for
a rematch.
texts.MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchIntro:
If you can mesh your heart with those
of your POKéMON, why, you should be

able to achieve great things.
texts.MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchDefeat:
Oh, my goodness.
Now, aren't you something!
texts.MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostRematch:
Perhaps your heart has become one
with the hearts of your POKéMON.
texts.MtChimney_Text_MelissaIntro:
I've got the fire in me, baby.
I can't stand it! I have to battle!
texts.MtChimney_Text_MelissaDefeat: Ooh, that was a scorching-hot match!
texts.MtChimney_Text_MelissaPostBattle:
The heat of MT. CHIMNEY warms
me up, baby!
texts.MtChimney_Text_SheilaIntro:
I've finally made it to MT. CHIMNEY.
I want to make my POKéMON battle!
texts.MtChimney_Text_SheilaDefeat:
The way you battle…
It's like a MT. CHIMNEY eruption!
texts.MtChimney_Text_SheilaPostBattle:
Like I said, I've finally made it to
MT. CHIMNEY. It would be a shame if

I only do a little sightseeing…

I want to get in some battles and buy
COOKIES as souvenirs.
texts.MtChimney_Text_ShirleyIntro:
Since I bathed in the hot springs,
I've been feeling great!

I'm sure I'm going to win!
texts.MtChimney_Text_ShirleyDefeat:
Yowch!
I'm getting a chill out of the water.
texts.MtChimney_Text_ShirleyPostBattle:
I'll have to take another dip in the
hot springs. Want to join me?

Just joking!
texts.MtChimney_Text_SawyerIntro:
This is one fine mountain! Plenty of
hot people around for company!
texts.MtChimney_Text_SawyerDefeat: Oh, you're a real firebrand, too!
texts.MtChimney_Text_SawyerPostBattle:
I think I need a dip in LAVARIDGE
HOT SPRING with the locals!
texts.MtChimney_Text_SawyerRegister:
I like little fireballs like you.
Let me register you in my POKéNAV.
texts.MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchIntro:
I'm happily surrounded by hot people
around these parts. I won't lose!
texts.MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchDefeat:
Gosh, you're still the same
firebrand as before!
texts.MtChimney_Text_SawyerPostRematch:
Actually, it really is hot here.
I'm overdressed for these parts.
texts.MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_CableCarR:
The CABLE CAR is ready to go down.
Would you like to be on it?
texts.MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_RideAnoth: Please ride with us another time.
texts.MtPyre_1F_Text_TakeThisForYourOwnGood:
All sorts of beings wander the slopes
of MT. PYRE…

There is no telling what may happen.
Take this. It's for your own good.
texts.MtPyre_1F_Text_ExplainCleanseTag:
Have a POKéMON hold that
CLEANSE TAG.

It will help ward off wild POKéMON.
texts.MtPyre_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespects:
Did you come to pay your respect
to the spirits of departed POKéMON?

You must care for your POKéMON a lot.
texts.MtPyre_1F_Text_RestingPlaceOfZigzagoon:
This is the final resting place of my
ZIGZAGOON. I cherished it…
texts.MtPyre_2F_Text_MemoriesOfSkitty:
Memories of my darling SKITTY…
My eyes overflow thinking about it.
texts.MtPyre_2F_Text_TumbledFromFloorAbove:
Ooch, ouch… There are holes in the
ground here and there.

I didn't notice and took a tumble from
the floor above.
texts.MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkIntro:
Hey! Are you searching for POKéMON?
You came along after me! You're rude!
texts.MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkDefeat:
Ayieeeeh!
I'm sorry, forgive me, please!
texts.MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkPostBattle:
People don't come here often, so
I thought there'd be rare POKéMON.
texts.MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeIntro:
LUKE: We're here on a dare.

Heheh, if I show her how cool I am,
she'll fall for me. I know it!

I know! I'll cream you and show her
how cool I am!
texts.MtPyre_2F_Text_LukePostBattle:
LUKE: Well, we lost but that's okay!
I'm right here by your side.

We'll make it through this dare!
texts.MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeNotEnoughMons:
LUKE: If you want to take me on,
bring some more POKéMON.

If you don't, I won't be able to show
off to my girl how cool I am!
texts.MtPyre_2F_Text_DezIntro:
DEZ: I came here on a dare with my
boyfriend.

It's really scary, but I'm with my
boyfriend. It's okay.

I know! I'll get my boyfriend to look
cool by beating you!
texts.MtPyre_2F_Text_DezPostBattle:
DEZ: We're lovey-dovey, so we don't
care if we lose!
texts.MtPyre_2F_Text_DezNotEnoughMons:
DEZ: If you want to challenge us, you
should bring at least two POKéMON.

My boyfriend's strong.
Just one POKéMON won't do at all.
texts.MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahIntro:
You are an unfamiliar sight…
Depart before anything befalls you!
texts.MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahPostBattle:
Our family has been TRAINERS here
since my great-grandmother's time…

It is my duty to protect this
mountain…
texts.MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderPostBattle:
I get freaked out every time I see
anything move…

I shouldn't have come here to train…
texts.MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamIntro:
The rich atmosphere of the mountain
has elevated my psychic power!

A mere child like you…
You dream of winning?
texts.MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamPostBattle:
My psychic powers have surely
grown several times, but…
texts.MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaIntro:
Ahahahaha!

This is no place for children, least
of all you!
texts.MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaPostBattle:
This means my training is still not
enough…

I've got to keep working toward the
summit…

Go, me!
texts.MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleDefeat:
That was amazing!
You're a very special TRAINER.
texts.MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostBattle:
POKéMON no longer of this world.
POKéMON that are with you now.

And the POKéMON that you will meet
in the future…

They are all to be equally cherished.
Please remember that.
texts.MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRegister:
I would like to see your POKéMON
when they grow up some more…

Please, I need to see your POKéNAV.
texts.MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchIntro:
Oh, it's you…

Have you come to show me your grown
POKéMON?
texts.MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchDefeat:
How amazing!
You are a special person.
texts.MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostRematch:
POKéMON no longer of this world.
POKéMON that are with you now.

And the POKéMON that you will meet
in the future…

They are all to be equally cherished.
I see that you've remembered that.
texts.MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiIntro:
Teacher…
Please watch over my progress!
texts.MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiPostBattle:
Until I improve, my teacher, who rests
here, will never find true peace…
texts.MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaIntro:
I love all things horrifying…
It's like a disease…

When I'm here…
I shiver with fear…
texts.MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaPostBattle:
I want to see dreadful things…
I can't leave…

Stay…
Won't you stay with me?
texts.MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieIntro:
When I'm here…
A curious power flows into me…
texts.MtPyre_6F_Text_ValeriePostBattle:
Perhaps the power is from the spirits
of POKéMON in fitful sleep here…
texts.MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRegister:
Fufufu… I lost the match, but…
I have this little ability…

Without ever laying my hands on
your POKéNAV… Hiyah!
texts.MtPyre_6F_Text_ValeriePostRematch:
The POKéMON at rest here…
Sometimes, they play…
texts.MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricIntro:
Have you lost your bearings?
Have no fear for I am here!
texts.MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricPostBattle:
I had this feeling that a lost TRAINER
would be panicked and easy to beat.

It's dirty and I won't try it again…
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Intro:
No! Those TEAM MAGMA goons got
here ahead of us!

We can't fall behind!
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Defeat:
I thought you were one of the MAGMAS
who happened to come back…
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1PostBattle:
Yeah, so you are strong…
But there're a lot of us!
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Intro:
Hah!
Too bad for you!

If you came earlier, you only would've
had to battle the wimpy TEAM MAGMA.

But since you arrived now, you have
to take on us toughies!
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Defeat:
Urgh… I should've let you take on
TEAM MAGMA first…
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2PostBattle:
You don't know anything!
So why are you messing with us?
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Intro:
You…
We saw you at MT. CHIMNEY.

You don't belong to either TEAM,
so why would you be here?
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Defeat:
If you're going to mess with anyone,
let it be TEAM MAGMA…
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3PostBattle:
Heh, it doesn't matter!
We bought ourselves some time!

The BOSS should have snatched what
he was after!
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Intro:
Oh, I know!
You tried to join TEAM MAGMA,

but they wouldn't have you!

Well, don't think that we'll let you
join our TEAM AQUA!
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Defeat:
If you want to join TEAM AQUA that
badly, we can consider it…
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4PostBattle:
We have a great combination going
with us members and our leader.
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_ArchieWeGotTheOrbLets:
ARCHIE: TEAM MAGMA's MAXIE got ahead
of us, but we also got what we wanted.

The RED ORB preserved at MT. PYRE…
I, ARCHIE, now have it in my possession!

Fufufu… Now we can bring our ultimate
objective to fruition!

Okay, TEAM!
We're pulling out!
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_BothOrbsTakenMagmaLef:
Oh, no…
This cannot happen…

Not only the BLUE ORB, but even
the RED ORB has been taken…

The BLUE ORB and RED ORB must never
be separated. They belong together.

What are those men trying to do with
the two ORBS?

… … … … … …
… … … … … …

Oh, yes. Was it TEAM MAGMA who came
and took the BLUE ORB first?

Well, in their haste, they left this
behind.

I couldn't imagine what exactly it
could be.

I would like you to have it.
Perhaps it will be useful in some way.
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_OrbsHaveBeenTaken:
The BLUE ORB and RED ORB taken by
those sinister men…

They must never be apart…
I fear something terrible will happen…
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreAwakened:
Oh, my goodness…

You say that both GROUDON and KYOGRE
have been awakened?

It is said that the BLUE ORB and
the RED ORB quelled the rage of

the two POKéMON…

It is also said that the true owner
of the ORBS still exists.

However, no one knows who, or what
exactly, the ORBS belong to.

It could be a human, or perhaps
a POKéMON, but no one knows.
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_ThoseTwoMenReturnedOr:
The two men who took the ORBS came
back to return them on their own.

Those men…
Perhaps they are not so evil after all…
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_SuperAncientPokemonTa:
The embodiments of the land, sea,
and the sky…

That is said to be the identities of
the super-ancient POKéMON…

In the same way that we humans and
POKéMON have life, our world, too,

is alive…

The super-ancient POKéMON have
taught us that…
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_WillYouHearOutMyTale:
MT. PYRE is where we calm the spirits
of POKéMON that have passed on…

This is a high place where one can
see all of HOENN…

The disembodied spirits of POKéMON
must find solace here…

Is it coincidence that you are here…

Will you hear out my tale? A tale long
told in the HOENN region?
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreTale:
It happened long, long ago…

The world was wracked by a ferocious
clash between the POKéMON of the land

and the POKéMON of the sea…

The POKéMON of the land raised
mountains and created continents…

The POKéMON of the sea raised huge
waves and carved out oceans…

Their fierce duel raged without end.

The world was engulfed in massive
infernos and vicious storms.

The BLUE ORB and the RED ORB brought
an end to the calamity.

Light poured from the two ORBS and
becalmed the enraged adversaries.

The pair, made docile, dove deep into
the sea where eventually they

disappeared…
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_WellThatTooIsFine:
I see…
Well, that, too, is fine…
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_HearTheNewLegendOfHoe:
It is my role to pass on the legends
of HOENN to future generations.

And the crisis that just ended in
SOOTOPOLIS rewrote a legend…

Have you the time to hear the new
legend of HOENN?
texts.MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale:
It happened long, long ago…

The world was wracked by a ferocious
clash between the POKéMON of the land

and the POKéMON of the sea…

The POKéMON of the land raised
mountains and created continents…

The POKéMON of the sea raised huge
waves and carved out oceans…

Their fierce duel raged without end.

The world was engulfed in massive
fires and vicious storms.

It was then that the POKéMON of
the sky descended from a storm.

The POKéMON, shining a vivid green,
becalmed the two enraged POKéMON.

Then, its duty done, the green POKéMON
flew off into the wild blue yonder…
texts.NewMauville_Entrance_Text_UsedBasementKe:
{PLAYER} used the BASEMENT KEY.

The door opened!
texts.NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorRadiati:
The generator is radiating heat that
can be felt even at a distance.

It looks like it should be turned off
as soon as possible.
texts.NewMauville_Inside_Text_SteppedOnSwitchG:
{PLAYER} stepped on the switch.

Click…

… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …

The generator appears to have
stopped…
texts.OldaleTown_Text_SavingMyProgress:
I want to take a rest, so I'm saving my
progress.
texts.OldaleTown_Text_IWorkAtPokemonMart:
Hi!
I work at a POKéMON MART.

Can I get you to come with me?
texts.OldaleTown_Text_ThisIsAPokemonMart:
This is a POKéMON MART.
Just look for our blue roof.

We sell a variety of goods including
POKé BALLS for catching POKéMON.

Here, I'd like you to have this as
a promotional item.
texts.OldaleTown_Text_PotionExplanation:
A POTION can be used anytime, so it's
even more useful than a POKéMON CENTER

in certain situations.
texts.OldaleTown_Text_WaitDontComeInHere:
Aaaaah! Wait!
Please don't come in here.

I just discovered the footprints of
a rare POKéMON!

Wait until I finish sketching
them, okay?
texts.OldaleTown_Text_DiscoveredFootprints:
I just discovered the footprints of
a rare POKéMON!

Wait until I finish sketching
them, okay?
texts.OldaleTown_Text_FinishedSketchingFootpri:
I finished sketching the footprints of
a rare POKéMON.

But it turns out they were only my
own footprints…
texts.OldaleTown_Text_MayLetsGoBack:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Over here!

Let's hurry home!
texts.OldaleTown_Text_BrendanLetsGoBack:
BRENDAN: I'm heading back to my dad's
LAB now.

{PLAYER}, you should hustle back, too.
texts.OldaleTown_Text_TownSign:
OLDALE TOWN
“Where things start off scarce.”
texts.OldaleTown_House1_Text_LeftPokemonGoesOu:
When a POKéMON battle starts, the one
at the left of the list goes out first.

So, when you get more POKéMON in your
party, try switching around the order

of your POKéMON.

It could give you an advantage.
texts.OldaleTown_House2_Text_PokemonLevelUp:
When POKéMON battle, they eventually
level up and become stronger.
texts.OldaleTown_House2_Text_YoullGoFurtherWit:
If the POKéMON with you become
stronger, you'll be able to go farther

away from here.
texts.OldaleTown_Mart_Text_PokeBallsAreSoldOut:
The clerk says they're all sold out.
I can't buy any POKé BALLS.
texts.OldaleTown_Mart_Text_ImGoingToBuyPokeBal:
I'm going to buy a bunch of POKé BALLS
and catch a bunch of POKéMON!
texts.OldaleTown_Mart_Text_RestoreHPWithPotion:
If a POKéMON gets hurt and loses its HP
and faints, it won't be able to battle.

To prevent your POKéMON from fainting,
restore its HP with a POTION.
texts.OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Trainer:
That PC in the corner there is
for any POKéMON TRAINER to use.

Naturally, that means you're welcome
to use it, too.
texts.OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Pokemon:
POKéMON CENTERS are great!

You can use their services as much
as you like, and it's all for free.

You never have to worry!
texts.OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Wireles:
The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on
the second floor was built recently.

But they say they're still making
adjustments.
texts.OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedI:
The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on
the second floor was built recently.

I traded POKéMON right away.
texts.PacifidlogTown_Text_FastRunningCurrent:
The sea between PACIFIDLOG and
SLATEPORT has a fast-running tide.

If you decide to SURF, you could end
up swept away somewhere else.
texts.PacifidlogTown_Text_NeatHousesOnWater:
See, isn't it neat?
These houses are on water!

I was born here!
texts.PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary:
The SKY PILLAR?

…Oh, you must mean that tall, tall
tower a little further out.

If you asked me, I wouldn't climb it.
It's too scary to get up that high.

Life at sea level in PACIFIDLOG,
that suits me fine.
texts.PacifidlogTown_Text_TownSign:
PACIFIDLOG TOWN

“Where the morning sun smiles upon
the waters.”
texts.PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_RegiStory:
In the HOENN region, there are three
POKéMON that represent the power of

rock, ice, and steel.

Each of them is said to hide away deep
inside caves.

That's the story I heard when I was
just a little kid.
texts.PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_SixDotsOpenTh:
“Six dots open three doors.”

Grandpa used to say that, but I don't
know what he meant.
texts.PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ChairmansYoun:
Er-hem!

I am the POKéMON FAN CLUB's most
important person, the CHAIRMAN's

younger brother.

I'm here enjoying my vacation with
POKéMON, yes, indeed.
texts.PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_AdoringPokemo:
It clearly likes you very much.

A POKéMON that adoring and adorable
deserves a TM like this, no?
texts.PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_PutInSomeMore:
Hmm…
It's not bad, but it's also not good.

You, as the TRAINER, need to put in
some more effort.
texts.PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ViciousPokemo:
It has a vicious look to it.

A frightening POKéMON like that
deserves a TM like this.
texts.PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ExplainReturn:
If a POKéMON likes you a lot, RETURN's
power is enhanced.

If it doesn't like you, FRUSTRATION's
power goes up.
texts.PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_GetGoodTMInXD:
Oh, yes. In about {STR_VAR_1} or so days,
I should be getting a good TM or two.

You should come see me then.
I'll give you a TM that's suitable for

your POKéMON.
texts.PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_VeryFriendlyW:
It appears to be very friendly with the
TRAINER.
texts.PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_DoesntLikeTra:
It doesn't appear to like the TRAINER
very much.
texts.PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_WillingToTrad:
Check out this {STR_VAR_2}!

It's the {STR_VAR_2} that I caught
yesterday to celebrate my birthday!

Oh, I can see that you want it!
After all, it's priceless!

I'll tell you what. I might be willing
to trade it for a {STR_VAR_1}.
texts.PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_ItsSubtlyDiff:
Oh, so this is a {STR_VAR_1}?

It's sort of like a {STR_VAR_2},
and yet it's subtly different.

Thank you!
texts.PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_WontAcceptAny:
No, no, no! I won't accept any
less than a real {STR_VAR_1}!
texts.PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_NotDesperateO:
Oh, so you're not going to go through
with this?

That's cool. I'm not desperate to make
a trade or anything.
texts.PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_ReallyWantedT:
I know I could go looking for one
on my own, but…

But I really wanted to get a BAGON
that another TRAINER caught…
texts.PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_IsThatAPokede:
Is that a POKéDEX?

Did you get to meet a lot of different
POKéMON?

I wish I was like you.
texts.PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_PeopleSawHigh:
People were saying they saw a POKéMON
flying high above HOENN.

Is it flying around all the time?
Doesn't it need to rest somewhere?
texts.PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_SkyPokemon:
A sky POKéMON!
A sky POKéMON!
texts.PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_YesTown:
Yes?
YES TOWN?

I've never heard of a place like that.
texts.PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_YouHaveToCome:
No? That doesn't make any sense.
You have to come from somewhere.

Oh! Wait! You're not going to say you
were born at the bottom of the sea?
texts.PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_CantSeeMirage: I can't see MIRAGE ISLAND today…
texts.PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_CanSeeMirageI:
Oh! Oh my!
I can see MIRAGE ISLAND today!
texts.PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_MirageIslandA:
MIRAGE ISLAND…

It must become visible and invisible
depending on the weather conditions

that make mirages appear.

Or is it really appearing and
disappearing?
texts.PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Wha:
What color is your TRAINER CARD?
Mine's copper!
texts.PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnC:
PACIFIDLOG TOWN floats on top of
a colony of CORSOLA.

If I told you that, would you believe
me?
texts.PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Anc:
The ancestors of the people in
PACIFIDLOG were said to have been

born on boats and then lived and died 

aboard them.

I understand that they lived that way
because they were searching for

something.
texts.PetalburgCity_Text_WhereIsWally:
Where has our WALLY gone?

We have to leave for VERDANTURF TOWN
very soon…
texts.PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer:
Hiya! Are you maybe…
A rookie TRAINER?

Do you know what POKéMON TRAINERS
do when they reach a new town?

They first check what kind of GYM
is in the town.
texts.PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsPetalburgGym: See? This is PETALBURG CITY's GYM.
texts.PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsGymSign:
This is the GYM's sign. Look for it
whenever you're looking for a GYM.
texts.PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection:
My face is reflected in the water.

It's a shining grin full of hope…

Or it could be a look of somber silence
struggling with fear…

What do you see reflected in your face?
texts.PetalburgCity_Text_FullPartyExplanation:
Let's say you have six POKéMON.
If you catch another one…

It is automatically sent to a STORAGE
BOX over a PC connection.
texts.PetalburgCity_Text_GymSign:
PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM
LEADER: NORMAN

“A man in pursuit of power!”
texts.PetalburgCity_Text_CitySign:
PETALBURG CITY
“Where people mingle with nature.”
texts.PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouATrainer:
Excuse me!

Let me guess, from the way you're
dressed, are you a POKéMON TRAINER?
texts.PetalburgCity_Text_WellMaybeNot:
… … … … … …

Well, maybe not.
Your clothes aren't all that dirty.

You're either a rookie TRAINER,
or maybe you're just an ordinary kid.
texts.PetalburgCity_Text_ImLookingForTalentedT:
I'm roaming the land in search of
talented TRAINERS.

I'm sorry to have taken your time.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadYoureHereWithY:
DAD: Hm?

Well, if it isn't {PLAYER}!
So you're all finished moving in?

I'm surprised that you managed to
get here by yourself.

Oh, I see.
You're with your POKéMON.

Hm… Then I guess you're going to
become a TRAINER like me, {PLAYER}.

That's great news!
I'll be looking forward to it!
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIdLikeAPokem:
Um… I…
I'd like to get a POKéMON, please…
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadOhYoureWallyRi:
DAD: Hm? You're… Uh… Oh, right.
You're WALLY, right?
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIveNeverCaug:
WALLY: I'm going to go stay with my
relatives in VERDANTURF TOWN.

I thought I would be lonely by myself,
so I wanted to take a POKéMON along.

But I've never caught a POKéMON before.
I don't know how…
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadPlayerGoWithWa:
DAD: {PLAYER}, you heard that,
right?

Go with WALLY and make sure that he
safely catches a POKéMON.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_IllLoanYouMyZigza:
WALLY, here, I'll loan you my POKéMON.

WALLY received a ZIGZAGOON!
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouAndD:
WALLY: Oh, wow!
A POKéMON!

DAD: Hm. I'll give you a POKé BALL, too.
Go for it!

WALLY received a POKé BALL!
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WouldYouReallyCom:
{PLAYER}… Would you really come
with me?
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadSoDidItWorkOut: DAD: So, did it work out?
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouBye:
WALLY: Thank you, yes, it did.
Here's your POKéMON back.

{PLAYER}, thank you for coming along
with me.

You two are why I was able to catch
my POKéMON.

I promise I'll take really good
care of it.

Oh! My mom's waiting for me,
so I have to go!

Bye, {PLAYER}!
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoCollectBadge:
DAD: Now…

{PLAYER}, if you want to become a
strong TRAINER, here's my advice.

Head for RUSTBORO CITY beyond this
town.

There, you should challenge
the GYM LEADER, ROXANNE.

After her, go on to other POKéMON
GYMS and defeat their LEADERS.

Collect BADGES from them,
understood?

Of course, I'm a GYM LEADER, too.
We'll battle one day, {PLAYER}.

But that's only after you become
stronger.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToRustbor:
DAD: Hm? Aren't you going to the
POKéMON GYM in RUSTBORO CITY?

There's no challenge for me to
battle a greenhorn TRAINER.

{PLAYER}, I want you to challenge me
when you become a lot stronger.

I'll battle you, {PLAYER}, when you
can show me four GYM BADGES, okay?
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToDewford:
DAD: I see… So, you've beaten
the GYM LEADER in RUSTBORO CITY.

But there are many more TRAINERS
who are stronger than you, {PLAYER}.

Across the sea in DEWFORD TOWN is a
GYM LEADER named BRAWLY.

You should go challenge him.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_YouHaveGottenStro:
DAD: Hm… {PLAYER}, you have gotten
stronger.

I can tell by the number of BADGES
that you've earned.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanIntro:
DAD: Hm…
So, you did get four GYM BADGES.

Fine, as I promised, we will have
a POKéMON battle.

{PLAYER}…

I'm so happy that I can have
a real battle with my own child.

But, a battle is a battle!

I will do everything in my power as
a GYM LEADER to win.

{PLAYER}, you'd better give it your
best shot, too!
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanDefeat:
…

I… I can't…

I can't believe it. {PLAYER}…

I lost to {PLAYER}?

But, rules are rules!
Here, take this.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedBalanceBa:
{PLAYER} received the BALANCE BADGE
from DAD!
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainBalanceBad:
DAD: With that BADGE, the DEFENSE
of all your POKéMON will increase.

POKéMON that know the HM move SURF
will be able to travel over water.

This is my gift to you. {PLAYER}, I'm
sure you can use it correctly.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFacade:
DAD: TM42 contains FACADE.

It doubles the power of moves if
the POKéMON is poisoned, paralyzed,

or burned.

It might be able to turn a bad
situation into an advantage.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHappyAndSad:
DAD: As the GYM LEADER, I can't
express how upset I am…

But as a father, it makes me both
happy and a little sad. It's odd…
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_PleaseComeWithMe:
Ah, there you are, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

Please come with me.
I have something I want you to have.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_LetMeBorrowPlayer:
NORMAN, you don't mind, do you?

Let me borrow your {PLAYER}{KUN} for
a minute or two.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoingToKeepTra:
DAD: {PLAYER}, you should go visit
your mother every so often.

I'm going to stay here and redouble
my training.

It would bother me as a TRAINER to
not avenge my loss to you, {PLAYER}!
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadNoAmountOfTrai:
DAD: {PLAYER}, how are things going?

The world of POKéMON is deep.

I honestly think that no amount of
training would ever be enough.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?

The doors in this GYM open when you
beat the awaiting TRAINERS.

Whoops! The doors in this room are
already open, so don't attack me!

The TRAINERS of PETALBURG GYM
use all kinds of items.

The door at the left leads to
the SPEED ROOM.

The door at the right leads to
the ACCURACY ROOM.

The room's name will be on
the door, so choose carefully.

Once you've chosen the door…
Well, hey, go for it!
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVicto:
{PLAYER}! Whoa! You've overcome even
your own father!

Like, whoa!
What a stunning turn of events!
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallIntro:
The ability to attack before the
opponent…

Just that alone puts me at a great
advantage, don't you agree?
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBattle:
Go on to the next room where a new
challenge awaits you.

At the left is the CONFUSION ROOM.

The right door leads to the DEFENSE
ROOM.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBadge:
Whomever you beat, and whomever you
may lose to, you never shirk from

training yourself and your POKéMON.

That's what I think being a
GYM LEADER is all about.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerIntro:
This is the CONFUSION ROOM.

Let me see how well bonded you are
with your POKéMON!
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerDefeat:
I couldn't confuse your team enough…
You share a strong bond together.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBattle:
The next room is the STRENGTH ROOM.
Can you withstand brute force?
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBadge:
After you beat our LEADER, the
training has become a lot tougher.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeIntro:
Just when you think you're going to
win, your opponent restores HP…

Can you just imagine how awful that
must feel?

I'll show you exactly how awful it
feels!
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeDefeat:
I couldn't restore HP enough…
What ATTACK power…
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBattle:
I should have expected no less from
our LEADER's kid.

No, wait! A TRAINER's abilities are
earned only through effort.

I lost because my own efforts
weren't enough.

Go on! The ONE-HIT KO ROOM is next.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBadge:
I'm going to keep training at GYMS.
One day, I'll become a LEADER.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeIntro:
I'm not going to take it easy just
because you're our LEADER's kid.

I'll show you how horrid it is for
a POKéMON to take a critical hit!
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeDefeat:
Your power…
You're the real deal.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBattle:
Your father really is strong.
He's a TRAINER worth my respect.

And, I sense the same glow coming
from you as your father.

I hope that you'll stage a terrific
battle with your father!
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBadge:
Since your dad became the LEADER,
the TRAINERS of PETALBURG CITY have

become a lot tougher.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro:
Giggle…
This is the ACCURACY ROOM.

It's pretty nasty when every attack
lands without fail.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryDefeat: You were a cut above me…
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle:
There are some even stronger
TRAINERS waiting for you.

The left is the DEFENSE ROOM, and
the right is the RECOVERY ROOM.

Your POKéMON's ATTACK power will be
on trial either way.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBadge:
Do you know what we're trying to
achieve as TRAINERS?

We're striving to become soul mates
with our POKéMON.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaIntro:
The higher the DEFENSE, the more
reckless I can be in attack.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBattle:
I think you've taught me a valuable
lesson here.

Now, go on! The left door goes to
the STRENGTH ROOM.

The right door opens to
the ONE-HIT KO ROOM.

Both of them have TRAINERS who are
skilled at offense.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBadge: Hi! Have you tried using SURF?
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyIntro:
Our GYM LEADER told us to go all out
and beat you.

Even if you happen to be the
LEADER's kid!
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBattle:
The way you use your POKéMON…
It's like your father's style.

Go on through! The GYM LEADER, your
father, is waiting!
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBadge:
Sure, it's fine to make your POKéMON
stronger.

But what decides the winner?

Why, it's the feelings TRAINERS have
for their POKéMON.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked:
This door appears to be locked
right now…
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterSpeedRoom:
“SPEED ROOM,” the sign says.

Do you want to go through?
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked:
This door appears to be locked
right now…
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterAccuracyRoom:
“ACCURACY ROOM,” the sign says.

Do you want to go through?
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterConfusionRoo:
“CONFUSION ROOM,” the sign says.

Do you want to go through?
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterDefenseRoom:
“DEFENSE ROOM,” the sign says.

Do you want to go through?
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterRecoveryRoom:
“RECOVERY ROOM,” the sign says.

Do you want to go through?
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterStrengthRoom:
“STRENGTH ROOM,” the sign says.

Do you want to go through?
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterOHKORoom:
“ONE-HIT KO ROOM,” the sign says.

Do you want to go through?
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterGymLeadersRo:
“GYM LEADER'S ROOM

“See for yourself what POKéMON await
you!” the sign says.

Do you want to go through?
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPreRematch:
DAD: {PLAYER}…
I had a feeling that you would come.

I would never refuse to accept
a challenge from you.

You do understand, don't you?

Inside a GYM, it doesn't matter that
we are a parent and child.

…No, because we are parent and child,
we owe it to each other to do the best

we can. Isn't that right, {PLAYER}?
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchDefe:
Uh… Haha…
Maybe that was going too hard…
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPostRematch:
DAD: {PLAYER}…
What is your dream?

My dream…
Hahaha…

It has already come true, actually.
texts.PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeed:
DAD: {PLAYER}…
I had a feeling that you would come.

I would never refuse to accept
a challenge from you.

You do understand, don't you?

Inside a GYM, it doesn't matter that
we are a parent and child.

Hm? Wait a second, {PLAYER}.

Do you only have one POKéMON that is
capable of battle?

Sorry, but you'll have to come back
with at least two POKéMON.
texts.PetalburgCity_House1_Text_TravelingIsWon:
Traveling is wonderful!

When I was young, I roamed the seas
and the mountains!
texts.PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure:
Sigh…

I wish I could go on an adventure
with some POKéMON…

Crawl through some damp grass…
Climb rocky, rugged mountains…

Cross the raging seas…
Wander about in dark caves…

And, sometimes, even get a little
homesick…

It must be fabulous to travel!
texts.PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGy:
NORMAN became our town's new
GYM LEADER.

I think he called his family over from
somewhere far away.
texts.PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanO:
I battled NORMAN once, but, whew,
he was way too strong.

How would I put it?

I just got the feeling that he
lives for POKéMON.
texts.PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_WeakWillGrowStro:
Even if a POKéMON is weak now,
it will grow stronger.

The most important thing is love!
Love for your POKéMON!
texts.PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_RepelIsUseful:
Do you use REPEL?
It keeps POKéMON away, so it's

useful when you're in a hurry.
texts.PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_TakeSomeAntidote:
Do you have any ANTIDOTES with
you?

If you walk around with a poisoned
POKéMON, it will lose HP until it faints.

Take some ANTIDOTES with you.
texts.PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCSt:
That PC-based POKéMON Storage
System…

Whoever made it must be some kind
of a scientific wizard!
texts.PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Oran:
When my POKéMON ate an
ORAN BERRY, it regained HP!
texts.PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Many:
There are many types of POKéMON.

All types have their strengths and
weaknesses against other types.

Depending on the types of POKéMON,
a battle could be easy or hard.
texts.PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Tree:
For example, your TREECKO
is a GRASS type.

It's strong against the WATER and
GROUND types.

But, it's weak against FIRE-type
POKéMON.
texts.PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Torc:
For example, your TORCHIC
is a FIRE type.

It's strong against the GRASS and
BUG types.

But, it's weak against WATER-type
POKéMON.
texts.PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Mudk:
For example, your MUDKIP
is a WATER type.

It's strong against the FIRE type.

But, it's weak against GRASS-type
and ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.
texts.PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksFor:
You're…
Ah, you must be {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?

Thank you for playing with WALLY a
little while ago.

He's been frail and sickly ever
since he was a baby.

We've sent him to stay with my relatives
in VERDANTURF TOWN for a while.

The air is a lot cleaner there
than it is here.

What's that? Where's WALLY?
He's already left, our WALLY.

I wonder where he could have
gotten by now?
texts.PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WonderHow: I wonder how our WALLY is doing?
texts.PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExc:
{PLAYER}{KUN}! Please excuse us for
dragging you here this way.

But our WALLY's become very healthy
since he went to VERDANTURF TOWN.

We owe it all to you!

When WALLY left town, you helped
him catch a POKéMON, right?

I think that made WALLY really
happy.

Actually, not just WALLY.
It made me, his father, happy too.

Happy that he's gained such a great
friend as you.

This isn't a bribe or anything, but
I'd really like you to have this.
texts.PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_SurfGoAll:
If your POKéMON can SURF, you'll be
able to go to all sorts of places.
texts.PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyIsCo:
WALLY's coming home soon.
I'm looking forward to that.
texts.PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWal:
Oh? You met WALLY in
EVER GRANDE CITY?

Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, don't be silly.

He may have gotten healthy, but he
can't go somewhere far away like

that all by himself.
texts.PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyWasR:
WALLY was really happy when he told
us that he caught a POKéMON.

It's been ages since I've seen him
smile like that.
texts.PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeft:
I want you to keep this a secret
from my husband…

But our WALLY left VERDANTURF TOWN
without telling anyone.

You know, WALLY is frail, but
he's surprisingly strong-willed.

I'm sure that he'll come back safe
and sound one day!
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_NotAOneToBeFound:
Hmmm…
Not a one to be found…
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_HaveYouSeenShroomish:
Hello, have you seen any POKéMON
called SHROOMISH around here?

I really love that POKéMON.
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_IWasGoingToAmbushYou:
I was going to ambush you, but you
had to dawdle in PETALBURG WOODS

forever, didn't you?

I got sick of waiting, so here I am!
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_HandOverThosePapers:
You! DEVON RESEARCHER!

Hand over those papers!
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_YouHaveToHelpMe:
Aiyeeeh!

You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?
You've got to help me, please!
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_NoOneCrossesTeamAqua:
Hunh? What do you think you're doing?
What, you're going to protect him?

No one who crosses TEAM AQUA
gets any mercy, not even a kid!

Come on and battle me!
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_YouveGotSomeNerve:
Grrr… You've got some nerve
meddling with TEAM AQUA!

Come on and battle me again!

I wish I could say that, but I'm out of
POKéMON…

And, hey, we of TEAM AQUA are also
after something in RUSTBORO.

I'll let you go today!
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_ThatWasAwfullyClose:
Whew…
That was awfully close!

Thanks to you, he didn't rob me of
these important papers.

I know, I'll give you a GREAT BALL as
my thanks!
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_TeamAquaAfterSomethi:
Didn't that TEAM AQUA thug say
they were after something in

RUSTBORO, too?
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_ICantBeWastingTime:
Uh-oh! It's a crisis!
I can't be wasting time!
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems:
You're loaded with items.
I can't give you this GREAT BALL.
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_GoBugPokemonTeam:
I caught a whole bunch of POKéMON!

Go, go, go!
My BUG POKéMON team!
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_ICouldntWin:
I have all these POKéMON,
but I couldn't win…
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_ImOutOfPokeBalls:
I caught a bunch of POKéMON.
Now I'm out of POKé BALLS.
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_InstantlyPopularWith:
If you take BUG POKéMON to school,
you get to be instantly popular!
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfILose: I can't be popular if I lose.
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_PeopleRespectYou:
If you have a big BUG POKéMON,
people respect you for it.
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch1:
I want a rematch when my BUG
POKéMON grow up!

I'm registering you in my POKéNAV!
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch2:
I want a rematch when my BUG 
POKéMON grow up!

I'm registering you in my POKéNAV!
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_MyPokemonHaveGrown:
My BUG POKéMON have grown.
I'll be popular again.
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfLose: I can't be popular if I lose.
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_IveBeenTrainingHard:
You get to be popular if you have
strong POKéMON, right?

So, I've been training hard.
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_StayOutOfTallGrass:
Yo, there!
Your POKéMON doing okay?

If your POKéMON are weak and you want
to avoid battles, you should stay out

of tall grass.
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_HiddenItemsExplanati:
Sometimes, there are things on the
ground even if you can't see them.

That's why I always check where I'm
walking.
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_TryUsingThisItem:
Oh, neat!
That's the BADGE from RUSTBORO GYM!

You must be a TRAINER.
You should try using this item.
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_MiracleSeedExplanati:
It's a MIRACLE SEED.
If a POKéMON holds that item, its

GRASS-type moves become stronger.

Besides MIRACLE SEED, I think there are
other convenient items for POKéMON

to hold.
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperienc:
TRAINER TIPS

Any POKéMON that appears even once
in a battle is awarded EXP Points.

To raise a weak POKéMON, put it at the
left of the team list.

As soon as a battle starts, switch it
out. It will earn EXP Points without

being exposed to any harm.
texts.PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP:
TRAINER TIPS

In addition to Hit Points (HP), POKéMON
have Power Points (PP) that are used to

make moves during battle.

If a POKéMON runs out of PP, it must be
taken to a POKéMON CENTER.
texts.Route101_Text_PleaseHelp:
Hello! You over there!
Please! Help!

In my BAG!
There's a POKé BALL!
texts.Route101_Text_DontLeaveMe:
Wh-Where are you going?!
Don't leave me like this!
texts.Route101_Text_YouSavedMe:
PROF. BIRCH: Whew…

I was in the tall grass studying wild
POKéMON when I was jumped.

You saved me.
Thanks a lot!

Oh?

Hi, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}!

This is not the place to chat, so come
by my POKéMON LAB later, okay?
texts.Route101_Text_TakeTiredPokemonToPokeCent:
If POKéMON get tired, take them to
a POKéMON CENTER.

There's a POKéMON CENTER in OLDALE
TOWN right close by.
texts.Route101_Text_WildPokemonInTallGrass:
Wild POKéMON will jump out at you in
tall grass.

If you want to catch POKéMON, you have
to go into the tall grass and search.
texts.Route102_Text_WatchMeCatchPokemon:
WALLY: {PLAYER}…
POKéMON hide in tall grass like this,

don't they?

Please watch me and see if I can
catch one properly.

…Whoa!
texts.Route102_Text_WallyIDidIt:
WALLY: I did it… It's my…
My POKéMON!
texts.Route102_Text_LetsGoBack:
