{PLAYER}, thank you!
Let's go back to the GYM!
texts.Route102_Text_ImNotVeryTall:
I'm…not very tall, so I sink right
into tall grass.

The grass goes up my nose and…
Fwafwafwafwafwa…

Fwatchoo!
texts.Route102_Text_CatchWholeBunchOfPokemon:
I'm going to catch a whole bunch of
POKéMON!
texts.Route103_Text_MayRoute103Pokemon:
MAY: Let's see… The POKéMON found
on ROUTE 103 include…
texts.Route103_Text_MayLetsBattle:
Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

…Oh, I see, my dad gave you
a POKéMON as a gift.

Since we're here, let's have a quick
battle!

I'll give you a taste of what being
a TRAINER is like.
texts.Route103_Text_MayDefeated:
Wow! That's great!
{PLAYER}{KUN}, you're pretty good!
texts.Route103_Text_MayTimeToHeadBack:
MAY: I think I know why my dad has
an eye out for you now.

I mean, you just got that POKéMON,
but it already likes you.

You might be able to befriend any
kind of POKéMON easily.

Well, it's time to head back to
the LAB.
texts.Route103_Text_BrendanRoute103Pokemon:
BRENDAN: Okay, so it's this one and
that one that live on ROUTE 103…
texts.Route103_Text_BrendanLetsBattle:
Hey, it's {PLAYER}!

…Oh, yeah, Dad gave you a POKéMON.

Since we're here, how about a little
battle?

I'll teach you what being a TRAINER's
about!
texts.Route103_Text_BrendanTimeToHeadBack:
BRENDAN: I think I get it.
I think I know why my dad has his eye

out for you now.

Look, your POKéMON already likes you,
even though you just got it.

{PLAYER}, I get the feeling that you
could befriend any POKéMON with ease.

We should head back to the LAB.
texts.Route103_Text_ShouldHaveBroughtPotion:
My POKéMON is staggeringly tired…
I should have brought a POTION…
texts.Route103_Text_ShortcutToOldale:
If you cross the sea from here,
it'll be a shortcut to OLDALE TOWN.

Fufufu, that's useful, isn't it?
texts.Route104_Text_BrineyLivesInSeasideCottag:
That seaside cottage is where
MR. BRINEY lives.

He was once a mighty sailor who never
feared the sea, however stormy.
texts.Route104_Text_WhatsItLikeAtBottomOfSea:
The sea, huh?

I wonder what it's like at the bottom
of the sea?
texts.Route104_Text_ThrowBallAtWeakenedPokemon:
If you're going to throw a POKé BALL,
weaken the wild POKéMON first.

It will be easier to catch if it's been
poisoned, burned, or lulled to sleep.
texts.Route104_Text_OnlyThrowBallAtWildPokemon:
You're a thief if you try to steal
someone else's POKéMON.

You should throw POKé BALLS only at
wild POKéMON.
texts.Route104_Text_ImNotATrainer:
Oh, no, I'm not a TRAINER.

But that's right, if TRAINERS lock eyes,
it's a challenge to battle.

If you don't want to battle, stay out
of their sight.
texts.Route104_Text_LikeFillingMouthWithSeedsT:
I like filling my mouth with seeds,
then spitting them out fast!

You can have this, so you try it out!

Use it on a POKéMON, and it will learn
a move for firing seeds rapidly.
texts.Route104_Text_TMsAreOneTimeUse:
A word of advice!

A TM, TECHNICAL MACHINE, is good only
for one-time use.

Once you use it, it's gone.
Think twice before using it!
texts.Route104_Text_DontNeedThisTakeIt:
This FLOWER SHOP started selling
saplings recently.

It made me so happy, I went overboard
shopping.

I don't need this WHITE HERB anymore.
Would you take it, please?
texts.Route104_Text_FlowerShopSellingSaplings:
This FLOWER SHOP started selling
saplings recently.

It made me so happy, I went overboard
shopping. Where should I put them?
texts.Route104_Text_TrainerTipsDoubleBattles:
TRAINER TIPS

In the HOENN region there are pairs
of TRAINERS who challenge others

for 2-on-2 POKéMON battles called

DOUBLE BATTLES.

In a DOUBLE BATTLE, the TRAINER must
send out two POKéMON, the one at the

left of the list and the top one.

Watch how POKéMON are lined up.
texts.Route104_Text_MayWeShouldRegister:
MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

DEVON upgraded your POKéNAV with
the MATCH CALL system, huh?

We should register each other so we
can get in contact anytime.
texts.Route104_Text_MayHowsYourPokedex:
MAY: Oh, by the way, {PLAYER}{KUN},
how's your POKéDEX coming along?
texts.Route104_Text_MayMinesDecentLetsBattle:
Mine's looking pretty decent.
So…

How about a little battle?
texts.Route104_Text_MayHaventRaisedPokemon:
MAY: Oh, what's the matter?

Haven't you caught or raised your
POKéMON very much?

That's not very good for a TRAINER!
texts.Route104_Text_MayLetsBattle:
MAY: So, what do you think?
How about a little battle here?
texts.Route104_Text_MayIntro:
MAY: You just became a TRAINER,
{PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm not going to lose!
texts.Route104_Text_MayDefeat:
Yikes!
You're better than I expected!
texts.Route104_Text_MayPostBattle:
MAY: I can tell you've gotten pretty
good with the way you handle POKéMON.

But instead of only making them
battle, you should be like MR. BRINEY.

It's important to become friends with
POKéMON, too.
texts.Route104_Text_BrendanWeShouldRegister:
BRENDAN: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!

Cool, you had DEVON install the MATCH
CALL system on your POKéNAV!

Let's register each other in our
POKéNAVS so we can keep in touch.
texts.Route104_Text_BrendanHowsYourPokedex:
BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX?
Have you filled in any pages yet?
texts.Route104_Text_BrendanDoingGreatLetsBattl:
Me, I'm doing great!

Want to check out how good I am with
a battle?
texts.Route104_Text_BrendanNoConfidence:
BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have
any confidence in your POKéMON?
texts.Route104_Text_BrendanLetsBattle:
BRENDAN: What's up?
Want to have a battle with me?
texts.Route104_Text_BrendanIntro:
BRENDAN: I know you just became
a TRAINER, but I won't go easy!
texts.Route104_Text_BrendanPostBattle:
BRENDAN: You've gotten pretty decent
at handling POKéMON.

But, you know, you shouldn't just be
making POKéMON battle.

Like MR. BRINEY, it's important to
become friends with your POKéMON.
texts.Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WaitUpPeeko:
MR. BRINEY: Hold on, lass!
Wait up, PEEKO!
texts.Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_ItsYouLetsS:
Hm? You're {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You saved my darling PEEKO!

We owe so much to you!

What's that?
You want to sail with me?

Hmhm…

You have a LETTER bound for DEWFORD
and a package for SLATEPORT, then?

Quite the busy life you must lead!

But, certainly, what you're asking is
no problem at all.

You've come to the right man!
We'll set sail for DEWFORD.
texts.Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_SetSailForD:
MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then!

Anchors aweigh!
PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!
texts.Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_DeclineDeli:
MR. BRINEY: Is that so?
Your deliveries can wait?

You just go on and tell me whenever
you want to set sail!
texts.Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToMakeD:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
I know exactly what you want to say!

You're to deliver a LETTER to DEWFORD
and a package to SLATEPORT.

What you need me to do is no problem
at all--I'm the man for the job!

First, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.
texts.Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToDeliv:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
I know exactly what you want to say!

You're to deliver a package to
CAPT. STERN in SLATEPORT.

What you need me to do is no problem
at all--I'm the man for the job!

First, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.
texts.Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WhereAreWeB:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
For you, I'll go out to sea anytime!

Now, my friend, where are we bound?
texts.Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_TellMeWhene:
MR. BRINEY: Is that so?
Well, PEEKO owes her life to you.

You just go on and tell me whenever
you want to set sail!
texts.Route104_Text_DadPokenavCall:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!

DAD: Oh, {PLAYER}?

… … … … … …
Where are you now?

It sounds windy wherever you are.

I just heard from DEVON's MR. STONE
about your POKéNAV, so I decided

to give you a call.

It sounds like you're doing fine,
so that's fine with me.

You take care now.

… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!
texts.Route104_Text_RegisteredDadInPokenav:
Registered DAD NORMAN
in the POKéNAV.
texts.Route106_Text_TrainerTips:
TRAINER TIPS

Advice on catching POKéMON with a ROD:
Press the A Button if you get a bite.
texts.DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInSlateport:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
We've made land in SLATEPORT!

I suppose you're going to visit CAPT.
STERN and deliver the DEVON GOODS?
texts.Route109_Text_BrineySailToDewfordQuestio:
MR. BRINEY: I thought you're supposed
to deliver the DEVON GOODS.

Would you like to sail back to
DEWFORD, then?
texts.Route109_Text_BrineyDewfordItIs:
MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then!

Anchors aweigh!
PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!
texts.Route109_Text_BrineyDeliverDevonGoods:
MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver
the DEVON GOODS. I'll be waiting.
texts.DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInSlateport:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've made land in
SLATEPORT!

You just go on and tell me whenever
you want to set sail again!
texts.Route109_Text_BrineyWhereAreWeBound:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
For you, I'll go out to sea anytime!

Now, my friend, where are we bound?
texts.Route109_Text_BrineyTellMeWhenYouNeedToS:
MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever
you need to set sail again!
texts.Route109_Text_ChillAtMyPapasSpot:
Yo, TRAINERS!
Whether you're hot to trot,

or cool cat not,

chill at my papa's spot!
texts.Route109_Text_LittleKidsDartAround:
Little kids can dart around so quickly…

You don't dare take your eyes off them
for an instant. It's very taxing.

Mine are with my POKéMON, so they
should be okay, but…
texts.Route109_Text_SandCastleTakingLongTime:
Our sand castle's taking a long time
to make.
texts.Route109_Text_WereGoingToMakeBigCastle:
We're going to get all the sand from
the beach and make a big castle!

And then we're going to be a king and
queen.

We'll let you be a servant.
texts.Route109_Text_ZigzagoonPicksUpLitter:
The water around these parts is clean.

But, I get my ZIGZAGOON to pick up
litter from the shoreline at times.

Dirty water becomes rain and joins our
rivers, which we drink from…

If we pollute the sea, it all comes
back to haunt us eventually.
texts.Route109_Text_SeashoreHouseSign:
SEASHORE HOUSE

“May hot battles rage on hot sands!
The place for hot TRAINERS!”
texts.Route109_Text_TrainerTipsSign:
TRAINER TIPS

POKéMON at the same level may not
always have identical stats.

POKéMON raised by TRAINERS are said
to grow stronger than wild POKéMON.
texts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SeashoreHous:
I'm the owner of the SEASHORE HOUSE.
But you can call me MR. SEA!

What I love above all is to see hot
POKéMON battles.

Let me see that your heart burns hot!

If you can defeat all the TRAINERS
here, I'll reward your efforts.
texts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_ShowMeSomeHo:
Show me some hot matches!

I run this SEASHORE HOUSE just for
that reason alone!
texts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_TakeTheseSod:
You're scorching hot!
Those battles blazed!

I'm more than just satisfied!

As thanks for showing me your hot
streak, I want you to take these.

It's half a dozen bottles of SODA POP!
texts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_BagFull:
Oh, but hey, your BAG's jammed full.
I'll hang on to these for you.
texts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_WantToBuySod:
Want to buy some SODA POP?
POKéMON love it!

Just ¥300 a bottle!
Buy some!
texts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwayneIntro:
If you're looking for a battle in the
SEASHORE HOUSE, you'll find no

hotter TRAINER than me, matey!
texts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwayneDefeat:
That was a hot battle!
I can accept that loss, matey!
texts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwaynePostBa:
Whenever I'm in SLATEPORT, I enjoy
hot battles and ice-cold SODA POP!
texts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaIntro:
Boring battles aren't worth the effort.

Fiery hot battles are what toughen up
TRAINERS and POKéMON!
texts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaPostB:
Whew, I'm all thirsty.
Maybe I'll have a SODA POP.
texts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonIntro:
I'm going to show you how great
my POKéMON are, but don't cry!
texts.Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonPostBat:
If one of my POKéMON knew the move
for carrying me across water on its

back, I could get rid of this inner tube.
texts.Route110_Text_WeCantTalkAboutAquaActivit:
TEAM AQUA's activities…
We can't talk about them yet.
texts.Route110_Text_KickUpARuckus:
I want to get going to SLATEPORT and
kick up a ruckus!
texts.Route110_Text_MyFirstJobInAqua:
This is my first job after joining
TEAM AQUA. It's a little scary.
texts.Route110_Text_AquaActionsBringSmiles:
TEAM AQUA's actions should bring
smiles to people's faces!
texts.Route110_Text_MayLetsBattle:
MAY: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}, long time no see!

While I was searching for other
POKéMON, my POKéMON grew stronger.

So…
How about a little battle?
texts.Route110_Text_MayDefeated:
Yikes!
You're better than I expected!
texts.Route110_Text_MayTakeThis:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've been busy
training, too, haven't you?

I think you deserve a reward!
This is from me!
texts.Route110_Text_MayExplainItemfinder:
MAY: That's an ITEMFINDER.

Try it out. If there is an item that's
not visible, it emits a sound.

Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let's meet again!

I know it's a little silly coming from
me, but I think you should train a lot

harder for the next time.
texts.Route110_Text_BrendanLetsBattle:
BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}.
So this is where you were.

How's it going?

Have you been raising your POKéMON?
I'll check for you.
texts.Route110_Text_BrendanTakeThis:
BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, you've trained
without me noticing…

Good enough!
Here, take this.
texts.Route110_Text_BrendanExplainItemfinder:
BRENDAN: That's an ITEMFINDER.

Use it to root around for items that
aren't visible.

If it senses something, it emits
a sound.

Anyway, I'm off to look for new
POKéMON.
texts.Route110_Text_RideBikeAtFullSpeed:
Wouldn't it be great to ride a BIKE
at full speed on CYCLING ROAD?
texts.Route110_Text_HairStreamsBehindMe:
How do you like the way my raven-
colored hair streams behind me?

I grew my hair out just for that.
texts.Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel:
Oh, hey, you got that BIKE from RYDEL!

Oh, it's glaringly obvious.
It says right on your bike…

RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,

RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,

RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,

RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,

RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL…
That name's everywhere.

You should ride it around all over
the place--it's good advertising!
texts.Route110_Text_TwoRoads:
The two roads, one above, one below…

A road each for people and POKéMON.
Perhaps that is right and fair.
texts.Route110_Text_WalkOnTheLowRoad:
I don't have a BIKE, so I'll take
a leisurely walk on the low road.
texts.Route110_Text_BikeTechniques:
Learning techniques will make BIKE
riding even more fun.

There are some places that you can
reach only by using a BIKE technique.
texts.Route110_Text_WhichShouldIChoose:
Which should I choose?

Make a beeline for MAUVILLE on
CYCLING ROAD, or take the low road

and look for POKéMON?
texts.Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBest:
Bravo! Splendid showing!

Your love of cycling comes from deep
within your heart.

You've shaken me to my very soul!
texts.Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionGood:
Your technique is remarkable.

I suggest you speed up a bit while
still avoiding collisions.
texts.Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionOk:
I would consider you a work in
progress.

Still, I hope you don't forget the
sheer pleasure of cycling.
texts.Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBad:
My word… Your cycling skills border
on terrifying.

Most certainly, you need much more
practice riding.
texts.Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionWorst:
…I am aghast…

You're perhaps not cut out for this
unfortunate cycling business.

You ought to give serious thought to
returning that BIKE to RYDEL.
texts.Route110_Text_RatedForNumberOfCollisions:
This is CYCLING ROAD.

If you were to ride from MAUVILLE to
SLATEPORT on a MACH BIKE, you would

be rated for the number of collisions

and your total time.
texts.Route110_Text_AlwaysAimHigher:
Regardless of the results, I count on
seeing more challenges from you.

Always aim higher!
texts.Route110_Text_AcroBikesDoNotQualify:
On this CYCLING ROAD, those riding
MACH BIKES are rated for their number

of collisions and their total times.

ACRO BIKES do not qualify for rating.
They are easy to turn, so it's not fair.
texts.Route110_Text_AquaWasHere:
“TEAM AQUA was here!”

Someone painted that onto this sign,
but then someone else painted over it.

“TEAM MAGMA rules!” is what it
says now.
texts.Route110_Text_TrainerTipsPrlzSleep:
TRAINER TIPS

The foe can be made helpless by
paralyzing it or causing it to sleep.

It is an important technique for
POKéMON battles.
texts.Route110_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterItems:
TRAINER TIPS

The items in the BAG can be reorganized
by pressing SELECT.
texts.Route110_Text_TrickHouseSign:
“Three steps {RIGHT_ARROW} and two steps {UP_ARROW}
to reach the wondrous TRICK HOUSE.”
texts.Route110_Text_ThereIsNoRecord:
THE BEST RECORD TO DATE…

No one seems to have taken the
challenge. There is no record…
texts.Route110_Text_ImagineSeeingYouHere:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Imagine seeing you here!

And where might my {RIVAL} be?
texts.Route110_Text_HeardYouInstallMatchCall:
Oh, I see!
You two are running separately.

Well, that's fine.

Oh, yes, I heard that your POKéNAV
had the MATCH CALL system installed.

Well, then, I should register you in
my POKéNAV as well.

That way, even when we're apart,
I can rate your POKéDEX anytime.

… … … … … …
texts.Route110_Text_RegisteredBirchInPokenav:
Registered PROF. BIRCH
in the POKéNAV.
texts.Route110_Text_KeepAnEyeOutForRival:
PROF. BIRCH: {PLAYER}{KUN}…

Please keep an eye out for my {RIVAL}.
… … … … … …

Well, I had better get going.
See you again, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
texts.Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadNorthEntrance:
On CYCLING ROAD, you can go all out
and cycle as fast as you'd like.

It feels great to go that fast, but try
not to crash into anyone!

Sorry, you can't walk on CYCLING
ROAD. It's too dangerous.

Please come back with a BIKE.
texts.Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance:
On CYCLING ROAD, you can go all out
and cycle as fast as you'd like.

It feels great to go that fast, but try
not to crash into anyone!

Sorry, you can't walk on CYCLING
ROAD. It's too dangerous.

Please come back with a BIKE.
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YouveMadeItT:
Aak!
You've made it to me?

Hmmm… You're sharp!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToPl:
It took me all night to plant all those
trees…

You're almost my equal in greatness by
one, two, three, four, five, six places!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMa:
It took me all night to make the maze…

You're almost my equal in greatness by
one, two, three, four, five places!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToPr:
It took me all night to prepare
the wall panels…

You're almost my equal in greatness by
one, two, three, four places!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToSh:
It took me all night to shove in those
boulders…

You're almost my equal in greatness by
one, two, three places!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMa:
It took me all night to make MECHADOLLS
and another to think up the quiz…

You're almost my equal in greatness by
one, two places!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToIn:
It took me all night to install
the doors…

You're almost my equal in greatness!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightSett:
It took me all night setting up arrows…

You're my equal in greatness!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightPoli:
It took me all night polishing floors…

You're above me in greatness!
Possibly…
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_FountainOfId:
Wh-what should I do?
My fountain of ideas for tricks has

run dry…

Perhaps it is time I toured the country
on a quest to devise new tricks…
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePr:
I hate to admit defeat, but you have
bested me!

Still, you must have been reeled in by
my charisma for you to visit me again

and again. Yes, you must have!

But that has nothing to do with my
losing!

In recognition of the friendship
between you, the driven, and the genius

that is myself, I demand that you take

this keepsake!

Actually there are two--
a RED TENT and a BLUE TENT.

Which do you prefer?
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomInPC:
What? No room in your PC?
What am I to make of that?

I wish I could say that, but I am much
too kind and caring, so come back later!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_LeavingOnJou:
… … … … … …

I am leaving on a journey of discovery.
A quest in search of new tricks.

I wish that you will one day visit and
entertain me again.

And now, farewell!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YouHaveEarne:
Fine!
You have earned this reward!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomForThi:
What? Have you no room for this?
What manner of items do you carry?

But fine, since you've reached me,
your reward will be with me till later.
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_MakeNewTrick:
Scrub that smug smirk from your face!
It's much too early to think you've won!

I'll make new tricks to stump you, I will.
You may mock me only when you're done.

Come back for the next exciting
installment!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YoureIgnorin:
Now, now! You're ignoring me now?
Now that, I consider heartbreaking!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_Conceal:
Hah? Grrr…

How did you know I concealed myself
beneath this desk? You're sharp!

Hah? Grrr…

How did you know I concealed myself
behind this tree? You're sharp!

Hah? Grrr…

How did you know I concealed myself
in this dresser? You're sharp!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_Coneale:
Hah? Grrr…

How did you know I concealed myself
beyond this window? You're sharp!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_Conceal:
Hah? Grrr…

How did you know I concealed myself
in this planter? You're sharp!

Hah? Grrr…

How did you know I concealed myself
in this cupboard? You're sharp!

Hah? Grrr…

How did you know I concealed myself
behind this window? You're sharp!

Hah? Grrr…

How did you know I concealed myself
beneath this cushion? You're sharp!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_TheyCal:
Behold!

For I am the greatest living mystery
of a man in all of HOENN!

They call me…

The TRICK MASTER!
Wahahaha! Glad to meet you!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ComeToC:
You, you've come to challenge
my TRICK HOUSE, haven't you?

That's why you're here, isn't it?
Yes, it is!

Consider your challenge accepted!

Enter through the scroll there,
and let your challenge commence!

I shall be waiting in the back!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_GoInHol:
There is a big hole behind the scroll!

Want to go in?
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_Leaving:
There is a note affixed to the scroll…

“I am leaving on a journey.
Don't look for me. TRICK MASTER”
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_NextTim:
For the next time, I'll use this trick,
and that scheme, and those ruses…

Mufufufu… If I may say so, it's
brilliantly difficult, even for me!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_InMidst:
Hah? What?!
Oh, it's you!

I'm in the midst of devising new tricky
challenges!

It's not too much to ask for a bit more
time for me to think, is it now?

You wouldn't begrudge me that?

Come back in a little while!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_YoureHe:
Ah, it's you! You're here to accept the
reward from before, isn't that right?

Yes, right I am!

Here!
I'll give it to you now!
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_DidYouN:
Hah?
Did you not come to claim your reward?
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_Mechado:
MECHADOLL 5 I AM!
IF REWARD IS NOT TAKEN BY YOU,

THEN TRICK MASTER YOU CANNOT FOLLOW.

RED TENT OR BLUE TENT,
WHICH DO YOU PREFER?
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_PCFullA:
YOUR PC STATUS: FULL AGAIN.
MEAN, YOU ARE.
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle_Text_Memorized:
{PLAYER} memorized the secret code
written on the scroll.
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle_Text_SecretCod: A secret code is written on it.
texts.Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_DoorLoc:
The door is locked.

…On closer inspection, this is written
on it: “Write the secret code here.”
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_WroteSec:
{PLAYER} wrote down the secret code
on the door.

“TRICK MASTER is fabulous.”
… … … … … … … …

The lock clicked open!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_SallyInt:
I'll hack and slash my way to victory
with the CUT we just learned!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_SallyPos:
I never get tired of hacking
and slashing!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_EddieInt:
I wandered into this weird house
by accident…
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_EddiePos:
I lost my way, I lost a battle, and I'm
now even more lost… I can't get out…
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_RobinInt: Just who is the TRICK MASTER?
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_RobinDef: I lost while I was lost in thought!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_RobinPos:
You're strong!
Just who are you?
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_WroteSec:
{PLAYER} wrote down the secret code
on the door.

“TRICK MASTER is smart.”
… … … … … … … …

The lock clicked open!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_TedDefea:
After that battle, I'm even more
confused!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_TedPostB:
Can I get you to push all the buttons
for me?
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_PaulIntr:
Oh! You're on your second TRICK HOUSE
challenge!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_PaulPost:
The TRICK MASTER rigged all the tricks
in this house all by himself.
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_GeorgiaI:
I want to make my own GYM one day.
So, I'm studying how to set traps.
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_GeorgiaP:
You're strong, aren't you?
Maybe even enough to be a GYM LEADER!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_WroteSec:
{PLAYER} wrote down the secret code
on the door.

“TRICK MASTER is coveted.”
… … … … … … … …

The lock clicked open!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_JustinIn: I keep coming back to this same place!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_JustinDe:
I'm already having trouble, and then
you have to beat me? It's not fair!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_JustinPo:
It's full of doors here!
It's too small and dark in here! Help!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_MarthaIn:
I don't know what's going on here.
I'm starting to feel sad…
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_MarthaPo:
I know I'm weak!
And, I have no sense of direction!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_AlanIntr:
I don't get it. What would anyone want
with a house this bizarre?
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_AlanDefe:
I don't get it.
How did I lose?
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_AlanPost:
I don't get it.
How many traps are in this house?

You may be the one to solve that.
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_WroteSec:
{PLAYER} wrote down the secret code
on the door.

“TRICK MASTER is cool.”
… … … … … … … …

The lock clicked open!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraIntr:
It's too much bother to think this out.
I only wanted to battle!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraDefe:
Even though I lost, I still like battling
the best!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraPost:
Wouldn't you agree? You would go
anywhere if TRAINERS were there.
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiIntr:
Heh! Boulders like this, I can brush
aside with one finger!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiDefe:
I can push boulders, but I can't solve
the puzzle…
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiPost:
It's not good enough to be brawny…
You have to use your head. Be brainy!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaInt:
The TRICK HOUSE is getting trickier,
isn't it?
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaPos: Has anyone made it to the end?
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_WroteSec:
{PLAYER} wrote down the secret code
on the door.

“TRICK MASTER is a genius.”
… … … … … … … …

The lock clicked open!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadol:
CLICKETY-CLACK…
MECHADOLL 1 AM I!

IF YOU ANSWER QUIZZES CORRECTLY,
THEN YOU WILL GO TO MECHADOLL 5.

THEN YOU CAN OBTAIN THE SECRET CODE.

MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ.

One of these POKéMON is not found
on ROUTE 110. Which one is it?

MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ.

One of these POKéMON is not of the
WATER type. Which one is it?

MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ.

One of these POKéMON does not use
LEECH LIFE. Which one is it?
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_CorrectG:
CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.
GO THROUGH. PLEASE.
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_WaitForN: YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE WE WAIT FOR.
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadol:
CLICKETY-CLACK…
MECHADOLL 2 AM I!

MECHADOLL 1'S QUIZ DIFFICULTY LEVEL
IS SET TOO LOW.

MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ.

Which of these POKéMON did WALLY
borrow from your father?

MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ.

Which of these POKéMON was chasing
PROF. BIRCH?

MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ.

Which of these POKéMON did TEAM AQUA
use in PETALBURG FOREST?

CLICKETY-CLACK…
MECHADOLL 3 AM I!

MATTERS OF MONEY ARE MY SOLE FOCUS.

MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ.

Which costs more?
Three HARBOR MAILS or one BURN HEAL?

MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ.

Sell one GREAT BALL and buy
one POTION. How much money remains?

MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ.

Do one REPEL and SODA POP cost
more than one SUPER POTION?

CLICKETY-CLACK…
MECHADOLL 4 THAT IS ME!

MY QUIZ IS AN OBJECT OF BEAUTY.

MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ.

In SEASHORE HOUSE, were there more men
or women?

MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ.

In LAVARIDGE TOWN, were there more
elderly men or elderly women?

MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ.

In the TRAINER'S SCHOOL, how many
girl students were there?

CLICKETY-CLACK…
MECHADOLL 5 AM I!

THE MASTER'S BEST AND PROUDEST
ACHIEVEMENT AM I.

MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ.

In SLATEPORT's POKéMON FAN CLUB,
how many POKéMON were there?

MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ.

In FORTREE CITY, how many
tree houses were there?

MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ.

On the CYCLING ROAD, how many
TRIATHLETES were there?
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_WroteSec:
{PLAYER} wrote down the secret code
on the door.

“TRICK MASTER is my life.”
… … … … … … … …

The lock clicked open!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaIn:
When I heard there was a strange
house, I had to check it out.
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaPo:
I'm sure having a good time checking
this place out.

It's a challenge I've found worth
repeating!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyInt:
Maybe I could get my BIRD POKéMON
to fly over the wall…
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyPos:
Ehehehe… I guess I lost because
I was trying to cheat.
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_Sebastia:
I'm getting dizzy from these rotating
doors…

Everything's spinning around and
around. I can't take this anymore…

You don't seem to be affected at all.
Or do you have your poker face on?
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_WroteSec:
{PLAYER} wrote down the secret code
on the door.

“TRICK MASTER is huggable.”
… … … … … … … …

The lock clicked open!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaIn:
The TRICK MASTER always vanishes
like smoke. How does he do it?
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaDe:
Aiyeeeh! You're much too strong!
How do you do it?
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaPo:
I wish I could appear and disappear as
if I were smoke, too.
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_Patricia:
Going around the same spot…
It begets ill fortune…

I've circled the same spot over ten
times now… It's ill fortune…
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisIn:
Whoever wins will get through here
first. That's the feeling I get.
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisPo:
You're solving all the puzzles in the
TRICK HOUSE. That's the feeling I get.
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaI:
Nufufufu, here at last!
Let's get right with it!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaP:
Humph! I'm not upset!
Not me!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroIn: I ever so closely watched you coming!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroDe: This outcome I didn't see coming…
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroPo:
Well, anyway, we both picked a weird
place to get acquainted.

As one weirdo to another,
let's do our best!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettP:
I was hoping to switch places with you
when I beat you, but…
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_WroteSec:
{PLAYER} wrote down the secret code
on the door.

“TRICK MASTER I love.”
… … … … … … … …

The lock clicked open!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentI:
Not many TRAINERS have made it
this far.
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentD: That must mean you're tough, too…
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentP:
You've beaten the POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION? That's too much!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraInt:
Consider yourself lucky to be
battling me!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraDef:
This isn't right!
I can't lose!
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraPos:
It's a miracle that you beat me.
You can brag about it.
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_LeroyInt:
You've been slugging through the TRICK
HOUSE challenge, too.
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_LeroyDef:
I see…
You possess an extraordinary style.
texts.Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_LeroyPos:
Seeing someone like you should please
the TRICK MASTER.
texts.Route111_Text_BattleOurFamily:
Hello! I take it you're a traveler.

How's this? What do you say to taking
on our family of four in a series of

POKéMON battles?
texts.Route111_Text_IsThatSo:
Is that so?
Drop in, if you change your mind!
texts.Route111_Text_VictorIntro: That's the spirit! I like you!
texts.Route111_Text_VictorDefeat:
Aiyah!
You're a lot tougher than I expected!
texts.Route111_Text_VictorPostBattle:
Hey, all!
I've found a pretty strong TRAINER!
texts.Route111_Text_VictoriaIntro:
Oh, my goodness! Aren't you young?

You must be quite the TRAINER to beat
my husband, though.

It's my turn to battle now!
texts.Route111_Text_VictoriaDefeat:
Oh, gosh!
I can't get over how strong you are!
texts.Route111_Text_VictoriaPostBattle:
There's a strong TRAINER here!
This one's really strong!
texts.Route111_Text_ViviIntro:
You're stronger than Mommy? Wow!

But I'm strong, too!
Really! Honestly!
texts.Route111_Text_VickyIntro:
How dare you make my granddaughter
cry!

For that, I'm going to smack you!
Prepare to lose!
texts.Route111_Text_VickyDefeat:
Kwah! You are strong…
My granddaughter was right…
texts.Route111_Text_VickyPostBattle:
If you're not in any hurry,
visit with us awhile.
texts.Route111_Text_ToughToKeepWinningUpTheRan:
If you don't raise your POKéMON some
more, it could be tough to keep winning

up through the ranks.

I've heard the POKéMON LEAGUE's
ELITE FOUR are far stronger than

any GYM LEADER.
texts.Route111_Text_WinstrateFamilyDestroyedMe:
I challenged the WINSTRATE family,
but four matches in a row is tough

going… They destroyed me.
texts.Route111_Text_WinstrateHouseSign:
“Our family's hearts beat as one!”
THE WINSTRATE'S HOUSE
texts.Route111_Text_OldLadysRestStopSign:
OLD LADY'S REST STOP
“Come in and rest your tired bones.”
texts.Route111_Text_TrainerTipsSpAtkSpDef:
TRAINER TIPS

One of the indicators of a POKéMON's
powerfulness is SP. ATK. It stands for

“SPECIAL ATTACK.”

Likewise, SP. DEF stands for “SPECIAL
DEFENSE.”
texts.Route111_Text_ShouldBeMirageTowerAroundH:
There should be a tower made of sand
around here somewhere.

But for some reason, it can be seen
sometimes, and sometimes not.

That's why I call it the MIRAGE TOWER.
texts.Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible:
I see it!
The tower of sand!

The sand tower they called a mirage
is clearly visible!

But it looks so fragile…
It could crumble away anytime…

I want to go inside it, but I can't
get my courage up for it…
texts.Route111_Text_ThatWasShockingSandRainedD:
Whoa…
That was shocking.

Sand rained down in chunks all of
a sudden.

What was it like inside?
Were there sandy ghosts and such?
texts.Route111_Text_MirageTowerHasntBeenSeenSi:
Since I spoke to you, the tower of sand
hasn't been seen.

Perhaps it really was
the MIRAGE TOWER…
texts.Route111_Text_ClawFossilDisappeared:
The CLAW FOSSIL disappeared into
the sand…
texts.Route111_Text_RootFossilDisappeared:
The ROOT FOSSIL disappeared into
the sand…
texts.Route111_Text_MauvilleUncleToldMeToTakeR:
Oh, no!

My uncle in MAUVILLE told me to take
ROCK SMASH with me if I was going to

ROUTE 111!

My uncle? He lives across from
the bike shop in MAUVILLE.
texts.Route111_Text_TrainerHillSign:
{RIGHT_ARROW} TRAINER HILL ENTRANCE

“Scale the heights, you hot-blooded
TRAINERS!”
texts.Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_RestUpHer:
Oh, dear, dear.
Aren't your POKéMON exhausted?

If you'd like, rest up here.
That's a fine idea! You should do that.
texts.Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_TakeYourT:
That's right.
Take your time and rest up!
texts.Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_StillTire:
Oh, dear, dear.
Are your POKéMON still tired?

You should take another rest here.
That's a fine idea. You should do that.
texts.Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_DontNeedT:
Is that so?
You don't need to be shy about it.
texts.Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_MySo:
You're the first TRAINER I've seen who
deploys POKéMON so masterfully.

But, I should tell you--my son is
stronger than you.

He even took the POKéMON LEAGUE
challenge, I'll have you know.
texts.Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_Like:
We use this MACHO BRACE to more
effectively strengthen our POKéMON

in training.

Since you've beaten all of us here,
I don't know if you need it, but we

would like you to have our MACHO BRACE.
texts.Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_Pass:
When it comes to POKéMON battles,
we tend to be pretty passionate.
texts.Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_Stro:
Mommy is stronger than Daddy.

I'm stronger than Mommy.

And Grandma's stronger than me!

But my big brother is even stronger
than Grandma.
texts.Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_Gran:
There's no question that you're strong.

But if you were to battle my grandson,
you'd end up crying in frustration.

He's much stronger than any TRAINER
our family knows.

He must be challenging the POKéMON
LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.

Knowing my grandson, he could be the
CHAMPION already!

My grandson must be challenging the
POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.

Knowing my grandson, he could be the
CHAMPION already!
texts.Route112_Text_LeaderGoingToAwakenThing:
Hey, man, is our leader really going
to awaken that thing?
texts.Route112_Text_YeahWeNeedMeteorite:
Sounds like it, yeah. But I heard
we need a METEORITE to do it.
texts.Route112_Text_OhThatsWhyCrewWentToFallar:
Oh, I get it now. That's why the rest
of the crew went out to FALLARBOR.
texts.Route112_Text_CantLetAnyonePassUntilThey:
You got it. And until they come back,
we're not to let anyone pass, right.
texts.Route112_Text_NotEasyToGetBackToLavaridg:
Eh, I'd like to get to MAUVILLE, but if
I went down these ledges, it'd be no

easy matter to get back to LAVARIDGE.
texts.Route112_Text_MtChimneyCableCarSign:
MT. CHIMNEY CABLE CAR
“A short walk {UP_ARROW} way!”
texts.Route112_Text_MtChimneySign:
MT. CHIMNEY

“For LAVARIDGE TOWN or the summit,
please take the CABLE CAR.”
texts.Route112_CableCarStation_Text_CableCarRe:
The CABLE CAR is ready to go up.
Would you like to be on it?
texts.Route112_CableCarStation_Text_RideAnothe: Please ride with us another time.
texts.Route113_Text_AshCanBeFashionedIntoGlass:
Wahahaha! Today's technology is a
wondrous thing!

Take this volcanic ash here.
It can be fashioned into glass.
texts.Route113_Text_FunWalkingThroughAsh:
It's fun walking through the volcano's
ashes on the ground and grass.

You can see where you walked--it's
really neat!
texts.Route113_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterKeyItem:
TRAINER TIPS

You may register one of the KEY ITEMS
in your BAG as SELECT.

Simply press SELECT to use
the registered item conveniently.
texts.Route113_Text_GlassWorkshopSign:
GLASS WORKSHOP
“Turning Volcanic Ash into Glass Items”
texts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_GoCollectAsh:
This area is covered in volcanic ash,
huff-puff!

I'm specially gifted, huff-puff.

I make glass out of volcanic ash
and make items, huff-puff.

Go collect ashes with this, huff-puff.
texts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_ExplainSootS:
Just take that SOOT SACK and walk
through piles of ash, huff-puff.

And it will fill up with the volcanic ash,
huff-puff.

Once you think you've collected a good
amount, come see me, huff-puff.
texts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_LetsSeeColle:
Have you collected ashes, huff-puff?
Let me see, huff-puff.
texts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAsh:
Hmmm…
There's not enough ash here, huff-puff.

I can't make glass with this, huff-puff.

Let's see… {STR_VAR_1} is the number of steps
you'll need to walk for me to make you

a BLUE FLUTE, huff-puff.
texts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichGlassIt:
Oh!
You've got a lot of ashes, huff-puff!

I'll make you a glass item, huff-puff!
Which one would you like, huff-puff?
texts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IsThatTheIte:
A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff?
Is that the one for you, huff-puff?
texts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichWouldYo: Which one would you like, huff-puff?
texts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IllMakeItemF:
A {STR_VAR_1} it is, then, huff-puff!

Okay! I'll make it for you, huff-puff.
Just wait a little while, huff-puff.
texts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAsh:
A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff?

There's not enough ash here to make
that, though, huff-puff.

Let's see… {STR_VAR_2} is the number of steps
you'll need to walk through volcanic ash

for me to make that item, huff-puff.

Which item would you rather have me
make instead, huff-puff?
texts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_AllThatAshBu:
You've collected all that ash, but you
don't want anything, huff-puff?
texts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IveFinishedG:
Ah, I've finished your {STR_VAR_1}.
Take it, huff-puff.
texts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInBag:
Oh?
You've no room in your BAG, huff-puff.

I'll hold on to it, so come back later,
huff-puff.
texts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInPC:
Oh?
You've no room in your PC, huff-puff?

I'll hold on to it, so come back later,
huff-puff.
texts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_HaventGotYou:
Hah? You haven't got your SOOT SACK
with you, huff-puff.

You have to keep it with you to collect
volcanic ash, huff-puff.
texts.Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_FunToBlowGla:
It's fun to blow a glass flute while
my boss is talking.

Huff-huff! Puff-puff!
texts.Route114_Text_AllMyMonDoesIsRoarTakeThis:
All my POKéMON does is ROAR…
No one dares to come near me…

Sigh… If you would, please take
this TM away…
texts.Route114_Text_ExplainRoar:
TM05 contains ROAR.
A ROAR sends POKéMON scurrying.
texts.Route114_Text_MeteorFallsSign:
METEOR FALLS
RUSTBORO CITY THROUGH HERE
texts.Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_HaveThi:
My big brother's the FOSSIL MANIAC…
He's a nice guy who loves FOSSILS…

He loves digging holes, too…
He dug this hole by himself…

You can have this, so you can DIG
holes just like my big brother…
texts.Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_DigRetu:
If you make a POKéMON DIG inside a
cave, you're returned to the entrance…
texts.Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_RocksFi:
Rocks in peculiar shapes fill
the display case…
texts.Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_Crammed:
THE COMPOSITION OF STRATA…
HOW RAIN SHAPES THE LAND…

STONES, SOIL, AND ROCK…

It's crammed with books.
texts.Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_LookIn:
I'm the FOSSIL MANIAC…
I'm a nice guy who loves FOSSILS…

Do you want a FOSSIL?

But the FOSSILS around these parts all
belong to me… None for you…

If you can't bear to go without
a FOSSIL, look in a desert where there

are boulders and sand that may hide

FOSSILS…
texts.Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_DevonC:
You found a FOSSIL, didn't you?
That's so nice… It's so dreamy…

What are you going to do with that
FOSSIL?

From what I've heard, DEVON is doing
research on reviving POKéMON from

FOSSILS…

I love my FOSSILS, so I would never
do anything like that…
texts.Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_Fossil:
FOSSILS are so… Wonderful…
It's so dreamy…
texts.Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_NotSaf:
Oh…
It's not safe that way…

I was digging away, you see…
When the whole wall collapsed…

I think there's a giant cavern
underneath now…

But I've left it alone because I don't
think there are any FOSSILS there…
texts.Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingCl:
LANETTE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!

I'm sorry everything is so cluttered…
When I get engrossed in research,

things end up this way…

This is embarrassing… Please keep
this a secret in exchange for this.
texts.Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_OrganizeYour:
May I offer advice about my POKéMON
Storage System?

You should organize your BOXES so you
can tell which POKéMON are in them.
texts.Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNote:
It's LANETTE's research notes.
There's information about BOXES.

Design BOXES to hold 30 POKéMON each.

Each TRAINER should be able to store
420 POKéMON on the PC system.

Keep reading?

A marking system should be added to
make POKéMON easier to organize.

The name and wallpaper design of each
BOX will be made changeable to please

the stored POKéMON.

Keep reading?

When storing a POKéMON, it should be
sent to the BOX inspected last.

If that BOX is full, the received
POKéMON is stored in the next BOX.

In other words, when a BOX is examined,
it is automatically selected as the BOX

to which POKéMON are sent.
texts.Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBil:
There's an e-mail from someone on
the PC.

“… … … … … … …

“Your Storage System offers more
convenience than mine.

“It has a lot of user-friendly features
that make it fun and useful, too.

“It makes me proud that I played
a part in its development.

“Here's hoping that you'll continue
research in Storage Systems.

“From BILL
… … … … … … … …”
texts.Route115_Text_NeverKnowWhenCavePokemonWi:
Exploring a cave isn't like walking
on a road.

You never know when wild POKéMON will
appear. It's full of suspense.
texts.Route115_Text_MeteorFallsSign:
METEOR FALLS
FALLARBOR TOWN THROUGH HERE
texts.Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko:
Ohhh, what am I to do?

We were on our walk, PEEKO and I, when
we were jumped by an odd thug…

The scoundrel made off with my
darling PEEKO!

Wrrrooooooaaaar! PEEKO!
texts.Route116_Text_WantToDigTunnel:
Nnn… Roar!

I want to dig that tunnel!
texts.Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrder:
Nnn… Roar!
What's going on?

I was digging the tunnel without any
tools when some goon ordered me out!

That tunnel's filled with POKéMON
that react badly to loud noises.

They could cause an uproar.

That's why we stopped using heavy
equipment for tunneling…

I'm worried that the goon will do
something stupid and startle the

POKéMON into an uproar.
texts.Route116_Text_GoonHightailedItOutOfTunne:
Nnn… Roar!

That goofy goon hightailed it out of
the tunnel! I can go back to digging!
texts.Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciatio:
Oh! It's you!

You're that person who not only helped
me in PETALBURG WOODS, but also got

back my stolen package and then even

graciously delivered it to SLATEPORT!

CAPT. STERN informed us that the
package arrived, too!

I thank you very, very much!

Why, if I were a rain cloud, I would
shower you with gratitude and hail

you as a hero!

For you, the most wonderful TRAINER,
I bear good news!

Recently, our company developed
a new kind of POKé BALL.

As a token of our appreciation, this
is our gift to our wonderful TRAINER!
texts.Route116_Text_NewBallAvailableAtMart:
Our new POKé BALL will be available
at the POKéMON MART in RUSTBORO.

Please do try it out!
Thank you and bye-bye!
texts.Route116_Text_BagIsJamPacked:
Your BAG is jam-packed.
I can't give you this REPEAT BALL.
texts.Route116_Text_TokenOfAppreciation:
As a token of our appreciation for
your delivering our package, I have

a gift of a new kind of POKé BALL

for our most wonderful TRAINER!
texts.Route116_Text_CanYouHelpMeFindGlasses:
I dropped my glasses…
Can you help me find them?
texts.Route116_Text_MayISeeThoseGlasses:
Those glasses!
May I see them for a second?
texts.Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingForMaybeTh:
Hmm…
These are BLACKGLASSES.

They're not what I'm looking for…

Maybe my glasses aren't around
here…
texts.Route116_Text_CantFindGlassesNotHere:
Hmm…
I can't find my glasses anywhere…

Maybe they're not around here…
texts.Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingFor:
Hmm…
These are BLACKGLASSES.

They're not what I'm looking for…
texts.Route116_Text_RusturfTunnelSign:
RUSTURF TUNNEL
“Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF

“The tunnel project has been
canceled.”
texts.Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBToStopEvolutio:
TRAINER TIPS

If you want to stop a POKéMON from
evolving, press the B Button while it

is trying to evolve.

The startled POKéMON will stop.

This is called an evolution cancel.
texts.Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets:
TRAINER TIPS

Your BAG has several POCKETS.

Items you obtain are automatically
placed in the appropriate POCKETS.

No TRAINER can afford to be without
a BAG of their own.
texts.Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_WeHadTo:
That RUSTURF TUNNEL there…

At first, we had a huge work crew boring
through rock with the latest machinery.

But, we had to stop.

It turns out that we would have had
a negative effect on wild POKéMON in

the area.

So, we've got nothing to do but loll
around here doing nothing.
texts.Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_ManDigg:
There's a man digging his way to
VERDANTURF all by his lonesome.

He's desperate to get through.

He says that if he digs little by little
without using machines, he won't

disturb POKéMON, and he'll avoid

harming the natural environment.

I wonder if he made it through yet.
texts.Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_GetToVe:
To get to VERDANTURF without using
this TUNNEL, you'd have to cross the

sea to DEWFORD, sail on to SLATEPORT,

then travel through MAUVILLE.
texts.Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_TunnelH:
Did you hear? The TUNNEL to VERDANTURF
has gone through!

Sometimes, if you hope strongly enough,
dreams do come true.
texts.Route117_Text_DayCarePokemonHadNewMove:
I left my POKéMON at the DAY CARE.

When I got it back, it had a new move
that I didn't teach it.

I was really, really surprised.
texts.Route117_Text_ArentTheseFlowersPretty:
What do you think?
Aren't these flowers pretty?

I planted them all!
texts.Route117_Text_DayCareSign:
POKéMON DAY CARE
“Let us raise your POKéMON.”
texts.Route118_Text_StevenQuestions:
STEVEN: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

It's me, STEVEN!
We met in the cave near DEWFORD.

Have you met many kinds of POKéMON
since I last saw you?

There are many, many kinds of POKéMON
in this wide world of ours.

If you wanted to raise only your
favorites, that's fine.

Perhaps you find it more fun to raise
all sorts of POKéMON.

As a TRAINER of POKéMON,
what do you think?

Of course, it's not any of my business.

It would be nice if we were to meet
again somewhere.
texts.Route118_Text_YouAgreeGoodRodIsGood:
Hmm!
A GOOD ROD is really good!

Wouldn't you agree?
texts.Route118_Text_IdenticalMindsTakeThis:
Hmm!
We're of identical minds!

Hmm!
Take this GOOD ROD!
texts.Route118_Text_TryYourLuckFishing:
Wherever there's water, try your luck
at fishing.
texts.Route118_Text_TryCatchingMonWithGoodRod:
Try catching all sorts of POKéMON
with your GOOD ROD.
texts.Route118_Text_CanCrossRiversWithSurf:
Even if there isn't a boat, you can
cross rivers and the sea if you have

a POKéMON that knows SURF.

POKéMON can be counted on to do so
much!
texts.Route119_Text_MayIntro:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Where were you? I was looking for you!

How much stronger have you gotten?
Let me check for you!

Ready with your POKéMON?
Of course you are! Go!
texts.Route119_Text_MayDefeat:
Achah!
{PLAYER}{KUN}, you're strong!

I was worried that you might be
struggling with your training.
texts.Route119_Text_MayPresentForYou:
MAY: But I had absolutely nothing to
worry about! Keep it up!

And, here! I have a present for you.
texts.Route119_Text_MayExplainFly:
MAY: Use FLY, and your POKéMON will
instantly carry you to any town you've

already visited.

But, to use FLY, you have to get
the GYM BADGE from FORTREE CITY.

That's important, so don't forget.

You should FLY home and visit
LITTLEROOT for a change.

I bet your mom's worried about you,
{PLAYER}{KUN}.

Well, let's meet again somewhere!
texts.Route119_Text_BrendanIntro:
BRENDAN: {PLAYER}! So this is where
you've been looking for POKéMON?

Let me see how good you got.
I'll test you!

Now!
It's a battle, so battle!
texts.Route119_Text_BrendanDefeat:
Hmm…
You've gotten pretty darn decent.
texts.Route119_Text_BrendanIllGiveYouThis:
BRENDAN: I'd say you're good enough
to search for POKéMON anywhere.

Here, I'll give you this.
Try it out.
texts.Route119_Text_BrendanExplainFly:
BRENDAN: Use FLY, and your POKéMON
instantly carries you to any town

you've already visited.

But you need the FORTREE GYM BADGE 
to do that.

Anyway, I have to move along.
texts.Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou:
SCOTT: Hahahah!
Way to go, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

I just passed by a TRAINER riding
a BIKE.

You just beat that TRAINER, didn't you?
It was pretty obvious that you did.

The kid looked really upset with
a face all red from anger.

I sure seem to run into you often.
Are you off to FORTREE GYM next?

I expect that you'll do well at the GYM.
Well, I'll be seeing you!
texts.Route119_Text_ScottYouWonAtFortreeGym:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!

SCOTT: Hiya, {PLAYER}{KUN}, it's me!

Just as I thought, you won at
the FORTREE GYM.

Your strength…
Perhaps you really are the TRAINER

that I've been searching for.

Remember, you have a fan in me.
I'll be cheering from the sidelines.

Keep up the great work!

… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!
texts.Route119_Text_StayAwayFromWeatherInstitu:
We're standing lookout here.

Hey, you! Stay away from the WEATHER
INSTITUTE. It's not safe.
texts.Route119_Text_DontGoNearWeatherInstitute:
Lookout duty is surprisingly boring.

Hey, you! Please don't go near the
WEATHER INSTITUTE.
texts.Route119_Text_ThoughtFlyByCatchingBirdMo:
I thought you FLY by catching a whole
flock of BIRD POKéMON, and then

hanging on to them somehow.

But it turns out there's an HM move
called FLY!

I wish I'd known about that a long
time ago…
texts.Route119_Text_TallGrassSnaresBikeTires:
Tch…
It's a no-go…

The tall grass snares BIKE tires.
There's no way you can cycle here.
texts.Route119_Text_CanYourMonMakeSecretBase:
Can your POKéMON use its SECRET POWER
on a big pile of grass and make a

SECRET BASE?
texts.Route119_Text_TrainerTipsDecoration:
TRAINER TIPS

Up to sixteen decorations and
furniture items can be placed in

a SECRET BASE.

Pick your favorite items and create
your very own SECRET BASE exactly the

way you want.
texts.Route119_House_Text_RumorAboutCaveOfOrig:
I heard about a cave called the CAVE
OF ORIGIN.

People rumor that the spirits of
POKéMON are revived there. Could

something like that really happen?
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1:
The BOSS got interested in
the research they have going here,

so he sent us out.

You quit meddling!

Blast it…
Blasted by a kid…

Our BOSS knows everything.

But I'm just a GRUNT. What would I know
about what he's thinking?
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4:
Huh?
What's a kid doing here?

Oh, no…
I'll catch an earful for losing to a kid…

I should just take a nap in the bed…
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Everyo:
While I was sleeping, everyone went
upstairs!
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_WowYou:
Wow, you're really strong!

I wish I could be a POKéMON TRAINER
like you!
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_ProfSt:
The PROFESSOR loves rain.
That's a fact.

But if it keeps raining, people will be in
trouble. That's another fact.

And thus, the PROFESSOR is studying
if the rain can be put to good use.
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Notici:
On the 2nd floor of the INSTITUTE,
we study the weather patterns over

the HOENN region.

We've been noticing temporary and
isolated cases of droughts and

heavy rain lately…
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_WhatWe:
Hello!
We've been saved by your actions!

What I don't understand is what on
earth the AQUAS were up to.
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_TakeRe:
There's a bed…
Let's take a rest.
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt2:
The INSTITUTE created a type of
POKéMON that has something to do with

the weather. We're here to take them!
Our plan's being spoiled by a kid?

If the POKéMON they made here can
control the weather freely, then we of

TEAM AQUA definitely need it!
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3:
We're TEAM AQUA!
We appear wherever anything rare is

found!

You don't have any idea what we of
TEAM AQUA are working towards!

You stay out of our way!
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5:
Don't tell me you're looking for that
weather POKéMON, too?

That's a no-no!
We were here to get it first!
Oh, will you look at my POKéMON?

Humph, so what?
What we want…

What we really want isn't here…
Ihihihihi…
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Shelly:
Ahahahaha!

You're going to meddle in TEAM AQUA's
affairs?

You're either absolutely fearless,
simply ignorant, or both!

You're so cute, you're disgusting!
I'll put you down, kiddy!

It's bad enough to have TEAM MAGMA
blunder about, but now there's you!

What makes you want to sniff around
in our business, anyway?
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_TeamMa:
We have a situation here!

A TEAM MAGMA mob just passed
the WEATHER INSTITUTE.

They appear to be headed for
MT. PYRE!
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_WeHave:
What?!

We can't waste any more time here!
We have to hurry to MT. PYRE, too!

Ahahahaha!
TEAM MAGMA, just you wait!
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Thanks:
Thanks!
Thanks to you, we're safe!

It might be an odd way of thanking you,
but take this POKéMON.
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_NoRoom:
Hm? You don't seem to have any room
for this POKéMON.
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Pokemo:
That POKéMON changes shape according
to the weather conditions.

There're plenty of them in the
INSTITUTE--go ahead and take it.
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Changi:
I've been researching rain for many
years, but it's ridiculous to think that

humans can freely change the weather.
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Groudo:
I track weather patterns over
the HOENN region.

Presently, a drought has been recorded
in {STR_VAR_1}.

Could that mean, somewhere near
{STR_VAR_1}…
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Kyogre:
I track weather patterns over
the HOENN region.

Presently, heavy rainfall has been
recorded over {STR_VAR_1}.

Could that mean, somewhere near
{STR_VAR_1}…
texts.Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_NoAbno:
Abnormal weather conditions are
no longer being reported.

The occasional rainfall is a blessing,
really.
texts.Route120_Text_StevenGreeting:
STEVEN: Hm? {PLAYER}{KUN}, hi.
It's been a while.

There's something here that you can't
see, right?

Now, if I were to use this device on
the invisible obstacle…

No, no. Rather than describing it,
I should just show you.

That would be more fun.

{PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON ready for
battle?
texts.Route120_Text_StevenIllWaitHere:
STEVEN: No?

I'll wait here, so you can get ready.
texts.Route120_Text_StevenReadyForBattle:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON
ready for battle?
texts.Route120_Text_StevenShowMeYourPower:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, show me your true
power as a TRAINER!
texts.Route120_Text_StevenUsedDevonScope:
STEVEN used the DEVON SCOPE.

An invisible POKéMON became completely
visible!

The startled POKéMON attacked!
texts.Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope:
STEVEN: I see…
Your battle style is intriguing.

Your POKéMON have obviously grown
since I first met you in DEWFORD.

I'd like you to have this
DEVON SCOPE.

Who knows, there may be other
concealed POKéMON.
texts.Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}.

I enjoy seeing POKéMON and TRAINERS
who strive together.

I think you're doing great.

Well, let's meet again somewhere.
texts.Kecleon_Text_SomethingUnseeable: Something unseeable is in the way.
texts.Kecleon_Text_WantToUseDevonScope:
Something unseeable is in the way.

Want to use the DEVON SCOPE?
texts.Kecleon_Text_UseDevonScopeMonAttacked:
{PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE.

An invisible POKéMON became completely
visible!

The startled POKéMON attacked!
texts.Route121_Text_OkayMoveOutToMtPyre:
Okay!
We're to move out to MT. PYRE!
texts.Route121_Text_AheadLoomsMtPyre:
Ahead looms MT. PYRE…

It is a natural monument to the spirits 
of departed POKéMON…
texts.Route121_Text_MtPyrePierSign:
MT. PYRE PIER

…The sign is old and worn out.
The words are barely legible…
texts.Route123_Text_LoveGrassMonsHaveAny:
I love GRASS-type POKéMON!

Do you have any GRASS-type POKéMON?
texts.Route123_Text_YouLikeGrassMonsTooHaveThi:
Oh?

You like GRASS-type POKéMON, too,
don't you?

I'm so happy, you can have this!
It's a token of our friendship.
texts.Route123_Text_CheckTreesWithMyGrassMon:
I check trees with my GRASS-type
POKéMON. I'm like a tree doctor.
texts.Route123_Text_RouteSignMtPyre:
{UP_ARROW} MT. PYRE
“Forbidden to the faint of heart.”
texts.Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text:
I'm the DIVING TREASURE HUNTER!

I'm the awesome dude who makes
deep-sea dives to gather treasures

resting at the bottom.

Tell me, have you seen any SHARDS of
tools made in ancient times?

You haven't got any treasures
for me…

If you see any SHARDS, like the RED
SHARD, you've got to trade it with me!

Oh, hey! That…
That's a SHARD! I'm looking for those!

Oh, man, you've got to trade that
with me! I'll give you something good!
What do you want to trade?

You'll trade your {STR_VAR_1} for
my {STR_VAR_2}, then?

It's a done deal!
Use that wisely!
Do you want to trade something else?

Whoops, your BAG's full.
Get rid of some items, friend!

No? That's a downer.
Well, if you change your mind, come back.
texts.Route128_Text_ArchieWhatHappened:
ARCHIE: What happened…
What is this wretched scene…

Did I…make a horrible mistake?
texts.Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow:
MAXIE: Do you understand now,
ARCHIE?

Do you finally see how disastrous
your dream turned out to be?

We have to hurry! We have to do
something before the situation goes

completely out of control!
texts.Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToA:
MAXIE: {PLAYER}, don't say anything.

I know that I have no right to be
critical of ARCHIE…

But the way things are now, I doubt
that we humans will be capable of

doing anything about it.

But neither can we stand by and
just watch helplessly.

The responsibility for putting an end
to this falls to ARCHIE and me…
texts.Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief:
MAXIE: This defies belief…

Those super-ancient POKéMON…

Their power is unbelievable.
They've upset the balance of nature…
texts.Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown:
This is terrible…

After the scorching heat wave ended,
this deluge began.

If this doesn't stop, all of HOENN…
No, the whole world will drown.

This huge rain cloud is spreading
from above SOOTOPOLIS…

What in the world is taking place there?

There's no point arguing here…
SOOTOPOLIS might provide answers…
texts.Route128_Text_StevenImGoingToSootopolis:
{PLAYER}{KUN}…
I don't know what you intend to do,

but don't do anything reckless.

Okay.
I'm going to SOOTOPOLIS.
texts.RustboroCity_Text_WeShortenItToDevon:
The DEVON CORPORATION…
We all just shorten it to DEVON.

That company makes all sorts of
convenient products.
texts.RustboroCity_Text_SneakyLookingManWentAr:
Hm? A sneaky-looking man?

Come to think of it, yes, a shady-
looking guy went around the corner.
texts.RustboroCity_Text_HaveYouChallengedGym:
Have you taken the POKéMON GYM
challenge?

When you get that shiny GYM BADGE
in hand, I guess TRAINERS begin to

realize what is required of them.
texts.RustboroCity_Text_HeyThatsRustborosGymBa:
Hey, that's RUSTBORO's GYM BADGE!

Out of all the POKéMON GYM BADGES,
RUSTBORO's is the coolest, I'd say.
texts.RustboroCity_Text_YoureNewAroundHere:
Oh? Who might you be?
You're a new face around these parts.

Have you just transferred into the
POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL?
texts.RustboroCity_Text_GymLeaderIsntEasyWithF:
I challenged the GYM LEADER, but…

It's not going to be easy winning with
my FIRE-type POKéMON…

FIRE-type POKéMON don't match up
well against ROCK-type POKéMON…
texts.RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyWalksInTheTunn:
The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in
a cottage by the sea.

He goes for walks in the tunnel every
so often.
texts.RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyLovesPeeko:
The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in
a cottage by the sea.

He said he was going shopping in
SLATEPORT for his pet, PEEKO.

That old sea dog, he must really love
that PEEKO.
texts.RustboroCity_Text_WowYouHavePokemon:
Wow, you have POKéMON with you, too.

When I get bigger, I'm going to go
places with POKéMON, too.
texts.RustboroCity_Text_CatchRarePokemonIfIGoT:
POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL!

If I go to this school, will I be able
to catch rare POKéMON easily?
texts.RustboroCity_Text_PokemonCanChangeLookFr:
If a POKéMON gains experience in
battles, it can sometimes change in

the way it looks.
texts.RustboroCity_Text_PokemonChangeShape:
A POKéMON changes shape?
If one did that, I would be shocked!
texts.RustboroCity_Text_TradePokemonGrowFast:
A POKéMON you get in a trade from
someone grows fast.

But if you don't have certain GYM
BADGES, it may not obey you…
texts.RustboroCity_Text_OutOfTheWay:
Get out!
Out of the way!
texts.RustboroCity_Text_WaitDontTakeMyGoods:
Wait! Pleeeaaase!

Don't take my GOODS!
texts.RustboroCity_Text_HelpMeIWasRobbed:
Oh, it's you!

You're that fantastic TRAINER who
helped me in PETALBURG WOODS!

Help me! I was robbed by TEAM AQUA!
I have to get the DEVON GOODS back!

If I don't…
I'm going to be in serious trouble.
texts.RustboroCity_Text_ShadyCharacterTookOffT:
That shady character, I think he took
off towards the tunnel over there.
texts.RustboroCity_Text_YouGotItThankYou:
Oh! How did it go?
The DEVON GOODS?

You did!
You got them back!

You really are a great TRAINER!

I know! As my thanks, I'll give you
another GREAT BALL!
texts.RustboroCity_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems:
You're loaded with items.
I can't give you this GREAT BALL.
texts.RustboroCity_Text_PleaseComeWithMe:
Excuse me, please!
Please come with me!
texts.RustboroCity_Text_MayHiLetsRegister:
MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

You had a MATCH CALL feature put
on your POKéNAV!

Let's register each other so we can
contact one another anytime!

… … … … … …
texts.RustboroCity_Text_MayPassedBrineyWantToB:
MAY: Oh, by the way, I passed
MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS.

I guess he's on his way home to his
cottage by the sea.

How's your POKéDEX coming along,
{PLAYER}{KUN}? Mine's looking pretty decent!

So…
How about a little battle?
texts.RustboroCity_Text_MayOhHaventRaisedPokem:
MAY: Oh, what's the matter?

Haven't you caught or raised your
POKéMON very much?

That's not very good for a TRAINER!
texts.RustboroCity_Text_MayWantToBattle:
MAY: So, what do you think?
How about a little battle here?
texts.RustboroCity_Text_MayImNotGoingToLose:
MAY: You just became a TRAINER,
{PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm not going to lose!
texts.RustboroCity_Text_MayDefeat:
Yikes!
You're better than I expected!
texts.RustboroCity_Text_MayMrBrineyHint:
MAY: Oh, by the way, MR. BRINEY, who
I just passed…

{PLAYER}{KUN}, you just moved here so you
might not know this, but MR. BRINEY

was once a revered seafarer.
texts.RustboroCity_Text_BrendanHiLetsRegister:
BRENDAN: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!

You had a MATCH CALL feature put
on your POKéNAV! Cool!

Let's register each other so we can
get in touch anytime!

… … … … … …
texts.RustboroCity_Text_BrendanPassedBrineyWan:
BRENDAN: By the way, {PLAYER}, I walked
by MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS.

I bet he was on his way home to his
cottage by the sea.

{PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX?
Have you filled in any pages yet?

Mine rules.

Want to have a battle to test how
far you've progressed?
texts.RustboroCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidenceInP:
BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have
any confidence in your POKéMON?
texts.RustboroCity_Text_BrendanWantToBattle:
BRENDAN: What's up?
Want to have a battle with me?
texts.RustboroCity_Text_BrendanIWontGoEasy:
BRENDAN: I know you just became
a TRAINER, but I won't go easy!
texts.RustboroCity_Text_BrendanMrBrineyHint:
BRENDAN: By the way, you know
MR. BRINEY? The guy I just passed?

I bet you didn't know this, since you
just moved here, {PLAYER}, but

MR. BRINEY was once a great sailor.
texts.RustboroCity_Text_TunnelNearingCompletio:
“Timesaving tunnel nearing
completion!”

…Is what it says on the sign, but
there's also a big “X” splashed

across it in red paint…
texts.RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpSign:
DEVON CORPORATION

“For all your living needs, we make
it all.”
texts.RustboroCity_Text_GymSign:
RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM
LEADER: ROXANNE

“The ROCK-loving honors student!”
texts.RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpBranchOfficeS:
DEVON CORP. BRANCH OFFICE

“Access limited to DEVON employees
and authorized personnel.”
texts.RustboroCity_Text_CitySign:
RUSTBORO CITY

“The city probing the integration of
nature and science.”
texts.RustboroCity_Text_TrainersSchoolSign:
POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL

“We'll teach you anything about
POKéMON!”
texts.RustboroCity_Text_DevelopedNewPokenavFea:
I've been developing an added feature
for the POKéNAV…

And it turned out great!

{PLAYER}, may I see that POKéNAV?
The one our PRESIDENT gave you?
texts.RustboroCity_Text_AddedMatchCallPleaseCa:
There you go, {PLAYER}!

I added a new feature named
MATCH CALL to your POKéNAV.

Using the MATCH CALL feature,
you can chat with people who have

been registered in your POKéNAV.

{PLAYER}, our PRESIDENT STONE should
be registered in your POKéNAV.

Test it out.
Please give our PRESIDENT a call.
texts.RustboroCity_Text_IdBetterGetBackToWork:
Okay, I'd better get back to work.
Please take care, {PLAYER}!
texts.RustboroCity_Text_YouCanHave2On2Battle:
Did you know this?

You can have a 2-on-2 battle even
if you're not with another TRAINER.

If you catch the eyes of two TRAINERS
when you have two or more POKéMON,

they'll both challenge you.

Don't you think it'd be cool if you
could beat two TRAINERS by yourself?
texts.RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_YouCanPut:
That determined expression…
That limber way you move…

And your well-trained POKéMON…

You're obviously a skilled TRAINER!

No, wait, don't say a word.
I can tell just by looking at you.

I'm sure that you can put this
HIDDEN MACHINE to good use.

No need to be modest or shy.
Go on, take it!
texts.RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_ExplainCu:
That HIDDEN MACHINE, or HM for
short, is CUT.

An HM move is one that can be used
by POKéMON outside of battle.

Any POKéMON that's learned CUT can
chop down thin trees if the TRAINER

has earned the STONE BADGE.

And, unlike a TM, an HM can be used
more than once.
texts.RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_DadHelped:
When they were expanding the city of
RUSTBORO, my dad helped out.

He made his POKéMON use CUT to clear
the land of trees.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_WelcomeTo:
Hello and welcome to the DEVON
CORPORATION.

We're proud producers of items and
medicine that enhance your life.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_StaffGotR:
One of our research staff stupidly
got robbed of an important parcel.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ThoseShoe:
Hey, those RUNNING SHOES!
They're one of our products!

It makes me happy when I see someone
using something we made.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RobberWas:
That stolen parcel…

Well, sure it's important, but it's not
anything that anyone can use.

In my estimation, that robber must not
have been very bright.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_SoundsLik:
It sounds like they've recovered
the ripped-off DEVON GOODS.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_OnlyAutho:
I'm sorry, only authorized people
are allowed to enter here.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_HowCouldW:
It's beyond stupid.
How could we get robbed?
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_YoureAlwa:
Hi, there!
You're always welcome here!
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMeta:
Samples of rocks and metal are
displayed in the glass case.

There's a panel with some writing
on it…

“DEVON CORPORATION got its start as
a producer of stones from quarries.

“The company also produced iron from
filings in the sand.

“From that humble start as a producer
of raw materials, DEVON developed.

“DEVON is now a manufacturer of a wide
range of industrial products.”
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ProductDi:
Prototypes and test products fill
the glass display case.

There's a panel with a description…

“In addition to industrial products,
DEVON now markets sundries and

pharmaceuticals for better lifestyles.

“Recently, DEVON has begun marketing
tools for POKéMON TRAINERS, including

POKé BALLS and POKéNAV systems.”
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceFor:
We're developing a device for talking
with POKéMON.

But we haven't had much success…
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_Developin:
I'm developing new kinds of
POKé BALLS…

But I haven't made much headway…
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinally:
We finally made new kinds of
POKé BALLS!

The REPEAT BALL makes it easier to
catch POKéMON you've caught before.

The TIMER BALL gets better at catching
POKéMON the longer a battle runs.

Both are proudly developed by
the DEVON CORPORATION.

Please give them a try!
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_IMadePoke:
I made the POKéNAV!

As an engineer, I feel blessed to have
made something so great!
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsA:
Oh, wow!
That's a POKéNAV!

It came about as a result of our
PRESIDENT's desire to learn about

the feelings of POKéMON.

Would you like me to describe its
features in detail?

No, no. I think you'll find out just by
trying the POKéNAV out.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceToV:
I'm trying to develop a device that
visually reproduces the dreams of

POKéMON…

But it's not going well.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopDe:
I've been trying to develop a device
that resurrects POKéMON from fossils…

And, it's working!
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBri:
Wait! That thing you have there…
Is that a POKéMON fossil?

Would you like to bring that POKéMON
back to life?

I can with my newly developed
FOSSIL REGENERATOR.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_OhIsThatS:
Oh, is that so?

DEVON's technological expertise
is outstanding, I tell you.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TwoFossil:
Oh, now that's a surprise!
You have not one, but two, fossils?

Unfortunately, my machine can only
regenerate one POKéMON at a time.

Would you like to pick one of your
fossils for regeneration?
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_HandedFos:
Excellent!
Let's do this right away.

{PLAYER} handed the {STR_VAR_1} to
the DEVON RESEARCHER.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilReg:
The FOSSIL REGENERATOR, which I made,
is incredible.

But it has one drawback--it takes
a long time to work.

So, uh… How about you go for a stroll
and look around for a while?
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_Fossilize:
Thanks for waiting!

Your fossilized POKéMON has been
brought back to life!

The fossil was an ancient POKéMON.
{STR_VAR_2}, it was!
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TooManyPo:
Uh-oh, you've got too many POKéMON.
You have no room for this one.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopNe:
I'm trying to develop a new feature
for the POKéNAV…

But it's not going well.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWor:
Well, now what shall I work on
developing next?

Our company allows us to make our
inspirations into reality.

One couldn't ask for a better
environment as an engineer.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIH:
I'm MR. STONE, the PRESIDENT of
the DEVON CORPORATION.

I'd just got word about you!

You saved our staff not just once,
but twice!

I have a favor to ask of an amazing
person like you.

I understand that you're delivering
a package to SLATEPORT's SHIPYARD.

Well, on the way, could you stop off in
DEWFORD TOWN?

I was hoping that you'd deliver a
LETTER to STEVEN in DEWFORD.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneWa:
MR. STONE: Now, you should know that
I am a great PRESIDENT.

So, I'd never be so cheap as to ask
a favor for nothing in return.

That's why I want you to have this!
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneEx:
MR. STONE: That device…

It's a POKéMON NAVIGATOR, or POKéNAV
for short.

It's an indispensable tool for any
TRAINER on an adventure.

It has a map of the HOENN region.

You can check the locations of
DEWFORD and SLATEPORT easily!

By the way, I've heard that sinister
criminals--MAGMA and AQUA, I believe--

have been making trouble far and wide.

I think it would be best if you rested
up before you go on your way.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneGo:
MR. STONE: Well, then, {PLAYER}{KUN},
go with caution and care!
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_CountingO: MR. STONE: I'm counting on you!
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThankYouF:
MR. STONE: You delivered my LETTER?
Thank you kindly!

This is my way of thanking you.
It should help you, a TRAINER.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainEx:
MR. STONE: A POKéMON holding that
EXP. SHARE will be given some of the

EXP Points from battle.

It will get EXP Points even if it didn't
actually battle.

I would say EXP. SHARE is quite useful
for raising weak POKéMON.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_NotFamili:
MR. STONE: Since my youth, I've immersed
myself in work.

Consequently, I'm not familiar with
trends and that sort of thing.

But do young people all want to be
TRAINERS in the POKéMON LEAGUE?
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rd:
This is the DEVON CORPORATION's
third floor.

Our PRESIDENT's OFFICE is on
this floor.

Anyway, I can't tell you how much I'm
grateful for what you've done.

Um… By the way, that parcel
you got back for us…

Could I get you to deliver that to
the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT?

It would be awful if those robbers
tried to take it again.

Uh… Hehehe, so, uh, could I count
on you to do that for me?

Oh, that's right.
Could you wait here a second?
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_WordWithP:
Our PRESIDENT would like to have
a word with you.

Please come with me.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_VisitCapt:
If you visit the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT,
you should go see CAPT. STERN.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RepeatAnd:
DEVON's new products, the REPEAT BALL
and TIMER BALL, have become hugely

popular among TRAINERS.
texts.RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RareRocks:
It's a collection of rare rocks and
stones assembled by the PRESIDENT.
texts.RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_EveryPokemonH:
Every POKéMON has a special ability
that it can use.
texts.RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ComingUpWithM:
Oh, it's so hard every day…

What's hard?
You need to ask?

It's trying to figure out what to
make for meals every day.

It really isn't easy coming up with
meals every day.
texts.RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_HelloDoYouKno:
Oh, hello!
Welcome to the PEPPER household.

I have a question for you.
Have you ever baby-sat?

You see, I'm a new father, so raising
a child is all new to me.

And I have a problem. My daughter
WALDA doesn't laugh enough.

I think she'd laugh for me if I told
her something funny.

Do you know of a funny word or
phrase you can tell me?
texts.RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_BeenSayingXDo:
I've been saying “{STR_VAR_1}”
to amuse her lately.

Do you know of a better word or
a phrase that might work?
texts.RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_WonderfulLets:
Oh, that's wonderful.
So, let's hear it, your suggestion.
texts.RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhIsThatRight:
Oh, is that right?

Well, if you come up with a good
suggestion, I'm all ears.
texts.RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATr:
Ah, I see.
Well, let's give it a try, shall we?
texts.RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhShesLaughin:
{STR_VAR_1}.
{STR_VAR_1}.

Oh, yes! She's laughing!
Oh, I am as delighted as she!
texts.RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATr:
Ah, I see.
