Well, let's give it a try, shall we?
texts.RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilin:
{STR_VAR_1}.
{STR_VAR_1}.

Hmmm… She's not smiling at all.
Maybe WALDA is one serious child…
texts.RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThinkOfMyOwnP:
Oh, so you don't know any good words.
I'd better think for myself, then.

Hmm…
How about “{STR_VAR_1}”?

Let's see if that will work.
texts.RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilin:
{STR_VAR_1}.
{STR_VAR_1}.

Hmmm… She's not smiling at all.
Maybe WALDA is one serious child…
texts.RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhYouDontKnow:
Oh, so you don't know any good words.
I guess I'll try to amuse her with

the saying I used before.

Anyways, if you have a good suggestion,
don't hesitate in telling me, okay?
texts.RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThankYouIllGi:
Thank you!

Thanks to you, my darling WALDA
laughed for me!

Actually, I may not look all that
special, but I'm one of DEVON

CORPORATION's top researchers.

So, how about I do something in return
for you?

I know, I'll add some new wallpaper
patterns for the BOXES in the PC

POKéMON Storage System.

In the wallpaper pattern menu,
select “FRIENDS.”

That will give you access to the new
wallpaper patterns.
texts.RustboroCity_Flat2_1F_Text_DevonWorkersL:
DEVON CORPORATION's workers live in
this building.
texts.RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_DevonWasTinyI:
Way back in the old days, DEVON was just
a teeny, tiny company.
texts.RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_MyDaddyMadeTh:
My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.

My daddy made this!
But I can't use it, so you can have it.
texts.RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_GoingToWorkAt:
My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.

When I grow up, I'm going to work for
DEVON, too.
texts.RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentColl:
DEVON's PRESIDENT likes to collect
rare stones.
texts.RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentsSon:
I think the PRESIDENT's son also
collects rare stones.
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Yo, how's it going?

Listen, my friend!
Would you like to become the CHAMPION?

I'm no TRAINER, not me, but I can
sure give you winning advice.

That's settled, then! We'll aim for the
POKéMON CHAMPIONSHIP together!

It's your job as a TRAINER to collect
GYM BADGES, am I right?

But GYM LEADERS aren't pushovers!

And that's where I come in!
I'm here to provide expert advice!

ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, is a user
of ROCK-type POKéMON.

The ROCK type is very durable, but
it can't stand WATER-type and

GRASS-type moves.

Come see me afterwards, if you beat
the GYM LEADER.

Well, go for it!
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictor:
Whoa! What a breathtaking victory!
My cheering must've worked!

Great!
Check your TRAINER CARD.

The STONE BADGE you got should be
properly recorded on it.

In other words…

You've climbed the first step on
the stairs to the CHAMPIONSHIP!

That's got to feel awesome!
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshIntro:
Don't take us GYM TRAINERS lightly!
I'll show you why we're better!
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshDefeat: You were too good for me…
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshPostBattle:
You haven't seen anything of the ROCK
type's terrifying power!
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyIntro:
If you can't beat me, you won't stand
a chance against ROXANNE!
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyPostBattle:
ROXANNE is stronger than me by
several times.

You'd better be on your guard!
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcIntro:
We might be in the middle of town,
but so what?

My ROCK POKéMON need room to
rampage!
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcDefeat:
Oh, man oh man!
Our challenger is one feisty customer!
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcPostBattle:
I have to hand it to our LEADER.

It took smarts and sense for her to
pick the ROCK type at her young age.
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneIntro:
Hello, I am ROXANNE, the RUSTBORO
POKéMON GYM LEADER.

I became a GYM LEADER so that I might
apply what I learned at the POKéMON

TRAINER'S SCHOOL in battle.

Would you kindly demonstrate how you
battle, and with which POKéMON?
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneDefeat:
So…
I lost…

It seems that I still have much more
to learn…

I understand.

The POKéMON LEAGUE's rules state
that TRAINERS are to be given this

if they defeat a GYM LEADER.

Please accept the official POKéMON
LEAGUE STONE BADGE.
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedStoneBadge:
{PLAYER} received the STONE BADGE
from ROXANNE.
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_StoneBadgeInfoTake:
The STONE BADGE heightens the ATTACK
power of your POKéMON.

It also enables them to use the HM move
CUT outside of battle.

Please take this with you, too.
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRockTomb:
That TECHNICAL MACHINE, TM39,
contains ROCK TOMB.

It not only inflicts damage by dropping
rocks, it also lowers SPEED.

If you use a TM, it instantly teaches
the move to a POKéMON.

Remember, a TM can be used only once,
so think before you use it.
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostBattle:
Since you are so strong, you should
challenge other GYM LEADERS.

By battling many TRAINERS, you should
learn many things.
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRegisterCal:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!

ROXANNE: Oh, hello, {PLAYER}?
This is ROXANNE of RUSTBORO CITY.

I heard from BRAWLY that you're
moving up through the ranks of

TRAINERS at an incredible clip.

Well, I'd rather not think that
I can't beat you.

I promise, I will shape up my GYM
so that you may challenge us again.

I hope you'll be looking forward to
that occasion as much as me!

… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredRoxanne:
Registered GYM LEADER ROXANNE
in the POKéNAV.
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePreRematch:
ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again.
I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here.

I'm sure we've both experienced many
battles since we last met.

I would like to see how much better
we've become. Let us battle!
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostRematch:
ROXANNE: I still have much to learn
when it comes to battling POKéMON.

That awareness makes me love battling
all that much more!
texts.RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRematchNeed:
ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again.
I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here.

I'm sure we've both experienced many
battles since we last met.

I would like to see how much better
we've become…

Oh, no…
You only have one POKéMON with you?

Please return with at least one more
POKéMON.
texts.RustboroCity_House1_Text_IllTradeIfYouWa:
Huh? My POKéMON is cute?
Sure, I knew that.

But if you really want, I'm willing
to trade it to you.

I'll trade you my {STR_VAR_2} for
a {STR_VAR_1} if you want.
texts.RustboroCity_House1_Text_PleaseBeGoodToM:
Eheheh…
Please be good to my POKéMON.
texts.RustboroCity_House1_Text_DoesntLookLikeM:
Huh? That doesn't look anything like
a {STR_VAR_1} to me.
texts.RustboroCity_House1_Text_YouDontWantToTh:
Oh, if you don't want to, that's okay.
But my POKéMON is cute, you know…
texts.RustboroCity_House1_Text_AnyPokemonCanBe:
Any POKéMON can be cute if you raise
it with care and kindness.
texts.RustboroCity_House1_Text_AllSortsOfPlace:
In all sorts of places, there are all
sorts of POKéMON and people.

I find that fascinating, so I go to all
sorts of places.
texts.RustboroCity_House2_Text_TrainerSchoolEx:
The TRAINER'S SCHOOL is excellent.

If you study there, you could even
become a GYM LEADER.
texts.RustboroCity_House2_Text_RoxanneKnowsALo:
ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, really knows
a lot about POKéMON.

She's really strong, too!
texts.RustboroCity_House3_Text_IGivePerfectlyS:
For my own POKéMON, I give them
perfectly suited nicknames!

It's my expression of, uh…
originality, yes, that's it!
texts.RustboroCity_House3_Text_NamingPikachuPe:
But giving the name PEKACHU to
a PIKACHU? It seems pointless.

I suppose it is good to use a name
that's easy to understand, but…
texts.RustboroCity_Mart_Text_BuyingHealsInCase:
I'm buying some PARLYZ HEALS and
ANTIDOTES.

Just in case I run into SHROOMISH
in PETALBURG WOODS.
texts.RustboroCity_Mart_Text_ShouldBuySuperPot:
My POKéMON evolved.
It has a lot of HP now.

I should buy SUPER POTIONS for it
instead of ordinary POTIONS.
texts.RustboroCity_Mart_Text_GettingEscapeRope:
I'm getting an ESCAPE ROPE just in
case I get lost in a cave.

I just need to use it to get back to
the entrance.
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Pokem:
My POKéMON has a NAIVE nature, and my
friend's has a JOLLY nature.

It's fascinating how POKéMON have
personalities!
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MaleA:
Just like people, there are male and
female POKéMON.

But no one seems to have any idea how
they're different.
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HMCut:
The man next door gave me an HM!

I used it to teach my POKéMON how to
CUT down skinny trees.
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Blackboa:
The blackboard lists status changes
that may affect POKéMON in battle.
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ReadWhic: Which topic do you want to read?
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainP:
If a POKéMON is poisoned, it will
steadily lose HP.

The effects of poison remain after
a battle.

A poisoned POKéMON's HP will drop
while it is traveling.

Heal a poisoning using an ANTIDOTE.

If a POKéMON becomes paralyzed,
its SPEED drops.

It may also not be able to move while
it is in battle.

Paralysis remains after battle.
Cure it using a PARLYZ HEAL.
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainS:
If a POKéMON falls asleep, it will be
unable to attack.

A POKéMON may wake up on its own,
but if a battle ends while it is

sleeping, it will stay asleep.

Wake it up using an AWAKENING.
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainB:
A burn reduces ATTACK power, and it
steadily reduces the victim's HP.

A burn lingers after battle.
Cure a burn using a BURN HEAL.
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainF:
If a POKéMON is frozen, it becomes
completely helpless.

It will remain frozen after battle.
Thaw it out using an ICE HEAL.
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Students:
Students who don't study get a little
taste of my QUICK CLAW.

Whether or not you are a good student 
will be evident from the way you use

this item.
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainQ:
A POKéMON holding the QUICK CLAW will
occasionally speed up and get to move

before its opponent.

There are many other items that are
meant to be held by POKéMON.

Just those alone will give you many
topics to study!
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_TradingR:
I'm trading POKéMON with my friend
right now.
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_AlwaysWa:
I always wanted a SEEDOT, and
I'm finally getting one!
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Pokemont:
POKéMON can hold items, but they
don't know what to do with man-made

items like POTION and ANTIDOTE.
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Confused:
You know how some POKéMON moves can
confuse a POKéMON?

A confused POKéMON will sometimes
attack itself without meaning to.

But once it leaves battle, it will
return to normal.
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemonH:
A POKéMON holding a BERRY will heal
itself…

There are many kinds of items that
POKéMON can hold…

Boy, it sure is hard taking notes
down…
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Students:
It's this student's notebook…

POKéMON are to be caught using
POKé BALLS.

Up to six POKéMON can accompany
a TRAINER.

A TRAINER is someone who catches
POKéMON, raises them, and battles

with them.

A TRAINER's mission is to defeat
the strong TRAINERS who await

challengers in POKéMON GYMS.
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMet:
Hello? Didn't we meet before?
I think back in PETALBURG CITY.

Let me introduce myself.
My name's SCOTT.

I've been traveling everywhere in
search of outstanding TRAINERS.

More specifically, I'm looking for
POKéMON battle experts.

So, what brings you to this SCHOOL?
Are you a TRAINER, too?

The first thing you should do is to
have a POKéMON learn the move CUT.

If I remember correctly, someone in
this town has CUT.
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentT:
SCOTT: Hmm…

The talent levels of the students here
are unknown. The potential's there.
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottSto:
SCOTT: Oh, what's that?

It's a STONE BADGE, isn't it?
That's pretty impressive, I'd say.

But, you know, I would've loved to see
you in battle.

It's hard to tell what you're like as
a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.
texts.RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMet:
Hello? Didn't we meet before?
I think back in PETALBURG CITY.

Let me introduce myself.
My name's SCOTT.

I've been traveling everywhere in
search of outstanding TRAINERS.

More specifically, I'm looking for
POKéMON battle experts.

Oh, what's that?
It's a STONE BADGE, isn't it?

That's pretty impressive, I'd say, for
a starting TRAINER like yourself.

But, you know, I would've loved to see
you in battle.

It's hard to tell what you're like as
a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.
texts.RusturfTunnel_Text_ComeAndGetSome:
What, are you coming?
Come and get some, then!
texts.RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntIntro:
Grah, keelhaul it all!

That hostage POKéMON turned out to
be worthless!

And to think I made a getaway…
In this tunnel to nowhere!

Hey! You!
So you want to battle me?
texts.RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntDefeat:
Urrrggh! My career in crime comes to
a dead end!
texts.RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntTakePackage:
This is plain not right…

The BOSS told me this would be a
slick-and-easy job to pull.

All I had to do was steal some package
from DEVON.

Tch!
You want it back that badly, take it!
texts.RusturfTunnel_Text_PeekoGladToSeeYouSafe:
PEEKO!
Am I glad to see you're safe!
texts.RusturfTunnel_Text_ThankYouLetsGoHomePee:
PEEKO owes her life to you!

They call me MR. BRINEY.
And, you are?

… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …

Ah, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I sincerely thank you!

Now, if there's anything that troubles
you, don't hesitate to tell me!

You can usually find me in my cottage
by the sea near PETALBURG WOODS.

Come, PEEKO, we should make our way
home.

PEEKO: Pihyoh!
texts.RusturfTunnel_Text_WhyCantTheyKeepDiggin:
… …

Why can't they keep digging?
Is the bedrock too hard?

My beloved awaits me in VERDANTURF
TOWN just beyond here…

If RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF were
joined by this tunnel, I could visit

her every day…

But this…
What am I to do?
texts.RusturfTunnel_Text_ToGetToVerdanturf:
To get from RUSTBORO to VERDANTURF,
you need to go to DEWFORD, then pass

through SLATEPORT and MAUVILLE…
texts.RusturfTunnel_Text_YouShatteredBoulderTa:
Wow! You shattered that boulder
blocking the way.

To show you how much I appreciate it,
I'd like you to have this HM.
texts.RusturfTunnel_Text_ExplainStrength:
That HM contains STRENGTH.

If a muscular POKéMON were to learn
that, it would be able to move even

large boulders.
texts.RusturfTunnel_Text_WandaReunion:
WANDA!
Now I can see you anytime!

WANDA: That's…wonderful.

Please, take some rest at my home.
texts.RusturfTunnel_Text_BoyfriendOnOtherSideO:
On the other side of this rock…
My boyfriend is there.

He… He's not just digging the tunnel
to come see me.

He works his hands raw and rough
for the benefit of everyone.
texts.RusturfTunnel_Text_MikeIntro:
What do you call a wild man up in the
mountains? A mountain man, right?

So why don't they call a POKéMON in
the mountains a mountain POKéMON?
texts.RusturfTunnel_Text_MikeDefeat:
My POKéMON…
Ran out of power…
texts.RusturfTunnel_Text_MikePostBattle:
They halted development here to
protect POKéMON, right?

There's a feel-good story!
texts.SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNe:
Hey!
I remember your face!

If you're here, it must mean that
you're about to mess with us again!

A punk like you, do you really think
you can take on TEAM AQUA?

I'd say you're too early by about
a trillion years!

You're a perfect fit for the likes of
TEAM MAGMA!

Speaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they
were spotted near MOSSDEEP.

That bunch of goons, they sure don't
look good near the sea!

A punk like you, do you really think
you can take on TEAM AQUA?

I'd say you're too early by about
a trillion years!

You're a perfect fit for the likes of
TEAM MAGMA!

Speaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they
were spotted near MOSSDEEP.

That bunch of goons, they sure don't
look good near the sea!
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1Intro:
We don't need a kid around!
Go on home already!
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1PostBatt:
I want to get a promotion so I can
boss around the GRUNTS…
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2Intro:
That submarine… It's tiny inside.
I'm sore all over!
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2PostBatt:
That submarine we jacked, man,
it's brutal as a ride.

It's way too tight in there!
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro:
Ahahahaha!

How did you manage to get here without
a submarine?

What an impressive child!

But… It won't do to have you
meddling about here.

And, I do want payback for what
happened at the WEATHER INSTITUTE…

I'm going to give you a little taste
of pain! Resign yourself to it!
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyPostBatt:
Ahahahaha!
You're so darn strong.

It's terribly disappointing that you're
not a TEAM AQUA member.

You could have enjoyed the fabulous
world our BOSS has promised as

one of us…
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Intro:
For our dream to become real, we need
the power of POKéMON.

But meddlers like you use the power of
POKéMON to mess with us even at

a place like this!

Life just doesn't work the way we
need it to!
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5PostBatt:
You know, we don't dare question
the motives of our leader.

But here you are, just some punk,
going up against our BOSS.

Maybe…
You must be something…
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3Intro:
Who are you?
Where did you come in from?
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3PostBatt:
I can't find the way out!

I'm not afraid. Don't get me wrong!
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4Intro:
Who are you?
Where do you think you're going?
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4PostBatt:
My partner forgot the map in that
submarine!

How's that for being useless?
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieSoItWasY:
ARCHIE: Fufufu…
So it was you, after all.
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieBeholdKy:
ARCHIE: Behold!

See how beautiful it is, the sleeping
form of the ancient POKéMON KYOGRE!

I have waited so long for this day to
come…
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieYouMustD:
ARCHIE: It surprises me, how you've
managed to chase me here.

But that's all over now.

For the realization of my dream,
you must disappear now!
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDefeat:
What?!
I lost to a mere child like you?!
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThis:
ARCHIE: Fufufu…

I commend you. I must recognize that
you are truly gifted.

But!
I have this in my possession!

With this RED ORB, I can make KYOGRE…
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_RedOrbShinesBy:
The RED ORB suddenly began shining
by itself!
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhereDid:
ARCHIE: What?!

I didn't do anything.
Why did the RED ORB…

Where did KYOGRE go?
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieAMessage:
ARCHIE: Hm? It's a message from our
members outside…
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRain:
ARCHIE: Yes, what is it?

Hm…
It's raining heavily?

Good… That should have happened.
That is why we awakened KYOGRE,

to realize TEAM AQUA's vision of

expanding the sea.

What?!

It's raining far harder than we
envisioned? You're in danger?

That can't be…
That's just not possible…

Hold your position and monitor
the situation!
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKy:
ARCHIE: There's something wrong…

The RED ORB is supposed to awaken
and control KYOGRE…

But… Why?
Why did KYOGRE disappear?

Why?!
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveY:
MAXIE: What have you wrought?

ARCHIE… You've finally awoken KYOGRE,
haven't you?

What will happen to the world if this
downpour continues for all eternity?

The world's landmass will drown in
the deepening sea…
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetA:
ARCHIE: W-what?!
Don't get all high and mighty with me!

Wasn't it you, TEAM MAGMA, that
infuriated GROUDON?

So long as I have this RED ORB,
I should be able to control KYOGRE…

I should be able to control it…
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWeDontHav:
MAXIE: We don't have the time to
argue about it here!

Get outside and see for yourself!

See if what you've wrought is the
world that we desired!
texts.SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieComeOnPla:
MAXIE: {PLAYER}, come on, you have
to get out of here, too!
texts.ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_CanOverc:
The penetrating cold around these
parts is an impediment to training.

But with focus, one can overcome!

With this FOCUS BAND, buckle down and
withstand the cold!
texts.SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPi:
WALLACE: Oh, my, I'm terribly sorry!

In my haste, I didn't notice that
I'd left you behind!

I've opened the locked door of
the SKY PILLAR.

{PLAYER}{KUN}, let's be on our way!
texts.SkyPillar_Outside_Text_EarthquakeNotMome:
WALLACE: It's an earthquake!

There's not a moment to waste!
We've got to hurry!
texts.SkyPillar_Outside_Text_SituationGettingW:
WALLACE: Hmm…
The situation is getting worse…
texts.SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSoo:
WALLACE: This isn't good…

The weather distortion is spreading
even here…

{PLAYER}{KUN}.

RAYQUAZA should be farther up
from here.

I'm worried about SOOTOPOLIS.
I've got to go back.

Everything is in your hands now.
Don't fail us!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_EnergyGuruSellWhatYou:
I'm the ENERGY GURU! I'll go for it and
sell you what you need!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_PleaseGiveItThisEffor:
Went for it stupendously!

As its reward, please give it this
EFFORT RIBBON.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_GoForItLittleHarder:
You have to go for it a little harder.

If you do, I'll give your POKéMON
something nice.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_EffortRibbonLooksGood:
Oh! Your {STR_VAR_1}, that EFFORT
RIBBON looks good on it!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_WonderIfLighthouseSta:
The light of the lighthouse reaches
dozens of miles away.

I wonder if it doesn't startle POKéMON
in the sea.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_SeaweedFullOfLife:
Ooh, look at this!

The seaweed you can get around these
parts is fresh and full of life.

Why, it looks like it can even rear up
and attack!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_HowTownIsBornAndGrows:
Where the water is clean, the fruits
of bountiful harvest gather.

And where people gather, a market
soon starts.

That is how a town is born and grows.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_SlateportWonderfulPla:
Shopping where you can breathe the
scent of the ocean…

SLATEPORT is such a wonderful place!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_BuyBricksSoDecorWontG:
If you put DOLLS or CUSHIONS on
the floor, they'll get dirty.

I'm going to buy some BRICKS so my
DOLLS and CUSHIONS won't get dirty

when I leave them out.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_GoingToCompeteInBattl:
Wroooar! I'm going to compete in
the BATTLE TENT, too!

But before that, I need to catch
some POKéMON!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_BushedHikingFromMauvi:
Whew… I'm just bushed…

I hiked over from MAUVILLE CITY.
But, boy, this city's huge.

If I'd known this, I would've ridden
my BIKE here.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_EveryoneCallsHimCaptS:
STERN, the fellow who built the
MUSEUM, also happens to be the leader

of an undersea exploration team.

So, everyone calls him CAPT. STERN.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_WhatsLongLineOverTher:
What is that over there?
That long line…
texts.SlateportCity_Text_VisitedMuseumOften:
When I was a child, I visited
the MUSEUM often.

I used to dream about the mysteries of
the sea after seeing the exhibits.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_QuitPushing:
Hey, there! Quit pushing!
This is the line, can't you see?
texts.SlateportCity_Text_AquaHasPolicy:
TEAM AQUA has a policy of
assembling and dispersing at

the operation site.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_BossIsBrilliant:
Our BOSS is brilliant.

What would he want to do with
a MUSEUM now?
texts.SlateportCity_Text_WhatsNewSchemeIWonder:
What's the new scheme, I wonder?

Our BOSS is scary when he's mad, so
I'd better not screw things up…
texts.SlateportCity_Text_ShouldTakeItAll:
If there's something we need in
the MUSEUM, we should take it all!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_DontButtIn:
Hey, you there!
Don't butt in!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_RemindsMeOfLongLineFo:
A long line, huh?

It reminds me of the times I lined up to
buy smash-hit games…
texts.SlateportCity_Text_WhyAreWeLiningUp:
Why are we even lining up and paying?
We should just march in!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_IllReadSignForYou:
You want to read this sign?
I'll read it for you!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_SaysSomethingLikeSeaI:
Let's see…

Um… I think it says something like
“the life in the sea is endless.”

Yup, I'm pretty sure that's what
it says.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_ShouldveBroughtMyGame:
Grumble…

I should've brought my Game Boy
Advance so I wouldn't get bored in line…

Grumble…
texts.SlateportCity_Text_HotSpringsAfterOperat:
When this operation's over, I'll take
you to a hot spring spa!

That's what our leader said.
I can't wait!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_SeaIsSoWet:
The sea is just so vast…

Could the sea have been made by
the tears shed by POKéMON?
texts.SlateportCity_Text_SinkOldBoats:
Do you know what they do with old
ships that become too creaky to sail?

They sink them in the sea so they
become habitats for POKéMON.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_BuyTooMuch:
Whenever I visit here, I get carried
away and buy too much.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_GetNameRaterToHelpYou:
If you want to change your POKéMON's
nickname, you'll have to get the NAME

RATER to help you.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_CantChangeTradeMonNam:
Any POKéMON you get in a trade,
you can't change its nickname.

The original TRAINER's love for that
POKéMON is in the nickname.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentBuiltRecent:
Recently, a BATTLE TENT was built
in SLATEPORT.

GYMS are fun, but the BATTLE TENT's
awesome in its own way.

You should go find tough POKéMON
for the BATTLE TENT!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_CaptSternBeingIntervi:
I was hoping that it was a famous star
so I could get an autograph.

But who's that being interviewed?
Isn't that CAPT. STERN?
texts.SlateportCity_Text_InterviewerSoCool:
That lady interviewer is so cool
and pretty.

When I grow up, I'm going to be
an international journalist!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_SternSaysDiscoveredSo:
CAPT. STERN says they discovered
something at the bottom of the sea.

I wonder what it is?
What could it be?
texts.SlateportCity_Text_CaptainComeBackWithBi:
What's going on here?

Did the good CAPTAIN come back with
a big fish from the ocean floor?
texts.SlateportCity_Text_AmIOnTV:
Hey! Are you watching?
Am I on TV?
texts.SlateportCity_Text_CaptainsACelebrity:
A TV interview! Here!
The CAPTAIN's a celebrity!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_BigSmileForCamera:
TY: Okay, CAPT. STERN, a big smile
for the camera!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_MostInvaluableExperie:
GABBY: I see, I see. You've had a most
invaluable experience…
texts.SlateportCity_Text_SternMoveAheadWithExp:
CAPT. STERN: Yes, indeed. We intend to
move ahead with our exploration.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_GabbyWonderfulThanksF:
GABBY: That's wonderful, CAPT. STERN!
Thank you for taking the time from

your busy schedule to talk to us.

We hope we can interview you again
with news of more discoveries!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_SternWhewFirstIntervi:
CAPT. STERN: Whew…

That was my first time to be filmed for
TV. That was nerve-wracking.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_OhPlayerWeMadeDiscove:
Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You're looking great!

We made a huge discovery on our last
seafloor exploration.

We found an underwater cavern on
ROUTE 128.

We think it's the habitat of a POKéMON
that's said to have been long extinct.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_AquaWillAssumeControl:
Fufufu…
CAPT. STERN, I presume.

We of TEAM AQUA will assume
control of your submarine!

Your objections are meaningless!
We expect your total cooperation!

Fufufu…
Just watch and learn what TEAM

AQUA has planned!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_SternWhatWasAllThat:
CAPT. STERN: What was that all about?

It sounded like someone using
a megaphone…

Where did it come from?
texts.SlateportCity_Text_FromHarborTryingToTak:
It's from the HARBOR!

The submarine!
They're trying to take it!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentSign:
BATTLE TENT SLATEPORT SITE
“Find it! The ultimate POKéMON!”
texts.SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardWantedS:
STERN'S SHIPYARD

“Wanted: A sailor capable of sailing
in all currents.”
texts.SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardNearsCo:
STERN'S SHIPYARD

“The ferry S.S. TIDAL nears
completion for serving the ports of

SLATEPORT and LILYCOVE.”
texts.SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardFerryCo:
STERN'S SHIPYARD

“Boarding of the SLATEPORT-LILYCOVE
ferry S.S. TIDAL is handled at the

HARBOR.”
texts.SlateportCity_Text_PokemonFanClubSign:
POKéMON FAN CLUB
“Calling all fans of POKéMON!”
texts.SlateportCity_Text_OceanicMuseumSign:
“The endless sea sustains
all life.”

OCEANIC MUSEUM
texts.SlateportCity_Text_CitySign:
SLATEPORT CITY

“The port where people and POKéMON
cross paths.”
texts.SlateportCity_Text_MarketSign:
SLATEPORT MARKET
“Unique items found nowhere else!”
texts.SlateportCity_Text_HarborFerryUnderConst:
SLATEPORT HARBOR

“The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under
construction in the SHIPYARD.

“Service is scheduled to begin
shortly.”
texts.SlateportCity_Text_HarborSign:
SLATEPORT HARBOR

“Enjoy a delightful cruise on
the ferry S.S. TIDAL.”
texts.SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerries:
If a wild POKéMON gets hurt, it heals
itself by chewing on BERRIES.

Did you know that?

Somebody saw that and got the idea
of making medicine from BERRIES.

Did you know that?

To turn BERRIES into medicine,
they must be crushed into powder.

Did you know that?

You seem to have an interest
in BERRIES!

I've got something good for someone
like you.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerryPowder:
I recently had machines installed at
POKéMON CENTERS for crushing BERRIES.

The BERRY CRUSH machines are at
the DIRECT CORNER upstairs.

Did you know?

Could you make BERRY POWDER for
me using those machines?

I can make you all sorts of medicine
if you bring me lots of BERRY POWDER.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_BroughtMeSomeBerryPow:
Have you brought me some
BERRY POWDER?
texts.SlateportCity_Text_ExchangeWhatWithIt:
What would you like to exchange
it with?
texts.SlateportCity_Text_ExchangeBerryPowderFo:
Okay, you want to exchange your
BERRY POWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?
texts.SlateportCity_Text_DontHaveEnoughBerryPo:
Oh, dear. You don't have enough
BERRY POWDER.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_FineBerryPowderTradeS:
This is fine BERRY POWDER.
It will make excellent medicine.

Would you like to trade more of your
BERRY POWDER for something else?
texts.SlateportCity_Text_WhenYouGetMoreBringIt:
Okay! When you get some more
BERRY POWDER, bring it to me, please!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_ComeBackToTradeBerryP:
Come back if you'd like to trade your
BERRY POWDER for some medicine.

I'm always running a bazaar here.

Did you know?
texts.SlateportCity_Text_YouDroveTeamAquaAway:
SCOTT: Huh?
I'm sure I met you somewhere before.

Have I introduced myself to you?
If not, my name's SCOTT.

I just saw TEAM AQUA run away from
here like they were stung.

Let me guess--you drove them away?
texts.SlateportCity_Text_MaybeThisTrainer:
SCOTT: Hmm…
Maybe, just maybe, this TRAINER…
texts.SlateportCity_Text_LetsRegisterEachOther:
SCOTT: All right! I think you're going
to become a good friend.

So, let's register each other in our
POKéNAVS.

… … … … … …
texts.SlateportCity_Text_RegisteredScott:
Registered this SCOTT person
in the POKéNAV.
texts.SlateportCity_Text_KeepEyeOnTrainersBeSe:
SCOTT: What I'd like to do is tag along
with you, but I do want to keep an eye

on the talents of other people, too.

So, I'll be off to roam other towns
a bit more.

Be seeing you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
texts.SlateportCity_Text_TakingBattleTentChall:
SCOTT: Oh, hey!
If it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}!

{PLAYER}{KUN}, let me guess--you're going
to take the BATTLE TENT challenge?

Yeah! That's a good idea!
That's a really great idea!

After all, a tough TRAINER is
the perfect fit for the BATTLE TENT!

Give it your best effort!
texts.SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceFor:
Want a tasty little bit of advice
for CONTESTS?

Using a certain move after another
certain kind of move sometimes gets

you extra attention.

If you know what you're doing,
you can score big in appeal.

Of course, your opponents might try
disrupting your POKéMON's showing.
texts.SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyPapaIsC:
My papa, he's a CONTEST JUDGE.

I wonder what I should be when I
grow up, a JUDGE or a GYM LEADER?
texts.SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMaj:
Hey, man, I'm like majorly cheesed,
you know. Like, you know, I just

wanted to know why my POKéMON

never won, you know, like, hey?

So, like, I gave the JUDGE my two
cents, you know, they're free.

And he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey!
So, like, total bummer, man!

Hey, like, you! Zip it, you know?
Just, you know, take this!
texts.SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ExplainTo:
That's, like, TM41, you know?
Hey, it's TORMENT, you hearing me?

Like, it won't let the other guy
use the same move twice in a row, see?

Hey, now, you listen here, like,
I'm not laying a torment on you!
texts.SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MCStepUpT:
MC: Oh, my, my!
Now isn't that a dandy of a POKéMON?

Please! Do step right up and take
part in our splendid CONTESTS!

You'll do well! I'm sure of it!
My eyes have never failed me!
texts.SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWoul:
JUDGE: Well, hello there!
I see that you're a TRAINER!

Then, it just wouldn't do for you
to miss a POKéMON CONTEST!

Get a CONTEST PASS in VERDANTURF
CITY and enter anytime!
texts.SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ItsAppeal:
It's appeal time!
What should I lead with?
texts.SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_DidntPayA:
They didn't pay much attention to
my POKéMON's appeal…

Humph, that JUDGE, he doesn't know
a good thing when he sees it.
texts.SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWit:
Oh, hi! You must be a serious fan to get
this close to the action.

I'll reward your enthusiasm with
this sage advice.

If a move goes over really well,
the audience will get excited.

The POKéMON that makes its appeal
right when everyone's excited…

Well, you'd think something good has
to happen!
texts.SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MoreFreak:
I can't do this! I'm more freaked out
than my POKéMON.

I'm shivering and my heart is racing!
texts.SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_BattleAnd:
A battle and a CONTEST aren't the
same, but they are alike, too.

You need to work hard and believe
in the POKéMON you've raised.
texts.SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MonLooksO:
That POKéMON looks like it's on top
of its game, huh?

A POKéMON that does good in the
secondary judging seems to be more

relaxed when it's doing appeals.
texts.SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonBett:
Will you look at that sorry sight?

Heh, my POKéMON's absolutely better
than that lot!
texts.SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_GetUrgeTo:
Don't you get the urge to move with
POKéMON if they're putting on an

energetic appeal?
texts.SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_Could:
So, like, I couldn't find myself any
POKéMON that were, like, for me.

So, I figured, like, hey, I should file
a complaint to the guy there?

And he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey!
So, like, total bummer, man!

Hey, like, you! Zip it, you know?
Just, you know, take this!
texts.SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_Expla:
That's, like, TM41, you know?
Hey, it's TORMENT, you hearing me?

Like, it won't let the other guy
use the same move twice in a row, see?

Hey, now, you listen here, like,
I'm not laying a torment on you!
texts.SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_IllTr:
I don't really like BUG POKéMON,
but maybe I'll try using some for

a change of pace.

Who knows, I might even get to like
them!
texts.SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_Battl:
You can battle all you want here even
if you don't have any tough POKéMON.
texts.SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_NiceI:
Wouldn't it be nice if they had more of
a selection?
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FerryServiceUn:
I beg your pardon?
You're looking for a ship?

I'm sorry, the ferry service isn't
available at present…
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_MayISeeYourTic:
Hello, are you here for the ferry?
May I see your TICKET?
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_YouMustHaveTic:
{PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…

I'm terribly sorry.

You must have a TICKET to board
the ferry.
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FlashedTicketW:
{PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.

Perfect! That's all you need!

And where would you like to go?
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SailAnotherTim: Please sail with us another time!
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_PleaseBoardFer:
Please board the ferry and wait for
departure.
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WhereWouldYouL: Then, where would you like to go?
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LoveToGoDeepUn:
A journey to the bottom of the sea…
I wonder what it'd be like?

I'd love to go deep underwater like
that someday.
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_AbnormalWeathe:
For a ship to sail safely, we need to
know about the weather!

Speaking of weather, I heard something
from a guy at the WEATHER INSTITUTE.

He was saying abnormal weather has
been reported all over the place!

You should visit the WEATHER INSTITUTE
and ask around!
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SubTooSmallFor:
I wanted to go with CAPT. STERN on
the ocean floor exploration.

But the sub's too small for me.

If I squeezed in, there wouldn't be
any room for the CAPTAIN…
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SameThugsTried:
CAPT. STERN: Those thugs…

They're the same lot who tried to rob
the DEVON GOODS at the MUSEUM.
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgain:
ARCHIE: Oh?
Not you again…

You are tenacious to track us here,
that much I will give you.

But now…
No one can stop us! No one!

Or, will you follow us back to our
HIDEOUT in LILYCOVE CITY?

Fwahahahaha…
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_CaptSternWhySt:
CAPT. STERN: Why…

Why would TEAM AQUA steal my
SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1?

They can't be after the slumbering
POKéMON at the bottom of the sea…

But even if I were to chase them,
I don't stand a chance against them…
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNe:
CAPT. STERN: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}…

Okay… So TEAM AQUA left before you
could stop them…

Oh, no, don't blame yourself.
You're not responsible for this.

Trying to catch a submarine…
It's impossible for most people.

You would need a POKéMON that knows
how to DIVE…

Perhaps if you went out to
MOSSDEEP CITY…

A lot of divers live out there, so
someone might teach you…
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_NeedDiveToCatc:
CAPT. STERN: Trying to catch a
submarine… It's impossible.

You would need a POKéMON that knows
how to DIVE…

Perhaps if you went out to
MOSSDEEP CITY…

A lot of divers live out there, so
someone might teach you…
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WontBeLongBefo:
CAPT. STERN: Oh, yes.
MR. BRINEY came to our SHIPYARD.

It won't be long now before we finish
making the ferry!
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FinishedMaking:
CAPT. STERN: {PLAYER}{KUN}!

We finally finished making the ferry
S.S. TIDAL!

We couldn't have done it without
your friend MR. BRINEY.

Please go for a short cruise on it!
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WouldYouTradeS:
CAPT. STERN: Oh?
{PLAYER}{KUN}, that item you have…

That's a SCANNER! That would sure
help us on our explorations.

{PLAYER}{KUN}, would you trade your
SCANNER for something?

Like, say, a DEEPSEATOOTH or
a DEEPSEASCALE that I have?
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_IfYouWantToTra:
CAPT. STERN: Are you certain?
It's useless to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}…

Well, okay, then. If you want to trade
your SCANNER, let me know.
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TradeForDeepSe:
CAPT. STERN: So you'll trade it for
my DEEPSEATOOTH?

CAPT. STERN: So you'll trade it for
my DEEPSEASCALE?
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WhichOneDoYouW: CAPT. STERN: Which one do you want?
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_HandedScannerT:
{PLAYER} handed the SCANNER to
CAPT. STERN.
texts.SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ThisWillHelpRe:
CAPT. STERN: Thanks, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
This will help our research a lot!
texts.SlateportCity_House_Text_NatureToDoWithS:
My POKéMON has a HASTY nature.

It has higher SPEED compared to
my other POKéMON.

Maybe their nature has something to
do with the stat gains of POKéMON.
texts.SlateportCity_House_Text_MustBeGoingToBa:
You're a TRAINER, aren't you?

Since you came to SLATEPORT CITY,
you must be going to the BATTLE TENT.
texts.SlateportCity_Mart_Text_SomeItemsOnlyAtM:
The MARKET does have some interesting
merchandise.

But there are some items you can only
get at a POKéMON MART.
texts.SlateportCity_Mart_Text_GreatBallIsBette:
A GREAT BALL is better than a POKé BALL
at catching POKéMON.

With this, I should be able to get that
elusive POKéMON…
texts.SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_Pleas:
Hi, hi! I'm the NAME RATER!
I'm the fortune-teller of names!

I shall be pleased to rate your
POKéMON's nickname.
texts.SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_Criti:
Which POKéMON's nickname should
I critique?
texts.SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_FineN:
Hmmm… {STR_VAR_1}, is it? That is
quite a fine name you bestowed.

But! What say you, if I were to
suggest a slightly better name?
texts.SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_WhatS:
Ah, good. Then, what shall the new
nickname be?
texts.SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_MonSh:
Done! From now on, this POKéMON
shall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!

It is a better name than before!
How fortunate for you!
texts.SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_DoVis:
I see.
Do come visit again.
texts.SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_NameN:
Done! From now on, this POKéMON
shall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!

It looks no different from before,
and yet, this is vastly superior!

How fortunate for you!
texts.SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_Magni:
Hmmm… {STR_VAR_1} it is!

This is a magnificent nickname!
It is impeccably beyond reproach!

You'll do well to cherish your
{STR_VAR_1} now and beyond.
texts.SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_ThatI:
Now, now.
That is merely an EGG!
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Woul:
Welcome to the OCEANIC MUSEUM.

The entrance fee is ¥50.
Would you like to enter?
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_NotE:
Oh? I'm sorry, but you don't seem to
have enough money.
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Catc:
Oh? You're with that group that
went in earlier?

You're the only one who's late.
You'd better go catch up to them!
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Aqua:
We, TEAM AQUA, exist for the good
of all!
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OurB:
We were told to assemble here,
so we did, but…

Our BOSS, the linchpin, isn't here.
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Woul:
If I ripped off the stuff here,
would it make me rich?
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_CanL:
What I learn here, I can put to use on
nefarious deeds…
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Rust:
If our goons didn't bungle things
in RUSTBORO, we wouldn't be here!
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Didn:
I didn't have ¥50, so it took a long
time getting by the receptionist.
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Lear:
I want to learn about the sea and
use that knowledge for battling.
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Ster:
I get all giddy and gooey when
I see the sea!

For me, CAPT. STERN is the number
one role model!
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Must:
The sea is vast without end, and
infinitely deep…

There must be many POKéMON that
we don't know about.
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Want:
I want a sea POKéMON.

I think it would feel cool and nice
to hug.
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Reme:
Aiyeeeh!
What are you doing here?

Me? I'm the TEAM AQUA member
you thumped before, remember?

Back in RUSTURF TUNNEL?

Here, take this!
You have to forgive me!
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Hope:
That TM, it suits you more than it
does me.

Hope I never see you again!
Wahahaha!
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_YouH:
Awww, come on!
You have to take this and let me go!
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Whir:
A blue fluid is spiraling inside
a glass vessel.

“This is an experiment to create a
WHIRLPOOL artificially using wind.”
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Wate:
A red ball is bobbing up and down
inside a glass vessel.

“This is an experiment simulating a
WATERFALL using the ball's buoyancy.”
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Ocea:
It's a sample of soil from the ocean
floor.

“Over many years, the remains of
life-forms settle at the bottom of

the sea, making sedimentary layers.

“By analyzing these layers, the
ancient past is revealed.”
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Beac:
It's a sample of beach sand.

“Stones from mountains are washed
down by rivers where they are

chipped and ground down.

“They are reduced to grains and end
up as sand on beaches.”
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Ocea:
“OCEANIC MINIFACT 1
Why is seawater blue?

“Light is composed of many colors.

“When light passes through water,
most kinds of light lose color.

“However, blue light retains its
color, making the sea appear blue.”

“OCEANIC MINIFACT 2
Why is the sea salty?

“Seawater contains dissolved salt in
the form of sodium and chlorine ions.

“These ions leech out of rocks
and are carried out to sea by rain.

“The concentration of dissolved salt
makes the sea salty.”

“OCEANIC MINIFACT 3
Which is bigger? The sea or land?

“The sea covers about 70% of
the planet, and the rest is land.

“The sea is therefore more than twice
the size of land.”
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Foss:
It's a fossil with wavy ridges on it.

“Soil on the ocean floor gets scoured
by the tide.

“The flowing seawater marks the soil
with small ridges and valleys.

“If this soil becomes fossilized, it is
called a ripple mark.”
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Dept:
A strange machine is rotating under
a glass dome.

Maybe it's for measuring the depth
of something…
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Than:
Yes? If you're looking for STERN,
that would be me.

Ah! Those must be the parts I ordered
from MR. STONE of DEVON.

Thank you! That's great!
We can prepare for our expedition now.
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Well:
Hehehe, hold it!
We'll take those parts!
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Ster:
CAPT. STERN: Wh-what?
Who are you people?
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Were:
We're TEAM AQUA!

Our BOSS wants those parts!
Shut your yap and fork them over!
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Boss:
Oh, man, what a disaster…
The BOSS is going to be furious…
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_LetM:
Humph, sniveling wimp!
Let me take care of this!
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Medd:
Now what? If we don't get the parts,
we're in for it!

Arrgh, I didn't count on being meddled
with by some meddling kid!
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Came:
I came to see what was taking so
long to snatch some parts, and you

simps are held up by a mere child?
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Arch:
We are TEAM AQUA,
and we love the sea!

And I am TEAM AQUA's leader,
ARCHIE!

What makes you interfere with us?

…No! You can't be!
You're not one of TEAM MAGMA?

Wait, that can't be right.
You're not dressed for the part.

… … … … … …
… … … … … …

POKéMON, people… All life depends on
the sea.

So, TEAM AQUA is dedicated to
the expansion of the sea.

Don't you agree? What we are doing
is a magnificent undertaking.

Ah, fine…
You're still too young to understand

our noble objective.

But, I warn you, don't even consider
interfering with our plans again.

The consequences will cost you
dearly!

And don't you forget it!
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Ster:
CAPT. STERN: You're…
Ah, okay, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}…

Anyway, that was a tense situation!
Thank you for saving us!

Oh, yes, I almost forgot that you
even brought the parts from DEVON!

CAPT. STERN: Whoops!
There's no time to lose!

We have to set out on our ocean-floor
expedition really soon.

Thanks again, but now I've got
to go!

Feel free to wander around and check
out our facilities, though.
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Remi:
I saw a model of a ship here.

It reminded me of the ABANDONED SHIP
near DEWFORD TOWN…
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Dont:
Don't you dare run around inside
the MUSEUM!
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Want:
Wow, the submarine's awesome!
I want to go for a ride!
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Wate:
“WATER QUALITY SAMPLE 1,” the
label says.

The sea is all connected, but the
water seems to differ by region.

“WATER QUALITY SAMPLE 2,” the
label says.

Does the saltiness of seawater differ
by region, too?
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Pres:
A rubber ball is expanding and
shrinking.

“In the sea, the weight of water itself
exerts pressure.

“In shallow water, the pressure is not
very heavy.

“However, in extremely deep water,
the pressure can reach even tens of

thousands of tons on a small area.”
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Hoen:
“MODEL OF HOENN REGION”

It's a miniature diorama of the
HOENN region.

Where is LITTLEROOT TOWN on this?
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Deep:
It's a display on the flow of seawater.

“Near the bottom of the sea, water
flows due to differences in such

factors as temperature and salinity.”
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Surf:
It's a display on the flow of seawater.

“Toward the surface, seawater flows
as currents driven by the winds.”
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSTi:
“THE FERRY S.S. TIDAL

“A scale replica of the ship under
construction at STERN'S SHIPYARD.”
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Subm:
“SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1

“A replica of the high-performance
ocean floor exploration submarine.”
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Sumb:
“SUBMERSIBLE POD

“A replica of a compact, unmanned
pod for seafloor exploration.”
texts.SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSAn:
“S.S. ANNE

“A replica of the luxury liner that
circles the globe.”
texts.SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Rais:
Want a tip for battling?

I'd say it's raising different kinds
of POKéMON in a balanced manner.

It's no good to make just one
POKéMON strong.

If it has a type disadvantage,
it might not stand a chance.
texts.SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Trad:
I trade POKéMON with my friends.

If a traded POKéMON is holding an
item, it makes me twice as happy!
texts.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MeetCh:
Er-hem! I am the CHAIRMAN of the
POKéMON FAN CLUB!

Being the CHAIRMAN, I am naturally
the most important!

No one can best me when it comes
to raising POKéMON. No one!

Well, let me tell you about
POKéMON CONTESTS.

They're events where one can show off
POKéMON for the world to see!

However, they're held in far-off towns,
so I cannot participate often enough.

That is why we gather here to show
off our POKéMON, and have others

show us theirs.
texts.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_LikeTo:
The POKéMON of a TRAINER who has
entered a POKéMON CONTEST…

That, I would like to see.
texts.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AllowM:
Er-hem! I see you've participated in
a POKéMON CONTEST!

Please! Allow me to examine how you
have raised your POKéMON.

It delights me no end to see POKéMON
raised by other TRAINERS.

The happy expressions of POKéMON
raised with proper care…

The kindly eyes of the TRAINER that
nurtured and raised the POKéMON…

The very thought fills my heart to
overwhelming with joy.

Oh! I do beg your pardon!
Forgive me for prattling on so!

Please! Allow me to examine how much
your POKéMON has grown!
texts.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_HowIsY:
How is your POKéMON growing?
Allow me to examine it.
texts.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_GiveMo:
Hmmm… It's not bad, but it's not
good, either…

You, the TRAINER, must put more
effort into raising this POKéMON!

For instance, may I suggest that
you give it more {POKEBLOCK}S?
texts.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_NoSpac:
Oh, my…

Your POKéMON is growing quite well,
so you deserve a reward.

Unfortunately, you have no space for
this in your BAG.
texts.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonMos:
Your {STR_VAR_1}, it is growing in
a most impressive manner!

It is one fine specimen!

But! If you were to give it this,
it would grow even better! Indeed!
texts.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Explai:
Let a POKéMON hold that RED SCARF.

Everyone will recognize the coolness
of that POKéMON!

Let a POKéMON hold that BLUE SCARF.

Its beauty will be accentuated much
more than now!

Let a POKéMON hold that PINK SCARF.

It will draw out the cuteness of
the POKéMON some more!

Let a POKéMON hold that GREEN SCARF.

That will enhance the
smartness of POKéMON!

Let a POKéMON hold that YELLOW SCARF.

It will bolster your POKéMON's
toughness so much more!
texts.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Nothin:
I'm sorry, but I've nothing else to
give you! None at all!

After all, you're blessed with the gift
of raising POKéMON without resorting

to any items!
texts.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ShowMe:
I love seeing POKéMON that love
their TRAINERS.

POKéMON are very sensitive to
the feelings of their TRAINERS.

If you treat your POKéMON with love
and care, they'll love you back.

When your POKéMON grow to love you,
please come show me.
texts.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Pokemo:
Your POKéMON really adores you.

For you, a most compassionate
TRAINER, a gift from the FAN CLUB!
texts.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_TreatP:
POKéMON are very sensitive to
the feelings of their TRAINERS.

If you treat your POKéMON with love
and care, they'll love you back.
texts.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Pokemo:
If you keep letting a POKéMON faint
in battle, it'll come to resent it.

Soon, it will become less trusting
of the TRAINER.

In other words, it certainly won't
like you very much.
texts.SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonEnj:
Do POKéMON enjoy having items used
on them?

Mine acted really happy when I gave
it some PROTEIN.
texts.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Can:
Umm… If this goes here, and that
goes over there…

Then where does this thing go?
And what about that doohickey?

Aaargh! I can't make heads or tails
of this!
texts.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Mee:
Hm?
Hi, I'm DOCK.

CAPT. STERN commissioned me to
design a ferry.

Oh! That there…
Are they DEVON GOODS?

But, hmm…
This won't do…

CAPT. STERN went off somewhere.
He said he had some work to do.

Could I get you to go find CAPT.
STERN and deliver that to him?
texts.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Cou:
DOCK: Where could CAPT. STERN have
gone off to?

Could you go find CAPT. STERN and
deliver that parcel to him?

DOCK: Shipbuilding is an art.

A lot of things can't be figured out
just by calculating.

I really could use advice from a veteran
who knows the seas…
texts.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Bri:
DOCK: Hi! MR. BRINEY's joined us to
lend us his help.

Thanks to the veteran sailor, the
ferry is steadily coming together.
texts.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Fer:
DOCK: The ferry is finally ready!

The new S.S. TIDAL is truly a marvel
of technology!

But, I get the feeling that we can
make something even better.

You know, there's never an end to
technology's march.
texts.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Dec:
MR. BRINEY: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
It's been too long!

Aye, since I met you, this old sea dog's
been feeling frisky!

So I've decided to help DOCK make
a ferry.

Aye, after all, a ferry would be able
to carry a lot of people.

But, you know, that DOCK is really
something special.

With his knack for technology and
my experience, I'm sure that we can

build one great ship, aye!
texts.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Sea:
The seasons, the weather, where
the moon sits in the sky…

These and other conditions make
the sea change its expression.

That's right!
The sea is like a living thing!
texts.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Get:
I get seasick real easily.
So I get to help out here instead.
texts.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_Shi:
Designing a large ship is more like
making a big building than putting

together a transportation vehicle.
texts.SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_Flo:
Don't you think it's strange that
a ship made of heavy iron floats?

It floats because of a principle
called buoyancy.
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_GymSign:
SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM
LEADER: JUAN

“The GYM LEADER with the beauty
of pure water!”
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_CitySign:
SOOTOPOLIS CITY

“The mystical city where history
slumbers.”
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_PhysicallyFitLivingH:
Diving in the sea. Climbing up and
down stairs all the time…

If you live in this town, you end up
getting physically fit.
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_GiantPokemonSuddenly:
These giant POKéMON suddenly appeared
in the middle of the city!

And, I've never seen them before!

Why are they smashing into each
other like that?

Why can't they be friends, those
POKéMON?
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_WhatIsThatGreenPokem:
What? What? What?
What is that green POKéMON?!
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_WhereDidLegendariesG:
GROUDON and KYOGRE…
Where did they go?

Will they cause droughts or downpours
somewhere else?
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_TwoPokemonArentAngry:
I just get this sense somehow that
the two POKéMON aren't angry.

I think… They probably can't control
their own power…
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_FlyingMonStoppedRamp:
That flying POKéMON came down from
the sky and stopped the rampaging

POKéMON…
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_WonderWhatWorldIsLik:
I… I've never been out of this city.

I wonder what the world is like on
the other side of this round sky?
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_GoRedAndBlueMon:
Go for it, red POKéMON!
Don't back off, blue POKéMON!
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_DoYouKnowMonNames:
… … … … … …

Hi, do you know the names of those
POKéMON fighting over there?
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_GreenOneSettlesThing:
I was wondering which one would win,
the red one or the blue one, but, oh no,

it's the green one that settles things!

Talk about a huge turn of events!
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_SeeingLegendWithOwnE:
There's an ancient legend that claims
the land and sea were shaped by

a colossal battle between POKéMON.

Well, I'm seeing that happen with
my very own eyes!

Whoa! I never expected to be
witness to something this huge!
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_SawLegendWithOwnEyes:
There's an ancient legend that claims
the land and sea were shaped by

a colossal battle between POKéMON.

Well, I saw that happen with
my very own eyes!

Whoa! I never expected to be
witness to something this huge!
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_BigPokemonFighting:
A big POKéMON is fighting with
another big POKéMON!

Please, someone make them stop!
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_PrettyMonCameFromSky:
A pretty POKéMON came down from
the sky…
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisWillBeWrec:
Oh, no!
SOOTOPOLIS CITY will get wrecked!
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_NoOrdinaryTourist:
Hm!
You've come all the way to SOOTOPOLIS?

You're no ordinary tourist.

But I suppose that doesn't make you
an extraordinary tourist, either.
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_CityRegainedCalm: The city has regained its calm…
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginPleaseLe:
Who might you be?

This is the CAVE OF ORIGIN.

The spirits of POKéMON, becalmed at
MT. PYRE, are said to be revived here.

Please leave.
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_LeadSuperiorTrainerT:
A person with a strong will and
superior talent…

A TRAINER who has knowledge and
experience of many kinds of POKéMON…

If such a person were to appear, I was
instructed by WALLACE to lead that

TRAINER to this CAVE.
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_AwakenedPokemonClash:
Oh, my…

The clash between the two awakened
POKéMON was quelled by the awakening

of a third POKéMON…
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginSleepsTo:
This is the CAVE OF ORIGIN…

With the passing of the crisis,
the cave, too, shall sleep…
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisSkyBeautif:
SOOTOPOLIS sprang up as a town in
the crater of a volcano.

If you look up at the sky, the lip of
the crater is also visible.

So, all you see is the sky in a circle.

But that's what makes the sky above
SOOTOPOLIS the most beautiful.
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_GiganticPokemonFight:
When two POKéMON that gigantic
are fighting that savagely, there's

not much that we can do.
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_FearedWorstWhenPokem:
When that third POKéMON flew down,
I feared the worst.
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_NightSkyFavoriteScen:
A circle of a night sky framed by
the crater of a volcano…

And in that ring, stars flicker and
blink as if they were alive…

It's my favorite scenery.
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_WeatherWentWild:
The weather was clear this morning,
but…

All of a sudden, dark clouds brewed up,
rain started falling in sheets, and

there was thunder and lightning, too.

The weather just went completely
wild!

Is all of this because of those
POKéMON?
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_YouBroughtFlyingMon:
Oh?

It was you who brought that flying
POKéMON here?

Well, aren't you amazing!
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_GroudonPleaseStop:
MAXIE: G… GROUDON…
Please! Stop what you're doing!

I know the extent of your power now!

If you keep going, all HOENN, not just
SOOTOPOLIS, will be utterly ruined!
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_AfterAllOurScheming:
MAXIE: So the super-ancient POKéMON
weren't only GROUDON and KYOGRE…

After all our fruitless scheming and
frantic efforts, that one POKéMON's

simple action puts everything right

again as if nothing had happened…

Fu…
Fuhahaha…
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_KyogreCalmDown:
ARCHIE: KYOGRE! What's wrong?!
Look over here! It's the RED ORB!

Calm down! KYOGRE!

… … … … … …
… … … … … …

It's no good!
It's not responding at all!
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_TryingMeaninglessToP:
ARCHIE: KYOGRE and GROUDON both
flew off to who knows where.

The weather in HOENN has returned
to its normal state…

Haha…
Hahaha…

Maybe what we were trying to do was
something small, even meaningless,

to POKéMON…
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisCo:
STEVEN: Those POKéMON fighting…
GROUDON… And KYOGRE…

The two super-ancient POKéMON
were awakened from a long sleep…

And now they are smashing each other
with their uncontrollable energy…

…{PLAYER}{KUN}.

You being here now I'll take to mean
that you're prepared to become

involved in this crisis.

Well, then, there's someone that
I'd like you to meet.

Come with me, please.
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFear:
STEVEN: Listen, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

Does seeing GROUDON and KYOGRE make
you think POKéMON are to be feared?

But that's not true.
POKéMON are really more…

…Why am I asking you this?
You already know.
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_HereWereAreHelpWalla:
STEVEN: Okay, here we are!

Inside here you'll find someone named
WALLACE.

I think you have what's needed to
help him…
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_KnowWhatsNeededToHel:
STEVEN: I think you have what's
needed to help him…
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_NeverBeenToSkyPillar:
STEVEN: The SKY PILLAR…

I've never been there.
I wonder where it could be?
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_SoThatsRayquaza:
STEVEN: So that's RAYQUAZA…

It's incredible how the two rampaging
POKéMON would flee from it in fear…
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_MaxieArchieLeft:
STEVEN: It looks like both MAXIE and
ARCHIE have gone away somewhere.

Perhaps they've gone to MT. PYRE to
return those ORBS…
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_HaventYouScaledSkyPi:
WALLACE: Oh?
{PLAYER}{KUN}?

Haven't you scaled the SKY PILLAR
yet?

I'm sure that you can make it to
the top of the SKY PILLAR…
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_AquaMagmaDidntMeanHa:
WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…

The leaders of TEAM MAGMA and AQUA,
I don't think they meant harm.

It wouldn't hurt to hear what they
have to say for themselves.
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_ThankYouForHelpAccep:
WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…
My eyes didn't deceive me.

Thanks to your help, SOOTOPOLIS…
No, all of HOENN was saved.

On behalf of the people, I thank you.

This is a gift from me.
Please accept it.
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_ExplainWaterfallGoTo:
That HIDDEN MACHINE contains
WATERFALL.

If you have the RAIN BADGE, a POKéMON
that has learned that HM move can

force its way up waterfalls.

And where does one get the RAIN BADGE?
You know, don't you?

That's right! You have to beat
the SOOTOPOLIS GYM LEADER.

When you're all set to go, step through
that door.
texts.SootopolisCity_Text_DazzledByMentor:
WALLACE: I'm sure that you will be
dazzled by my mentor's breathtakingly

elegant battle style.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvic:
Yo! How's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?

SOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER JUAN is
a master of WATER-type POKéMON.

And, to get to JUAN, an icy floor
will hamper your progress…

Listen, I'm sorry, but that's all the
advice that I have for you.

The rest of the way, you have to
go for it yourself!
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostV:
Yow! You've beaten even JUAN, who
was supposedly the best in all HOENN!

Okay! Check out your TRAINER CARD.

If you've gotten all the BADGES, you're
set for the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge!
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro:
Let me ask you.
Did you know?

Ah, I should not be so coy.

It was I who taught WALLACE everything
there is to know about POKéMON.

Once, I had given up my position as
the GYM LEADER.

In my place, I had entrusted WALLACE
with the GYM.

However, a compelling reason arose for
me to make a comeback.

Ah, but enough chatter.
Let us begin our match, shall we?

Please, you shall bear witness to
our artistry.

A grand illusion of water sculpted
by POKéMON and myself!
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat:
Ahahaha, excellent!
Very well, you are the winner.

From you, I sense the brilliant shine
of skill that will overcome all.

However, compared with me or even
WALLACE, you are lacking in elegance.

Perhaps I should make you a loan
of my outfit?

… … … … … …
… … … … … …

Hahaha, I merely jest!

Rather than my clothes, I shall reward
you with this, the RAIN BADGE!
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ReceivedRainB:
{PLAYER} received the RAIN BADGE
from JUAN.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainRainBa:
Having the RAIN BADGE shall assure you
the full obedience of all your POKéMON

to your every command.

The RAIN BADGE also allows the use
of the HM move WATERFALL to scale

walls of cascading water.

And, so that you never forget the
battle we shared, take this…
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainWaterP:
The TECHNICAL MACHINE I handed you
contains WATER PULSE.

In use, it will occasionally confuse
the target with ultrasonic waves.

… … … … … …
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredJua:
Registered GYM LEADER JUAN
in the POKéNAV.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostBattl:
The TRAINERS who have gathered all
the GYM BADGES of HOENN should make

way to the ultimate destination.

The POKéMON LEAGUE.

Travel to the easternmost reaches
of HOENN, to the island EVER GRANDE.

There, you shall find the POKéMON
LEAGUE.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GoGetFortreeB:
There remains but one BADGE to
obtain in HOENN.

If you wish to challenge the POKéMON
LEAGUE, you must obtain the last

BADGE from the GYM in FORTREE.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPreRematc:
JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its
usual state of serenity…

But our young typhoon has returned
to put us to the test again!

Well, my friend, most certainly!

I shall be delighted to dance with you
as often as you wish!
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchDe:
Ahahaha, you are the winner!
You have defeated me again!
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostRemat:
JUAN: If I told you to become my
apprentice, you will refuse, I am sure.

I would like to make a gift of my coat
to you.

But again, you will refuse.
I imagine that to be so.

And that, my friend, is a certain sign
of nobility!
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNe:
JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its
usual state of serenity…

But our young typhoon has returned
to put us to the test again!

Well, my friend, most certainly!
I shall be delighted to dance with you…

Ah, no, no, no.
You have with you but one POKéMON.

I wish that you would return with
two, perhaps more, POKéMON, please.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaIntro:
I'll show you the sublime techniques
I learned from our LEADER JUAN!
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaPostBa:
Watch what happens if you crack all
the floor tiles.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyIntro:
You came all the way here, but you won't
get to see JUAN.

Not if you lose to me, you won't!
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyDefeat:
You're strong!
I was fooled by your cute looks!
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyPostBa:
You might be good enough to avoid
being wiped out in one hit by JUAN.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneIntro:
The sight of JUAN conducting
a battle…

The very beauty of it compelled me to
become a TRAINER.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneDefeat:
You battled with more beauty than
I could muster…
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphnePostBa:
The grace you bring to battle is
fabulous.

Oh… I'm so fortunate to have found
POKéMON.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieIntro:
I should teach you how harsh battles
can be.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConniePostBa:
I'll tell you something good.

If you want to reach JUAN, you
need to walk on each floor tile once.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetIntro:
The POKéMON GYM of the highest level
in the HOENN region…

That's the SOOTOPOLIS GYM.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetDefea: What a high level you are!
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetPostB:
Rather than being satisfied by being
in a strong GYM, I imagine training in

other places will make you stronger.

But above all, it looks more fun.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaIntro:
I train my POKéMON together with
JUAN.

Don't think I'm a pushover.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaPostBa:
I think you have potential.
Why don't you stay and train with us?
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyIntro:
A graceful glide across the ice while
crossing no lines…

A TRAINER putting on that performance
would be elegantly beautiful!
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyPostB:
This is really obvious, but how strong
you are as a TRAINER has nothing to do

with how young or old you are.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyIntro:
When I'm with my POKéMON, the time
flies by before you can say, “Oops!”
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyPostB:
I wish I could forget about lost causes
before I can manage an “Oops!”
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaIntro:
I can battle with really rare POKéMON
if you'd like.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaDefeat:
Oh, there now! Did you have a good look
at my POKéMON?
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaPostBa:
I came to this GYM because JUAN
praised me for my darling POKéMON.

Oh, if only I'd met JUAN years ago
when I was younger…
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaIntro:
Giggle…
Your grim look is so charming.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaDefea:
Oh, dear.
I went much too easy on you.
texts.SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaPostB:
You couldn't lay a finger on JUAN,
I'm sure. Giggle…
texts.SootopolisCity_House1_Text_DevelopedThis:
For thirty years I've remained in
SOOTOPOLIS honing my skills.

I developed a shattering TM.
I bequeath it to you!
texts.SootopolisCity_House1_Text_ExplainBrickB:
TM31 contains BRICK BREAK! It's a move
so horrible that I can't describe it.
texts.SootopolisCity_House2_Text_DidYouKnowAbo:
MT. PYRE…

At its peak are two orbs placed side
by side. Did you know?
texts.SootopolisCity_House2_Text_YesTwoOrbsSid:
Yes, two orbs side by side…

The sight of them together…
It is somehow soothing…
texts.SootopolisCity_House2_Text_OughtToVisitA:
Is that so?
Perhaps you ought to visit and see…
texts.SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFa:
You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?

SOOTOPOLIS's JUAN has many fans.
Even more than his student WALLACE!

Do you have any?
texts.SootopolisCity_House3_Text_YouMustBePret: Oh, then you must be pretty strong.
texts.SootopolisCity_House3_Text_LonesomeTryWo:
Oh, dear…
That's a little lonesome.

Try working a little harder to get
a fan following.
texts.SootopolisCity_House3_Text_TrainerFanClu:
Dedicated fans come over from even
outside of HOENN.

It was really wild when I went to the
TRAINER FAN CLUB in LILYCOVE.
texts.SootopolisCity_House4_Text_AncientTreasu:
Listen up, and I'll tell you something
good.

There's supposed to be an ancient
ruin in the sea around here.

There could be treasures just waiting
to be discovered down there.
texts.SootopolisCity_House4_Text_StrollUnderwa:
Ancient treasures…

It would be nice if they existed, but
even if they didn't, it would be so

beautiful to take an underwater

stroll with my POKéMON.
texts.SootopolisCity_House5_Text_SootopolisMtP:
There appears to be some connection
between SOOTOPOLIS and MT. PYRE.

My friends and I did some research on
it at the lab where I used to work.
texts.SootopolisCity_House5_Text_BrotherUsedTo: My big brother used to study the sea.
texts.SootopolisCity_House6_Text_FirstGuestInW:
Hello! You're our first guest in
a good while.

You've brightened up my day, so I'll
give you a big WAILMER DOLL.
texts.SootopolisCity_House6_Text_IllHoldItForY:
Oh, you want it, but not right now?
Okay, then I'll hold it for you.
texts.SootopolisCity_House6_Text_DontWantThisD:
Are you sure?
You don't want this DOLL?
texts.SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CityFromErupt:
An underwater volcano erupted and
forced itself up from the depths.

Its crater emerged from the sea and
became filled with rainwater.

That's how SOOTOPOLIS CITY came into
being.
texts.SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CaveMadeToKee:
The cave that links SOOTOPOLIS and
the outside world…

It seems as if the cave was made to
keep something from getting out.

Or am I just imagining things?
texts.SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_:
Do you know the POKéMON SEEDOT?
It's hardly ever seen in SOOTOPOLIS.

Anyway, I love big SEEDOT.
The bigger the better.

But my younger brother, he says that
LOTAD is bigger.

That's silly.
SEEDOT has to be bigger than that!

Huh? Do you have a SEEDOT with you?
P-p-please, show me!

{STR_VAR_2} inches!
Oh, my gosh, this is a big one!

It might even beat the big LOTAD
my younger brother saw!

Thanks for showing me.
This is my thanks!

Hunh?
Your BAG is crammed full.

{STR_VAR_2} inches, is it?

Hmm… I've seen a bigger SEEDOT
than this one.

Oh, now this is quite something…
But it's not a SEEDOT!

You don't have a big SEEDOT?
That's too bad…

If you get a big SEEDOT, please
come show me.

The biggest SEEDOT in history!
{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}-inch giant!

A SEEDOT bigger than a LOTAD
always wanted!

Do you know the POKéMON LOTAD?
It's rarely seen in SOOTOPOLIS.

I love, I mean love, big LOTAD!

My big brother says that SEEDOT is
bigger.

But that's wrong! Everyone knows that
LOTAD is a lot bigger.

Hunh? Do you have a LOTAD?
P-p-please show me!

{STR_VAR_2} inches!
Wow, that is big!

It might be even bigger than the huge
SEEDOT my big brother saw.

Thanks for showing me!
This is my thanks!

Hunh?
Your BAG is crammed full.

{STR_VAR_2} inches?

Hmm… I've seen a bigger LOTAD
than this one here.

Well, isn't this something!
But it's no LOTAD!

Don't you have a big LOTAD?
How disappointing…

If you get a big LOTAD, please
come show me!

The biggest LOTAD in history!
{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}-inch colossus!

A LOTAD bigger than a SEEDOT
always wanted!
texts.SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_PPUpIsGreat:
PP UP is great!

It raises the POWER POINTS, the PP,
of a POKéMON move.
texts.SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_TooScaryOutside:
What…
What is happening?

I really want to know, but it's too
scary to go outside.
texts.SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_FullRestoreItem:
Do you know FULL RESTORE?

Full restoration of HP!
Eradication of all status problems!

It's truly an item of your dreams!
texts.SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Tex:
When I was young, I traveled the world
as a POKéMON TRAINER.

Now that I've become an old buzzard,
my only amusement is watching young

TRAINERS battle.
The door appears to be locked.

A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1}
is visiting my home.

Would you like to challenge
{STR_VAR_1}?

You won't battle? I'm disappointed
that I can't see you battle…

Oh, good, good!

But my house isn't all that sturdy.

Could I ask you to keep it down to
a 3-on-3 match?

Before you two battle, you should
save your progress.
I hope to see a good match!
texts.SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_B1F_Te: The match ended up a draw.
texts.SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Tex:
So, it became a standoff.

It was a brilliant match in which
neither side conceded a step!

That was superlative!

Why, it was like seeing myself in
my youth again!

Ah, too bad for you!

But it was a good match.
I hope you can win next time.
texts.SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Wal:
WALLACE is rumored to be the toughest
TRAINER in the whole HOENN region.

This town's GYM is led by the TRAINER
who taught WALLACE.

But the ELITE FOUR… They're said to be
even stronger than WALLACE's mentor.

How strong could they be?
texts.SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Eve:
Everyone in town has taken refuge
and won't come out of their homes.

Even I would rather not venture
outside.
texts.SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Alw:
Whenever, wherever, and whatever
happens, I will always be friends with

POKéMON.

Because it's fun to be with POKéMON!
texts.SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Are:
Aren't POKéMON our friends?

Why are they going wild this way?
texts.SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontier:
SCOTT: Well, hi, hi!
{PLAYER}{KUN}, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

Something's come up, so I have to
disembark, but am I glad to see you!

Congratulations, LEAGUE CHAMPION!

There's a place I'd like to invite
someone like you.

It's the…
BATTLE FRONTIER!

What's the place like?
You'll understand when you see it!

I've spoken with the ship's CAPTAIN
about this.

The next time you take a ferry,
you should be able to sail to

the BATTLE FRONTIER.

Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll be waiting for you
at the BATTLE FRONTIER!
texts.SSTidal_Text_FastCurrentsHopeYouEnjoyVoy:
This ferry is built to plow through
fast-running currents.

We hope you enjoy your voyage with us.
Feel free to explore the ship.
texts.SSTidal_Text_HopeYouEnjoyVoyage:
We hope you enjoy your voyage on
our ferry.
texts.SSTidal_Text_MadeLandInSlateport:
We have made land in SLATEPORT CITY.
Thank you for sailing with us.
texts.SSTidal_Text_MadeLandInLilycove:
We have made land in LILYCOVE CITY.
Thank you for sailing with us.
texts.SSTidalCorridor_Text_CanRestInCabin2:
It'll be some time before we make land,
I reckon.

You can rest up in your cabin if you'd
like. Your cabin's No. 2.

The bed in there is soft and plushy.
I can attest to how comfy it is!
texts.SSTidalCorridor_Text_VisitOtherCabins:
Go visit other cabins.
TRAINERS bored of the boat trip will

be itching to battle.
texts.SSTidalCorridor_Text_HorizonSpreadsBeyon:
The horizon spreads beyond
the porthole.
texts.SSTidalCorridor_Text_BrineyWelcomeAboard:
MR. BRINEY: Welcome aboard, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

They made me honorary captain of
the S.S. TIDAL!

You can call me CAPTAIN BRINEY now!

You know, I retired once before,
but when I saw this majestic ship…

Let me just say, it stirred my sleeping
soul as a sailor!
texts.SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipIntro:
Arrrgh! I'm fed up and dog-tired of
cleaning this huge place!

Let's have a quick battle!
texts.SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipPostBattle:
We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS!

The old one dumps the detergent,
and the young one does the scrubbing!
texts.SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardIntro:
This is the bottom of the ship's hull.
There's plenty of room.
