It'll be alright for a POKéMON battle.
texts.SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardPostBattle:
We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS!

The old one dumps the detergent,
and the young one does the scrubbing!
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_TakeRestOnBed:
There's a bed…
Let's take a rest.
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonIntro:
I often sail to LILYCOVE CITY.

I enjoy attending CONTESTS,
you see.
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonPostBattle:
I get so excited imagining what kinds
of POKéMON I'll get to see in the next

CONTEST. The anticipation of it thrills!
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_MicahPostBattle:
Friends need not be human.
For me, POKéMON are treasured friends!
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasIntro:
Child…
Did you knock on the door?
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasDefeat:
A loss is to be accepted without haste
or panic.
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasPostBattle:
To be never ruffled in any situation is
the GENTLEMAN's code of conduct.
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_JedIntro:
JED: I feel a little shy about this, but…
We'll show you our lovey-dovey power!
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_JedPostBattle:
JED: It's the first time that our lovey-
dovey power couldn't prevail!

You must be an awesome TRAINER!
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_JedNotEnoughMons:
JED: You only have one POKéMON?
Isn't that just too lonesome?
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaIntro:
LEA: I feel a little silly, but…
We'll show you our lovey-dovey power!
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaPostBattle:
LEA: I can't believe it!
Our lovey-dovey power failed…

You must be an awesome TRAINER!
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaNotEnoughMons:
LEA: I wanted to battle…
But you don't even have two POKéMON…
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretIntro:
Ah, you've come just in time.

I'm bored, you see.
You may entertain me.
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretPostBattle:
Perhaps I shall get Father to acquire
a yacht for me.

A yacht for me and POKéMON!
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiIntro:
Oh, you're such an adorable TRAINER.
Would you like to have tea?

Or would you rather battle?
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiDefeat:
I see.
You're the active sort.
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiPostBattle:
A world cruise on a luxury liner has its
charms, I must say…

But, I will admit there is an appealing
side to touring HOENN by ferry.
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_NotSuspiciousTakeThis:
Uh… Hi! I… I'm not acting suspicious!
Uh… You can have this! For free!

It… Honestly, I didn't SNATCH it from
someone! I'd never do such a thing!

It's clean! You can use it!
texts.SSTidalRooms_Text_ExplainSnatch:
SNATCH steals the beneficial effects
of certain moves before they can be

used by a foe or ally.
texts.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_StillGettingRe:
This is the TRAINER HILL where
you may enjoy tag battles with many

TRAINERS.

Unfortunately, we're still getting
things ready. Please come back later!
texts.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WelcomeToTrain:
Welcome!

This is the TRAINER HILL where
you may enjoy tag battles with many

TRAINERS!
texts.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_SaveGameBefore:
Is this your first visit here?

Before you enter, please save
your game.
texts.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersUpToFl:
Let's see…
The TRAINERS here now are…

Up to floor no. {STR_VAR_1}.
texts.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersInEver:
Let's see…
The TRAINERS here now are…

There appear to be TRAINERS gathered
in every room.
texts.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_LikeToChalleng:
Would you like to challenge the
waiting TRAINERS?
texts.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TimeProgessGet:
I will time your progress.
Best of luck!

On your marks…

Get set…

Go!
texts.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TooBadTremendo:
That was too bad.

I think you put in a tremendous
effort in your battling.

Please come back and try again!
texts.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_HopeYouGiveItY: I hope you give it your best.
texts.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_MovedReception:
When the TRAINERS switch places,
the movement can be hectic.

To avoid the stampede, we moved
the reception counter here.

I'm sorry for the inconvenience.
texts.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ExplainTrainer:
Here at the TRAINER HILL, we conduct
an event called the Time Attack.

It is a race that measures how long
you take to reach our owner on

the rooftop from this counter.

The fastest times are posted on
the Time Board--try competing with

your friends.

In TRAINER battles along the way,
neither Exp. Points nor money will

be awarded.
texts.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_NeedAtLeastTwo:
Oh, I'm sorry, but you appear to have
only one POKéMON with you.

You will need at least two POKéMON
to enter this event.
texts.TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBrav:
Hm! Hm!

You finally came!
Yes, you have arrived!

Wait! Don't say it!
I know why you came all the way

here by yourself!

You wanted to see me, the owner
of the TRAINER HILL, because…

You want to form a tag team with me!
Wa-hoo!

…Uh?
That's not it?

Anyway, I watched you on your way up.
Marvelous battling! Bravo, indeed!
texts.TrainerHill_Roof_Text_HaveTheMostMarvelo:
For a marvelous someone like you,
I have the most marvelous gift!
texts.TrainerHill_Roof_Text_FullUpBeBackLaterF:
Oh, no, full up with things!
You'll be back later for this!
texts.TrainerHill_Roof_Text_GotHereMarvelously:
Oh, hold on here! Did you possibly get
here marvelously quickly?

How splendid! You needn't have
hurried so to see me!

That is so delightful. I'll have the Time
Board at the reception updated!
texts.TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouWerentVeryQuick:
But, oh…
You weren't very quick getting here.
texts.TrainerHill_Roof_Text_ArriveZippierNextT:
Perhaps it would please me more if you
arrived zippier next time.

Then, I should be pleased to form
a tag team with you!

Until we meet again, amigo!
texts.TrainerHill_Roof_Text_BuiltTrainerHillTo:
I had the TRAINER HILL built for but
one reason and one only!

To find the most suitable partner
with whom I may form a tag team!
texts.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WhatSortOfTrai:
Who knows what sort of TRAINERS
and POKéMON combos are ahead?

All I know is that I'll knock aside
anyone that stands in my way!
texts.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_CantWaitToTest:
I heard tough TRAINERS come to this
TRAINER HILL from all over.

I can't wait to test the waters!

I'll knock aside anyone that stands
in my way!
texts.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_FriendsTryingT:
Do you see the Time Board over there?

My friends and I are trying to see who
can reach the top in the least time.
texts.TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_DoYouKnowWhenT:
Do you know when they're opening
this place up?

I'm waiting here to be the first
challenger ever!
texts.TrainerHill_Elevator_Text_ReturnToRecept:
Would you like to return to
the reception counter?
texts.Underwater_SeafloorCavern_Text_SubExplor:
“SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1” is painted
on the hull.

This is the submarine TEAM AQUA
stole in SLATEPORT!

TEAM AQUA must have gone
ashore here.
texts.VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel:
My papa told me.

He says this tunnel is full of
timid POKéMON.

They get all scared of loud noise and
make a big uproar.

So they had to stop the big tunnel
project.

But there's one man. He's trying to dig
the tunnel by himself!
texts.VerdanturfTown_Text_ManDugTunnelForLove:
There was a man who dug a tunnel for
a lady he loved.

I don't really get it, but hey!
texts.VerdanturfTown_Text_AirCleanHere:
The way the winds blow, volcanic ash
is never blown in this direction.

The air is clean and delicious here.
Living here should do wonders for even

frail and sickly people.
texts.VerdanturfTown_Text_MakeBattleTentDebut:
My POKéMON and I, we've been riding
a hot winning streak.

So I decided to make my BATTLE TENT
debut in this town.
texts.VerdanturfTown_Text_GuyTryingToBustThrou:
Did you see the cave next to the
POKéMON MART?

There's a guy in there who's trying to
bust up boulders so he can bust out

through to the other side.

It'd be great if we could go through…
It'll make it easy to visit RUSTBORO.
texts.VerdanturfTown_Text_EasyToGetToRustboroN:
That cave next to the POKéMON MART
is now a tunnel to the other side.

It's great--it's easy to go shop for
new DEVON products in RUSTBORO now.
texts.VerdanturfTown_Text_TownSign:
VERDANTURF TOWN

“The windswept highlands with the
sweet fragrance of grass.”
texts.VerdanturfTown_Text_BattleTentSign:
BATTLE TENT VERDANTURF SITE
“Feast Your Eyes on Battles!”
texts.VerdanturfTown_Text_RusturfTunnelSign:
RUSTURF TUNNEL
“Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF

“The tunnel project has been
canceled.”
texts.VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_WhichCon:
Which CONTEST are you entering?
Want a piece of advice?

In any CONTEST, for example, a CUTE
CONTEST, I don't think they judge you

only on cuteness in the first round.

You need to work out ways for raising
POKéMON better.
texts.VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMo:
I raised my POKéMON to be cute.

I found out you can put POKéMON in
a CONTEST for cuteness!

I'm so glad I raised my POKéMON with
loving care…
texts.VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_MyMonRul:
My POKéMON rules!

It's cool, tough yet beautiful, cute,
and smart. It's complete!

I may as well go for wins in every
single CONTEST.
texts.VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Mons:
If it doesn't like a certain move,
a POKéMON will be reluctant to use it.

It doesn't matter how strong it is,
either.

For example, a POKéMON with a GENTLE
nature probably won't enjoy hurting

its opponents.

If it can't seem to live up to its
potential, it's probably failing at

using a disliked move against its will.
texts.VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Gent:
My big sister is gentle usually.
But when she gets angry,

she's really, really scary!

I bet a gentle POKéMON will be scary
if it gets angry!
texts.VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Attr:
My feelings toward my POKéMON…
The attraction runs deep…

Oh, hi, you didn't see that, did you?
Well, it doesn't matter.

How would you like this TM for
your POKéMON?

My feelings toward my POKéMON…
I'm sure the attraction is mutual!

They battle exactly the way I want
them to!
texts.VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Taug:
What kind of moves have you taught
your POKéMON?

I think you would give yourself
an advantage if they knew how to

heal or protect themselves.
texts.VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Scot:
SCOTT: Hey there, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I thought I might see you here.

A BATTLE TENT's a place where
you can meet tough TRAINERS.

It doesn't matter what the rules are,
or how battles are waged, either.

{PLAYER}{KUN}, I expect you to do
the best you can!

SCOTT: I visit here regularly in hopes
of seeing tough TRAINERS in action

in whatever the situation.
texts.VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Tex:
Let me see your POKéMON.
I'll check to see how much it likes you.

Oh.
Your POKéMON…

It adores you.
It can't possibly love you any more.

I even feel happy seeing it.

It seems to be very happy.
It obviously likes you a whole lot.

It likes you quite a lot.
It seems to want to be babied a little.

It's getting used to you.
It seems to believe in you.

It's not very used to you yet.
It neither loves nor hates you.

It's very wary.
It has scary viciousness in its eyes.

It doesn't like you much at all.

This is a little hard for me to say…

Your POKéMON simply detests you.
Doesn't that make you uncomfortable?
texts.VerdanturfTown_House_Text_TrainersGather:
Far away, deep in EVER GRANDE CITY,
is the POKéMON LEAGUE.

The TRAINERS who gather there are
all frighteningly well skilled.
texts.VerdanturfTown_House_Text_DefeatEliteFou:
In the POKéMON LEAGUE, I think the
rules say that you have to battle the

ELITE FOUR all in a row.

If you lose to any of them, you have
to begin your challenge again from the

first one.
texts.VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_XSpecialIsCruci:
For any POKéMON match, X SPECIAL
is crucial.

It jacks up the power of some moves
even though it's only for one battle.
texts.VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NoStrategyGuide:
They don't seem to sell any winning
strategy guides for the BATTLE TENT…

It seems one must rely on one's
own wits after all…
texts.VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NestBallOnWeake:
The NEST BALL works better on
weakened POKéMON.

VERDANTURF is the only place you can
buy it.
texts.VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Fai:
You can't consider yourself a real
TRAINER if you don't have faith

in your POKéMON.

Only those people who can believe
in their battling POKéMON can win

through to the very end.
texts.VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Vis:
The reason why anyone would visit
VERDANTURF…

It's the BATTLE TENT. It goes without
saying.

Or is there somebody here that you
came to see?
texts.VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_Stronger:
WALLY: I lost to you, {PLAYER}, but I'm
not feeling down anymore.

Because I have a new purpose in life.
Together with my RALTS, I'm going

to challenge POKéMON GYMS and become

a great TRAINER.

Please watch me, {PLAYER}.
I'm going to be stronger than you.

When I do, I'm going to challenge you
to another battle.

WALLY: Please watch me, {PLAYER}.
I'm going to get stronger than you.

When I do, I'm going to challenge you
to another battle.
texts.VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallysNe:
UNCLE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
WALLY's next door.

But, boy, there's something I have to
tell you.

This natural environment is doing
wonders for WALLY's health.

Maybe it's not just the environment.
It could be POKéMON that are giving

the boy hope.
texts.VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallySli:
WALLY's gone away…
He slipped off on his own…
texts.VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallyGon:
UNCLE: Is that right?
WALLY's gone away that far all by

himself…

Well, I have to give him credit--he is
my little brother's son.
texts.VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_MeetWand:
WANDA: You are?
Oh, right, I get it!

You're the {PLAYER} who WALLY was
telling me about.

I'm WALLY's cousin.
Glad to meet you!

I think WALLY's become a lot more lively
and healthy since he came here.
texts.VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_DontWorr:
WANDA: Don't worry about WALLY.
He'll be just fine.

I know my little cousin, and he has
POKéMON with him, too.
texts.VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_CanSeeGi:

texts.LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainCo:
A POKéMON CONTEST involves four
TRAINERS entering one POKéMON each

in competitive judging.

A CONTEST has two stages of judging,
primary and secondary.

Primary judging is a popularity poll
involving the audience.

Secondary judging features appeals
by the POKéMON using their moves.

Plan appeals carefully to earn the
most attention of the JUDGE and

excite the audience.

Do your best to stand out.

The primary and secondary scores are
added at the end.

The POKéMON garnering the highest
score is declared the winner.

There are five kinds of CONTESTS.

COOL, BEAUTY, CUTE, SMART, and
TOUGH are the five categories.

Choose the CONTEST that is right for
the POKéMON you plan to enter.

There are four ranks of POKéMON
CONTESTS.

NORMAL, SUPER, HYPER, and MASTER
are the four ranks.

In the NORMAL Rank, any POKéMON may
enter.

Any POKéMON that won a NORMAL Rank
CONTEST may move up to the SUPER Rank

in the same category.

In the same way, a SUPER Rank winner
can move up to the HYPER Rank, and

a HYPER Rank winner can advance to

the MASTER Rank in the same category.

A POKéMON that won in the MASTER Rank
may compete in the MASTER Rank as

often as its TRAINER wants.

I welcome you to the BATTLE TENT
FALLARBOR SITE!

I am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!

of a Set KO Tourney?

texts.FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Expla:
In the FALLARBOR BATTLE TENT,
we undertake the Set KO Tourney.

All participants enter with a team of
three POKéMON.

The three POKéMON must be lined up
in the order that they are to appear in.

During battle, the POKéMON will appear
one at a time in the preset order.

Once a POKéMON enters battle, it must
remain out until the match is decided.

If a match remains undecided in
three turns, it goes to judging.

If you wish to interrupt your challenge,
please save the game.

If you don't save, you will not be able
to continue with your challenge.

If you pull off the feat of beating
three TRAINERS in succession,

we will present you with a fine prize.

texts.SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_Expla:
In a Battle Swap event, you may use
only three POKéMON.

Whether you are renting or swapping,
your team may not have two or more

of the same POKéMON.

You may swap POKéMON only with
the TRAINER you have just defeated.

You may swap for only those POKéMON
used by the beaten TRAINER.

After every battle you win, you may
swap for one of your defeated

opponent's POKéMON.

You will not be able to swap POKéMON
with the third TRAINER in the event.

There are two key points to be aware
of when swapping POKéMON.

First, when swapping, you can't check
the stats of the POKéMON you are

about to receive.

Second, the POKéMON on your team
are lined up in sequence, depending on

the order in which you rented them.

This sequence remains unchanged
even when swaps are made.

The POKéMON of the SLATEPORT
BATTLE TENT are all rentals.

All rental POKéMON are kept at
Level 30.

texts.VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Expl:
Here at the VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT,
POKéMON are required to think and

battle by themselves.

Unlike in the wild, POKéMON that live
with people behave differently

depending on their nature.

Depending on its nature, a POKéMON
may prefer to attack no matter what.

Another POKéMON may prefer to protect
itself from any harm.

Yet another may enjoy vexing or
confounding its foes.

Depending on its nature, a POKéMON
will have favorite moves that it is good

at using.

It may also dislike certain moves that
it has trouble using.

There are offensive moves that inflict
direct damage on the foe.

There are defensive moves that are
used to prepare for enemy attacks or

used to heal HP and so on.

There are also other somewhat-odd
moves that may enfeeble the foes with

stat problems including poison and 

paralysis.

POKéMON will consider using moves in
these three categories.

When not under command by its TRAINER,
a POKéMON may be unable to effectively

use certain moves.

A POKéMON is not good at using any
move that it dislikes.

If a POKéMON only knows moves that
do not match its nature, it will often

be unable to live up to its potential.

Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may
start using moves that don't match its

nature when it is in trouble.

If a POKéMON begins behaving oddly
in a pinch, watch it carefully.

texts.MatchCall_Text_Scott7:

texts.MatchCall_Text_Norman_Preparing:

texts.MatchCall_Text_MrStone2:

What's wrong? Have you forgotten

I need you to deliver my letter
to STEVEN in DEWFORD.

After that, deliver our parcel to
CAPT. STERN in SLATEPORT.

texts.MatchCall_Text_MrStone3:

Ah, so you've met STEVEN!
I'd better reward you, then!

When you visit RUSTBORO again,

texts.MatchCall_Text_MrStone4:

Did you know that DEVON was

texts.MatchCall_Text_MrStone5:

texts.MatchCall_Text_MrStone6:

texts.GiddyText_ISoWantToGoOnAVacation:
I so want to go on a vacation.
Would you happen to know a nice place?
texts.GiddyText_IBoughtCrayonsWith120Colors:
I bought crayons with 120 colors!
Don't you think that's nice?
texts.GiddyText_WouldntItBeNiceIfWeCouldFloat:
Wouldn't it be nice if we could float
away on a cloud of bubbles?
texts.GiddyText_WhenYouWriteOnASandyBeach:
When you write on a sandy beach,
they wash away. It makes me sad.
texts.GiddyText_WhatsTheBottomOfTheSeaLike:
What's the bottom of the sea like?
Just once I would so love to go!
texts.GiddyText_WhenYouSeeTheSettingSunDoesIt:
When you see the setting sun, does it
make you want to go home?
texts.GiddyText_LyingBackInTheGreenGrass:
Lying back in the green grass…
Oh, it's so, so nice!
texts.GiddyText_SecretBasesAreSoWonderful:
SECRET BASES are so wonderful!
Can't you feel the excitement?
texts.MoveTutor_Text_ThisMoveCanOnlyBeLearnedO:
This move can be learned only
once. Is that okay?
texts.MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTeach:
Heh! My POKéMON totally rules!
It's cooler than any POKéMON!

I was lipping off with a swagger in
my step like that when the CHAIRMAN

chewed me out.

That took the swagger out of my step.

If you'd like, I'll teach the move
SWAGGER to a POKéMON of yours.
texts.MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerDeclined:
What, no? Can't you get into
the spirit of things?
texts.MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerWhichMon:
All right, which POKéMON wants to
learn how to SWAGGER?
texts.MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTaught:
I'll just praise my POKéMON from now
on without the swagger.
texts.MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTeach:
Did you know that you can go from
here a long way in that direction

without changing direction?

I might even be able to roll
that way.

Do you think your POKéMON will
want to roll, too?

I can teach one the move ROLLOUT
if you'd like.
texts.MoveTutor_Text_RolloutDeclined:
You don't need to be shy about it.
Let's roll!
texts.MoveTutor_Text_RolloutWhichMon:
Ehehe, sure thing! It'd be great if
the POKéMON looked like me.
texts.MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTaught:
Rolling around in the grass makes me
happy. Come on, let's roll!
texts.MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTeach:
There's a move that gets stronger
when you keep using it in a row.

It's a BUG-type move, and it is
wickedly cool.

It's called FURY CUTTER.
Want me to teach it to a POKéMON?
texts.MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterDeclined: We're not on the same wavelength.
texts.MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterWhichMon:
Yay!
Show me which POKéMON I should teach.
texts.MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTaught:
I get a thrill watching to see if
the move keeps hitting in succession!
texts.MoveTutor_MimicTeach:
Ah, young one!

I am also a young one, but I mimic
the styles and speech of the elderly

folks of this town.

What do you say, young one?
Would you agree to it if I were to

offer to teach the move MIMIC?
texts.MoveTutor_MimicDeclined:
Oh, boo! I wanted to teach MIMIC
to your POKéMON!
texts.MoveTutor_Text_MimicWhichMon:
Fwofwo! And so I shall!
Let me see the POKéMON

you wish me to teach.
texts.MoveTutor_Text_MimicTaught:
MIMIC is a move of great depth.

Could you execute it to perfection
as well as me…?
texts.MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTeach:
I want all sorts of things!
But I used up my allowance…

Wouldn't it be nice if there were
a spell that made money appear when

you waggle a finger?

If you want, I can teach your POKéMON
the move METRONOME.

Money won't appear, but your POKéMON
will waggle a finger. Yes?
texts.MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeDeclined:
Okay. I'll be here if you change
your mind.
texts.MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeWhichMon:
Okay! I'll teach it!
Which POKéMON should I teach?
texts.MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTaught:
When a POKéMON waggles its finger
like a METRONOME, all sorts of nice

things happen.

Wouldn't it be nice if we could
use it, too?
texts.MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTeach:
Humph! My wife relies on HIDDEN
POWER to stay awake.

She should just take a nap like I do,
and SLEEP TALK.

I can teach your POKéMON how to
SLEEP TALK instead. Interested?
texts.MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkDeclined:
Oh, fine, fine. You want to stay awake
with HIDDEN POWER, too…
texts.MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkWhichMon:
Ah, an appreciative child!
Which POKéMON should I teach?
texts.MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTaught:
I've never once gotten my wife's
coin trick right.

I would be happy if I got it right
even as I SLEEP TALK…
texts.MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTeach:
When I see the wide world from up
here on the roof…

I think about how nice it would be
if there were more than just one me

so I could enjoy all sorts of lives.

Of course it's not possible.
Giggle…

I know! Would you be interested in
having a POKéMON learn SUBSTITUTE?
texts.MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteDeclined:
Oh, no?

A POKéMON can make a copy of
itself using it, you know.
texts.MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteWhichMon:
Giggle…
Which POKéMON do you want me to

teach SUBSTITUTE?
texts.MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTaught:
We human beings should enjoy our
own lives to the utmost!

I hope you'll get that way, too!
texts.MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach:
I can't do this anymore!

It's utterly hopeless!

I'm a FIGHTING-type TRAINER,
so I can't win at the MOSSDEEP GYM

no matter how hard I try!

Argh! Punch! Punch! Punch!
Punch! Punch! Punch!

What, don't look at me that way!
I'm only hitting the ground!

Or do you want me to teach your
POKéMON DYNAMICPUNCH?
texts.MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchDeclined:
Darn! You're even making fun of me?
Punch! Punch! Punch!
texts.MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchWhichMon:
What? You do? You're a good person!
Which POKéMON should I teach?
texts.MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTaught:
I want you to win at the MOSSDEEP GYM
using that DYNAMICPUNCH!
texts.MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach:
Sigh…

SOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER is really
lovably admirable.

But that also means I have many
rivals for his attention.

He's got appeal with a DOUBLE-EDGE.
I couldn't even catch his eye.

Please, let me teach your POKéMON
the move DOUBLE-EDGE!
texts.MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeWhichMon:
Okay, which POKéMON should I teach
DOUBLE-EDGE?
texts.MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTaught:
I won't live for love anymore!
I'll become tough!
texts.MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTeach:
I don't intend to be going nowhere
fast in the sticks like this forever.

You watch me, I'll get out to the city
and become a huge hit.

Seriously, I'm going to cause
a huge EXPLOSION of popularity!

If you overheard that, I'll happily
teach EXPLOSION to your POKéMON!
texts.MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionDeclined:
Gaah! You're turning me down because
I live in the country?
texts.MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionWhichMon:
Fine! An EXPLOSION it is!
Which POKéMON wants to blow up?
texts.MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTaught:
For a long time, I've taught POKéMON
how to use EXPLOSION, but I've yet

to ignite my own EXPLOSION…

Maybe it's because deep down,
I would rather stay here…

texts.gBirchDexRatingText_AreYouCurious:

Are you curious about how your
POKéDEX is coming along?
texts.gBirchDexRatingText_Cancel:

texts.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan20:

of it. But, it gets harder from here.
texts.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan30:

texts.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan40:
Well, it could use more quantity,

a POKéDEX now.
texts.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan50:

texts.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan70:
Instead of just catching POKéMON,

texts.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan80:
This is going to be a fantastic

texts.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan90:

texts.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan100:

texts.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan110:

This is an impressive POKéDEX!
texts.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan120:

texts.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan130:

texts.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan140:

TRAINERS.
texts.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan150:
I had no idea that there were so

region.
texts.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan160:

in large numbers like outbreaks.

those.
texts.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan170:

the POKéMON of the HOENN region

by looking through your POKéDEX.
texts.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan180:
I would say you already qualify as
a POKéMON PROFESSOR, and a good

one, too!
texts.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan190:
With a POKéDEX this complete,
you're a real professional at this!
texts.gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan200:
You're very close to completing
this POKéDEX.

I can feel it in my bones!

texts.gPokeNewsTextSlateport_Upcoming:

It's time for POKéMON NEWS.

SLATEPORT's most popular kind of guy,
the ENERGY GURU, is in the news again!

He promises to, “Stupendously go for
it in just this many days: {STR_VAR_1}!”

While he refused to elaborate on what
he will stupendously go for, the

ENERGY GURU advised, “Save up your

money. That'll be good…”

It sounds like a trip to SLATEPORT
would be well worth your while that day.

That's the news on POKéMON NEWS.
texts.gPokeNewsTextSlateport_Ongoing:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.

This is the news you've all been
waiting for!

SLATEPORT'S ENERGY GURU is going
for it stupendously in the MARKET!

He promises unbeatable bargain
prices on CALCIUM and PROTEIN!

A trip to SLATEPORT CITY sounds
worthwhile. Why not visit and shop

to your heart's content?

It's time for POKéMON NEWS.

It's approaching!
It's finally coming!

The GAME CORNER's service day will be
here in just this many days: {STR_VAR_1}!

Even those who are usually unlucky

you will regret it, however things

drowning when I saw you.

say to a battle?
texts.Route105_Text_LuisPostBattle:
If you are drowning, the signal is to
wave one arm toward the beach.
texts.Route105_Text_DominikIntro:
Swimming the deep blue sea…
It feels the greatest!
texts.Route105_Text_DominikDefeated:
I lost…
Now I'm feeling blue…
texts.Route105_Text_DominikPostBattle:
Why is the sea blue?

I learned about that at the MUSEUM in
SLATEPORT, but I forgot.
texts.Route105_Text_BeverlyIntro:
My body feels lighter in the water.
It's as if I've gotten slimmer!
texts.Route105_Text_PostBattle:
Your body weight is reduced to just
one tenth in the water.

That would make me…
Whoops! I'm not telling you my weight!
texts.Route105_Text_ImaniIntro:
The blue, blue sky…
The vast sea…

It's so peaceful…
texts.Route105_Text_ImaniDefeated: I lost while I was lounging!
texts.Route105_Text_ImaniPostBattle:
I want to be told I'm relaxing to be
with. Giggle.
texts.Route105_Text_AndresIntro:
I'm convinced that the sea keeps
secrets from us.
texts.Route105_Text_AndresDefeated:
Yes…
I am no good at battling…
texts.Route105_Text_AndresPostBattle:
I'm sure there are many secrets to be
discovered in the world's seas.

I mean to find them all!
texts.Route105_Text_AndresRegister:
Huh? I'm so weak, but you're willing
to register me in your POKéNAV?
texts.Route105_Text_AndresRematchIntro:
I've told you that I'm weak…
Are you sure you want to do this?
texts.Route105_Text_AndresRematchDefeated:
Yes…
I didn't think I could win.
texts.Route105_Text_AndresRematchPostBattle:
I may be weak at battling, but my
drive to explore can't be bested.

I will travel the seas all around
the world!
texts.Route105_Text_JosueIntro:
I'm exhausted from swimming.
I'm just not used to it.

I need a battle for a change of pace!
texts.Route105_Text_JosueDefeated: I lost because I battled at sea.
texts.Route105_Text_JosuePostBattle:
Yeah, for me, the sky is a much better
match than the sea.
texts.Route106_Text_ElliotIntro:
Which do you prefer, fishing in the
sea or a stream?
texts.Route106_Text_ElliotDefeated:
Like in deep-sea fishing, I lost
spectacularly!
texts.Route106_Text_ElliotPostBattle:
Fishing is the greatest whether it's
in the sea or a stream.

You agree with me, right?
texts.Route106_Text_ElliotRegister:
Fishing's great, but so is battling.
If you don't mind, can we meet again?
texts.Route106_Text_ElliotRematchIntro:
I caught a bunch of POKéMON fishing.
I'll show you an impressive battle!
texts.Route106_Text_ElliotRematchPostBattle:
Win or lose, POKéMON are the greatest!
You agree with me, right?
texts.Route106_Text_NedIntro:
What do people do if they need to go
to a washroom?

What if my ROD hooks a big one while
I'm in the washroom? I just can't go…
texts.Route106_Text_NedDefeated:
I lost because I'm trying to not go
to the washroom…
texts.Route106_Text_NedPostBattle:
Oh, no! I've got this feeling I'll hook
a big one!
texts.Route106_Text_DouglasIntro:
Hahahah! I'm a lousy runner, but in
the water you can't catch me!
texts.Route106_Text_DouglasPostBattle: I wouldn't lose in a swim race…
texts.Route106_Text_KylaIntro:
The sea is my backyard. I'm not going
to take it easy because you're a kid!
texts.Route106_Text_KylaDefeated:
Did you take it easy on me by any
chance?
texts.Route106_Text_KylaPostBattle:
Drifting along with the waves…
I love it! Why don't you give it a try?
texts.Route107_Text_DarrinIntro:
Yawn…

I must have drifted off to sleep while
I was drifting in the waves.
texts.Route107_Text_DarrinDefeated:
Ahaha, I lost…
I'll take a snooze, I think…
texts.Route107_Text_DarrinPostBattle:
Floating and being rocked by
the waves--it's like sleeping in

a plush, comfy bed.
texts.Route107_Text_TonyIntro:
The sea is like my backyard.
Let's battle!
texts.Route107_Text_TonyDefeated:
I lost on my home field…
I'm in shock!
texts.Route107_Text_TonyPostBattle:
I swim the seas with a heart full of
dreams…

It's a song!
Anyways, I'm swimming some more.
texts.Route107_Text_TonyRegister:
You've shocked me to the bone!
Well, so you won't forget me…
texts.Route107_Text_TonyRematchIntro:
Swimming in the big, wide sea,
my POKéMON has grown stronger!
texts.Route107_Text_TonyRematchDefeated:
What a shock!

My POKéMON has gotten stronger, but
I stayed weak as a TRAINER!
texts.Route107_Text_TonyRematchPostBattle:
What you learn in battle makes you
a stronger TRAINER.

The waves taught me that.
texts.Route107_Text_DeniseIntro:
Do you know a little town called
DEWFORD?
texts.Route107_Text_DenisePostBattle:
A weird saying is getting really
trendy at DEWFORD HALL.
texts.Route107_Text_BethIntro:
Did you want to battle me?
Sure, I'll go with you!
texts.Route107_Text_BethDefeated: I wasn't good enough for you.
texts.Route107_Text_BethPostBattle:
I think you're going to keep getting
better. I'll go for it, too!
texts.Route107_Text_LisaIntro:
LISA: We challenge you as a sister
and brother!
texts.Route107_Text_LisaDefeated:
LISA: Awesome.
You're in a different class of tough.
texts.Route107_Text_LisaPostBattle:
LISA: Do you have any friends who
would go to the beach with you?
texts.Route107_Text_LisaNotEnoughPokemon:
LISA: If you want to battle with us,
bring more POKéMON.
texts.Route107_Text_RayIntro:
RAY: We always battle POKéMON,
me and my sister.

I always lose, but we can beat you
2-on-2!
texts.Route107_Text_RayDefeated:
RAY: Wowee, you're at a higher level
than us!
texts.Route107_Text_RayPostBattle:
RAY: My sister gave me my POKéMON.
I raised it, and now it's my important

partner!
texts.Route107_Text_RayNotEnoughPokemon:
RAY: If you want to battle us,
go bring some more POKéMON!
texts.Route107_Text_CamronIntro:
I'm in the middle of a triathlon,
but I'm nowhere near tired!
texts.Route107_Text_CamronPostBattle:
I still have swimming and running left
to do after this.

Am I going to be okay?
texts.Route108_Text_JeromeIntro:
My dream is to swim the world's seven
seas!
texts.Route108_Text_JeromeDefeated:
I won't be able to swim the seven seas
like this…
texts.Route108_Text_JeromePostBattle:
Playing with marine POKéMON is one of
the pleasures of swimming!
texts.Route108_Text_MatthewIntro:
Ahoy, there! Are you going out to
the ABANDONED SHIP, too?
texts.Route108_Text_MatthewPostBattle:
Some people even go inside that
ABANDONED SHIP.
texts.Route108_Text_TaraIntro:
My liar of a boyfriend told me that
I look great in a bikini…
texts.Route108_Text_TaraPostBattle:
Even if it's a lie, I love being told
I look great…

We girls are so complex…
texts.Route108_Text_MissyIntro:
I love the sea!
I forget all my worries when I swim!
texts.Route108_Text_MissyDefeated:
When I lose a battle, I get all
stressed out!
texts.Route108_Text_MissyPostBattle:
Work off your stress by swimming!
It's so healthy!
texts.Route108_Text_CoryIntro:
I love WATER-type POKéMON.
I love other POKéMON, too!
texts.Route108_Text_CoryPostBattle:
Shouting is good for me!
It uplifts me!
texts.Route108_Text_CoryRegister:
I love tough TRAINERS, too!
Register me in your POKéNAV!
texts.Route108_Text_CoryRematchIntro: Win or lose, I love battling at sea!
texts.Route108_Text_CoryRematchDefeated:
Waaah! I lost again!
Waaah! Waaah!
texts.Route108_Text_CoryRematchPostBattle:
If you're faced with a challenge,
try shouting at the sea!
texts.Route108_Text_CarolinaIntro:
I take huge pride in my POKéMON.
We'll show you one speedy battle!
texts.Route108_Text_CarolinaPostBattle:
Since I'm at sea like this, I wouldn't
mind putting on a pink, frilly swimsuit…
texts.Route109_Text_DavidIntro:
Hiyah! Look at my chiseled abs!
This is what you call “cut”!
texts.Route109_Text_DavidPostBattle:
Hiyah!

My sculpted abs have nothing to do
with POKéMON battles!
texts.Route109_Text_AliceIntro:
Are you properly protected against
the sun?
texts.Route109_Text_AlicePostBattle: Cheeks are the most prone to burning!
texts.Route109_Text_HueyIntro:
I've laid anchor in ports around
the world, but SLATEPORT's the best.
texts.Route109_Text_HueyPostBattle:
In the best port was the best
TRAINER…
texts.Route109_Text_EdmondPostBattle:
I'm usually stronger than this!
I'm just seasick as a dog!

I'm a SAILOR, but…
texts.Route109_Text_RickyIntro:
I'm thirsty… I could go for a SODA POP
at the SEASHORE HOUSE…
texts.Route109_Text_RickyPostBattle:
I'm getting famished… My inner tube
looks like a giant doughnut…
texts.Route109_Text_RickyRegister:
Will you have another match with me
when I'm not all thirsty?
texts.Route109_Text_RickyRematchIntro:
I'm hungry, but I've got enough pep in
me for a battle!
texts.Route109_Text_RickyRematchDefeated:
I lost…
It's because I'm hungry…
texts.Route109_Text_RickyRematchPostBattle:
When you eat on a beach, everything
seems to taste a little better.
texts.Route109_Text_LolaIntro:
Doesn't a beach umbrella look like
a giant flower?
texts.Route109_Text_LolaPostBattle:
If you look at the beach from the sky,
it looks like a big flower garden!
texts.Route109_Text_LolaRematchIntro:
I'm not losing to you again!
That's why I have my inner tube!
texts.Route109_Text_LolaRematchPostBattle:
If I have an inner tube, me and my
POKéMON's cuteness goes way up!
texts.Route109_Text_AustinaIntro:
I can't swim without my inner tube,
but I won't lose at POKéMON!
texts.Route109_Text_AustinaDefeated:
Did I lose because I have an inner
tube?
texts.Route109_Text_AustinaPostBattle:
My inner tube is a fashion item.
I can't be seen without it.
texts.Route109_Text_GwenIntro:
Hi, big TRAINER.
Will you battle with me?
texts.Route109_Text_GwenPostBattle: How did you get to be so strong?
texts.Route109_Text_CarterIntro:
Wahahah! This dude's going to catch
himself a big one!
texts.Route109_Text_CarterPostBattle:
This dude thinks you're a big one.
No, you're a big-one-to-be!
texts.Route109_Text_PaulIntro:
PAUL: Well, this is a mood-breaker.

I wish you wouldn't disturb our
precious time together.
texts.Route109_Text_PaulPostBattle:
PAUL: Well, don't tell anyone that
we're here.

This is just our private world of two!
texts.Route109_Text_PaulNotEnoughPokemon:
PAUL: We're totally, deeply in love.
That's why we make our POKéMON battle

together.
texts.Route109_Text_MelIntro:
MEL: We're, like, totally in love.
Our romance is heating up all of HOENN!
texts.Route109_Text_MelDefeated:
MEL: We lost, and it's my fault!
PAUL will hate me!
texts.Route109_Text_MelPostBattle:
MEL: Um, PAUL, are you angry with me?
Please don't be angry.
texts.Route109_Text_MelNotEnoughPokemon:
MEL: We're, like, deeply and truly in love.
That's why we make our POKéMON

battle together.
texts.Route109_Text_ChandlerIntro:
Tadaah! See?
My inner tube's round!
texts.Route109_Text_ChandlerPostBattle:
After I showed you my round inner
tube, too…
texts.Route109_Text_HaileyIntro:
I can't swim, so I'm pretending
to swim.
texts.Route109_Text_HaileyDefeated:
I thought so!
I didn't think we could win.
texts.Route109_Text_HaileyPostBattle:
When I learn how to swim, I think
my POKéMON will become tougher.
texts.Route109_Text_ElijahIntro:
For a guy as macho as me, this kind
of POKéMON is the perfect match!
texts.Route109_Text_ElijahDefeated: I'm cool even in defeat, hey?
texts.Route109_Text_ElijahPostBattle:
For a guy as macho as me, a port
is the perfect setting!

I guess I'll head for SLATEPORT.
texts.Route110_Text_JacobIntro:
Whoa! Watch it!
I guess you're not used to BIKE racing.
texts.Route110_Text_JacobPostBattle:
Flat tires and brake problems can
cause serious injury!

Inspect your BIKE for problems!
texts.Route110_Text_AnthonyIntro:
Yo, you!
Can you keep up with my speed?
texts.Route110_Text_AnthonyPostBattle:
Speed alone won't let me win at POKéMON.
I need to reconsider this…
texts.Route110_Text_BenjaminIntro: Don't panic if your BIKE's going fast!
texts.Route110_Text_BenjaminDefeated:
I shouldn't panic during POKéMON
battles…
texts.Route110_Text_BenjaminPostBattle:
There's no need to panic or stress.
Take it easy. There's plenty of time.
texts.Route110_Text_BenjaminRegister:
I'll keep chugging on without stressing.
Give me a shout if you're up to it.
texts.Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchIntro:
Aren't you going a little too fast?
Take it easy and let's battle.
texts.Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchDefeated: I didn't panic, but I still lost…
texts.Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchPostBattle:
There's no need to panic or stress.
Take it easy. There's plenty of time.
texts.Route110_Text_AbigailIntro:
The triathlon is hard in the extreme.

You have to complete the three events
of swimming, cycling, and running.
texts.Route110_Text_AbigailPostBattle:
I'm exhausted, so I need a break.
It's important to get proper rest.
texts.Route110_Text_AbigailRegister:
You know, I like you!
Let's have a rematch on CYCLING ROAD.
texts.Route110_Text_AbigailRematchIntro:
Isn't it neat to hold a battle while
cycling?
texts.Route110_Text_AbigailRematchDefeated:
Wow…
How could you be so strong?
texts.Route110_Text_AbigailRematchPostBattle:
Were you going after a record?

I'm sorry if I held you up!
texts.Route110_Text_JasmineIntro:
I've been riding without stopping.
My thighs are like rocks!
texts.Route110_Text_JasminePostBattle:
Oh, you have some GYM BADGES?
No wonder you're so strong!
texts.Route110_Text_EdwardIntro:
I have foreseen your intentions!
I cannot possibly lose!
texts.Route110_Text_EdwardDefeated: I failed to prophesize my own demise!
texts.Route110_Text_EdwardPostBattle:
I see your future…

Hmm…
I see a shining light…
texts.Route110_Text_JaclynIntro:
Ahahahaha!
I'll dazzle you with my wonders!
texts.Route110_Text_JaclynPostBattle:
You managed to win only because it was
a wonder! Yes, a wonder!

Don't think you can win all the time!
texts.Route110_Text_EdwinIntro:
Could I see your POKéMON?
Just one look, please?
texts.Route110_Text_EdwinDefeated:
I wanted to complete
my collection…
texts.Route110_Text_EdwinPostBattle:
When I see a POKéMON that I don't know,
my passion as a collector is ignited!
texts.Route110_Text_EdwinRegister:
I like collecting MATCH CALL
registrations, too…
texts.Route110_Text_EdwinRematchIntro:
Hi, have you caught any new POKéMON?

Could I see your POKéMON?
Just one look, please?
texts.Route110_Text_EdwinRematchPostBattle:
Oh, I long to make all rare POKéMON
mine!
texts.Route110_Text_DaleIntro:
Hey!
Don't sneak up behind me like that!
texts.Route110_Text_DalePostBattle:
Fishing is all about concentration.
You have to focus on the floater.
texts.Route110_Text_IsabelIntro:
Ahahaha! I would go anywhere to show
off my delightful POKéMON.
texts.Route110_Text_IsabelPostBattle:
Rather than battling, perhaps I should
show off my POKéMON at the FAN CLUB.
texts.Route110_Text_IsabelRegister:
That wasn't close to what I could
do to show off my POKéMON.

I'll have you as my captive audience
as often as possible!
texts.Route110_Text_IsabelRematchIntro:
Ahahahaha! I would be happy to show
off my POKéMON as often as you like!
texts.Route110_Text_IsabelRematchPostBattle:
I don't think that I could ever stop
from showing off my POKéMON.

But I like to battle, too!
texts.Route110_Text_TimmyIntro:
I found some cool POKéMON in the grass
around here!
texts.Route110_Text_TimmyDefeated: Being cool isn't enough to win…
texts.Route110_Text_TimmyPostBattle:
It's hard to battle with POKéMON you
just caught.
texts.Route110_Text_AlyssaIntro:
I fell off CYCLING ROAD…

I'll get over my embarrassment by
battling with you!
texts.Route110_Text_AlyssaPostBattle:
Falling… Losing…
This is so humiliating for me!
texts.Route110_Text_JosephIntro:
Okay! Full-throttle time! If you can't
groove, you get left behind!
texts.Route110_Text_JosephDefeated: You got into the groove all right…
texts.Route110_Text_JosephPostBattle:
This isn't going to bring me down!
Losing has made me a better man!
texts.Route110_Text_KalebIntro:
When cute POKéMON help each other…
You won't see a more adorable sight!
texts.Route110_Text_KalebDefeated: Have you no compassion or pity?
texts.Route110_Text_KalebPostBattle:
Okay, okay, you've done the best you
could, my pretties.
texts.Route111_Text_DrewIntro:
Oh, hey! Those GO-GOGGLES suit you.
But I think they look better on me.

Let's decide who they look better on
with a battle!
texts.Route111_Text_DrewDefeat:
I couldn't see what was happening at
my sides because of the GO-GOGGLES.
texts.Route111_Text_DrewPostBattle:
The GO-GOGGLES make it possible to
get through sandstorms.

That makes me happy!
texts.Route111_Text_HeidiIntro:
I'm having a picnic in the desert.

You can always find a TRAINER,
so I can enjoy a battle here, too!
texts.Route111_Text_HeidiPostBattle:
When you're battling in a sandstorm,
watch out for your POKéMON's HP.

It can faint if you don't keep
an eye on it!
texts.Route111_Text_BeauIntro:
Wearing these GO-GOGGLES makes me
feel like a superhero.

Right now, nobody can beat me!
texts.Route111_Text_BeauDefeat: I can't win on spirit alone…
texts.Route111_Text_BeauPostBattle:
I'm going to be a real hero one day.
I'm going to work harder to make me

and my POKéMON stronger.
texts.Route111_Text_BeckyIntro:
I heard there are fossils to be found
in the desert. Where could they be?
texts.Route111_Text_BeckyPostBattle:
If they can find fossils in the desert,
it must have been a sea before.
texts.Route111_Text_DustyIntro:
For thirty years I have searched for
ancient ruins!

I am to be challenged?
texts.Route111_Text_DustyDefeat:
While I have searched for ruins,
I've not searched for strong POKéMON.
texts.Route111_Text_DustyPostBattle:
For thirty years I have searched for
ancient ruins!

No, wait, was that forty years?
Which was it now?
texts.Route111_Text_DustyRegister:
I haven't been searching for any
tough POKéMON.

But, for some reason, I sure do like
POKéNAVS.
texts.Route111_Text_DustyRematchIntro:
For thirty years I have searched for
ancient ruins!

No, wait, was that forty years?
Anyway, am I to be challenged?
texts.Route111_Text_DustyRematchDefeat:
I've found no ruins, nor have I found
any strong POKéMON…
texts.Route111_Text_DustyPostRematch:
For thirty years I have searched for
ancient ruins!

No, wait, was that forty years
I've searched?

Hmm… It could even be fifty…
How long have I been at this?
texts.Route111_Text_TravisIntro:
I'm full of pep!
And my POKéMON is peppy, too!
texts.Route111_Text_TravisPostBattle:
When I see a TRAINER with a lot of pep,
I can't help looking.
texts.Route111_Text_IreneIntro:
I don't know where you're going,
but would you like to battle?
texts.Route111_Text_IrenePostBattle:
I'm thinking that I should go to
MT. CHIMNEY, but the view around

here is very nice, too.
texts.Route111_Text_DaisukeIntro:
To train myself, I challenge all
whom I meet!
texts.Route111_Text_DaisukePostBattle:
All I can do is keep training until
I can defeat strong TRAINERS such

as yourself.
texts.Route111_Text_WiltonIntro:
Show me how much you've toughened
your POKéMON.
texts.Route111_Text_WiltonDefeat:
I see, you've toughened them
considerably.
texts.Route111_Text_WiltonPostBattle:
POKéMON and TRAINERS learn much
through battling.

What's important is to never give up
even if you lose.
texts.Route111_Text_WiltonRegister:
There is much to be learned from
your training style.

I request a rematch if it
behooves you.
texts.Route111_Text_WiltonRematchIntro:
We're training here to elevate our
game to the next level.

Stay and train with us!
texts.Route111_Text_WiltonPostRematch:
Since you're that strong, you should
aim for the POKéMON LEAGUE.
texts.Route111_Text_BrookeIntro:
Oh, your POKéMON look like serious
actors.

I have to ask you for an engagement.
texts.Route111_Text_BrookeDefeat:
They didn't just look strong,
they are strong!
texts.Route111_Text_BrookePostBattle:
I thought I was raising my POKéMON
diligently, but, oh no, there is still

much to be done.
texts.Route111_Text_BrookeRegister:
I wish I could become friends with
more strong people like you!
texts.Route111_Text_BrookeRematchIntro:
You can make POKéMON stronger or
weaker depending on the moves you

teach them.

What kinds of moves do your POKéMON
know?
texts.Route111_Text_BrookePostRematch:
Maybe I should have stopped my
POKéMON from evolving until they

learned better moves…
texts.Route111_Text_CeliaIntro:
I shouldn't have come to a place like
this for a picnic!
texts.Route111_Text_CeliaDefeat:
Aww!
I really shouldn't have come!
texts.Route111_Text_CeliaPostBattle:
In a sandstorm like this, I can't set
the places for a picnic even with my

GO-GOGGLES on…
texts.Route111_Text_BryanIntro:
How tough are you?
We shall expose that secret!
texts.Route111_Text_BryanDefeat:
Oh! Your strength!
It is shrouded in mystery!
texts.Route111_Text_BryanPostBattle:
This desert hoards mysteries in
its shifting sands!
texts.Route111_Text_BrandenIntro:
I'll give you some of my sandwich
if you'll lose.
texts.Route111_Text_BrandenDefeat:
Tch! I thought a sandwich would be
enough of a bribe…
texts.Route111_Text_BrandenPostBattle:
My SANDSHREW loves eating
my sandwiches.
texts.Route111_Text_TyronIntro: This is my favorite kind of POKéMON!
texts.Route111_Text_TyronDefeat:
Wait!
Did you get a good look at my POKéMON?
texts.Route111_Text_TyronPostBattle:
When having a battle, I get a kick out
of showing off my POKéMON.

I bet everyone feels that way when
they enter a battle!
texts.Route111_Text_CelinaIntro:
Show me how to put a little excitement
into my life.
texts.Route111_Text_CelinaDefeat:
Oh… My…
That was too much excitement.
texts.Route111_Text_CelinaPostBattle:
My pulse is still racing.
You're one fabulous TRAINER.
texts.Route111_Text_HaydenIntro:
When you're as famished as I am,
there is no room for pity!
texts.Route111_Text_HaydenPostBattle:
My stomach is grumbling!
Maybe I can grill some BERRIES…
texts.Route111_Text_BiancaIntro:
Did you come from MAUVILLE?
Then you should be full of energy!
texts.Route111_Text_BiancaDefeat:
Ooh lala!
That's a lot to take!
texts.Route111_Text_BiancaPostBattle:
This road here…
You have quite a ways to travel.
texts.Route112_Text_BriceIntro:
Hahahaha!
How about we have a battle?

You and me!

Hahahaha!
texts.Route112_Text_BricePostBattle:
Hahahahaha! Something flew up my nose!
Hahahaha-hatchoo!
texts.Route112_Text_TrentIntro:
My legs are solid from pounding up
and down the mountains.

They're not going to buckle easily,
friend!
texts.Route112_Text_TrentPostBattle:
Try hiking, and I mean really
pounding, on these mountain trails

with a heavy pack weighing dozens of

pounds.

That, my friend, will get your body
into serious shape.
texts.Route112_Text_TrentRegister:
Ow, my legs have cramped up.
Can you grab me some bandages from

my backpack?

No, that's my POKéNAV!
Oh, fine, I'll register you.
texts.Route112_Text_TrentRematchIntro:
I've been keeping fit by hiking.
Power, I have in spades!
texts.Route112_Text_TrentRematchPostBattle:
I hear there are some seriously tough
TRAINERS on top of MT. CHIMNEY.

I intend to get up there and give them
a challenge!
texts.Route112_Text_LarryIntro:
I'm strong.
I won't cry if I lose.
texts.Route112_Text_LarryPostBattle:
I'm not crying because I miss my mommy!
Snivel…
texts.Route112_Text_CarolIntro:
When you're out on a picnic, why,
you simply have to sing!

Come on, sing with me!
texts.Route112_Text_CarolPostBattle:
It doesn't matter if you're good or bad
at singing or POKéMON.

If you have the most fun, you win!
texts.Route112_Text_BryantIntro:
I caught hot POKéMON in FIERY PATH!
Take a look!
texts.Route112_Text_BryantDefeat: What a bumpy ride that was!
texts.Route112_Text_BryantPostBattle:
I like the way you battle.
It has a certain flair to it.
texts.Route112_Text_ShaylaIntro:
Oh, aren't you an adorable TRAINER!
Please, I need a romantic battle!

I'm somewhat decent!
texts.Route112_Text_ShaylaDefeat:
Oh, how strong you are!
You've given me quite a shock!
texts.Route112_Text_ShaylaPostBattle:
Are you busy right now?
I was thinking that maybe we can have

a rematch right now…

But it's all right if you're busy.
texts.Route113_Text_JaylenIntro:
Can you guess why it's so cool
around here?
texts.Route113_Text_JaylenPostBattle:
The volcanic ash blocks the sun,
so it doesn't get very warm.

That's good for me--I can't stand heat!
texts.Route113_Text_DillonIntro:
The volcano's eruption is proof that
the earth is alive.
texts.Route113_Text_DillonPostBattle:
Ouch! Owww! I can't see!
I got ashes in my eyelashes!

Get it? Ashes and eyelashes?

Okay, that was bad, sorry…
texts.Route113_Text_MadelineIntro:
I use this parasol to ward off this
filthy, yucky volcanic ash from

my dear NUMEL.
texts.Route113_Text_MadelinePostBattle:
You're very good at this.
I must say I'm impressed!
texts.Route113_Text_MadelineRegister:
Here, slide under my parasol.
Let me register you in my POKéNAV.
texts.Route113_Text_MadelineRematchIntro:
Oh, hello, hasn't it been a while?
May I invite you to battle?
texts.Route113_Text_MadelinePostRematch:
You've remained very good at this.
I must say I'm impressed!
texts.Route113_Text_LaoIntro:
From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah!
I challenge thee!
texts.Route113_Text_LaoPostBattle:
I must refine the art of concealment.
I bid thee farewell.
texts.Route113_Text_LaoRegister:
Yiiyaah! Witness the ancient ninja
technique of POKéNAV registration!
texts.Route113_Text_LaoRematchIntro:
From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah!
I challenge thee!
texts.Route113_Text_LaoPostRematch:
My flawless concealment was let down
by my immature battle skills…

I bid thee farewell.
texts.Route113_Text_LungIntro:
Thanks for finding me!
But we still have to battle!
texts.Route113_Text_LungDefeat:
I'll use my ninjutsu on you…
“VOLCANIC ASH SWIRL CLOAK”!

…What?
It's already over?
texts.Route113_Text_LungPostBattle:
You know what's crummy about hiding?
It's lonely if no one comes along.
texts.Route113_Text_ToriIntro:
TORI: Both of us, we collect ashes.
We battle POKéMON, too.
texts.Route113_Text_ToriDefeat:
TORI: We lost… It's boring, so I'm going
to get some more ashes.
texts.Route113_Text_ToriPostBattle:
TORI: How much ash do we have?
Enough for a WHITE FLUTE, I hope.
texts.Route113_Text_ToriNotEnoughMons:
TORI: We want to battle 2-on-2.
If we didn't, we would lose!
texts.Route113_Text_TiaIntro:
TIA: Both of us, we collect ashes.
We battle POKéMON, too.
texts.Route113_Text_TiaDefeat:
TIA: We couldn't win… It's boring,
so I'm getting some more ashes.
texts.Route113_Text_TiaPostBattle:
TIA: We have a lot of ashes!
I think enough for a WHITE FLUTE!
texts.Route113_Text_TiaNotEnoughMons:
TIA: We want to battle 2-on-2.
If we don't, we won't win!
texts.Route113_Text_CobyIntro:
Pfft, with these wings I can
flick you away!
texts.Route113_Text_CobyPostBattle:
I don't know what to say when I get
beaten so easily…
texts.Route113_Text_SophieIntro:
The warmth here is making me drowsy.
Battle with me so I can stay awake.
texts.Route113_Text_SophieDefeat:
This is a dream.
I'm sure of it…
texts.Route113_Text_SophiePostBattle:
Losing burns me up…
I'm just going to sleep right here!

Zzz!
texts.Route113_Text_LawrenceIntro:
Were you maybe in the middle
of gathering volcanic ashes?
texts.Route113_Text_LawrencePostBattle: I ought to hide under the ashes, too.
texts.Route113_Text_WyattIntro:
Y-you want to battle with me?
Even though I just caught my POKéMON?
texts.Route113_Text_WyattDefeat:
Y-you're all happy to win?
Even though it's only me?
texts.Route113_Text_WyattPostBattle:
Oh, so now you want to say a word to
the loser?

Aren't you just the coolest?
Humph!
texts.Route114_Text_LennyIntro:
Yodelayhihoo!

… …

You're supposed to shout
“yodelayhihoo” since it doesn't

echo here!
texts.Route114_Text_LennyPostBattle:
When I was a wee tyke, I believed there
was someone copying me and shouting

back, “Yodelayhihoo.”
texts.Route114_Text_LucasIntro:
If you're not prepared, you shouldn't
be up in the mountains!
texts.Route114_Text_LucasPostBattle:
In the winter, mountains turn deadly
with blizzards and avalanches.
texts.Route114_Text_ShaneIntro:
Camping's fun! You can fish, roast
marshmallows, and tell spooky stories!

But the best of all are the POKéMON
battles!
texts.Route114_Text_ShanePostBattle:
I think it's great that I can go
camping with my POKéMON.
texts.Route114_Text_NancyIntro:
I need to exercise after a meal.
Let's have a match!
texts.Route114_Text_NancyPostBattle:
I just had a tasty meal.
I'm getting drowsy…
texts.Route114_Text_SteveIntro:
Ufufufufufu…
Want to battle against my POKéMON?
texts.Route114_Text_StevePostBattle:
A big body that's all lumpy and hard,
enormous horns, and vicious fangs…

Ufufufufu…
I wish I had a POKéMON like that…
texts.Route114_Text_SteveRegister:
Don't forget what you've done to me!
I'll make it so you can't forget!
texts.Route114_Text_SteveRematchIntro:
Ufufufufufu…
Come on, battle my POKéMON…
texts.Route114_Text_SteveRematchDefeat:
I feel so lucky getting to see your
POKéMON…
texts.Route114_Text_StevePostRematch:
Ufufufufufu…

When I see POKéMON battling, I get all
shivery and shaky…
texts.Route114_Text_BernieIntro:
If you're lighting a campfire,
make sure you have water handy.
texts.Route114_Text_BerniePostBattle:
You really do have to be careful with
any sort of fire in a forest.

Don't ever underestimate the power
of fire.
texts.Route114_Text_BernieRegister:
You set my spirit on fire.
Let's register each other!
texts.Route114_Text_BernieRematchIntro:
Have you learned to keep water handy
for campfires?
texts.Route114_Text_BernieRematchDefeat:
I got hosed down before I could
flare up, I guess.
texts.Route114_Text_BerniePostRematch:
You really do have to be careful with
any sort of fire in a forest.

Don't ever underestimate the power
of fire.
texts.Route114_Text_ClaudeIntro:
If we were fishing, you wouldn't stand
a chance against me.

So, bring on your POKéMON!
texts.Route114_Text_ClaudeDefeat: If we were fishing, I would've won…
texts.Route114_Text_ClaudePostBattle:
I think I'll try my luck at landing
a big one at METEOR FALLS.

There has to be something in there.
I just know it.
texts.Route114_Text_NolanIntro:
I like to fish. But I also like to
battle!

If anyone challenges me, I'm there,
even if I'm fishing.
texts.Route114_Text_NolanDefeat:
I like to battle, but that doesn't
mean I'm good at it…
texts.Route114_Text_NolanPostBattle:
This time I'll do it!

I always think that, so I can't walk
away from fishing or POKéMON.
texts.Route114_Text_TyraIntro:
TYRA: Well, sure.
I'm in the mood for it.

I'll teach you a little about POKéMON.
texts.Route114_Text_TyraDefeat: TYRA: What an amazing battle style!
texts.Route114_Text_TyraPostBattle:
TYRA: I was teaching my junior IVY
about POKéMON.
texts.Route114_Text_TyraNotEnoughMons:
TYRA: Giggle…
If you want to battle with us, just one

POKéMON isn't enough!
texts.Route114_Text_IvyIntro: IVY: Who taught you about POKéMON?
texts.Route114_Text_IvyDefeat: IVY: What an amazing battle style!
texts.Route114_Text_IvyPostBattle:
IVY: I started training POKéMON
because TYRA, my student mentor,

taught me!
texts.Route114_Text_IvyNotEnoughMons:
IVY: Do you only have one POKéMON?
I think it must feel lonesome.
texts.Route114_Text_KaiIntro:
I landed a big one!
A huge one, I tell you!
texts.Route114_Text_KaiDefeat:
What was that about?
Did mine lose in size?
texts.Route114_Text_KaiPostBattle:
Okay!
I'll just fish me a bigger one!
texts.Route114_Text_CharlotteIntro:
Me!
I'm not just a pretty face!
texts.Route114_Text_CharlotteDefeat: That wasn't cute in the least!
texts.Route114_Text_CharlottePostBattle:
I don't want a POKéMON that's
just cute.

I adore cute ones that have a quirk
or two!
texts.Route114_Text_AngelinaIntro:
Have you made your POKéMON evolve
very much?
texts.Route114_Text_AngelinaDefeat:
Oh, I see.
That's good to know.
texts.Route114_Text_AngelinaPostBattle:
Some POKéMON change so much when
they evolve, it's startling!
texts.Route115_Text_TimothyIntro:
Hm…
You seem rather capable…

Let me keep you company!
texts.Route115_Text_TimothyDefeat:
You're much stronger than
I'd imagined!
texts.Route115_Text_TimothyPostBattle:
There is no such thing as a born genius.
It all depends on effort!

That is what I believe…
texts.Route115_Text_TimothyRegister:
Hmm… A loss this thorough has been
a distant memory.

If you would allow it, I wish for
another opportunity to do battle.
texts.Route115_Text_TimothyRematchIntro:
Hm… As always, your agility speaks
for itself.

Come, keep me company!
texts.Route115_Text_TimothyPostRematch:
All it takes is effort!

I lost because I haven't put in enough
effort!
texts.Route115_Text_KoichiIntro:
You!

My MACHOP!

Demand a battle!
texts.Route115_Text_KoichiPostBattle:
My MACHOP crew!

So long as they seek power, I will
grow strong with them!
texts.Route115_Text_NobIntro:
My strongest skill is busting bricks
with my forehead!
texts.Route115_Text_NobPostBattle:
I've been teaching my POKéMON karate.

It looks like they'll get a lot better
than me. I'm excited about that.
texts.Route115_Text_NobRegister:
You impress me! Give me a rematch
after I redo my training!
texts.Route115_Text_NobRematchIntro:
After you beat me, we trained hard to
improve our skills.

Come on, give us a rematch!
texts.Route115_Text_NobPostRematch:
My POKéMON will grow stronger!
I'll redouble my training!
texts.Route115_Text_CyndyIntro:
This beach is my secret training spot!
Don't come butting in!
texts.Route115_Text_CyndyPostBattle:
The sand acts as a cushion to reduce
impact and prevent injury.

This is the perfect place to train.
texts.Route115_Text_CyndyRegister:
Okay, fine, you're free to come here.
In return, I'd like to battle you again.
texts.Route115_Text_CyndyRematchIntro: Okay, let's get this battle on!
texts.Route115_Text_CyndyRematchDefeat: I can battle but my POKéMON…
texts.Route115_Text_CyndyPostRematch:
Even when I lose, I still get some
enjoyment out of it.

It must be that I love POKéMON.
texts.Route115_Text_HectorIntro:
I have a rare POKéMON!
Would you like me to show you?
texts.Route115_Text_HectorDefeat:
You…
You want my POKéMON, don't you?
texts.Route115_Text_HectorPostBattle:
I have this rare POKéMON.
It's enough to keep me satisfied.
texts.Route115_Text_KyraIntro:
I'll battle while I'm running!
Try to keep up with me!
texts.Route115_Text_KyraPostBattle:
I made the mistake of trying to battle
while running!

I should take a run to calm down…
texts.Route115_Text_JaidenIntro:
Take that!
Ultra POKéMON ninja attack!
texts.Route115_Text_JaidenPostBattle:
But my POKéMON were ultra,
weren't they?
texts.Route115_Text_HeleneIntro:
My POKéMON have black belt-level
strength!
texts.Route115_Text_HelenePostBattle:
I rarely meet anyone who's better
than me…

I get it now!
You're a GYM LEADER, aren't you?
texts.Route115_Text_AlixIntro:
Our eyes met!
There's no getting away now!
texts.Route115_Text_AlixPostBattle:
Oh, well.
I think I will TELEPORT home.
texts.Route115_Text_MarleneIntro:
You've disturbed my meditation…
You'll be punished for it.
texts.Route115_Text_MarlenePostBattle:
I was meditating with my POKéMON.
But this place isn't very peaceful…
texts.Route116_Text_ClarkIntro:
If the tunnel doesn't go through, then
I'll just go over the top.
texts.Route116_Text_ClarkDefeat:
Gasp… Gasp…
Losing made me tired…
texts.Route116_Text_ClarkPostBattle:
It's no big deal if there's no tunnel.
To a HIKER, mountains are roads!
texts.Route116_Text_JoeyIntro:
My POKéMON rule!
Check them out!
texts.Route116_Text_JoeyDefeat:
Ouch! A scrape!
I have to put on a bandage!
texts.Route116_Text_JoeyPostBattle:
Bandages are signs of toughness!
I've got another one!
texts.Route116_Text_JoseIntro:
My BUG POKéMON are tough!
Let's battle!
texts.Route116_Text_JoseDefeat:
I lost!
I thought I had you!
texts.Route116_Text_JosePostBattle:
BUG POKéMON evolve quickly.
So they get strong quickly, too.
texts.Route116_Text_JaniceIntro:
Let me teach you how strong my
adorable POKéMON is!
texts.Route116_Text_JanicePostBattle:
POKéMON that possess cuteness and
power, that's ideal, I think.
texts.Route116_Text_JerryIntro:
We learn all sorts of things at the
TRAINER'S SCHOOL.

I want to test things out for real!
texts.Route116_Text_JerryDefeat:
I slacked off in school…
That's why I lost.
texts.Route116_Text_JerryPostBattle:
I'll have to redo some courses at
the TRAINER'S SCHOOL.

If I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.
texts.Route116_Text_JerryRegister1:
I learned at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL
that a POKéNAV can register TRAINERS.

I don't really get what that means,
so can I just try it?
texts.Route116_Text_JerryRegister2:
I learned at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL
that a POKéNAV can register TRAINERS.

I don't really get what that means,
so can I just try it?
texts.Route116_Text_JerryRematchIntro:
I've been studying seriously at the
TRAINER'S SCHOOL.

I won't lose like I did last time.
texts.Route116_Text_JerryPostRematch:
I'll have to redo some courses at
the TRAINER'S SCHOOL.

If I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.
texts.Route116_Text_KarenIntro:
I study at school, and I study on
the way home, too!
texts.Route116_Text_KarenPostBattle:
Awww, I'll never become an elegant
TRAINER like ROXANNE this way!
texts.Route116_Text_KarenRegister1:
Oh, wow! Isn't that a POKéNAV?
I have one, too! Please register me!
texts.Route116_Text_KarenRegister2:
Oh, wow! Isn't that a POKéNAV?
I have one, too! Please register me!
texts.Route116_Text_KarenRematchIntro:
I studied a whole lot since I saw you.
You must see my achievements!
texts.Route116_Text_KarenRematchDefeat:
I'm in shock.
I lost again?
texts.Route116_Text_KarenPostRematch:
You've beaten ROXANNE?
I can't beat you, then. Not yet.
texts.Route116_Text_SarahIntro:
Just so you know, I've never once been
bested by anyone at anything.
texts.Route116_Text_SarahDefeat:
Oh, my goodness.
This is a new experience for me.
texts.Route116_Text_SarahPostBattle:
My life of luxury affords me all that
I could possibly desire.

However, when it comes to POKéMON,
my wealth has no meaning.
texts.Route116_Text_DawsonIntro:
When you lay your eyes on my POKéMON's
gorgeous fur, their beauty will render

you helpless!
texts.Route116_Text_DawsonDefeat: Oh, baby, say it isn't so!
texts.Route116_Text_DawsonPostBattle:
Oh, no, no, no!
You've mussed up my POKéMON's fur!

You've ruined my hairdo, too!

I'll have to call my stylist now!
texts.Route116_Text_DevanPostBattle:
I should try different POKéMON
types, that's what I ought to do.
texts.Route116_Text_JohnsonIntro:
It's a dead end up here.
I'm bored, so can we battle?
texts.Route116_Text_JohnsonDefeat: That was fun even though I lost.
texts.Route116_Text_JohnsonPostBattle:
Want to stay here and keep
me company?
texts.Route117_Text_IsaacIntro:
Listen, could I get you to battle
the POKéMON I'm raising?
texts.Route117_Text_IsaacPostBattle:
POKéMON isn't all about power.

Polishing a unique aspect of one's
character is another way of enjoying

POKéMON.
texts.Route117_Text_IsaacRegister:
I'm going to redouble my training.
Would you come look in on us?
texts.Route117_Text_IsaacRematchIntro:
The POKéMON I've been raising are
looking good, just like before.
texts.Route117_Text_IsaacRematchDefeat:
You know how to raise them properly.
You might have DAY CARE skills…
texts.Route117_Text_IsaacPostRematch:
Your POKéMON are growing good!
You should enter them in CONTESTS.
texts.Route117_Text_LydiaIntro:
Please, allow me to evaluate if you
have raised your POKéMON properly.
texts.Route117_Text_LydiaPostBattle:
Try raising POKéMON with more
attention to their character traits.
texts.Route117_Text_LydiaRegister:
I'm glad I met a superb TRAINER in you.
I hope to see you again.
texts.Route117_Text_LydiaRematchIntro:
Allow me to reevaluate if you have
raised your POKéMON properly.
texts.Route117_Text_LydiaPostRematch:
POKéMON seem to like different kinds
of {POKEBLOCK}S, depending on their nature.
texts.Route117_Text_DylanIntro:
I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but,
whatever, let's have a battle!
texts.Route117_Text_DylanPostBattle:
I may have blown it…

I might have dropped to last during
that battle…
texts.Route117_Text_DylanRegister:
POKéMON have to be strong, too?
I'd like you to train me!
texts.Route117_Text_DylanRematchIntro:
I'm smack in the middle of a triathlon,
but I'm comfortably ahead.

Let's make this a quick battle!
texts.Route117_Text_DylanRematchDefeat: I ran out of energy again!
texts.Route117_Text_DylanPostRematch:
I was tops in swimming and cycling,
but I'm not quite that confident with

POKéMON yet.
texts.Route117_Text_MariaIntro:
I do my triathlon training with POKéMON,
so I'm pretty confident about my speed.
texts.Route117_Text_MariaDefeat:
I need to get more practices in,
I guess.
texts.Route117_Text_MariaPostBattle:
Training is meaningful only if you
keep it up regularly.

Okay! I'll resume my training!
Tomorrow!
texts.Route117_Text_MariaRegister:
You appear to be training properly…
If you'd like, I'll battle you later!
texts.Route117_Text_MariaRematchIntro:
Are you keeping up with your training?
I sure am!

Let me show you the evidence!
texts.Route117_Text_MariaRematchDefeat:
I need to get more practices in,
I guess.
texts.Route117_Text_MariaPostRematch:
I'll resume training tomorrow.
Let's battle again sometime!
texts.Route117_Text_DerekIntro:
Once a BUG CATCHER!
And now a BUG MANIAC!

But my love for POKéMON remains
unchanged!
texts.Route117_Text_DerekPostBattle:
All I did was follow my heart, and now
they call me a BUG MANIAC…

Still, I am an expert on BUG POKéMON,
so it's only natural that they call me

a BUG MANIAC.
texts.Route117_Text_AnnaIntro:
ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student
partner. I have to do good!
texts.Route117_Text_AnnaDefeat:
ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student
partner! Let me win!
texts.Route117_Text_AnnaPostBattle:
ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good
combinations.

I'd say you're second only to us!
texts.Route117_Text_AnnaAndMegRegister:
ANNA: We can't take this lying down!
You will come back, won't you?
texts.Route117_Text_AnnaNotEnoughMons:
ANNA: If you want to battle us,
bring two POKéMON with you.
texts.Route117_Text_MegIntro:
MEG: I'm going to tag up with my super
senior student partner and beat you!
texts.Route117_Text_MegDefeat:
MEG: Oh, no!
I'm sorry, ANNA! I let you down…
texts.Route117_Text_MegPostBattle:
MEG: I dragged ANNA down…
If I didn't, she would have won!
texts.Route117_Text_MegNotEnoughMons:
MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON?
We can't battle with you, then.

We want to have a 2-on-2 battle.
texts.Route117_Text_AnnaRematchIntro:
ANNA: I can't keep losing in front of
my junior partner, right?
texts.Route117_Text_AnnaRematchDefeat: ANNA: I couldn't get into the groove.
texts.Route117_Text_AnnaPostRematch:
ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good
combinations.

I'd say you're second only to us!
texts.Route117_Text_AnnaRematchNotEnoughMons:
ANNA: If you want to battle us,
bring two POKéMON with you.
texts.Route117_Text_MegRematchIntro:
MEG: I'm going to tag up with my
senior partner and win this time!
texts.Route117_Text_MegPostRematch:
MEG: I battled together with my
senior partner, but we lost…

That's so discouraging…
texts.Route117_Text_MegRematchNotEnoughMons:
MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON?
We can't battle with you, then.

We want to have a 2-on-2 battle.
texts.Route117_Text_MelinaIntro:
Isn't it nice? To battle while looking
at pretty flowers?
texts.Route117_Text_MelinaPostBattle:
It feels wonderful to go for a jog
while looking at flowers.
texts.Route117_Text_BrandiIntro:
Let me demonstrate the power
hidden within a PSYCHIC POKéMON!
texts.Route117_Text_BrandiPostBattle:
PSYCHIC POKéMON are complex.
You should try catching some.
texts.Route117_Text_AishaIntro:
Concentrate on getting the win.
That's how I battle!
texts.Route117_Text_AishaDefeat:
I don't waste any time being angry
over a loss--I would rather train.
texts.Route117_Text_AishaPostBattle:
I think that if you worry about losing,
you're more likely to lose.
texts.Route118_Text_RoseIntro:
The aroma of flowers has a magical
power. It cleanses us body and soul.
texts.Route118_Text_RoseDefeat:
Oh, dear me.
I seem to have lost.
texts.Route118_Text_RosePostBattle:
Flowers, POKéMON…
I love whatever smells nice.

Stinky things…
I'll pass.
texts.Route118_Text_RoseRegister:
Sniff… That odor--it's a POKéNAV!
We must register each other!
texts.Route118_Text_RoseRematchIntro:
Were you drawn here by the sweet
aroma?
texts.Route118_Text_RoseRematchDefeat:
The power of aroma…
It didn't seem to do much.
texts.Route118_Text_RosePostRematch:
If you use a sweet aroma properly,
POKéMON will be attracted by it.
texts.Route118_Text_PerryIntro:
BIRD POKéMON that FLY elegantly in
the sky… They're the best!
texts.Route118_Text_PerryPostBattle:
You've got great POKéMON.
I'll have to train mine better.
texts.Route118_Text_ChesterPostBattle:
If they'd get stronger, they'd be able
to fly more freely…
texts.Route118_Text_BarnyIntro:
I'm a FISHERMAN, but also a TRAINER.
I'm raising the POKéMON I caught.
texts.Route118_Text_BarnyDefeat:
I thought I was doing okay in my
training…
texts.Route118_Text_BarnyPostBattle:
I couldn't win by training POKéMON
while I fished…

Was I doing things in half measures?
texts.Route118_Text_WadeIntro:
For FISHERMEN, equipment is the key.

But for TRAINERS, the key ingredients
are POKéMON and heart, of course!
texts.Route118_Text_WadePostBattle:
Come to think of it, fishing is a battle
between a FISHERMAN and a POKéMON.
texts.Route118_Text_DaltonIntro: Let my melody rock your soul!
texts.Route118_Text_DaltonPostBattle:
An electric guitar doesn't always
have to be noisy…

It can be strummed to squeeze out
this heart-stirring melody…
texts.Route118_Text_DaltonRegister:
When I compose better melodies,
you have to come listen, okay?
texts.Route118_Text_DaltonRematchIntro:
A melody from my POKéMON and me…
Let us deliver it to your soul.
texts.Route118_Text_DaltonPostRematch:
When I play, my emotions should reach
you through my electric guitar…
texts.Route118_Text_DeandreDefeat:
Come in, POKéMON! Are you okay?
POKéMON 1, 2, and 3?!
texts.Route118_Text_DeandrePostBattle:
Isn't it cool that I have a POKéMON
battle team?

You can copy me--I don't mind!
texts.Route119_Text_BrentIntro:
We're the MIMIC CIRCLE!
We MIMIC what you do!
texts.Route119_Text_BrentPostBattle:
What's so good about mimicry?

Fufufu…
You'll never understand…
texts.Route119_Text_DonaldIntro:
So, we finally meet!
My BUG POKéMON will keep you company!
texts.Route119_Text_DonaldPostBattle:
I want to MIMIC you some more.
Can you hurry up and move?
texts.Route119_Text_TaylorIntro:
If you step forward, we step forward.

If you turn right, we turn, too…
texts.Route119_Text_TaylorDefeat: But if you win, I lose…
texts.Route119_Text_TaylorPostBattle:
I can't MIMIC you winning the match.
That's just impossible…

It's burning me up…
texts.Route119_Text_DougIntro:
Yep, you've finally caught me!
Or were you trying to avoid me?
texts.Route119_Text_DougDefeat: Whoop, that was a great match!
texts.Route119_Text_DougPostBattle:
We're the MIMIC CIRCLE!
I hope you enjoyed our performance.
texts.Route119_Text_GregIntro:
You don't know who I am, do you?

But, I also don't know you.
So, we'll battle!
texts.Route119_Text_GregPostBattle:
Until you go away somewhere, we'll
keep on mimicking your every move.
texts.Route119_Text_KentIntro:
The MIMIC CIRCLE was formed by people
who like to MIMIC.

A battle starts the instant we meet!
texts.Route119_Text_KentPostBattle: Won't you join our MIMIC CIRCLE?
texts.Route119_Text_JacksonIntro:
Who has the knowledge and
the technique for survival?

POKéMON RANGERS, that's who!
texts.Route119_Text_JacksonDefeat:
I didn't have enough POKéMON
know-how…
texts.Route119_Text_JacksonPostBattle:
To break away from civilization and
awaken the wild spirit within!

That's our vision.
texts.Route119_Text_JacksonRegister:
I hope you'll give me a rematch without
mocking my lack of knowledge.
texts.Route119_Text_JacksonRematchIntro:
I'm going to regain my wild spirit by
being together with POKéMON.
texts.Route119_Text_JacksonPostRematch:
Believe in your POKéMON.
Believe in yourself.

The road will reveal itself to you.
texts.Route119_Text_CatherineIntro:
Oh? Look at you.

For someone on an adventure,
you're traveling awfully light.
texts.Route119_Text_CatherineDefeat:
Accidents happen when you're not
prepared!
texts.Route119_Text_CatherinePostBattle:
You're traveling light but you have
everything you need.

You're on top of things mentally and
physically, too.
texts.Route119_Text_CatherineRegister:
Do you have a POKéNAV?
It's a must-have tool for any TRAINER.

Oh, you do have one!
Let's register each other, then!
texts.Route119_Text_CatherineRematchIntro:
How's your journey with POKéMON
going?
texts.Route119_Text_CatherinePostRematch:
In the same way that you, as a TRAINER,
rely on your POKéMON, your POKéMON

rely on you.
texts.Route119_Text_HughIntro:
The vast sky holds untold promise!

Nothing can compare to the sheer
exhilaration of flight!
texts.Route119_Text_HughPostBattle:
My BIRD POKéMON made my dreams of
flying come true!
texts.Route119_Text_PhilIntro:
I'll show you the true potential of me
and my BIRD POKéMON!
texts.Route119_Text_PhilPostBattle:
Ever since I was a little kid, I always
admired BIRD POKéMON…
texts.Route119_Text_YasuIntro:
To lurk in shadows, and live in
darkness… That is my destiny.

I emerge to challenge you!
texts.Route119_Text_YasuPostBattle:
Those defeated in battle withdraw
quietly back into the shadows.

That, too, is destiny…
texts.Route119_Text_TakashiIntro:
If you're not on your guard,
you're in for some pain!
texts.Route119_Text_TakashiPostBattle:
My surprise attack ended in
failure…
texts.Route119_Text_HideoIntro: To hide a tree, use a forest!
texts.Route119_Text_HideoPostBattle:
To hide a tree, use a forest!
To hide a POKéMON, use a POKéMON!

There is no deep, hidden meaning
to that.
texts.Route119_Text_ChrisIntro:
You spoke to me…
So you want to challenge me!

Sure! I'll try out the POKéMON I caught
while SURFING!
texts.Route119_Text_ChrisDefeat:
I don't have a clue about what it
takes to win.
texts.Route119_Text_ChrisPostBattle:
Go for a SURF on my POKéMON…

Then fish off its back…

It's an indescribably luxuriant moment!
texts.Route119_Text_FabianIntro:
Hit me with a power chord!
Victory is mine!

It's our time to shine, whoa, yeah!
texts.Route119_Text_FabianDefeat:
You showed me who's the boss!
We'll have to take the loss, oh, no!
texts.Route119_Text_FabianPostBattle:
Hit me with another power chord!
Leave me alone!

Your win you have to atone!
texts.Route119_Text_DaytonIntro:
Hohoho!
I like kid TRAINERS!

Let's have a good one!
texts.Route119_Text_DaytonPostBattle:
Hohoho!
I'll try emulating the pep of kid

TRAINERS like you!
texts.Route119_Text_RachelIntro:
Wherever and whenever I may be,
I always have my parasol in hand.
texts.Route119_Text_RachelPostBattle:
You're asking if my parasol is heavy?
Your BAG is filled with more junk than

I ever carry around.
texts.Route120_Text_ColinIntro:
Do you have any moves that can strike
a flying POKéMON?
texts.Route120_Text_ColinPostBattle:
The move FLY is convenient,
don't you think?

While the POKéMON is flying,
almost no moves can strike it.
texts.Route120_Text_RobertIntro:
My POKéMON is strong!
How about yours?
texts.Route120_Text_RobertPostBattle:
A POKéMON that grows steadily is one
you can count on.
texts.Route120_Text_RobertRegister:
You can be counted on to get better.
I'd like to register you in my POKéNAV!
texts.Route120_Text_RobertRematchIntro:
A POKéMON that grows steadily is one
you can count on.
texts.Route120_Text_RobertPostRematch:
My POKéMON are growing stronger.
I have to grow stronger, too.
texts.Route120_Text_LorenzoIntro:
I'll check your POKéMON and see if
they're fit for the outdoors.
texts.Route120_Text_LorenzoDefeat:
With POKéMON that strong, you're in
no danger of needing rescue!
texts.Route120_Text_LorenzoPostBattle:
To travel wherever your heart desires
with POKéMON…

That's the joy of being a TRAINER.
texts.Route120_Text_JennaIntro:
How's your physical fitness?
If you're not fit, you could have a

rough time in critical situations.
texts.Route120_Text_JennaPostBattle:
Fitness training is in my routine.
I always run with my POKéMON.
texts.Route120_Text_JeffreyPostRematch:
… … … … … …
… … … … … …

I'll try harder…

For my precious BUG POKéMON…
texts.Route120_Text_JenniferIntro:
